sanskrit: vidyārṇavākhye tantre prathamaḥ śvāsaḥ dvitīyaḥ śvāsaḥ śvāsaḥ caturthaḥ śvāsaḥ pañcamaḥ śvāsaḥ śrīvidyārṇavākhye tantre ṣaṣṭhaḥ śvāsaḥ aṇimādibhirāvṛtāṃ mayūkhairahamityeva vibhāvaye bhavānīm śrotrayorbhujayoḥ pṛṣṭhe jānvornābhau ca vinyaset mūlavidyāṃ pṛthaṅnyaset tritārādi yathākramam sphicordhvajāgre cādhāre mūlādhāre ca vinyaset anāhate viśuddhau ca lambike bhrūyugāntare sundarī tripurādyā ca tathā tripuravāsinī saptamī tripurāsiddhā tripurāmbāṣṭamī bhavet navacakreṣu vinyasediti nyāsaḥ samīritaḥ māṃ rakṣayugalaṃ proktvā ṣaḍaṅgānyatra vinyaset kuryācca sādhako bījaṣaḍaṅganyāsa īritaḥ vidyāpañcadaśīmūlaṣaḍaṅganyāsa īritaḥ śrīvidyāṣoḍaśārṇāyāḥ ṣaḍaṅgo'yamudāhṛtaḥ svatantrā ca tato nityāluptaśaktistataḥ param ṣaḍaṅgayuvatīnyāsaḥ proktaḥ sarvārthasiddhaye sarvajñatāśatidhāmne ityādi prāgvadīritaḥ lāvaṇyalīlākhilayauvanāḍhyāḥ śrīdevadevyāstanavo yuvatyaḥ sampūrṇāṃ cintayedvidyāṃ brahmarandhre'ruṇaprabhām vāmāṃsadeśe saubhāgyadāṃgulīṃ bhrāmayettataḥ punaḥ sampūrṇayā devi galordhve vinyasettataḥ

vyāpakānte yonimudrāṃ mukhe kṣiptvābhivandya ca sammohanākhyo deveśi nyāso'yaṃ kṣobhakārakaḥ pādayorjaṅghayorjānvoḥ kaṭyorandhuni pṛṣṭhake karṇayorbrahmarandhre ca vadane caiva pārvati saṃhāro'yaṃ mahānyāso bījaiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ kramāt sṛṣṭyarthaṃ vinyaseddevi mātṛkāṃ pūrvavat priye trividheti yaduktaṃ tu prakaṭīkuru śaṅkara śivaśaktimayaṃ tattra kathayāmi tavānaghe pūrvaṃ guṇaistu kathitā śivaśaktyātmikāṃ śṛṇu hakāraḥ parameśāni kevalaṃ śiva ucyate yaducyate mātṛkārṇaistatsarvamahamīśvaraḥ sakāraḥ śaktirūpatvāt paravācī ca sargavān ātmānaṃ darśayedyogaḥ so'haṃśabdena sundari nādarūpeṇa sā devī hakārārdhasvarūpiṇī tasyārdhāṅgaṃ mahāśaktirhakārārdhasvarūpiṇī nityeti kathyate devi citkalā paradevatā prātarutthāya deveśi guruṃ smṛtvā svanāmabhiḥ sarvaśṛṅgāraveṣāḍhyaḥ karpūraghusṛṇādibhiḥ navaratnavibhūṣāḍhyo raktāmbaravirājitaḥ yāgamaṇḍapamāsādya lākṣācitravicitritam gomayena ca saṃliptaṃ cārupuṣpavitānitam mantroddhāraṃ prakurvīta sarvakāryārthasiddhaye kumāryāstu tṛtīyaṃ tu tripurā parameśvari kumārī tu dvitīyā sā tripureśī maheśvari anayā cāsanaṃ vidyāt tripureśyā ṣaḍaṅgakam

cakrāsanagatāviddhi devi tripuravāsinī śivacandrasamāyuktā tārtīye śivarūpiṇī ātmāsanagatāyāstu hitvā tārtīyamadrije sādhyasiddhāsanagatā viddhi tripuramālinī binduṃ hitvā tatra sargaṃ nikṣipet surasundari sarvadarśanavandyāṃ ca citkalāmavyayāṃ śive ardhacandraśca binduśca navārṇo merurucyate lakārāt pṛthivī devī saśailaṃvanakānanā sakārācandratārādigraharāśisvarūpiṇī īkārādviśvamūrtiryā mahāturyātmikā priye rakārāt tejasā yuktā parajyotiḥsvarūpiṇī ardhacandreṇa deveśi viśvayoniritīritā anayā saha sarvatra vyāptirniścalatātmanā evaṃ ca navabhirvarṇairjāyate tripurāmanuḥ śrīcakramapi deveśi merurūpaṃ na saṃśayaḥ sakāraścandramā bhadre kalāṣoḍaśakātmakam aṣṭamūrtiḥ sadā bhadre tasmādvasudalaṃ bhavet pālayantī parā tasmācchakrakoṇaṃ bhavet priye viśvayoniriti khyātā sā viṣṇordaśarūpakā daśakoṇaparā tasmādrakārājjyotiravyayaḥ kakārānmādanaṃ devi śivaṃ cāṣṭasvarūpakam ardhamātrā guṇān sūte bhedarūpā yatastataḥ kāmeśvarasya rūpaṃ tadviśvādhārasvarūpakam agastyanandisūryāśca viṣṇuskandaśivāstathā smṛtāḥ śakraśca cotmanī caiva tathā ca varuṇastathā

pañcaviṃśatisaṃkhyākopāsakānāṃ maheśvari sakalā bhuvaneśānī kāmeśībījamuttamam śaktyantastūryavarṇo'yaṃ kalāmadhye sulocane mādanaṃ śivacandrādyaṃ śivāntaṃ mīnalocane sarvasākṣimayī nityā sarvayonimayī parā sarvadevamayī sākṣāt sarvasaubhāgyasundarī kena kenopāsiteyaṃ viśadīkuru śaṅkara kāmarājākhyavidyāyāḥ śaktiṃ turyaṃ ca sundari eṣā vidyā kāmarājapūjitaiva na saṃśayaḥ kāmarājākhyavidyāyā vāgbhavena varānane śivaṃ kuryādvāgbhave tu śivādyaṃ kāmarājakam mādanaṃ kāmabījaṃ tu śaktibījaṃ hasānanam mādanaṃ kāmabīje tu tārtīyaṃ ṛṇu pārvati śaktibījaṃ sahādyaṃ syādvidyāgastyaprapūjitā candraṃ tatraiva saṃyojya kāmarāje tataḥ param śaktibījaṃ varārohe candrādyaṃ sarvasiddhidam śaktibīje sthitāṃ devi candrādhaḥ kuru tatra ca kāmarāje bhṛguṃ hitvā mukhe kuryāttameva hi eṣā vidyā vārārohe tripurā sūryapūjitā lopāmudrā dvitīyāṃ tu vilikhya surasundari hitvā tu bhuvaneśānīmekocāreṇa coccaret nandikeśvaravidyāṃ ca ṣaṭkūṭā vaiṣṇavī bhavet yā sthitā bhuvaneśānī dvidhā kuru maheśvari durvāsasā purā devi niṣkalā pūjitā parā tvaṃ manohāriṇī yasmāt kathyate bhuvi durlabhā

vāmākṣibindunādāḍhyaṃ viśvamātṛkalānvitam utpattirjāgaro bodho vyāvṛttirmanasastathā jāgrat sattvaguṇā proktā kevalaṃ śaktirūpiṇī vaiṣṇavī vasukūṭā syāt ṣaṭkūṭā śāṅkarī bhavet lajjābījādikūṭaistu proktā jāgararūpakāḥ jāgratsvarūpā śrīvidyā caturddhā sā prakīrtitā vaiṣṇavī saptakūṭā syātpañcakūṭā tu śāṅkarī māyālakṣmyādikāścaitā abhilāṣasvarūpakāḥ ramāmāyādikāścintārūpiṇyaḥ kūṭayojitāḥ paścakūṭā bhavantyete vasukūṭā tu vaiṣṇavī vedādibījayugalayogāt sarvāḥ samīritāḥ maraṇaṃ vismṛtirmūrcchā nidrā ca tamasāvṛtā tāramāyādikāścaiva māyātārādikāstathā tadā bhedāstu sakalāḥ ṣaṭkūṭāḥ parameśvari asyāḥ smaraṇamātreṇa jagadānanditaṃ bhavet yasya vijñānamātreṇa brahma sākṣānna saṃśayaḥ avasthāśeṣatāṃ prāptā turyā tu parameśvari vairāgyaṃ ca mumukṣutvaṃ samādhirvimalaṃ manaḥ ādyabījadvayaṃ bhadre viparītakrameṇa tu antarmukhī vārārohe kumārī tripureśvarī ṣaṭkūṭāṃ parameśāni vidyeyaṃ ṣoḍaśākṣarī vaiṣṇavyekonaviṃśārṇā śaivī saptadaśākṣarī kāmabījaṃ samālikhya vāgbījaṃ tadanantaram praṇavaṃ bhuvaneśānīṃ ramāṃ caiva maheśvari vyutkramāt parameśāni pūrvoktaṃ bījapañcakam

śaktyādibījaiśca vilomataḥ sā śrīṣoḍaśīyaṃ ca śivapradiṣṭā haripriyā trikūṭā sā parā vāṇī manobhavaḥ bālāṃ cāntarmukhīṃ kṛtvā vilikhettadanantaram bālādi saṃpuṭāṃ kuryādramākhyāṃ parameśvari viparītaṃ punaścānte mantraṃ tatsaṃpuṭaṃ smṛtam vedādirbhuvaneśānī śrībījaṃ ca trikūṭakam bālāntaḥ saṃsthitaṃ bījaṃ praṇavaṃ ca tataḥ param lopāṃ vā kāmarājaṃ vā trikūṭāmathavā parām viparītakrameṇaiva vinyaset ṣoḍaśī parā śrīṣoḍaśākṣaramihāgamasuprasiddham bījaṃ pañcakamitthamevamuditaṃ sarvārthasiddhipradam sārātsāratarā samastajagatāmutpattibhūtā śivā varṇituṃ naiva śakye'haṃ śrīvidyāṃ ṣoḍaśākṣarīm yato nirakṣaraṃ vastu parā tatraiva kāraṇam brahmavidyāsvarūpā hi bhuktimuktiphalapradā aśvamedhasahasrāṇi prādakṣiṇyaṃ bhuvastathā tulāṃ nārhanti deveśi nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ṣoḍaśārṇā mahāvidyā na prakāśyā kadācana ṣoḍaśīyaṃ sugopyā hi snehāddevi prakāśitā rājyaṃ deyaṃ śiro deyaṃ na deyā ṣoḍaśākṣarī kālī kāmakalā kūrcaḥ sarvādau praṇavaḥ priye jñānena mṛtyuhā vidyā sarvāmnāyairnamaskṛtā tāsāṃ sāratamā bhūtā yā yā vidyāḥ sugopitāḥ prakāśitā mahādevi yā pṛṣṭā te punaḥ punaḥ tadā saptadaśavidyā sākṣājjñānasvarūpiṇī

sakāraṃ kāmarājādau lopā tu ṣoḍaśākṣarī ṣoḍaśārṇā mahāvidyā cidbrahmakyamayī śubhā tathaiva śaktibīje tu lopā saptadaśākṣarī aṇimādyaṣṭasiddhīśaḥ sākṣādbhūmipurandaraḥ mādanaṃ kāmabījādye tartīyādye maheśvari aṣṭādaśākṣarī hyeṣā śrīvidyā bhuvi durlabhā navalakṣaṃ japitvā tu lopāmudrāṃ maheśvari anyathā śāpamāpnoti kulaṃ tasya vinaśyati sarvasaubhāgyadā devī sarvamaṅgalakāriṇī bhuvaneśīṃ kāmarāje śrībījaṃ śaktipūrvataḥ bhogamokṣapradā sākṣāt puruṣārthapradāyikā nāsti nāsti punarnāsti satyaṃ satyaṃ vadāmyaham kāmākṣaraṃ śaktivarṇaṃ purandaraharau tataḥ praṇavaṃ savisargaṃ ca punaśca kulasundarīṃ praṇavaṃ savisargaṃ tu tato vai kulasundarīm vilomāṃ bālikāṃ tatra brahmārṇaḥ savisargakaḥ asyā lakṣajapenaiva kiṃ na siddhyati bhūtale nādabindukalābhedāt turīyasvarasaṃyutam kakāre sarvamutpannaṃ kāmakaivalyadāyakam evaṃ bījatrayaṃ devi vidyānāṃ sārasaṃgraham ekākṣareṇa kathitā brahmavidyaiva kevalam ādyabhūtairvidyamānā sundarī ṣaḍvidhā smṛtā ramāmāyā tathā kāmo vasucandrākṣarī tridhā jātavedomṛgāṅkena lāñchitaṃ parameśvari vāmanetreṇa saṃyukto nādabinduvibhūṣitaḥ

prathamā sundarī devī dvitīyā brahmasundarī eṣā tu ṣoḍaśī vidyā matabhedena darśitā eṣā śrīprāṇasaṃyuktā dāridryaduḥkhanāśinī mahāmāyā tataḥ paścāttavasnehāt prakīrtitam iti śaktī mahāvidyā paścimāmnāyayojitā vyomavahnisamāyuktaṃ turīyasvarabindukam eṣā vidyā maheśāni varṇituṃ naiva śakyate kāmaṃ vyoma ca deveśi mahāmāyā tataḥ param rudraśaktiriyaṃ devi pūrvāmnāye hi yojitā nādabindusamāyuktaḥ kathitaḥ parameśvari māyābindusanādena kāmarājaṃ samuddharet bindunādasamākrāntaḥ kathitaḥ kāmado manuḥ arihā siddhidā devī mahātripurasundarī purandaro mahāmāyā vāgbhavaṃ bījamuttamam vāmākṣivahnicandrāḍhyaṃ vāgbhavaṃ parameśvari bhuvaneśī tataḥ paścādvāgbhavaṃ kathitaṃ tvayi śaktiḥ svayambhūḥ śambhuśca śakraśca bhuvaneśvarī kāmaḥ śivastato brahmā indraśca bhuvaneśvarī trikūṭānte haṃsabījaṃ tadā saptadaśī bhavet mānmathaṃ śivaśaktī ca mādano hara indrakaḥ candraḥ prajāpatiḥ śakro mahāmāyā tataḥ param sarvānte haṃsasaṃyuktā viṃśākṣarī tadā bhavet brahmā śivendrau śaktiśca mahāmāyā tataḥ parā śivendrakāmarudrāśca candraśca parameśvarī kāmaścandro maheśaśca indraḥ śaktiśca pārvatī

śivaśaktī mādanendrau śivo vahnīndumāyayā vāgbhavaṃ kathitaṃ caitatkāmarājaṃ tataḥ śṛṇu śivaḥ śaktiśca somaśca śūnyo brahmā maheśvarī idānīṃ śrotumicchāmi yadi cāsti kṛpā mayi maheśo brahma haṃsaśca indro'pi bhuvaneśvarī agnimāyākalāyuktaṃ nādabinduvibhūṣitam brahmā maheśa indraśca śaktiśca bhuvaneśvarī mādanaṃ somacandrau ca śakraśca bhuvaneśvarī vāmakeśvara vidyaiva trikūṭakramapāṭhitā tripurāyā mahāvidyā kūṭaikādaśanirmitā mahāmāyāṃ tataḥ paścādvāgbhavaṃ bījamuddharet māyāsvareṇa saṃyuktaṃ nādabindukalānvitam viyadviṣṇuyutaṃ kāmo haṃsaḥ śakrastataḥ param indrabījaṃ tataḥ paścānmahāmāyāṃ samuddharet mahāmāyāṃ tataḥ paścācchaktikūṭaṃ samuddharet madhyakūṭatrayaṃ devi kāmarājaṃ manoharam vāgbhavaṃ prathamaṃ kūṭaṃ kāmarājaṃ trikūṭakam jīvaprāṇau mahādevi mādanaṃ tadanantaram kūṭatrayaṃ kāmarājaṃ śaktibījaṃ (kūṭaṃ) ca pūrvavat arihā siddhidā vidyā sarvadoṣavivarjitā madhye ṣaḍakṣaraṃ caiva śaktiśca caturakṣarā tadadho haṃsabījaṃ tu indrabījaṃ vicintayet tadadhaścandrabījaṃ tu pṛthvībījaṃ tato likhet ramāṃ māyāṃ haṃsabījaṃ vāgbhavādye niyojayet ebhiryuktena deveśi vidyājapanamācaret

śaktyante tu maheśāni haṃsaṃ māyāṃ ramāṃ tathā māyābindvīśvarayutaṃ sūryakoṭisamaprabham vāntaṃ vahnisamāyuktaṃ vāmanetreṇa bhūṣitam dvitīyaṃ kāmarājaṃ tu japeduktvā tu sundarīm nādabindusamāyuktaṃ māyābījaṃ prakīrtitam kulākulamaye madhye dhyeyaṃ sākṣānmaheśvari etajjaptvā tataḥ paścādvāgbhavākhyaṃ samuddharet kāmarājaṃ tato japtvā trailokyakṣobhakārakam svapnāvatīṃ mahādevi prajapecca samāhitaḥ madhumatīṃ tato japtvā māyāṃ śrīkūrcabījakam etadbījaṃ samuccārya śaktikūṭaṃ tato japet kāmarājādividyānāṃ dīpinīṃ caiva kārayet saptatriṃśatprabhedena ṣaṭtriṃśattatvarūpiṇī śrīkaṇṭhadaśakaṃ tadvadavyaktasya hi vācakam śivakāmaharendrāṃśca bhuvaneśīmataḥ param unmanyāḥ kāmarājaṃ tu candrahaṃsau tu mādanam śivayormādanaṃ māyā tārtīyaṃ varuṇasya ca śivacandrendramadanā bhūmiśca bhuvaneśvarī vahnīnopāsitā vidyā bhogamokṣaphalapradā sakalā vahnibhūmiśca bhuvaneśīṃ samuddharet śivamādanabhūmiśca rahalā bhuvaneśvarī vāyūpāsitavidyeyaṃ caturvargaphalapradā śivamādanasūryendravahnayo bhuvaneśvarī budhopāsitavidyeyaṃ bhogamokṣaphalapradā śivamādanabhūmiśca śivendrendrānalāstathā

īśānopāsitā vidyā hyaṇimādyaṣṭasiddhidā nārāyaṇopāsiteyaṃ ṣaṭkūṭā bhuvi durlabhā śivamādanasūryenduvahniśca bhuvaneśvarī lopāvāgbhavakūṭaṃ tu jīvenārādhitātviyam māyāśrībījapūrvā tu svapnāvasyāsvarūpiṇī śrīmahāṣoḍaśārṇā tu turīyā samprakīrtitā sadasadvastunirdhārasturīyāyā imāḥ kalāḥ māyādiḥ ṣoḍaśārṇā tu mumukṣutvasvarūpiṇī ramādiḥ ṣoḍaśī cittavaimalyasya svarūpiṇī pañcadhā ṣoḍaśārṇā tu durlabhā bhuvanatraye bhedāḥ pūrvoktarītyā ca jñātavyāstantrakovidaiḥ ubhayātmakabhedāśca śavalāśca tathaiva ca aśuddhā iti vijñeyā ubhayātmāna eva ca evaṃ caturvidhā vidyā vijñeyā deśikottamaiḥ yayā vijñātayā devi sākṣāt suraguruprabhaḥ svarāntaṃ pṛthivīsthaṃ tu turyasvarasamanvitam śakrasvarasamopeto vidyeyaṃ tryakṣarī matā mahāsaubhāgyajananī mahāsārasvatapradā nyasecchirasi pūjyatvāt paṃktiśchando mukhe priye bījaṃ tu vāgbhavaṃ śaktistārtīyaṃ kīlakaṃ tathā nābhyādipādaparyantaṃ galādānābhi cāparam vāmapāṇitale caikaṃ dakṣapāṇitale tathā pañca bāṇān krameṇaiva karāṃguliṣu vinyaset thāntadvayaṃ samālikhya vahnisaṃsthaṃ krameṇa tu bāṇadvayamidaṃ proktaṃ mādanaṃ bhūmisaṃsthitam

phāntaṃ śakreṇa saṃyuktaṃ vāmakarṇavibhūṣitam pañca bāṇā maheśāni nāmāni śṛṇu pārvati vaśyonmādau krameṇaiva nāmāni parameśvari parābījaṃ madhyabāṇaṃ vāgbhavaṃ parameśvari pañca kāmāḥ kramāddevi nāmāni śṛṇu vallabhe mīnaketurmaheśāni pañcamaḥ parikīrtitaḥ mūlavidyādvirāvṛttyā sarvāṃgulitaleṣvapi kurvīta dehasannāhaṃ tribhirbījaiḥ kramāt priye dakṣe vāme ca vinyasya dakṣakūrparapāṇiṣu nādānte hṛdaye liṅge nyaseddevi tataḥ param vidyāsṛṣṭikrameṇaiva jānīhi parameśvari karṇayościbuke devi śaṅkhayormukhamaṇḍale tathā karpūrayoḥ kukṣau jānvorjaṅghe ca vinyaset kaṇṭhe ca navayonyākhyaṃ nyasedbījatrayātmakam tridvyekadaśakatridvisaṃkhyayā śailasambhave ratnamaṇḍapamadhye tu mahākalpavanāntare anarghyaratnaghaṭitamukuṭāṃ ratnakuṇḍalām pustakaṃ cābhayaṃ vāme dakṣiṇe cākṣamālikām saṃpatpradā nāma tasyāḥ śṛṇu nirmalamānase kāmarājaṃ tathā devi śivacandrānvitaṃ tataḥ śaktibīje maheśāni śivavahnī niyojayet tripurābhairavī devī mahāsaṃpatpradā priye mūlamantradvirāvṛttyā ṣaḍaṅganyāsa īritaḥ devīṃ baddhahimāṃśukhaṇḍamukuṭāṃ vande sumandasmitām vāgbhavaṃ bījamuccāryaṃ jīvaprāṇasamanvitam

jīvaprāṇaṃ vahnisaṃsthaṃ śakrasvaravibhūṣitam trailokyamohanī devī parabrahmacidātmikā mukuṭordhvalasaccandralekhāṃ raktāmbarānvitām varadābhayaśobhāḍhyāṃ pīnonnataghaṭastanīm tadante parameśāni nityaklinne madadrave raktāṃ muṇḍasrajaṃ pañcapretasiṃhāsanasthitām śaktibhinnaṃ bindunādakalāḍhyaṃ vāgbhavaṃ priye sadāśivasya bījaṃ tu mahāsiṃhāsanasya ca udyatsūryasahasrābhāṃ candracūḍāṃ trilocanām vamadrudhiramuṇḍālikalitāṃ raktavāsasam pinākaṃ ca śarān devi pāśāṃkuśayugaṃ kramāt aghore vāgbhavaṃ paścādghore tu bhuvaneśvarī namaste'stu rudrarūpebhyo devyā bījayugaṃ likhet nādabindususaṃyuktaṃ prathamaṃ bījamuddhṛtam śivacandrau vahnisaṃsthau manusvarasamanvitau madhyakūṭena ṣaḍadīrghayuktenāṅgāni kalpayet kirīṭaratnavilasaccitracitritamauktikām nayanatrayaśobhāḍhyāṃ pūrṇenduvadanānvitām raktāmbaraparīdhānāṃ yauvanonmattarūpiṇīm varadānaratāṃ nityāṃ mahāpretāsanasthitām pretabījaṃ samuddhṛtya vidyeyaṃ tryakṣarī bhavet udyatsūryasahasrābhāṃ māṇikyamukuṭojjvalām ratnamañjīrasubhagāṃ raktavastrānulepanām bālyalīlāparāṃ devīṃ kumārīrūpadhāriṇīm kāmeśvarīdevatā syādbījenāṅgakriyā matā

nānālaṅkārasubhagāṃ mohayantīṃ jagattrayam sakalā vahnimāyābhyāṃ dvitīyaṃ bījamīritam ṣaḍdīrghacandrabījena ṣaḍaṅganyāsa īritaḥ ratnakuṇḍalamuktālipadakāṅgadabhūṣaṇām pāśāṃkuśau pustakaṃ ca dadhānāṃ cākṣamālikām nitambinīṃ kṣāmamadhyāṃ prāntaraktasulocanām vākśāntimanubhiryuktaṃ bījatrayamudāhṛtam bālasūryaprabhāṃ devīṃ japākusumasannibhām suvarṇakalaśākārapīnonnatapayodharām dadhatīṃ bhairavīṃ dhyāyet pretasiṃhāsanasthitām nityā ca bhairavī proktā caturvargaphalapradā pañcamuṇḍasamāsīnāṃ muṇḍamālāvibhūṣitām pāśāṃkuśābhayavarān dadhatīṃ bhāvayecchivām jūṃjīvaṃ prāṇapadaṃ granthiṃ kuruyugaṃ tataḥ mṛtasañjīvanī devī devatā parikīrtitā haṃsastu kīlakaṃ proktaṃ mṛtasañjīvanāya ca ṣaṭcaturdikakenaiva ṣaḍaṅgāni samācaret vidyācatuṣṭayaṃ sākṣādamṛtānandavigraham śaktibījaṃ samālikhya śivacandrau samālikhet sañjīvani ca jūṃ jīvaṃ prāṇagranthisthamālikhet sañjīvanī devatā syācchaktirasyādibījakam trikaṃ ca kramato devi ṣaḍaṅgāni pravinyaset jñānamudrāmakṣamālāṃ dadhatīṃ cintayet parām vadadvandvaṃ vādanīti vāṅmadhye nikṣipet priye mahākṣobhaṃ kurudvandvaṃ śivacandrakalānalām

mokṣaṃ kuruyugaṃ haṃsraṃ śakrasvaravisargavat gāyatraṃ chanda ākhyātaṃ devateyaṃ tu bhairavī antyakūṭaṃ bhavecchaktiḥ sākṣānmṛtyuvināśinī dhyātvā cāvāhayeddevīṃ kadambavanamadhyagām vibhratīṃ kundadhavalāṃ kumārīṃ cintayet parām tato nityamadaprānte drave māyāṃ ca saṃlikhet chando virāṭ ca vajreśī devatā parikīrtitā tārtīyaṃ kīlakaṃ devyāstato'ṅgāni pravinyaset dvikaṃ dvikaṃ trikaṃcaiva ṣaḍaṅgāni prakalpayet raktāṃ candrakalācārumukuṭāṃ varabhūṣaṇām śoṇitābdhitaratpotamahāyantroparisthitām cāpaṃ kapālaṃ dadhatīṃ śoṇamālyānulepanām rephaṃ śivādho niḥkṣipya bhuvaneśī ca bhairavī japākusumasaṅkāśāṃ dāḍimīkusumaprabhām nānālaṅkārasubhagāṃ pīnonnataghanastanīm pāśāṃkuśavarābhītīrdhārayantīṃ śivāṃ śraye kumāryā eva munyādyā dhyānamasyā vadāmi te candrakhaṇḍasphuradratnamukuṭāṃ kṣāmamadhyamām unmattayauvanaprauḍhāṃ pīnonnataghanastanīm pustakaṃ cābhayaṃ vāme dakṣiṇe cākṣamālikām mahāsiṃhāsanagatā bhairavī ḍāmareśvarī hitvoccaret tadā vidyāṃ mahāsiṃhāsaneśvarīm bandhūkakusumābhāsāṃ pañcamuṇḍādhivāsinīm trinetrāṃ raktavasanāṃ pīnonnataghanastanīm dadhatīṃ saṃsmarennityamuttarāmnāyamānitām

kāminībhairavī ceyaṃ bhayavidhvaṃsinīti vā ātāmrārkāyutābhāsāṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām muṇḍamālāvalīramyāṃ cintayedbhairavīṃ parām vidyānāṃ pañcakaṃ devi triṣu lokeṣu durlabham hakālānte maheśāni śivabījaṃ tu saṃlikhet hasānugrahasargāḍhyaṃ vidyaikā sundarī priye antyaṃ sasargamādye hi bindunādakalātmike hasa-ehasahasrāṃśca vāgbhavena ca yojayet catuṣkaṃ śivabījānāṃ repho'nugrahasargavān parayā piṇḍitaṃ kuryāt kūṭametat tridherayet caturthī sundarī khyātā bhogamokṣapradāyinī etadādyaṃ ca madhyaṃ ca hasayukkṣmākṣahendumat tripureśīmanoreṣā pañcamī sundarī bhavet ṛṣyādipūjā vijñeyā tripureśīva nānyathā mahālakṣmīśvarīvṛndamaṇḍitāsanasaṃsthitā bindunādasamāyuktaṃ lakṣmīmantra udāhṛtaḥ śaturye bījaśaktī ca kīlakaṃ repha ucyate dhyāyet tataḥ śriyaṃ ramyāṃ sarvadevanamaskṛtām āsicyamānāmamṛtairmuktāratnadravairapi ratnaughabaddhamukuṭāṃ śuddhakṣaumāṅgarāgiṇīm evaṃ dhyātvā japeddevīṃ padmayugmadharāṃ sadā śrīpuṭaṃ cātha kamale kamalāye prasīda ca prasīda pūrvabījāni sampuṭatvena yojayet gāyatrī devatā lakṣmīrhṛdayaṃ parikīrtitam praṇavaḥ kīlakaṃ devi tato'ṅgāni pravinyaset

ratnodyadvasupātraṃ ca padmayugmaṃ ca hemajam caturbhujāṃ sphuradratnanūpurāṃ mukuṭojjvalām padmāsanasamāsīnāṃ dūtībhirmaṇḍitāṃ sadā iyaṃ triśaktirdeveśi triṣu lokeṣu durlabhā triśaktirdevatāṅgāni dvirāvṛttyā yajet priye navahemasphuradbhūmau ratnakuṭṭimamaṇḍape kamalāsanaśobhāḍhyāṃ ratnamañjīramaṇḍitām anarghyaratnaghaṭitanānāmaṇḍalabhūṣitām ṣaḍbhujāminduvadanāṃ dūtībhiḥ parivāritām tāmbūlasvarṇapātrībhirbhūṣāpeṭīsupāṇibhiḥ yasyā ārādhane viṣṇurabhūllakṣmīpatiḥ svayam vidhvakrūreśvarīyuktaṃ vidyeyaṃ vaiṣṇavī priye devatā mohanī lakṣmīrmahāsāmrājyadāyinī ṣaḍbhirādyaiḥ svarairbhitvā ṣaḍaṅgāni pravinyaset śaṅkhacakragadāpadmaśārṅgabāṇadharāṃ karaiḥ sarvasaubhāgyajananīpādukāṃ pūjayāmi ca yasya vijñānamātreṇa punarjanma na vidyate ajapā mātṛkā caiva pañca kośāḥ prakīrtitāḥ tataḥ so'haṃ śiro devi vasuvarṇayamīritā parajyotirmayī sākṣāddevatā parikīrtitā svāhā tu hṛdayaṃ so'haṃ śiro haṃsaḥ śikhā bhavet sṛṣṭyānmantreṇa deveśi samagraṇāstrakaṃ bhavet yasyāḥ smaraṇalātreṇa cidānandāyaye tanuḥ paraniṣkaladevīyaṃ parabrahmasvarūpiṇī jñānamudrāṅkitā yogipativṛndena sevitā

brahmaiva devatā bījaśaktī a-ū krameṇa tu svaradvandvasya madhye tu kṣiptvā tyaktvā catuṣṭayam yasya vijñānamātreṇa parabrahmaiva deśikaḥ mohabaddho na jānāti mokṣastasya na vidyate ucchvāsaniḥśvāsatayā tadā bandhakṣayo bhavet tasmāt prāṇastu haṃsākhya ātmākāreṇa saṃsthitaḥ ṣaṣṭināḍyā ahorātraṃ japasaṃkhyājapāmanoḥ japate pratyahaṃ prāṇī spandānandamayīṃ parām vinā japena deveśi japo bhavati mantriṇaḥ śrīguroḥ kṛpayā devi labhate nānyathā priye gaṇeśabrahmaviṣṇubhyo harāya parameśvari ṣaṭśatāni sahasrāṇi ṣaḍeva ca tathā punaḥ punaḥ sahasraṃ gurave krameṇa tu nivedayet sahajaṃ parameśāni nyāsaṃ kuru vicakṣaṇe devatā paramādistu haṃso haṃ bījamucyate nāda sthānaṃ tathā śveto varṇastu parameśvari mokṣārthe viniyogaḥ syādevaṃ jānīhi pārvati sūryaṃ somaṃ tathā devi nirañjanamataḥ param kavacāntān pravinyasya tato'nantapadaṃ smaret svāhāntenaiva nayanamavyaktapadapūrvakaḥ asya haṃsasya deveśi nigamāgamapakṣakau bindutrayaṃ śikhā netre mukhe nādaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ ayaṃ paramahaṃsastu sarvavyāpī prakāśavān saṃhārarūpī haṃso'yaṃ vivekaṃ darśayatyapi yāsāṃ vijñānamātreṇa palāyante mahāpadaḥ

pañcabāṇeśvarī devī kumārī pañca kīrtitāḥ tāreṇa parayā devī sampuṭīkṛtya mantravit pārijāteśvarī vāṇī devatā parikīrtitā kīlakaṃ parameśāni mahāsārasvatapradam haṃsārūḍhāṃ lasanmuktādhavalāṃ śubhravāsasam vidyāṃ vīṇāṃ sudhākumbhamakṣamālāṃ ca bibhratīm tripureśīmantramadhye bāṇāḥ proktā maheśvari kāmeśvarīva bījādi devatā ceyamīśvarī udyaddivākarābhāsāṃ nānālaṅkārabhūṣitām ikṣukodaṇḍapuṣpeṣuvirājitabhujadvayām pūrvoktapañcakāmaistu pañcakāmeśvarī bhavet devateyaṃ kāmadā ca bījaśaktī tu kīlakam aṅgāni pūrvavat kāmabāṇanyāsadvayaṃ bhavet pāśāṃkuśau dhanurbāṇān pustakaṃ cākṣamālikām kāmeśvarīṃ bhagavatīṃ trailokyākarṣaṇakṣamām kāmaśaktidvayāntastu vidyeyaṃ tryakṣarī bhavet ādyante kīlakaṃ madhyaṃ mahāvaśyakarī bhavet sphuradratnadukūlāḍhyāṃ nānālaṅkārabhūṣitām dadhatīṃ cintayennityaṃ sarvarājavaśaṅkarīm bhavāni bhavaśāntyai tvāṃ bhāvayāmyamṛteśvarīm śrīkāmayugalaṃ proktvā hṛdante bhagavatyapi caturvarṇaṃ vahnijāyātārādyo manurīritaḥ annapūrṇeśvarī devī devatā parikīrtitā ṣaḍdīrghamāyayā kuryāt ṣaḍaṅgāni maheśvari candracūḍāmannadānaniratāṃ ratnabhūṣitām

rudratāṇḍavasānandāṃ dvibhujāṃ parameśvarīm vāgbhavaṃ kāmarājaṃ ca sargavān bhṛguruttame śrībījaṃ tārakaṃ caiva namo bhagavatīti ca sarvarājavaśaṃ cānte kari sarvamukhāntakam puruṣānte vaśaṃ coktvā karyante sarvaduṣṭataḥ śailaje vaśamālikhya kariśabdaṃ tato vadet saptatiśca trayo varṇā mātaṅgīvigrahāḥ priye ṛṣirmataṅgo bhagavān gāyatrī chanda ucyate kāmabījaṃ vāgbhavaṃ ca bījaśaktī ca kīlakam ādyabījatrayeṇaiva dvirāvṛttyā ṣaḍaṅgakam kvaṇadvīṇālasannādaślāghāndolitakuṇḍalām kadambapuṣpadāmāḍhyāṃ vīṇāvādanatatparām yasyāḥ smaraṇamātreṇa pavano'yaṃ sthiro bhavet nādena bhūṣitaṃ bījaṃ pārthivaṃ coccarettataḥ vārtāliyugmaṃ vārāhi punaretaddvayaṃ likhet andhe cāndhini saptārṇaṃ hṛdantena bhavetpriye mohe mohini hṛccāpi stambhe stambhini hṛttataḥ sānāmantaṃ ca sarveṣāṃ sarvavāgiti citta ca śīghraṃ vaśyaṃ kurudvandvaṃ vāgbhavaṃ pārthivaṃ punaḥ caturdaśottaraśataṃ mantravarṇā bhavanti hi mātṛkāvannyasedvaktre padāni daśa mantravit padārṇānyatha vinyasya pārśvayorekamuttamam tataḥ ṣaḍaṅgavinyāsaṃ kuryād dehaviśuddhaye vārāhiyugalaṃ devi śiromantra udāhṛtaḥ kavacaṃ ca tataḥ saptavarṇairnetraṃ nyaset kramāt

indranīlamahātejaḥprakāśāṃ viśvamātaram anarghyaratnaghaṭitamukuṭaśrīvirājitām halena muśalenāpi varadenābhayena ca nitambinīmutpalābhāṃ kaṭhoraghanasatkucām kāmeśvarī mahābhedā bahavaḥ santi pārvati tripureśīṃ samuccārya tārānte hṛtpadaṃ tataḥ sarvasattvavaśaṃ proktvā kari sarvajagatpadam viparītāṃ samālikhya vidyā ṣaṭtriṃśadakṣarā (?) kāmeśvarīvadṛṣyādi dhyānayantrārcanādikam vāgbhavaṃ bhagaśabdānte bhuge vāgbhavameva ca bhagaklinne vāgbhavaṃ ca vāgbhavādau bhagāvahe bhaganyante pātanīti vāgbhavaṃ bhagasarva ca vāgbhavaṃ bhagarūpe tadbhaganitye ca vāgbhavam rūpe sarvabhagānīti me hyānaya ca vāgbhavam bhagaṃ drāvaya cālikhya bhagāmoghe bhageti ca vāgbhavaṃ ca bhagablūṃ ca vāgbhavaṃ bhagajaṃ likhet vāgbhavaṃ ca bhagablūṃ ca vāgbhavaṃ bhagamoṃ likhet vāgbhavaṃ ca bhagablūṃ ca vāgbhavaṃ bhagaheṃ likhet bhagaklinne ca sarvāṇi bhagānyatha ca me likhet bhagāntare bhagānte'tha harablemātmakamālikhet ṅe'ntāmuccārya vidyeyaṃ trailokyavaśakāriṇī varṇānāṃ bhagamāleyaṃ nityā sā phalasiddhidā devateyaṃ tu bījaṃ tu harablemātmakaṃ priye ṣaḍdīrghasvarabhedena nyasedaṅgāni deśikaḥ kadambavanamadhyasthāmudyatsūryasamadyutim

pāśāṃkuśau pustakaṃ ca taulikīnakhalekhanīm vahnijāyā ca vidyeyaṃ rudravarṇā mahotkaṭā dvābhyāṃ dvābhyāṃ ṣaḍaṅgānivinyaseddeśikottamaḥ svidyatvaktrāṃ mahāghūrṇalocanāṃ ratnabhūṣitām dadhatīṃ saṃsmarennityāṃ padmāsanavirājitām bherākāraṃ samuccāryāṃkuśābhyāṃ taṃ ca veṣṭayet anugrahendubindvāḍhyaṃ tārasvāhodarasthitaḥ devateyaṃ parāśaktistṛtīyaṃ bījamucyate ṣaḍdīrghasvarabhedena bījenaiva ṣaḍaṅgakam nīlakaṇṭhāṃ trinetrāṃ ca nānābharaṇabhūṣitām pāśāṃkuśau kapālaṃ ca cchurikāṃ varādābhaye parāṃ vilikhya vahnyante vāsinyai nama ityapi ādyante bījaśaktī ca kīlakaṃ madhya eva ca dhyāyettāṃ ca suvarṇābhāṃ nānālaṅkārabhūṣitām dadhatīṃ ratnamukuṭāṃ trailokyatimirāpahām nityaklinnāṃ samālikhya mukhe tāraṃ samālikhet gāyatraṃ chanda ākhyātaṃ devatā parameśvarī catuṣkeṇa ca yugmena yugmena yugalena ca japākusumasaṅkāśāṃ raktāṃśukavirājitām pāśāṃkuśau kapālasthasudhāpānavighūrṇitām bhuvaneśīṃ samuccārya śivadūtyai namo likhet ādyante bījaśaktī ca madhye kīlakamucyate dūrvānibhāṃ trinetrāṃ ca mahāsiṃhasamāsanām tāraṃ parānte kavacaṃ khecachekṣaḥ samālikhet tvaritā ravivarṇeyaṃ bhogamokṣaphalapradā

kavaca strīśaktibīje kīlakaṃ ca prakīrtitam kṣaḥstrīyugmaṃ ca kavacaṃ strīṃhūmātmayugaṃ tathā śyāmāṅgīṃ raktasatpāṇicaraṇāmbujaśobhitām svarṇāṃśukāṃ svarṇabhūṣāṃ vaisyāhidvandvamekhalām dadhatīṃ śikhipicchānāṃ valayāṅgadaśobhitām dvijanāgasphuratkarṇabhūṣāṃ mattāruṇekṣaṇām kairātīṃ śikhipatrāḍhyaniketanavirājitām bālākhyā tripureśānī pūrvasiṃhāsane sthitā tripureśīṃ samuccāryaṃ nityākhyāṃ bhairavīṃ tathā tāraṃ hṛtpadamābhāṣya kāmeśvarīparaṃ tataḥ bhagavatyatha nīlānte patāke ca bhagāntike paramānte tathā guhye hrīṅkāratritayaṃ likhet āveśaya tathā lekhyaṃ kavacāstrāgnivallabhā indranīlasphurannīlapatākāṃ kamale sthitām dadhatīṃ parameśānīṃ trailokyākarṣaṇakṣamām śivacandrakhapāntāgnirudrasvaravibhūṣitam bījaṃ hṛnmadhyavarṇāstu bījaśaktī tu kīlakam ekavaktrāṃ daśabhujāṃ sarpayajñopavītinīm asthicarmāviśeṣāṃ tāṃ vahnikūṭasamaprabhām raṇe smaraṇamātreṇa bhaktebhyo vijayapradām pāśamagnimabhītiṃ ca dadhānāṃ vijayāṃ smaret jīvaṃ varuṇatārāḍhyaṃ sarvānte maṅgalāpadam vidyābhāgatrayeṇaiva dvirāvṛttyā ṣaḍaṅgakam suprasannāṃ śaśimukhīṃ nānāratnavibhūṣitām varadābhayaśobhāḍhyāṃ smaret saubhāgyavardhinīm

oṃkārabījamuccārya namo bhagavatīti ca hārakāri ca ke jātavedasīti jvalanti ca vahni dvidhā ca kavacamastraṃ cāpi samālikhet ravisūryaśarāgāṣṭavedairaraṅgāni vinyaset udyadvidyullatākāntisvarṇābharaṇabhūṣitām ariśaṅkhau khaḍgakheṭe triśūlaṃ ḍamaruṃ tathā yasyāḥ smaraṇamātreṇa palāyante mahāpadaḥ vicitrā devatā bījaṃ kakāraḥ kīlakaṃ ca tu ṣaṭdīrghasvarabhedena nyasedaṅgāni deśikaḥ vicitratilakā nityaṃ vicitrakusumojjvalā saptamaḥ śvāsaḥ pūrve ca dakṣiṇe paścādudagūrdhvaṃ krameṇa ca yayā prakāśyate brahmasaccidānandalakṣaṇam caturviṃśatyakṣarātmā gāyatrī śirasā saha dīptaṃ viśvadharaṃ svavakṣasi lasacchrīvatsacihnaṃ bhaje māṇikyamauliṃ dinanāthamīḍe bandhūkakāntiṃ vilasattrinetram caturmūrtivapuṣkāya bhāsitāṅgāya śambhave hūṃhūṃhūṃdrāṃdrīṃklīṃblūṃsaḥ sauḥ klīṃ aiṃ hrīṃ klinne aiṃkroṃ nityamadadrave hrīṃ vajranityāyai namaḥ tato bhagamālinīvidyā tripurabhairavī aiṃ vicce klīṃ mahātripurasundaryai namaḥ pañcavaktraiḥ śivaproktāḥ pañca cāmnāyadevatāḥ īśānākhyaṃ tatpuruṣamaghoraṃ tadanantaram oṃkārādyaiḥ pañcahrasvairvilomāt sayutaṃ viyat śirovadanahṛdguhyapādadeśe yathākramam

īśānādyā ṛcaḥ samyagaṃgulīṣu yathākramam mūrdhāsyahṛdayāmbhojaguhyapādeṣu vā punaḥ tārapañcakamuccārya sarvajñāya hṛdīritam tadante brahmaśirase śiro'ṅgaṃ jvalitāntataḥ vajriṇe vajrahastāya svatantrāya tanucchadaḥ netramuktaṃ ślīṃpaśu huṃ phaḍanto'nantaśaktaye tataḥ pravinyasedvidvānaṣṭātriṃśatkalāstanau vaktreṣu pañca vinyasedīśānasya kalāḥ kramāt īśvaraḥ sarvabhūtānāmaṅgadā tadanantaram brahmeṣṭadā tṛtīyā syācchivo me astu tatparā aṃśumālinyatha parā praṇavādyā namontakāḥ catasro vinyasenmantrī puruṣasya kalāḥ kramāt mahādevāya śabdānte dhīmahi syāt tataḥ param pratiṣṭhā kathitā paścāt tṛtīyā syāt pracodayāt hṛdgrīvāṃsadvaye nābhau kukṣau pṛṣṭhe ca vakṣasi aghorebhyastamā pūrvamīritā prathamā kalā ghorānte syāt kṣamā paścāt tṛtīyā parikīrtitā vyādhistu pañcamī proktā sarvebhyastadanantaram kṣudhā syāt saptamī proktā rudrarūpebhyastṛṣṇikā kaṭyāṃ pārśvadvaye caiva vāmadevakalā nyaset syājjyeṣṭhāya namo rakṣā dvitīyā parikīrtitā kālāya nama ityante mālinī parikīrtitā namaḥ saṃyaminī ṣaṣṭhī kathitā tadanantaram namo vṛddhiraṣṭamī syādbalānte ca sthitā kalā sarvabhūtadamanāya namo'nte bhrāmiṇī kalā

unmanāya namaḥ paścājjvarā proktā trayodaśī pādadostalanāsāsu mūrdhni bāhuyuge nyaset sadyojātaṃ prapadyāmi siddhiḥ syāt prathamā kalā bhave dyutistṛtīyā syādabhave tadanantaram medhā syāt pañcamī proktā kalā bhūyo bhavasva mām udbhavāya namaḥ paścāt sudhā syādaṣṭamī kalā aṣṭātriṃśatkalāḥ proktāḥ pañcabrahmapadādikāḥ anantacandrabhuvano bindurbinduyugānvitaḥ parāprāsādamantrastu sādiruktaḥ kuleśvari ardhanārīśvaro devo devatā parikīrtitā mahāṣoḍhāhvayaṃ nyāsamaṅgaṣoḍhāpuraḥsaram mahāṣoḍhāhvayaṃ nyāsaṃ tataḥ kuryāt samāhitaḥ jagatī chanda ākhyātamardhanārīśvaraḥ prabhuḥ viniyogaḥ samākhyātaḥ sarvāgamaviśāradaiḥ mahāṣoḍhāhvayo nyāsaḥ sarvanyāsottamottamaḥ āyai parāmbādevyai ca namo'stu vyāpakaṃ nyaset tritāramūlavidyānte amāṃ-imatalaṃ bhavet guhyādyayoginīmūladevānte'yutaṃ vadet śeṣaṃ ca pūrvavat proktvā gulphayorvinyasetpriye śeṣaṃ ca pūrvavat proktvā jaṅghayorvinyaset priye śeṣaṃ ca pūrvavat proktvā devi jānvoḥ pravinyaset śeṣaṃ ca pūrvavat proktamūrvordeveśi vinyaset śeṣaṃ ca pūrvavat proktvā guhyadeśe pravinyaset śeṣaṃ ca pūrvavat proktvā mūlādhāre pravinyaset śeṣaṃ ca pūrvavat proktvā svādhiṣṭhāne nyaset priye

śeṣaṃ ca pūrvavat proktvā nābhideśe nyaset priye śeṣaṃ ca pūrvavat proktvā hṛdaye vinyaset priye śeṣaṃ ca pūrvavat proktvā tālumūle nyaset priye śeṣaṃ ca pūrvavat proktvā ājñāyāṃ vinyaset priye śeṣaṃ ca pūrvavat proktvā lalāṭe vinyaset priye śeṣaṃ ca pūrvavat proktvā brahmarandhre nyaset priye nādhipāyai śrīparāmbādevyai hṛd vyāpakaṃ nyaset keśavo nārāyaṇo mādhavagovindaviṣṇavaḥ śrīdharastu hṛṣikeśaḥ padmanābho dāmodaraḥ akṣarādyeṣṭadeśāno ugrordhvanayanā tathā aikāriṇī caughavatī sarvakāmāñjanaprabhā bhavaḥ śarvaśca rudraśca paśupatiścogra eva ca aghorasadyojātau ca vāmadeva itīritāḥ dharmapraśamanī paṃktināsā candrārdhadhāriṇī jñānānādāṭaṅkaḍhakkādharā ṭhaṅkāraḍāmarī brahmā prajāpatirvedhāḥ parameṣṭhī pitāmahaḥ hiraṇyagarbha ityuktāḥ kramād brahmādayo'pyamī ṣaḍādhārālayā sarvanāyikā hasitānanā tritāramūlamantrānte svarādyakṣaraśaktikān svaskandhapārśvakukṣyūrujānujaṅghāpadeṣu ca kabhādyarṇayutān mantrī ṭhaḍāntān śaktisaṃyutān daśādhāreṣu brahmādīn yādīñ śaktiyutān nyaset āyai parāmbādevyai ca namaḥ sa vyāpakaṃ nyaset bhedaśca praṇavādyekākṣarātmākhilamantrataḥ āyai tathaikakūṭeśvaryambādevyai namo vadet

ṛ ṝṃ ḷmādi vahnyāditrikūṭaṃ pūrvavatparam omaumaṃmaḥpañcalakṣaṃ sūryādi pūrvavatparam ghaṃṅaṃcaṃ saptalakṣaṃ gaṇeśādi pūrvavatparam ñaṃ ṭaṃṭhaṃ navalakṣaṃ ca brahmādi pūrvavatparam taṃthaṃdamekādaśalakṣaṃ rudrādi pūrvavatparam (phaṃbaṃbhaṃ trayodaśalakṣaṃ lakṣmyādi pūrvavatparam) laṃvaṃśaṃ pañcadaśalakṣaṃ durgādi pūrvavatparam tritāramūlamantrānte sakalāṃ mātṛkāṃ vadet devyai hṛdvyāpakaṃ kuryānmantranyāse maheśvari nirodhikāyāmardhendau bindau caiva kalāpade dhruvamaṇḍaladeśe ca vinyaset kulanāyike āyai devyai parādi syāt pūrvavadvyāpakaṃ nyaset tritāramūlamantrānte amāṃ sahasrakoṭi ca nivṛttyambāpadaṃ devyai nama ityuccaret priye uṃ ūṃ tapasvividyāṃ ca śeṣaṃ pūrvavaccaret ḷṃ ḹṃ muniṃ tathā śāntyatītāṃ śeṣaṃ ca pūrvavat oṃ auṃ rakṣaḥkulānte ca gaganāṃ pūrvavat priye kaṃkhaṃ siddhaṃ mahocchuṣmāṃ śeṣaṃ pūrvavaduccaret ṅaṃcaṃ tathāpsarojayāṃ śeṣaṃ pūrvavaduccaret jhaṃ ñaṃ guhyakaśabdānte ajitāṃ pūrvavatparam ḍaṃḍhaṃ kinnaravāmāmbā śeṣaṃ ca pūrvavatparam thaṃdaṃ ca pitṛraudryambā śeṣaṃ ca pūrvavat param paṃphaṃ bhaivaraśabdānte kuṇḍalī pūrvavat param maṃyaṃ ca kṣetraśabdānte kālarātrī ca pūrvavat vaṃśaṃ brahmāpi sarveśvaryambā śeṣaṃ ca pūrvavat

haṃlaṃ rudraḥ sarvakartrī śeṣaṃ ca pūrvavatparam aṃguṣṭhagulphajaṅghāsu jānūrukaṭipārśvake dakṣabhāgādivāmāntaṃ vinyaset kulanāyike samastadevatādhiṃ ca pāyai śrī ca parāmbikām devatānyāsa evaṃ syānmātṛnyāsastathocyate bhūcarīkulaśabdānte sahitāyaipadaṃ vadet āṃkṣāmante tu brahmāṇyambādevyai ca padaṃ vadet akṣaṃ maṅgalanāthāya aṃkṣamante'sitāṅga ca cavargaṃ khecarīmīlāṃ carcikāṃ ca maheśvarīm śeṣaṃ ca pūrvavat proktvā tato vakṣye maheśvari kaumārīṃ piśācamūhāṃ vadedyogeśacaṇḍakau apasmāraṃ harasiddhiṃ krodha ca pūrvavat param indrāṇīṃ vaṭuka eṃśaṃ kilikilānte kapālinam cāmuṇḍāṃ pretamāvaṃ ca kālarātraśca bhīṣaṇam tritāramūlamantrānte mātṛbhairavaśabdataḥ mātṛnyāsaṃ maheśāni aṣṭādhāreṣu vinyaset amṛtārṇavamadhyasthasvarṇadvīpe manorame navaratnamaye śrīmatsiṃhāsanagatāmbje ardhāmbikāsamāyuktaṃ pravibhaktavibhūṣaṇam mandasmitamukhāmbhojaṃ trinetraṃ candraśekharam pānapātraṃ ca cinmudrāṃ triśūlaṃ pustakaṃ karaiḥ mahāṣoḍhoditāśeṣadevatāgaṇasevitam puṃrūpaṃ vā smareddevi strīrūpaṃ vā vicintayet sarvatejomayaṃ dhyāyet sacarācaravigraham yoniṃ liṅgaṃ ca surabhiṃ hetimudrācatuṣṭayam

smarecchirasi haṃsagaṃ tadabhidhānapūrvaṃ gurum mantrī nacātra sandeho nigrahānugrahakṣamaḥ devāḥ sarve namasyanti taṃ namāmi na saṃśayaḥ divyakṣetraṃ samuddiṣṭaṃ samantād daśayojanam tatra śrīrvijayo lābhaḥ sanmānaṃ pauruṣaṃ priye samāsānmṛtyumāpnoti yadi trātā śivaḥ svayam divyāntarikṣabhūśailajalāraṇyanivāsinaḥ bhayagrastena manasā nekṣante sādhakaṃ priye devāḥ sarve prakūrvanti ṛṣayaśca munīśvarāḥ akṣayāṃ labhate siddhiṃ rahasi nyāsamācaret loke nāsti na sandehaḥ satyaṃ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ mahāṣoḍhāparijñānaṃ nālpasya tapasaḥ phalam so'haṃ turīyavidyāṃ ca cidānandapadaṃ tataḥ prāgvat sarvaṃ samuccārya saccidānandaśabdataḥ tataḥ prāgvat samuccāryāhamevāsmīti coccaret saṃghaṭṭamudrayā mūrdhni vinyased deśikottamaḥ ahamasmīti brahmāhamasmi so'haṃ samīrayet mahāprakāśaparyante pūrṇānandapadaṃ tataḥ prakāśaparipūrṇeti parāparamahāpi ca yoginīmūlavidyāśrīpādukāṃ pūjayāmi ca parāprāsādabījaṃ ca śrīprāsādapareti ca (3)praṇavāditritāraṃ ca vāgbhavaṃ makaradhvajaḥ kāmarājadvayaṃ mohayadvayaṃ kāmarājahṛt (4)praṇavāditritāraṃ ca haṃsaḥ svaccheti vai vadet svāhā hsau hsau vidyeyaṃ śambhavīmūla pūrvikā

tmacaitanyānandamayi mahābindupadaṃ vadet praṇavāditritāraṃ mīmiyaṃ vai kathitā budhaiḥ svacchaprakāśātmike ca māyāṃ kulamahāpadam samayānte ca vimale śrībījamiyamīśvari (7)tāraṃ tāratrayaṃ haṃsastato nityaprakāśa ca siddhe mahābhairavīti ātmānaṃ bodhayadvayam parabodhinī mūlānte vidyā syāt parameśvari kulapañcākṣarīmūlavidyeti paripaṭhyate caitanyatripurāmūlavidyeyaṃ parameśvari śuddhasūkṣma-nirākāra-nirvikalpapadaṃ tataḥ nandaśaktipadaṃ bālātṛtīyaṃ bījamuddharet mūlavidyeti kathitā sarvāgamaviśāradaiḥ paramānte haṃsaparamātmane vahnivallabhā (12) tāraṃ tāratrayasyānte'pnāmākhyapadaṃ bhavet vyomātītapadaṃ vyomeśvaryambāpadamuddharet (13) tāraṃ tāratrayaṃ vāṇīṃ iṃ īṃ uṃ bījamuddharet (14) tāraṃ tāratrayaṃ māyāṃ tato bhagavatīti ca mahāmātaṅgini vāṇīṃ klinne blūṃstrīṃ likhediyam (15) tāraṃ tāratrayaṃ prāsādaparāṃ khecarīṃ tataḥ iyaṃ tu kathitā mūlavidyānuttaraśāṅkarī uddharet parameśāni mahātripurasundarī phreṃbījaṃ ca tato lekhyaṃ pareśvaramanurmataḥ kubjike phreṃ viśuddhau tu vicceśvaramahāmanuḥ kubjikāyai padaṃ caiva hsaphraṃ vicce tathaiva ca hasroṃkṣrāṃkṣrīṃ tathaivakṣrīṃ kiṇidvandvamataḥ param

hasaphreṃ hasakṣamalavayarūṃ praṇavameva ca kṣamalān vayarūṃ caiva tadbījaṃ vāmanetrayuk hrīṃhraṃhrāṃhlāṃ tato vāṇīṃ nitye bhagavatīti ca hyehauṃṅañaṇanān me ca kṣrāṃkṣrīṃkṣrūṃkṣrastathaiva ca kubjikāyai tataśchrāṃ chraṃchrīṃ ghore ca tataḥ param mahākiṇiyugaṃ vicce saṃvarteśamahāmanuḥ rigaṭini padaṃ caiva piṅgaṭini padaṃ tataḥ maṇipūrakacakre tu nyastavyaḥ sādhakottamaiḥ rayūṃ namo bhagavati hasphreṃ bījamataḥ param aghoramukhi chrāṃchrūṃchrīṃ kiṇidvandvaṃ kiṇidvayam ṣaḍanvayeśvaraḥ śrīmān paraśambhurajo'vyayaḥ dvīpicarmakaṭisphāramuṇḍamālāvibhūṣaṇaḥ brahmanābhikajāṃguṣṭho daṃṣṭrāvistṛtalāpanaḥ śūlāsīṣuśaktisṛṇivaradhārī mahātanuḥ devāvṛtaḥ pitṛvane krīḍākṛnmānasottare iti dhyātvābhisampūjya mūlavidyādvayaṃ punaḥ jayadurgā cchinnamastā samayāḥ pañca kīrtitāḥ devīṃ bhajāmi dhṛtamudgaravairijihvām caturbhujāṃ trinayanāṃ bhīṣaṇāṃ candraśekharām dakṣiṇe cābhayaṃ pāśaṃ vāme bhuvanameva ca dhyāyed durgāṃ jayākhyāṃ tridaśaparivṛtāṃ sevitāṃ siddhikāmaiḥ tatpadmakośamadhye tu maṇḍalaṃ caṇḍarociṣaḥ rajaḥsattvatamorekhāyonimaṇḍalamaṇḍitam chinnamastāṃ kare vāme dhārayantīṃ svamastakam pibandīṃ raudhirīṃ dharāṃ nijakaṇṭhasamudbhavām

dakṣiṇe ca kare katrīṃ muṇḍamālāvibhūṣitām asthimālādharāṃ devīṃ nāgayajñopavītinīm sadā ṣoḍaśavarṣīyāṃ pīnonnatapayodharām yonimudrāsamārūḍhāṃ vicitrāsanasaṃsthitām pūjanīyāḥ prayatnena sarvakāmārthasiddhaye merukailāsabhūsaṃjñā bhedāstasya tridhā bhavet mātṛkāyāstu kailāsaprastārākhyaṃ sureśvari sṛṣṭikramaṃ merucakraṃ kailāsaṃ cārddhamerukam ekaikasva tu cakrasya tribhedāstu bhavanti hi sṛṣṭikramaṃ tu samayamataṃ syāt sthitisaṃjñakam merucakre tu saṃhārakramapūjā na vidyate saṃhārapūjā kailāsaprastāre'tra vidhīyate sthitikramo gṛhasthasya saṃhāro vaninoyateḥ sauvarṇe rājate tāmre sphāṭike vaidrume tathā kṛtvā cakrasya nirmāṇaṃ sthāpayet pūjayedapi teṣāṃ madhye sphāṭikaṃ tu sarvasiddhipradaṃ bhavet suvarṇaracitaṃ yantraṃ sarvarājavaśaṅkaram tāmre tu racitaṃ yantraṃ sarvaiśvaryapradaṃ matam lohatrayodbhavaṃ yantraṃ sarvasiddhikaraṃ matam tanme vadasva kṛpayā yadyahaṃ tava vallabhā tāmrasya ravibhāgena pīṭhaṃ kuryānmanoharam śāntidaṃ puṣṭikaṃ proktaṃ sarvaśatrunivarhaṇam traividhyaṃ śṛṇu cakrasya bhūprastāro'rdhamerukam ūrdhvarekho mahāśāntirmartyalokanivāsinām bhūpuraṃ tu samārabhya vaindavāntaṃ maheśvari

samordhvarekhānavakamūrdhvarekhaṃ prakīrtitam yantrabījasvarūpaṃ te mayā snehāt prakāśitam unnatonnatamāmadhyāccakraṃ syānnidhanaṃ dhanam ekadviṣaṭkramonnāmaḥ śriyai kīrtyai ca kalpate bhūcakre ṣoḍaśāraṃ cāpyaṣṭāraṃ ca samaṃ bhavet caturasraṃ samaṃ devi ṣoḍaśārādibindukam caturasraṃ samārabhya vindvantaṃ samarekhakam phalakāyāṃ paṭe bhittau sthāpayenna kadācana kulaṃ vittamapatyaṃ ca nirmūlayati sarvathā palapramāṇaṃ kartavyamarccāpīṭhaṃ manoharam tasmin pīṭhe ca nirmāṇaṃ śrīcakrasya tu kārayet tāmrasya pūrvasaṃkhyaiva māṇikyādau yathecchayā śālibhirvā ṛjunyastaistribhirmānāntaraṃ bhavet vṛttatrayaṃ ca dharaṇīsadanatrayaṃ ca śrīcakrametaduditaṃ paradevatāyāḥ śivaśaktyātmakaṃ jñeyaṃ śrīcakraṃ śivayorvapuḥ yoginīsahitāstasya hiṃsāṃ kurvanti bhairavāḥ sthaṇḍile nityapūjāyāṃ hastamātraṃ praśasyate naśyanti sarvavighnāni prāpsyate ca yathepsitam ṣaḍguṇaṃ (ṣoḍaśa) rajatasyāpi caitallohatrayaṃ śubham aṇimādyaṣṭasiddhīnāmadhipo jāyate'cirāt indranīle ca vaiḍūrye sphaṭike marakate'pi vā tāmraṃ tu kāntidaṃ yantraṃ suvarṇaṃ śatrunāśanam khaṇḍite sphuṭite bhagne bhraṣṭe mānavivarjite anyamantrārcite caiva patitasparśadūṣite dagdhaṃ ca sphuṭitaṃ yantraṃ hṛtaṃ caureṇa vā priye

lakṣamātraṃ japedvidyāṃ homatarpaṇapūrvikām bhagnaṃ karoti yo mūrkho mṛtyustamya dhruvaṃ bhavet samudre vā kṣipeddevi anyathā duḥkhamāpnuyāt śaktyopaviṣṭāṃ śaktiṃ tu vilikhedvistṛtāṃ sakṛt agnīśāsuravāyavyarekhā vistārya yojayet madhyakoṇacatuṣkasya rekhe ākṛṣya buddhimān samatrikoṇaśaktyaikyaṃ sukhadaṃ netrayoryathā bahiraṣṭadalaṃ padmamakiñjalkaṃ samālikhet suvṛttaṃ parameśāni tato bhūbimbamālikhet śalākayā suvarṇasya miśrayā ghusṛṇendubhiḥ athavā bhūtale devi surekhaṃ kuṃkumena vā etaccakraṃ maheśāni madhye binduvirājitam manukoṇaṃ maheśāni madhyacakramidaṃ priye catvāriṃśadbhagairyuktaṃ tribhagairapi pārvati navātmakamidaṃ bhadre navayonyaṅkitaṃ bhavet lakāraḥ pṛthivībījaṃ tatrovāpuramucyate tasmāt ṣoḍaśapatraṃ tu hakāraḥ śiva ucyate īkārastu mahāmāyā bhuvanāni caturdaśa śaktirekā daśasthāne sthitvā sūte jagattrayam rakārāt parameśāni cakraṃ vyāpya vijṛmbhate kalādaśānvito vahnirdaśakoṇapravartakaḥ yonirasya tadā cakre vasuyonyaṅkitaṃ bhavet trikoṇarūpā yonistu bindunā baindavaṃ bhavet śrīcakraṃ tu varārohe śrīvidyāvarṇasambhavam bhūpradeśe same cāḍhye sindūrarajasā'thavā

ṛjurekhaṃ netraramyaṃ sandhibhedaṃ samamṛju paṭṭaṃ viracya śrīkāṣṭhe raktacandanasambhave rocanākuṃkumābhyāṃ ca kastūrīcandanendubhiḥ īśādagrestadagrābhyāṃ rekhe ākṛṣya deśikaḥ trikoṇākārarūpeyaṃ tasyā upari saṃlikhet pūrvaśaktyagrabhāge tu mānayaṣṭivadālikhet saṃdhibhedakrameṇaiva tayoḥ śaktyostataḥ param vahnimaṇḍalametattu pūrvāgraṃ vīravandite pūrvaśaktīśavahnibhyāṃ koṇābhyāṃ suravandite vāyurākṣasakoṇābhyāṃ rekhāṃ paścimagāṃ tathā yonyagragāṃ pūrvadeśe dakṣiṇottarataḥ kramāt koṇāgragāṃ yojayitvā daśakoṇaṃ tadā bhavet īśānavahnito rekhe pūrvayonyagrayoḥ kramāt vāyurākṣasakoṇāgrarekhe vistārya sundari ekāgra pūrvakoṇāgracumbinīṃ tu manoharām daśakoṇeṣu deveśi tyaktvā koṇacatuṣṭayam dve dakṣiṇe vibhāge tu tathā cottarabhāgake yoniṃ vahniṃ ca saṃyojya śakrāraṃ jāyate tathā ṛjvākṛtiryathā devi jāyate'timanoharā bindutrikoṇavasvāraṃ cakrabhedādvarānane śakrayonyaṅkitaṃ devi bāhyamadhyagataṃ bhavet sarvasāmrājyadaṃ devi sarvopadravanāśanam mahāmokṣapradaṃ devi vāgvilāsakaraṃ mahat tadyutaṃ kuru padmākṣi vasupatraṃ manoharam caturasraṃ caturdvārasahitaṃ parameśvari

cakre'smin saviśeṣāstāḥ sādhakaṃ mānayanti hi muktāmāṇikyaghaṭitasamujjvala virājitam ṣoḍaśāraṃ candrabimbarūpaṃ tu svakalālayam aṣṭapatraṃ maheśāni japākusumasannibham etat trayaṃ varārohe sṛṣṭicakraṃ vasupradam caturdaśāraṃ deveśi dāḍimīkusumaprabham daśāraṃ taptahemābhaṃ sindūrasadṛśaṃ priye dvitīyamapi paṃktyasraṃ japākusumasannibham etat trayaṃ maheśāni sthiticakraṃ sukhapradam aṣṭakoṇaṃ varārohe bālārkakiraṇāruṇam udyatsūryasahasrābhaṃ bandhūkakusumaprabham trikoṇaṃ sarvasambhūtikāraṇaṃ bhṛtidaṃ sadā sadāśivamayaṃ cakranāyakaṃ parameśvari paścimāmnāyasaṃsevyaṃ trayamuttarasevitam cakrapatreṣu deveśi padādhvā tu nigadyate varṇādhvā mātṛkārūpī kathayāmi tavānaghe pārthivaṃ tanmayaṃ viddhi ṣoḍaśāraṃ kalātmakam kādiḍhāntāḥ śakravarṇāḥ śakrakoṇeṣu saṃsthitāḥ makārādikṣakārāntā dvitīye tu daśārake akathāditrikoṇāntaṃ hakṣayugmaṃ tu madhyamam saṭtriṃśattattvabharitaṃ cakramūlānurūpataḥ sā bālā bhairavīyuktā mahātripurabhairavī mantrādhvā ca samākhyāto niścayena sadā priye taccaturdhā vibhajyādau caturviṃśāṃgulaṃ kramāt tāsāṃ sammārjayed bhāgānagrayorubhayorimān

jīve purāṇaṃ śukre tu svaraṃ rāhau śaraṃ punaḥ rekhāyugmaṃ śaniṃ sūryāddharāvṛtte niyojayet candrāt ketuṃ kaveḥ somaṃ budhādrāhuṃ guroḥ kujam aṣṭāṣṭāṃgulamānena bahiścakratrayaṃ likhet tatra kramānmadhyayonistiryagrekhāḥ samantataḥ sampradāyaviśeṣaṇa kṣamā viśvakalāśraye cakrarājamidaṃ proktaṃ madhye binduvibhūṣitam sindūrarajasā bhūmau likhitvā cakramarcayet pramṛjya tiryaṅmadhyasthaṃ sūtraṃ tiryaṅ nipātayet vidhāya taddvayorantānmadhyasūtrāntataḥ kramāt dvyaṣṭāgrataḥ samārambhānnavamaprathamāntarā navamaprathamāgrābhyāṃ turyasaptamakāvadhi tataścaturthaṣaṣṭhāntadvayārambhāt tathāṣṭagam caturmarmānuguṇyena tataḥ pañcamakāntayoḥ mārjayenmadhyagaṃ brahmasūtraṃ syāccakramuttamam vidhāya ṣaḍbhirvṛttaiśca caturasraṃ tathāṣṭabhiḥ dakṣiṇottarato rekhātrayāt sthānadvayaṃ tathā dvidhā kuryācca catvāri padāni parameśvari śaraṇakoṇāḥ pariṇatāḥ pañca tāni ca śāktāni māyādīni śivasya tu pañcaviṃśatitatvāni tatraivāntarbhavanti te trirekhāsaṅgamasthānaṃ marmamarmavido viduḥ aṣṭāviṃśatimarmāṇi caturviṃśatisandhayaḥ sevamānāścakrakidyāṃ devagandharvasevitām agnāvantarvabhau bhānuragnīṣomamayaṃ smṛtam

trikoṇaṃ vaindavaṃ saumyamaṣṭakoṇaṃ ca miśrakam etat prasādādindrādyā vasavo'ṣṭau marudgaṇāḥ puratrayaṃ ca cakrasya somasūryānalātmakam guhyādguhyatamaṃ jñānaṃ na kutrāpi prakāśitam tanmadhye baindavasthānaṃ tatrāste parameśvarī cakraṃ tripurasurandaryā brahmāṇḍākāramīśvari indriyātmakamevaṃ ca manastattvātmakaṃ tathā baindave jagadutpattisthitisaṃhārakāriṇī jyotīrūpā varākārā yasya dehodbhavāḥ śive kodirarbudameteṣāṃ parā saṃkhyā na vidyate yasyā devyā maheśāni bhāsā sarvaṃ vibhāsate tasyāśca śivaśakteśca cidrupāyāścitiṃ vinā teṣāmanantakoṭīnāṃ mayūkhānāṃ maheśvari brahmāṇḍaṃ vyaśnuvānāste somasūryānalātmanā ṣaṭtriṃśaduttaraśataṃ candrasya kiraṇāḥ śive divā sūryastathā rātrau somo vahniśca sandhyayoḥ ṣaṣṭyuttaraṃ ca triśataṃ dinānyeva tu hāyanaḥ prajāpatirlokakartā marīcipramukhān munīn saṃhāraśca harāyatta utpatirbhavanirmitā niyuktaḥ parameśānyā jagadevaṃ pravartate śrīvidyāraṇyayativiracite śrīvidyārṇavākhye tantre'ṣṭamaḥ śvāsaḥ bindumadhye pretabījaṃ vilikhet parameśvari dvāratrayaṃ prakartavyaṃ yathā dvārāṇi bhūpure granthayastu prakartavyāstriśūlāṣṭakameva ca pūrvādigranthiṣu tathā pūjayedaṣṭa bhairavān

triśūleṣu mahādevi pūjayedaṣṭa bhairavīḥ yoginīḥ pūjayet tāsāṃ mantrāstu parameśvari bhūrlokavāsinībhyastu yoginībhyo namo namaḥ (svarlokavāsinībhyastu yoginībhyo namo namaḥ) viphalā jāyate sarvā vāhanādidhanāpahā dhūpahīne tathodvegaṃ vastrahīne dhanakṣayam kalaśairbandhunāśaśca bhavedvai girikanyake dakṣiṇārahite sarvaṃ vyarthaṃ syānnātra saṃśayaḥ pātramantrasamāyuktaṃ sarvadoṣāpahaṃ bhavet mantrāḥ parāṅmukhā yānti āpadaśca pade pade ādhāreṇa vinā bhraṃśo na ca tṛpyanti devatāḥ siddhijanakaṃ muktipradaṃ mauktikam nārikelaṃ ca śaṅkhaṃ ca muktāśuktisamudbhavam nārikelodbhavaṃ devi jñeyaṃ cottamamadhyayam madhyamottamakaṃ haimaṃ tāraṃ madhyamamadhyamam kanyasottamakaṃ bailvaṃ brahmavṛkṣajameva ca purā vai nirmitaṃ pātraṃ viśvāmitreṇa dhīmatā tasmin sampūjayeccaiva siddhayo'ṣṭau bhavanti hi uddhariṣyatyasandeho gṛhastho bhavati priye dṛṣṭvā pātraṃ nārikelaṃ sarvapāpaṃ praṇaśyati yo dadāti maheśāni rāhugraste divākare alābhe tasya pātrasya pātrasya cānyapātraistu pūjayet nṛtyanti sarvayoginyaḥ prītāḥ siddhiṃ dadanti ca ratnādīni ca pātrāṇi śubharekhāṅkitāni ca arghyaṃ datvā tu raupyeṇa āyū rājyaṃ sutāṃllabhet

sarvālābhe tu māheyaṃ svahastaghaṭitaṃ yadi sarvatra svarṇavat tāmramarghyapātre tato'dhikam balihomakriyārthaṃ hi vinā pātraṃ na siddhyati madhyamaṃ tu tribhāgonaṃ kaniṣṭhaṃ dvādaśāṃgulam nābhivivararūpāṇi puṇḍarīkākṛtīni ca tattadbhūtasamānābhamaṇḍalābhāni kalpayet yādṛśaṃ pātrarūpaṃ syādādhāraṃ tādṛgānayet śāntike pauṣṭike caiva rājataṃ kārayet priye stambhakāryeṣu sarveṣu viśeṣeṇa tu mṛnmayam tatpātreṇa varārohe devatāṃ yastu tarpayet tathā mantrārṇanakṣatravṛkṣotthaṃ pātramuttamam tathaiva mantrasiddhiḥ syānnātra kāryā vicāraṇā mantrarkṣayonisambhūtapātraṃ caivottamottamam parābhicāraśamanaṃ svamantrāṇāṃ ca siddhidam pātrāṇi śrīgurumukhājjñātvārcanavidhau kṣipet kāṣṭhapātraṃ vijānīyānmantrārādhanakarmaṇi gurupātraṃ bhogapātraṃ balipātramanukramāt aṅgaṃ vīraṃ tathā guhyaṃ yoginīpātrameva ca prokṣaṇīsahitāni syurnava pātrāṇi suvrate pātrāṇyaṣṭādaśaitāni devyāḥ prītikarāṇi ca ādyapaṃkteradhaḥsthāpyau vidhivat parameśvari sāmānyaḥ sarvadevānāmarghyo'yaṃ parikīrtitaḥ anyeṣāṃ devi devānāṃ sāmānyaṃ cācyadīśvari arghyapātraṃ tu vāyavye nair-ṛtyāṃ pādyapātrakam madhye tu madhuparkaḥ syādityetatpātralakṣaṇam

sahā siddhārthakā dūrvā kuṃkumaṃ rocanā niśā siddhārthaḥ kuṃkumaṃ dūrvā kuṣṭhaṃ lāmañjakaṃ śaśī amūnyācamanīyasya dravyāṇi pravadanti ṣaṭ daghyabhāve payaḥ kāryaṃ maghvabhāve tathā guḍaḥ aṣṭagandhaṃ samāloḍya snānāmbhaḥ sādhu sādhayet pṛthak pātrāṇi pañca syurekaṃ pañcāmṛtasya ca saptamaṃ koṣṭhyatoyasya cāṣṭamaṃ navamaṃ tathā etāni daśa pātrāṇi saure śaive ca vaiṣṇave arghyādipañcapātrāṇi tridhā saṃsthāpayedbudhaḥ pañcāyatanapūjāyāṃ pañcadhārghyādipañcakam sāmānyāvaraṇaṃ devi sāmānyārghyeṇa sundari śaktīnāṃ śaktipātreṇa gurūṇāṃ gurupātrataḥ yoginīpātratoyena tarpayet kulanāyike bhairavasya ca pātreṇa bhairavāṃstarpayedbudhaḥ balipātreṇa deveśi balyutsarjanamācaret rājarājeśvarasyāpi baliṃ tenaiva kārayet guhyapātrāmṛtenaiva tarpayed guhyayoginīḥ ūrdhvāmnāyakramaṃ caiva śrīvidyāvṛndapūjanam antaryāgaṃ cātmapūjāṃ cāntarhavanameva ca dūtīyāge prayoktavyaṃ dūtīpātracatuṣṭayam pañca vā ṣaṭ ca saptāṣṭau nava vā sthāpayedbudhaḥ apavitraṃ karodbhraṣṭaṃ paśuspṛṣṭaṃ vivarjayet na kuryāt pātrasāṃkaryaṃ dravyāṇāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ raśmicakraṃ ca deveśi nānyapātreṇa tarpayet pātraṃ yanna bhavet tatra prokṣaṇyadbhiḥ samācaret

kṣetrādhipasya pātreṇa kṣetrapālabalirbhavet madhyadevyā baliṃ devi śrīpātreṇa visarjayet balyādhārāṇi pātrāṇi śṛṇu vakṣye samāsataḥ trīṇi vai kurukullāyā vaṭukādeścatuṣṭyam rājarājeśvarasyaikamekaṃ devyāstataḥ param ityaṣṭādaśa pātrāṇi sarvavighnaharāṇi ca pūjādravyasya racanadravyārthaṃ caikapātrakam manoharāṇi pātrāṇi sthāpayet pūjayedapi ekaṃ prasthajalāgrāhi ekaṃ tarpaṇapātrakam tadeva ravipūjāyāṃ sāmānyārghyaṃ bhavet priye dukūlavastrasaṃvītaṃ bṛhadādhārasaṃyutam svavāmāgrāt tataḥ sthāpyaṃ devyā dakṣiṇabhāgataḥ pañcaratnasamāyuktaṃ pañcabhaṅgadalānvitam sthāpayedavraṇaṃ kumbhaṃ varuṇaṃ tatra vinyaset gajāśvarathyāvalmīkasaṅgamahradagokulāt snānārthaṃ vinyaset tatra yajamānaśca dharmavit āyāntu yajamānasya duritakṣayakārakāḥ kāñcanaṃ ghṛtagodhūmān dūrvārocanayā saha viśeṣārghyādipātreṣu śrīpātreṣu viśeṣataḥ skando bhānurmātṛgaṇā dikpālāśca navagrahāḥ ṣaṭtriṃśadaṃgulaṃ kumbhaṃ vistāronnatiśālinam arghyasya trīṇi pātrāṇi pādyasyāpi trayaṃ bhavet daśavarṣasahasrāṇi durgāloke mahīyate tilā siddhārthakāścaiva aṣṭāṅgārghyaḥ prakīrtitaḥ devyai tadā mahārāja agniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet

raupyapātreṇa dattvā vai viṣṇuyāgaphalaṃ labhet dattvā sauvarṇapātreṇa labhedbahuḥ suvarṇakam pañcāyatanapūjāyāṃ daśa pātrāṇi vai kṣipet balipātrāṇi pañca syuḥ rudhirasyaikapātrakam ekaṃ pakvasya māṃsasya -------------------------------- sthāpanīyāni yatnena yadīcchet siddhimātmanaḥ yoginīnāṃ samarcāyāṃ pañcāśanmithunārcane gurumaṇḍalapūjāyāṃ dineśānāṃ tathaiva ca akṣarauṣadhipūjāyāṃ japamālāprapūjane arghyādipañcapātrāṇi sampādyāni pṛthak pṛthak carusthālīdvayaṃ caiva praṇītā prokṣaṇī tathā mukhyānyetāni pātrāṇi ------------------------------- vṛttena veṣṭitaṃ bāhye caturasreṇa caiva hi gandhalipte svavāmāgre vidadhyānmatsyamudrayā aṅgāni caturasrasya koṇeṣu puratastathā mūlena kṣālitaṃ śaṅkhādhāraṃ saṃsthāpayāmi vahnyante maṇḍalāyeti tathā dharmapradeti ca vahnerdaśa kalāstatra prādakṣiṇyena pūjayet tasmād vidhivadādhāraṃ kalpayet kulanāyike athavā vartulākāraṃ kuryād devi manoharam suśrīḥ svarūpā kapilā havyakavyavahe tathā śaṅkhamānaṃ tu prādeśaṃ caturaṃgulamucchritam ahamarthapradāyeti vadeta dvādaśetyapi anena śaṅkhamabhyarcya kalāḥ sūryasya pūjayet suṣumnā bhogadā viśvā bodhinī dhāriṇī kṣamā

vilomāṃ pūjayettatra pūjako manunāmunā toyaiḥ sugandhipuṣpāḍhyai pūjayettaṃ yathāvidhi ṣoḍaśānte kalāśabdamātmane nama ityatha śaśinī candrikā kāntirjyotsnā śrīḥ prītiraṅgadā somamaṇḍalamadhyasthāḥ ----------------------------------- saṃyojya netramantreṇa puṣpaṃ nyasya śikhāṇunā amṛtīkṛtya vidhivat sudhābījena sādhakaḥ aṅganyāsena cāstreṇa kalayecca diśo daśa avaṣṭabhya (guṇṭhya) taduddipya mudrayā yonirūpayā ṣaḍaṅgāni ca sampūjya mantrayenmūlamantrataḥ madhuparkaṃ ca saṃsthāpya trikoṇeṣu yathākramam tadāpyate yadā tena madhuparkaḥ sadā smṛtaḥ kiñcidarghyāmbu saṃgṛhya prokṣaṇyambhasi nikṣipet dūrvā ceti kramādarghyadravyāṣṭakamudīritam ājyasiddhārthapuṣpāṇi bhasitaṃ cārghyapātrake dāpayet prokṣaṇīpātre bhasitaṃ praṇavena ca jātīkakkolakarpūrabahumūlatamālakam sarvaṃ haratu me pāpaṃ dūrvā duḥsvapnanāśinī maṇḍale sthāpayet kumbhaṃ sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ tathā āyāntu yajamānasya duritakṣayakārakāḥ narmade sindhukāveri jale'smin sannidhiṃ kuru mūle tasya sthito brahmā madhye mātṛgaṇāḥ sthitāḥ ṛgvedo'tha yajurvedaḥ sāmavedo hyatharvaṇaḥ kacodbhavāṃ | brahmahatyāṃ tena te nāśayāmyaham amābījamaye devi śukraśāpādvimucyatām

tena satyena me devi brahmahatyāṃ vyapohatu carukaṃ ca manohari śarkarādyaiśca pūritam etāni pañcadravyāṇi tridhā saṃśodhayettataḥ saṃvitprayogaḥ kartavyaḥ pūjādau sādhakottamaiḥ bhairavāṇāṃ ca tṛptyarthaṃ pavitrā bhava sarvadā rājaputravaśaṅkāri śatrukaṇṭhatriśūlini ānandādyāhutiṃ matvā samyajjñānaṃ prayaccha me trailokyavijaye mātaḥ samādhiphaladā bhava satakraṃ vaṭakaṃ vāpi saṃgṛhya ca vicakṣaṇaḥ sauvīreṇāthavā kuryādetatkarma na lopayet ādhāya pūjayeddevīmanyathā niṣphalaṃ bhavet laśunaṃ ca maheśāni dvitīyapratinidhau smṛtam kareṇācchādya dakṣeṇa kumārīṃ tripureśvarīm samaṣṭividyayā devi bhogapātre'bhimantraṇam ṣaḍaṅgayuvatīmantrairaṅgapātraṃ sakṛtsakṛt guhyapātraṃ tu kuṇḍanyā bījena parameśvari ātmāṣṭākṣaramantreṇa cātmapātraṃ maheśvari kūmāryaiva maheśāni dūtīpātracatuṣṭayam daśadhā japapūjābhyāmarghyaṃ saṃsādhyapūjayet nikṣipettena pūjāyāṃ devyāḥ saṃmīlanena ca anyāni siddhadravyāṇi pratyahaṃ śodhayedbudhaḥ malayotthaṃ mahādevi svayambhūkusumaṃ tathā pṛthakpṛthak saptavāraṃ hastaṃ dattvābhimantrayet viṣṇuryoniṃ trayeṇaiva tribhiṣṭvāditrayeṇa ca śroṇāmeketi caikena śukraśāpaṃ vimocayet

sutaḥ rakṣohā viśvacarṣaṇirabhi yonimayohatam | druṇā sadhasthamāsadat varivodhātamo bhava maṃhiṣṭho vṛtrahantamaḥ | parṣi rādho maghonām abhyarṣa mahānāṃ devānāṃ vītimandhasā | abhi vājamuta śravaḥ āsiñcatu prajāpatirdhātā garbhaṃ dadhātu te garbhaṃ te aśvinau devāvādhattāṃ puṣkarasrajā agne dakṣaiḥ punīhi naḥ viśvedevāḥ punīta māṃ jātavedaḥ punīhi mā navamaḥ śvāsaḥ balādvā yatnato vāpi abhiṣekaṃ samācaret namaḥśabdaṃ samuccāryaṃ imāṃ śaktiṃ tato vadet vahnijāyāṃ samuccārya śuddhimantraḥ sureśvari kuṇḍagolodbhavaṃ dravyaṃ svayambhūkusumaṃ tathā sudhayā cārghyadānena yoginīnāṃ bhavet priyaḥ kevalaiḥ pañcamairvāpi siddho bhavati sādhakaḥ kālāgnirudramādhāraśaktiṃ kūrmamanantakam padmaṃ ca karṇikāṃ caiva maṇḍalaṃ samarcayet anaiśvaryamavairāgyamadharmamapi pūjayet gandhapuṣpākṣatādīni dattvā tatra nidhāpayet pūjayecca tatastasyāṃ pañca kāmān samāhitaḥ arcayitvā caturdikṣu pūjayet kulanāyakam blūmātmakaṃ tato dattvā ādhāraśaktimuddharet mahāpretāsanaṃ madhye bālāṃ ca pūjayettataḥ trikoṇeṣu tu sampūjya basantaṃ madanaṃ priye durgāṃ bhruvostathā lakṣmīṃ rasanāyāṃ sarasvatīm

pādāntaṃ pūjayet sarvāḥ kalā vai kāmasomayoḥ ekā tu vāhikā cāndrī saurī cānyā tu vāhikā ambu sravati cāndrī sā puṣpaṃ sravati bhānavī vāgbhavādyairnamoyuktaiḥ pūjayet suprasannadhīḥ bhagamālāmanuṃ procya tritārānantaraṃ tathā sarvāṇīti bhagānīti vaśamānaya me tataḥ ihāpyāvāhanaṃ nāsti jīvanyāso maheśvari iṣṭadevīṃ prapūjyātha sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavet mūlamantraṃ tataḥ oṃ namo śivāya tataḥ param tāraṃ ca śāntyatītāṃ ca tadaṅge tadanantaram vajreśvarīṃ kālikāṃ ca tathā dikcaravāsinīm tadanujñāṃ tato labdhvā dattvā tāmbūlameva ca dharmādharmahavirdīpte ātmāgnau manasā srucā svāhānto'yaṃ mahāmantra ārambhe parikīrtitaḥ prakāśākāśahastābhyāmavalambyonmanīsrucā svāhānto'yaṃ mahāmantraḥ śukratyāge prakīrtitaḥ sītkāro mantrarūpaṃ ca vacanaṃ stavanaṃ bhavet nakhadantakṣatādīni puṣpāṇi vividhāni ca darśanasparśane yonervikāraṃ (so) liṅgagharṣaṇam kulāmṛtaṃ prayatnena gṛhṇīyāddurlabhaṃ naraḥ yatkāmaṃ kurute mantrī tat kṣaṇādeva siddhyati bījāmṛtaṃ paraṃ brahma japannikṣipya sundari śrīvidyākramamabhyarcya parabrahmamayo bhavet savikalpastu satataṃ pāpabhāgjāyate naraḥ ata eva varārohe nirvikalpaḥ sadā bhavet

tadarghyeṇa samārādhya pūjāśeṣaṃ samāpayet devi padaṃ śukraśāpaṃ pramocaya padadvayam svāhāpadaṃ tato devi śukraśuddhirbhavet priye arghyadravyaiśca deveśi yonau devīṃ prapūjayet vidhāya vanditāṃ tāṃ ca taducchiṣṭaṃ svayaṃ caret ghoraṃ ca narakaṃ yāti kulamārgāt pateddhruvam ānandaṃ kārayedvīrastattvaṃ nirbhrāntitaḥ pibet tataḥ padmanibhāṃ devīṃ bālārkakiraṇāruṇām padmarāgapratikāśāṃ kuṃkumodarasaṃnibhām kālālikulasaṃkāśakuṭilālakapallavām kiñcidardhendukuṭilalalāṭamṛdupaṭṭikām ānandamuditollolalīlāndolitalocanām sugaṇḍamaṇḍalābhogajitendvamṛtamaṇḍalām tāmravidrumavimbābharaktoṣṭhīmamṛtopapām ratnadvi(dī)pasamudbhāsijihvāṃ madhurabhāṣiṇīm anaupamyaguṇopetacibukoddeśaśobhitām maṇikaṅkaṇakeyurabhārakhinnaiḥ praśobhitām karāmbujanakhajyotirvitānitanabhastalām trivalīvalayāyuktamadhyadeśasuśobhitām anargharatnaghaṭitakāñcīyuktanitambinīm kadalīlalitastambhasukumārorumīśvarīm gūḍhagulphapadadvandvaprapadājitakacchapām brahmaviṣṇuśiroratnanirghṛṣṭacaraṇāmbujām śītāṃśuśatasaṅkāśakāntisantānahāsinīm raktavastraparīdhānāṃ pāśāṃkuśakarodyatām

caturbhujāṃ trinetrāṃ ca pañcabāṇadhanurdharām mahāmṛgamadoddāmakuṃkumāruṇavigrahām jagadāhlādajananīṃ jagadrañjanakāriṇīm sarvamantramayīṃ devīṃ sarvasaubhāgyasundarīm evaṃ dhyāyet pareśānīṃ mahātripurasundarīm tattatsthāneṣu devyaṅge gandhāmbhobhyaktapuṣpakaiḥ layāṅgametat saṃproktaṃ devatābhāvasiddhidam bhogāṅgaṃ tatsamuddiṣṭaṃ devatāprītikārakam trivāraṃ prokṣayedevaṃ devaśuddhiritīritā trivāraṃ prokṣayedevaṃ devaśuddhiritīritā kartavyā siddhimicchadbhirdevatāprītikāriṇī svacchādarśe yathā yantre tathaiva pratibimbitāḥ samaṣṭipūjā sā proktā vyaṣṭipūjā tathocyate śrīsundaryaṅgalīnāstāḥ santu sarvasukhāvahāḥ bimbībhūtā vibhāvyaivaṃ tattatsthāneṣu deśikaḥ sarvasaubhāgyajanīpādukāṃ pūjayāmi ca pradarśayedyonimudrāṃ tataḥ saṃprāthayed budhaḥ anujñāṃ dehi deveśi parivārārcanāya me vahneḥ samastāvaraṇadevatā raśmirūpiṇaḥ manuścandraḥ kuberaśca lopāmudrā ca kāmarāṭ dūrvāsāśca tathā śakraḥ unmanī varuṇastathā īśānaśca ratiścaiva tathā nārāyaṇastathā etairupāsitā vidyā jāgratsvapnasuṣuptikāḥ pūjanīyāḥ prayatnena tāratrayapuṭāḥ kramāt pūjayāmi namaścoktvā yajet pañcopacārakaiḥ

cintanīyāḥ prayatnena sarvasaubhāgyadā budhaiḥ anena kramayogena vidyāvṛndaṃ prapūjayet nivedayenmahādevyai tarpaṇādi samācaret vibhāvya ca mahātryasraṃ dakṣapūrvottarakramāt pratipattithimārabhya paurṇamāsyantamadrije kṛṣṇapakṣe vicitrādikāmeśvaryantameva hi kāmeśvaryādikā nityā vicitrāntāḥ kramādyajet tattadvidyāṃ samuccārya tāratritayasaṃpuṭām namaḥpadaṃ mahādevi sarvatrāyaṃ kramaḥ smṛtaḥ nityaklinnā mahānityā bheruṇḍā vahnivāsinī tvaritā ca mahādevi tato vai kulasundarī jvālāmālinyatha tataścitrā tripurasundarī pāśāṃkuśau dhanurbāṇān pustakaṃ cākṣamālikām evaṃ kāmeśvarīṃ dhyāyed vaśyasaubhāgyavākpradām nānābhūṣaṇasaṃpannāṃ trailokyākarṣaṇakṣamām varadaṃ cābhayaṃ caiva dadhatī viśvamātaram raktāṃ raktāṅgavasanāṃ candracūḍāṃ trilocanām pāśāṃkuśau kapālaṃ ca mahābhītiharaṃ tathā candrakoṭipratīkāśāṃ sravantīmamṛtadravam indranīlasphuratkāntiṃ śikhivāhanaśobhitām dadhatīṃ cintayed devīṃ bheruṇḍāṃ viṣanāśinīm pāśāṃkuśau svastikaṃ ca śaktiṃ ca varadābhaye japākusumasaṃkāśāṃ raktāṃśukavirājitām pāśāṃkuśau kapālasthasudhāpānavighūrṇitām dūrvāvarṇā trinetrāṃ ca mahāsiṃhāsanāsanām

dadhatīṃ cintayennityāṃ śivadūtīṃ parāṃ śivām vṛṣalāhisumañjirāṃ phaṭāratnavibhūṣitām tanumadhyāṃ pīnavṛttakucayugmāṃ varābhaye guñjāruṇāṃ nṛpāhīndrakeyūrāṃ ratnabhūṣitām nīlakuñcitadhamillavarapuṣpāṃ kapālinīm sphuratsiṃhāsanaprauḍhāṃ saṃsmaret tvaritāṃ budhaḥ ratnamaṇḍapamadhye tu mahākalpavanāntare anargharatnaghaṭitamukuṭāṃ ratnakuṇḍalām hīramuktālasadbhūṣāṃ śuklakṣaumavirājitām śubhāṅgarāgasubhagāṃ karpuraśakalojjvalām varadānaratāṃ divyāṃ mahāsārasvatapradām śubhravastrāsanāṃ ramyāṃ candrakundasamadyutim anantamuktābharaṇāṃ sravantīmamṛtadravam udyadvidyullatākāntisvarṇāṃśukavirājitān ariśaṅkhau khaḍgakheṭau triśūlaṃ ḍamaruṃ tathā śubhrāṅgī jñānadā nityāṃ vicitravasanāṃ sadā varadābhayaśobhāḍhyāṃ nānāśastradharāṃ kvacit pāśāṃkuśau śarāṃścāpaṃ dhārayantīṃ śivāṃ śriye prāṅmadhyayonyantarāle gurupaṃktitrayaṃ yajet aṃguṣṭhamadhyamābhyāṃ ca gurūn samyak pratarpayet gurūn sampujayeddevi paramādigurūṃstathā guruśaktīryajed devi tataḥ śrīgurupādukāḥ athādiśivanāthaśca jñānāmbā ca sadāśivaḥ raudrī viṣṇustathā jyeṣṭhā brahmā vāmā parābhidhāḥ sanātanaścāpi sanatkukārastu tathaiva ca

vāmadevastathā vyāsaḥ śukaḥ siddhaughasaṃjñakāḥ bhāskaraśca mahādevi tatastasmānmahāśivaḥ ete sāmānyaguravaḥ śrīnāthādīn yajettataḥ paraśaktiśca kauleśaḥ śukladevī kuleśvaraḥ bhogaḥ klinnastu samayaḥ sahajo vedasaṃkhyakāḥ vimalo madanaścaiva bhuvano līla eva ca kāmarājākhyavidyāyā guravo'tra prakīrtitāḥ gurubhyo nama ityuktvā pādukābhyo namo vadet parameṣṭhina ācāryāstato nijagurūn yajet divyaughaśca mahaughaśca sarvākhyastadanantaram lopāmudrā prabhā māyā divyaścitrastathaiva ca mahodayaśca siddhaughāścidānandastathaiva ca kamalaśca paraścaiva manohara iti kramāt lopāmudrākhyavidyāyā guravaśca nijāstataḥ kāmeśvarī ca mokṣaścāpyamṛtaḥ puruṣastataḥ siddhaugha uttamaścaite catvāraḥ parikīrtitāḥ paramākhyaśca sarvajñaḥ sarvasaṃjñaśca siddhakaḥ śrīvidyāmātraguravastato nijagurukramāt jñānamudrāsudhāpūrṇakapālāḍhyakaradvayāḥ etān pañcopacāraistu yajet saṅghaṭṭamudrayā vasukoṇe tu pūrvādi śrīpātrāmṛtabindubhiḥ dakṣiṇāmnāyeśvarīṃ ca bhoginīṃ dakṣiṇe yajet uttarāmnāyeśvarīṃ ca kālikāmuttare yajet varābhayakarā raktāḥ pāśāṃkuśadharāḥ śubhāḥ āmnāyaṃ tu prapūjyātha samyagāyatanaṃ yajet

brāhmyadarśanagāyatrīṃ pūrvāyatanadevatām sauradarśanasūryaṃ ca paścimāyatanādhipam ūrdhvāyatanaśaivākhyadarśaneśaṃ śivaṃ yajet śaktiṃ yajedbinducakre devatāḥ paricintayet pañcopacārairārādhya liṅgamudrāṃ pradarśayet bahirdaśāre pūrvādi śrīpātrāmṛtabindubhiḥ vārāhīti maheśāni pañcaratnaṃ prakīrtitam mahāratneśvarīvṛndamaṇḍitāsanasaṃsthitā ityuccārya yajettatra yonimudrāṃ pradarśayet pañcaratnaṃ prapūjyātha pañca kalpalatā yajet śrīvidyā tvaritā caiva pārijāteśvarī tathā pāśāṃkuśakarā raktā nijāyudhakaradvayāḥ aṣṭapatre tu pūrvādi śrīpātrāmṛtabindubhiḥ dvitīyā caitanyarūpā kāmeśī tadanantaram siṃhāsanaṃ ca brahmākhyaṃ yajecca tadanantaram lalitābhairavī caiva kāmeśī bhairavī tathā dakṣiṇe saṃsthitāścaiva yajet saubhāgyahetave mṛtasañjīvinī caiva mṛtyuñjayaparā tathā siṃhāsanaṃ yajeddevi paścimāyāṃ diśi kramāt kamaleśībhairavīṃ ca siddhakauleśabhairavīm kālikāmīśvarākhyaṃ ca yajet siṃhāsanaṃ budhaḥ prathamā sundarī caiva dvitīyā sundarī tathā pañcamī sundarī caiva mahātripurasundarī varābhayakarā raktāḥ pāśāṃkuśakarāḥ śubhāḥ ṣoḍaśāre tu pūrvādi śrīpātrāmṛtabindubhiḥ

ajapā mātṛkā ceti pañca kośāḥ prakīrtitāḥ caturasre tu pūrvādi śrīpātrāmṛtabindubhiḥ triśaktiḥ sarvasāmrājyā lakṣmyaḥ pañca prakīrtitāḥ pañca lakṣmīḥ pūjayitvā pañca kāmadughā yajet śrīvidyāmṛtapīṭheśī sudhāsūramṛteśvarī pāśāṃkuśasudhāpātrakalaśā raktavigrahāḥ sthiticakre tu pūrvādi śrīpātrāmṛtabindubhiḥ vajravairocanī devī samayāḥ pañca prakīrtitāḥ samayā pūjanānte tu ṣaḍaṅgāvaraṇaṃ yajet bindumadhye caturdikṣu śrīpātrāmṛtabindubhiḥ sarvajñā nityatṛptā ca tathānādiprabodhinī nityānantā ca kathitā tathā bhogaṣaḍaṅgake varadābhayadhāriṇyaḥ pradhānatanavaḥ striyaḥ turīyopāsakānāṃ ca etānyāvaśyakāni vai atra madhyavidhānīśe navāvṛttirathāmbike turīyopāsakānāṃ ca etānyāvaśyakāni vai udīcyāṃ prayajed devi kṣobhaṇadrāvaṇau tataḥ agre saṃmohanaṃ yaṣṭvā cintayed bāṇadevatāḥ antardaśāre deveśi pārśvayoragrayostathā kāmamanmathakandarpamakaradhvajasaṃjñakāḥ varābhayakarā raktāḥ pañcabāṇadhanurdharāḥ sāmānyapātrasudhayā līnā vāgaparā parā jñānamudrābhayāḥ śuklā vīṇāpustakapāṇayaḥ agre ca bindumadhye ca sāmānyāmṛtabindubhiḥ jāgratsvapnasuṣuptyaśca turīyā ca prakīrtitāḥ

athāṣṭadalamūle ca vṛtte veṣṭanātha śive vāmā jyeṣṭhā tathā raudrī ambikecchā tathaiva ca bhūcarī khecarī caiva jayā ca vijayā tathā dalāṣṭamūlavṛtte tu vāmādyā divyabhūṣaṇāḥ muktācchatraṃ śaraccandracandrikāramyācamaraiḥ prāntamuktāvalīrājatsvarṇādarśaṃ ca pīṭhikām navaratnasphuraddīptiṃ tāmbūlasya karaṇḍakam caṣakaṃ svarṇaracitaṃ sudhākumbhaṃ kamaṇḍalum pūrṇaṃ ratnamayaṃ bhāṇḍaṃ kaṅkatīṃ gajadantajām tataḥ ṣoḍaśapatrābjamūlavṛtte maheśvari vidadhyādbhāvacinmāyānāthecchātuṣṭipuṣṭayaḥ kriyātmajñānalokāśca devavedau tathaiva ca śabdavarṇasvarāścaiva vargasaṃyogamantrakāḥ ṣoḍaśāramūlavṛtte raktā bhāvādiraśmayaḥ tataḥ ṣoḍaśapatrābjabāhye prathamavṛttake ḍākinī rākiṇī caiva lākinī kākinī tathā ṣoḍaśārabāhyavṛtte yoginyo ḍākinīmukhāḥ muṇḍamālāsamāyuktā daṃṣṭrābhīmamukhāmbujāḥ madhyavṛtte veṣṭanatve sāmānyasudhayā śive mahābhairavyatha siṃhabhairavī dhūmrabhairavī mohanākhyā bhairavīti bhairavyaḥ kathitāḥ priye pāśāṃkuśakarā bhīmāḥ kapālaśūlapāṇayaḥ tataḥ sāmānyasudhayā bhairavān daśa pūjayet agnijihva ca kālāntaṃ karālaṃ caikapādakam ṣoḍaśārāntyavṛtte tu herukādyā daśa sthitāḥ

meghaśyāmāḥ śavārūḍhāḥ kapāladaṇḍadhāriṇaḥ śṛṇu vakṣye mahādevi navāvaraṇapūjanam tatastrikoṇaṃ cāṣṭāraṃ daśāraṃ ca daśārakam baindavādaṣṭakoṇāntaṃ sarvamadhyamidaṃ bhavet vasupatraṃ kalāpatraṃ caturasraṃ kramāt priye catuṣṣaṣṭiryataḥ koṭyo yoginīnāṃ mahaujasām vinā gurūpadeśena sādhakaṃ bhakṣayanti hi sāmānyapātrasudhayā pūjayet siddhidevatāḥ dvāreṣu vāyukoṇādikoṇeṣu hyadha ūrdhvataḥ aṇimā mahimā caiva laghimā garimā tathā icchā prāptiḥ sarvakāmā mokṣasiddhiḥ kramāt priye mahābharaṇaratnāni sasuvarṇāni vai nidhīn trailokyamohane cakre madhyarekhāsamāśritāḥ pāśāṃkuśābhayavarakarāḥ prakaṭarūpakāḥ pūrvadvārādidvāreṣu śucikoṇādiṣu kramāt vārāhyaindrī ca cāmuṇḍā mahālakṣmīḥ kramāt priye kapālī bhīṣaṇaścaiva saṃhāraścāṣṭa bhairavāḥ cohārapīṭhaṃ deveśi jālandharamataḥ param mātaro bhairavāṅkasthāḥ smeravaktrāḥ madālasāḥ pāśāṃkuśadharāḥ sarvāḥ krameṇa dadhatīṃḥ smaret vajravaidūryamālāṃ ca padmaṃ ca varadaṃ tathā śūlaṃ kapālaṃ pretaṃ ca bibhrāṇāḥ kṣudradundubhim pāśāṃkuśavarābhītikarāḥ pīṭhāṣṭadevatāḥ evaṃ tṛtīyarekhāyāṃ siddhivat pūjayet priye sarvasaṃkṣobhiṇī caiva sarvavidrāviṇī tathā

sarvonmādinikā caiva tataḥ sarvamahāṃkuśā sarvayonistataḥ sarvatrikhaṇḍā parikīrtitā ghṛtapāśāṃkuśāḥ sarvāḥ svasvamudrākarāstathā pāśāṃkuśotpalābhītipāṇayo raktavigrahāḥ aṇimāsiddhipurataścakreśīṃ tripurāṃ yajet etāḥ prakaṭayoginyaścaturasre vyavasthitāḥ savāhanāśca saparivārāścaiva sasiddhayaḥ tarpitāḥ santviti vadejjalaṃ tatra viniḥkṣipet bhaktyā samarpaye tubhyaṃ prathamāvaraṇarcanam iti te kathitaṃ bhadre prathamāvaraṇārcanam tataḥ ṣoḍaśapatreṣu kāmākarṣiṇikāṃ yajet kāmākarṣiṇikā caiva buddhyākarṣiṇikā tathā sparśākarṣiṇikā caiva rūpākarṣiṇikā tathā cittākarṣiṇikā caiva dhairyākarṣiṇikā tathā bījākarṣiṇikā caivāmṛtākarṣiṇikā tathā sarvāśāpūrake cakre dalaṣoḍaśake sthitāḥ kalāṣoḍaśarūpāśca candramaṇḍalamadhyagāḥ pāśāṃkuśa(dharāḥ)sudhāpūrṇakāśmarīghaṭadānandāḥ (?) yajedvidrāviṇīṃ mudrāṃ darśayedbhāgyahetave cakre samudrā ityādi devyai puṣpāñjaliṃ kṣipet bhaktyā samarpaye tubhyaṃ dvitīyāvaraṇārcanam sarvasaṃkṣobhaṇe cakre dalāṣṭakavijṛmbhite pūrvādidikṣu patreṣu āgneyādividikṣu ca anaṅgamadanā paścādanaṅgamadanāturā anaṅgamālinī hyetā bandhūkakusumaprabhāḥ

anaṅgakusumāgre tu yajet tripurasundarīm etāguptatarāścaiva yoginyaḥ sarvasaṃ tataḥ devyai puṣpāñjaliṃ dadyādabhīṣṭheti ca mantravit sāmānyādbhiḥ paścimādivāmāvartakrameṇa ca sarvasaṃkṣobhiṇī śaktiḥ sarvavidrāviṇī tathā sarvasammohinī sarvastambhinī sarvajṛmbhiṇī tataḥ sarvonmādinī ca tathā sarvārthasādhinī sarvamantramayī śaktiḥ sarvadvandvakṣayaṅkarī sampradāyākhyayoginyaḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ pāśāṃkuśau darpaṇaṃ ca pānapātraṃ sudhāmayam sarvasaṃkṣobhiṇīpūrve yajet tripuravāsinīm tata etāḥ sampradāyayoginya iti vai kramāt bahirdaśārake cakre sāmānyasudhayā śive sarvasiddhipradā devī sarvasampatpradā tathā sarvakāmapradā devī sarvaduḥkhavimocinī sarvāṅgasundarī devī sarvasaubhāgyadāyinī sarvasiddhipradādyāśca yoginyaḥ sarvakāmadāḥ mahāsaubhāgyagambhīrāḥ pīnavṛttaghanastanāḥ nānāratnamayān dīpān dadhatyo hasitānanāḥ sarvasiddhipradāgre tu cakreśīṃ tripurāṃ yajet etāśca kulakaulākhyayoginya iti pūrvavat sarvarakṣākare cakre'ntardaśāre maheśvari sarvajñā sarvaśaktiśca sarvaiśvaryapradā tathā sarvādhārasvarūpā ca sarvapāpaharā tathā pūjanīyā prayatnena sarvepsitaphalapradā

sarvajñādyāśca yoginyo jvalatpāvakatejasaḥ pāśaṭaṅkāyudhajñānamudrāvaradasatkarāḥ devyai saṃdarśayed devi mudrāṃ sarvamahāṃkuśām cakre samudrā ityādi dadyāt puṣpāñjaliṃ tataḥ paścimādi krameṇaiva vaśinyādyā yajet kramāt jayinī sarveśvarī ca kaulinī vāgaghīśvarī yoginyaḥ kāmadāyinyau dāḍimīkusumaprabhāḥ nānābharaṇasampannāḥ pañcabāṇadhanurdharāḥ yajet tripurasiddhāṃ ca cakreśīṃ vaśinīpuraḥ etā rahasyayoginya ityādi ca maheśvari antarāle mahācakre sarvasiddhipradābhidhe kāmeśvarasya kāmeśyā jṛmbhakā bāṇadevatāḥ stambhakākhyā mahādevi tathaivāṃkuśadevatāḥ rudrātmaśaktisahitā kāmeśī sarvasiddhidā pīṭhe pūrṇagirau caivoḍḍīśanāthātmikā tataḥ vajreśvarī mahādevī tatastṛtīyakoṇake ṣaṣṭheśanāthātmikā ca tathā suṣuptyadhiṣṭhitā bindumadhye maheśāni kūṭatrayavijṛmbhite caryānāthātmikā caiva turīyādhiṣṭhitā tataḥ sarvasiddhiprade cakre yoginyaḥ siddhidāyikāḥ kāmeśvarīmukhāstisraḥ koṇatrayavirājitāḥ raktāḥ vidyullatākārā uddāmakusumānvitāḥ varābhaye sudhāpātraṃ dhārayantyaḥ sukhāvahāḥ muktāphalasphuradbhūṣā nānābharaṇabhūṣitā dadhato cāgrakoṇasthā rudraśaktiḥ prikīrtitā

bālārkavasanā nīlakarṇacumbivilocanā dakṣakoṇasthitā devī viṣṇuśaktiriyaṃ matā anargharatnaghaṭitabhūṣaṇā bhuvaneśvarī brahmaśaktirmaheśānī tāpatrayanikṛntanī cakreśīṃ tripurāmbāṃ ca kāmeśīpurato yajet etā atirahasyākhyā yoginya iti pūrvavat binducakre maheśāni sarvānandamayābhidhe kūṭatrayakrameṇaiva ratiḥ pratirmanobhavā sarvamantreśvarī caiva sarvacakreśvarī tathā sarvabhogeśvarī caiva sarvavīreśvarī tathā sarvavidyeśvarī caiva sarvasiddheśvarī tathā (--------------------) sarvacakreśvarī tathā) parāpararahasyākhyā yoginya iti pūrvakāḥ pāśāṃkuśadharāḥ sarvā jñānamudrābhaye tathā śrīvidyābhimukhāḥ sarvā devatāḥ paricintayet athavā raśmayaḥ sarvā devīrūpeṇa cintayet cakreśīṃ ratipūrve tu mahātripurabhairavīm parāpararahasyākhyā yoginītyādinā priye daśamaḥ śvāsaḥ ṣoḍaśairupacāraistu sāṅgaṃ sāvaraṇaṃ śivam mahāṣoḍhotitāśeṣaparivārāṃśca śāmbhavi parāprāsādamantreṇa turīyāvidyayāthavā gurupātrāmṛtenaivāthavā śrīpātrabindubhiḥ paramādiśivaśrī ca pādukāṃ tarpayāmi ca binducakre ca pūrvādicaturdikṣu ca madhyataḥ

īśatatpuruṣāghoravāmasadyādimūlakaiḥ rudraśambhuparāṇāṃ ca viśrānticaraṇān yajet pūjanīyāḥ pratyatnena sarvakāmārthasiddhaye yogmaśaḥ pārśvayugmeṣu śrīpātrāmṛtabindubhiḥ ghṛtapāśāṃkuśā raktā varadābhayapāṇayaḥ caturdikṣu tatho'rdhvādhaḥ śrīpātrāmṛtabindubhiḥ īśānasya kalā iṣṭvā manvasre puruṣasya tu ṣoḍaśacchadapadme tu vāmedevakalā yajet śrīcakrasthāntarāleṣu kesareṣu ca vai kramāt mahāṣoḍoditāśeṣadevatāḥ paripūjayet itthaṃ pūjāṃ vidhāyātha ṣoḍaśairupacārakaiḥ dadyāt karpūrasahitaṃ tāmbūlaṃ paraśaktaye yathāśakti japaṃ kuryāt stutiṃ ca parameśvari phalaṃ kalpalatānāṃ ca cāruratnasphuratkalam nityānandi paraṃ brahmadhāma naumi sukhāptaye gandhena culukaṃ madhye mudrāṃ vā tatra vai nyaset bhrāmayedratnavidyābhistridhā bhṛtvā tu mastake vāmakarṇaviśobhāḍyā bindubhūṣitamastakāḥ ratneśvarī devatā syānmāyābījaṃ tu bījakam svaprakāśe tu deveśi viniyogaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ārā(rti ? tri)kamidaṃ devi gṛhāṇa mama siddhaye vahatpuṭena hastābhyāṃ maṇḍaloddhāralakṣaṇam tāraṃ ca bhuvaneśānīṃ vyāpakādi ca maṇḍalam annodamiśraṃ bhāgena sādhāraṃ puṣpapūjitam tāraṃ parāṃ sarvavighnakṛdbhyaḥ sarva ca bhū likhet

pūrvoktabalidānaṃ tu kuryādvighnopaśāntaye tataḥ kumārīḥ santarpya tripureśyānayāthavā khecaryāḥ śakticakrasya svāminīṃ saṃvidaṃ parām śivakoṇe deśikebhyo nirmālyaṃ siddhaye kṣipet nāmamantreṇa ca svasya tarpayedupadeśataḥ punarādhāragaṃ kuryādācāre dīpalakṣaṇam kapālinyā vāpi pātraṃ tayā vāpi samuddharet tattvatrayeṇa saṃyogāttarpayet svāntavāsinīm tṛtīyamīśarūpaṃ ca vijñeyaṃ munisattamaiḥ śrīgurorājñayā devi svayaṃ śrītripurā bhavet ākṛṣya mantrāt tatrasthaṃ śiṣikābhyo'kṣatādikam anarghyamapi vijñeyamakṣaraiḥ kathitaṃ mayā gopitavyaṃ tvayā bhadre jananījāragarbhavat sahasrajanmajaṃ pāpaṃ hanti māsena deśikaḥ avaśyaṃ sarvakāleṣu paramājñādharo bhavet samudravalayāṃ pṛthvīṃ saṃprāpya sukhamedhate sa buddhimān bhaveddevi sarvatra vijayī bhavet svayambhūbāṇadeśe vā śaivasthāne maheśvari muktārudrākṣapadmākṣasphaṭikodbhavayā tathā japtvā lakṣaikamātre tu bhūcaryo vighnakārikāḥ tadā lakṣatrayaṃ kuryānniyamena śucirbudhaḥ manasoccāraṇaṃ devi japakoṭiphalapradam vācikāt mukhapātraṃ syācchrīgurorājñayā priye kusumbhapuṣpairjuhuyānmadhuratrayasamplutaiḥ yonikuṇḍe bhagākāre vartulendvardhayoḥ priye

vākpatiryonikuṇḍe tu bhage cākarṣaṇaṃ bhavet navatrikoṇe mahatīkhecarīsiddhivān bhavet śāntikaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ lakṣmīrārogyaṃ vasukoṇake mallikāmālatībhiśca trimadhvaktairvacaspatiḥ yoṣidvaśyā tato devī karpūraṃ kuṃkumaṃ madam cāmpeyaiḥ pāṭalai ramyairāmrairanyaiḥ phalairhunet śrīkhaṇḍaṃ cāgaruṃ devi karpūraṃ gugguluṃ hunet hutvā phalaṃ trimadhvaktaṃ khecaratvaṃ catuṣpathe athavā navalakṣa tu japedvidyāṃ samāhitaḥ sādhayet svargabhūlokapātālatalavāsinaḥ dadhnā śatāṣṭakaṃ hutvā kālamṛtyuṃ vināśayet madhvājyaguggulenaiva rājendraṃ vaśamānayet madhvājyāktai raktavarṇaiḥ karavīraiḥ saguggulaiḥ madhvaktakaravīraistu sāṅgaṃ bhūpaṃ vaśaṃ nayet pāṭalairyūthikākundaiḥ śatapatraiśca jātibhiḥ pūjanāddhavanādvāpi miśrairvā'miśritairapi mucukundairbilvapatreḥ phalairasitanīrajaiḥ nārikelaiśca kharjūrairdrākṣābhiścūtasatphalaiḥ pūjanena ca homena śrīvidyāṃ paritoṣayet pūrvoktabalidānena guruṃ santoṣya ca kramāt samagraṃ kusumaṃ home kuṣmāṇḍaṃ bahudhā hunet samagreṇaiva cūtasya phalena badaraṃ tathā jambūphalaṃ samagraṃ syāddrākṣāṃ caiva tathā hunet phalaṃ laghu samagraṃ syāt kastūrī kuṃkumaṃ śaśī tathaiva lavaṇaṃ lājā muṣṭipātraṃ hunedbudhaḥ

pūrṇaṃ tu kramukārdhena śrīkhaṇḍaṃ kramukākṛti kuṇḍasya pūjanaṃ vakṣye mahāvighnavināśanam khātaṃ ca racayet kuṇḍaṃ sarvatra sumanoharam sarvatraikāṃgulaṃ tyaktvā tisraḥ kāryāḥ suśobhanāḥ caturaṃgulavistārāstisro'pi parameśvari ravyaṃgulisuvistārāṃ vasvaṃgulisuvistṛtām lakṣaṇaṃ caturasrasya kathitaṃ tava sundari tena mānena sarvāṇi kuṇḍāni racayed budhaḥ dakṣiṇādyūttarāntaṃ tu tisrastisraśca kārayet śarkarāṃ vikirettatra trikoṇaṃ tatpuṭaṃ likhet uparyupari bhedena tatra pīṭhaṃ samarcayet ādhāraśaktikūrmau ca tato'nantaṃ varāhakaṃ pātrāṇi kesarāṇyevaṃ tattatsthāneṣu pūjayet adharmāścaiva koṇeṣu pīṭhasya paripūjayet madhye ṛtumatīṃ vedamātaraṃ vedamasyakām vahniṃ kuṇḍe paribhrāmya kiñcidaṅgārakaṃ tyajet paścāt prajvālayedvahniṃ jñānāgneḥ saṃkrameṇa tu śvāsamārgeṇa manuvidyonimārgeṇa saṃkṣipet ādau vyāhṛtibhiḥ paścādvahnimantreṇa ca kramāt sarvajñājñāpaya svāhā manunā prārthayet tataḥ suvarṇavarṇamamalaṃ samiddhaṃ viśvatomukham saṣaśā valarāyaśca ramasvasvarayā(rayaṣaṣṭhasvarā)nvitāḥ padmarāgā suvarṇā ca tṛtīyā bhadralohitā krameṇa yojayedbījairvinyaset parameśvari surāśca pitaraścaiva gandharvā yakṣapannagāḥ

sahasrārciḥ svastipūrṇaṃ uttiṣṭhapuruṣastathā ṅahṛdantaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgāni tato mūrtyaṣṭakaṃ nyaset aśvodayaiścaturthaḥ syādvaiśvānara ume tataḥ mūrdhāṃsapārśvakaṭyandhukaṭipārśvāsakeṣu ca evaṃ vinyastadehaḥ san paryukṣyārghyajalena ca vaiśvānara tato jātaveda paścādihāvaha svāhānto'ṇurayaṃ tāraṃ vaktre citpiṅgalo'pi ca madhye ca koṇaṣaṭke ca tato'ṅgāni prapūjayet punarvaiśvānaraṃ japtvā trinetramaruṇaprabham varaṃ śaktiṃ svastikaṃ cābhītiṃ hastaiśca vibhratam arghyodakena pātrāṇi prokṣayecchuddhaye tataḥ praṇītāprokṣaṇīyugme jalaṃ sthālyāṃ ghṛtaṃ tathā srukpātre ca sruve pātre ghṛte puṣpaṃ vinikṣipet mekhalāsu ca sarvāsu veṣṭayeddīpamālikāḥ brahmāṇaṃ dakṣiṇe'bhyarcya hunedvaiśvānarāṇunā anena vidhinābhyarcya śrīcakraṃ tatra cintayet samastacakracakreśīsahitāṃ homayet tataḥ samastacakracakreśīḥ prakaṭādyāśca yoginīḥ tataḥ pūrvoktasudravyairhomayet subhagāṃ parām rudraraktā suvarṇā ca sarvakāmaphalāptaye uccāṭanaṃ ca dhūminyāṃ karālinyāṃ ca māraṇam kṛte vighnaughaśamanaṃ nānyathā varavarṇini vasukoṣṭhaṃ likhet kūrmaṃ madhye sthāne prakalpayet kādyā vargāstu saptaite pūrvādikramato likhet sthānākṣaraṃ yatra devi siddhistatra na saṃśayaḥ

tatra śūnyaṃ phalaṃ madhyakoṣṭhayugmaṃ tu mṛtyudam rogahānikarau pucchaṃ tayormadhyagataṃ bhavet tathaiva siddhirnānyatra śrīgurorājñayā priye dīpāvaso'pi kartavyaḥ kiṃ punarhavane yajet svabhambhūkusumāktaiśca kusumairakṣatairyajet gāyatrī samyaguccārya tadante'pyamukaṃ tataḥ tataścāmukadevīśrīpādukāṃ pūjayāmi ca saptāhābhyantare mantrī vāṃchitaṃ samavāpnuyāt tattadbhūtārṇakiraṇairvṛtāścakrasthadevatāḥ evaṃ saṃsiddhavidyāyā viniyogakrama śṛṇu sādhyapratikṛtiṃ nāma lekhanyaikāṃ śubhāṃ tataḥ tyaktvā lajjāṃ samāyāti hyathānyat kathyate priye ātmānaṃ ca tathā sādhyaṃ tathā saubhāgyasundaraḥ yasya nāmnā punaḥ samyak sa bhaveddāsa eva hi yonimudrādharo bhūtvā vegādākarṣaṇaṃ bhavet gorocanākuṃkumābhyāṃ samabhāgaṃ ca candanam puṣpaṃ phalaṃ jalaṃ cānnaṃ gandhaṃ vastraṃ ca bhūṣaṇam aṅganā vīkṣaṇādeva dāsī cāsya bhavet priye cintayan māsamātraṃ hi sādhyākhyāṃ lalanāṃ tataḥ sindūraracite cakre rājānaṃ mohayet kṣaṇāt cittāṅgāreṇa cakraṃ tu likhedraktadraveṇa hi arkanimbadravābhyāṃ tu likhinyārkasya saṃlikhet dhūpayeccandanaṃ rātrau vastraṃ vā dhārayet tataḥ liptagomayabhūmau tu likhedrocanayā tataḥ tadbhālagalahṛnnābhijanmamaṇdalayojitam

sarvāṅgasandhisaṃlīnaṃ kāmakūṭaṃ samālikhet kṣobhiṇībījamudrābhyāṃ vidyāmaṣṭaśataṃ japet sānurāgātivimalā kāmasāyakapīḍitā athavā mātṛkācakraṃ bāhyaṃ saṃveṣṭya mantravit avadhyaḥ sarvaduṣṭānāṃ vyāghrādīnāṃ na saṃśayaḥ svanāma kramato lekhyaṃ pūrvavanmātṛkāṃ likhet anenaiva prakāreṇa rocanāgurukuṃkumaiḥ trailokyamohano mantrī bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ sādhyanāmnastrikoṇāntarmātṛkāṃ veṣṭayedbahiḥ lokapālāśca rājāno duṣṭāstrailokyasaṃsthitāḥ anena vidhinā nāma purīṃ sandarbhya saṃkṣipet tasya saubhāgyamāyāti rājānaḥ kiṅkarāḥ sadā cakrāntaścintayennityaṃ māsaṣaṭkaṃ tato naraḥ dṛṣṭyākarṣayate lokān viṣaṃ nāśayati jvarān rātrau sindūralikhitaṃ pūjayedekacittataḥ akhaṇḍaṃ dikṣu koṇeṣu krameṇa paripūjayet bhūrjapatre likheccakraṃ rocanāgurukuṃkumaiḥ maṇḍalaṃ viṣamasthānaṃ bhūmau cakraṃ nidhāpayet unmattarasalākṣārkakṣīrakuṃkumarocanāḥ yannāma tasya deveśi caurajaṃ vyāghrajaṃ bhayam ahijaṃ vājijaṃ vāsti sarvān mohayati kṣaṇāt trikoṇobhayagāṃ caiva sādhyanāmāṅkitāmadhaḥ pītadravyeṇa cakrānte likhedvidyāmadhastataḥ tasmādbrahmāpi jīvo'pi sarvajño mūkatāṃ vrajet dakṣiṇābhimukho mantrī vahnau dagdhvā ripūn dahet

āranālasthitaṃ kuryādbhavedvidveṣaṇaṃ kṣaṇāt saṃlikhya rocanādravyairākāśe dṛṣṭigaṃ yathā mahānīlīrasodbhinnarocanādugdhamiśritaiḥ anena vidhinā nīre sthāpayet tajjalena tu pītaṃ cakraṃ yajet pūrve stambhayet sarvavādinaḥ paścime pūjitaṃ cakraṃ gairikālikhitaṃ tataḥ tathaiva dakṣiṇāsyastu kṛṣṇaṃ cakraṃ samarcayet kramāddigantarāsyaḥ san vahnikoṇādiṣu kramāt dugdhe vaśyakaraṃ kṣiptaṃ rocanālikhitaṃ haṭhāt gomūtramadhyagaṃ caitadbhaveduccāṭanaṃ ripoḥ sindūreṇa likheccakraṃ nirjane tu catuṣpathe kulācārakrameṇaiva rātrau sampūjayet kramam caturdaśyāṃ niśi svastho rudrabhūmau prapūjayet añjanaṃ vivaraṃ siddhiṃ guṭikāṃ pādukāñjanam sakalaṃ siddhijananaṃ mantrī prāpnoti nānyathā ekaviṃśatirātraṃ tu niśi pretasthito jale pāśāṃkuśadhanurbāṇaiḥ pauruṣeyairmaheśvari hartā kartā svayaṃ caiva mahadākarṣaṇaṃ bhavet puruṣākarṣaṇaṃ caitadrājānaḥ kiṅkarāḥ priye vāgbhavārādhane devi jñānaṃ sārasvataṃ bhavet anena vidhinā devi vāgbhavārādhanaṃ bhavet kāmamanmathakandarpā makaradhvaja eva ca kāmaṃ manmathamadhyasthaṃ devi kandarpaveśmagam anena kāmatattvena mohayejjagatīmimām tasmāt kuṇḍalinī śaktiḥ śaktikūṭe maheśvari

catuṣṣaṣṭiryataḥ koṭyo yoginīnāṃ mahaujasām tato vāgbhavakūṭaṃ ca yadadyakacca vṛtrahan śaktikūṭaṃ samālikhya sarvaṃ tadindra te vaśe tataḥ sarvajanaṃ me'nte vaśamānaya ṭhadvayam sarvavaśyakaraḥ puṃsāmāyurārogyasiddhidaḥ ardhaṃ saṃvādasūktasya punarardhaṃ kramāllikhet pratyahaṃ japataḥ puṃso yathāśakti viśeṣataḥ kubera iva vittāḍhyo jāyate bhuvi mānavaḥ ṛkpañcakaṃ samākhyātaṃ mahāsārasvatapradam vavasvidasyāḥ paramaṃ jagāma dhenurvāgasmānupa suṣṭutaituḥ manuṣyā vadanti deveṣvamṛtamajuryam palastijamadagnayo dadhuḥ sundarī garbhagaṃ japyāt pṛthakpṛthagatandritaḥ bahuśrutaḥ śāstrakartā śrutān vedāgamānapi sakalahrīṃ amṛtasya deva dhāraṇo bhūyāsam manasaḥ kāmamākūtiṃ sakalahrīṃ vācaḥ satyamaśīmahi śubhayā smṛtyā saṃyunavatu caturthī tvaṃ soma praceti pañcamī tu prajāpate yo narastasya niyataṃ dhanadhānyadharāsutaiḥ lakṣmīṃ samāvahedramyāṃ putrapautrādigāminīm vayaṃ syāma patayo rayīṇām patayo rayīṇām sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ

dhīrāḥ rayīṇām dhanairdhānyaiśca vibhavairanyaiścāśvagavādibhiḥ sampuṭīkṛtya japatāṃ phalānyācakṣmahe sphuṭam śrīsūktaiḥ kāmarājākhyāṃ prajapedyatnato budhaḥ tṛtīyena caturthena vandhyādoṣavināśanam saptamena tu garbhasya sthiratā hyaṣṭamena tu daśamena pareṇāpi puṣpadoṣān vināśayet pumapatyaṃ bhavatyeva caturbhistatparairdhruvam tṛtīyena bhaveddhānyaṃ caturthena mahīṃ labhet saptamādrājasammānamaṣṭamena dhṛtiḥ sthirā ekādaśena vastrāṇi dvādaśena sutāṁllabhet pṛthivīṃ śasyasampannāṃ śriyaṃ pañcadaśena tu śrīvidyāvṛndanivahastvevaṃ sampuṭito yadi jāyante tatkramaṃ jñātvā gurutaḥ śāstrato'pi vā dīkṣā tu ṣoḍaśārṇāyāḥ (ṣaḍdarśanavidhā bhavet caturviṃśatihastaṃ tu maṇḍapaṃ kārayedbudhaḥ yonikuṇḍāni vā kuryādardhacandranibhāni vā aṣṭāstrāṇyathavācāryakuṇḍamīśendramadhyataḥ hastamātraṃ parityajya kuṇḍānyanyāni kalpayet dīkṣāyāṃ ṣoḍaśārṇāyāṃ japahomeṣu ṛtvijām nārāyaṇaṃ vāsudevaṃ varāhaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ tathā pañcadaśyāṃ samāyojya jape home ca pārvati jātavedasapañcarcaṃ devīlakṣmyostu sūktake prāsādaṃ vāpāśupataṃ dakṣiṇāmūrtisaṃjñakam

saure tu ghṛṇimantraṃ ca ṣaḍarṇaṃ vedavarṇakam ajapākhyaṃ tu śākte tu bālāmantraśca bhairavī bhairavī tripurāmbā ca bauddhe padmāvatī tathā mātaṅgī sumukhī caiva caṇḍamātaṅginī tathā mūlavidyāḥ ṣoḍaśaiva dīkṣāyāṃ śrīgurormanoḥ śambhoścaraṇavidye dve parāprasādasaṃjñake ekārṇaṃ gāṇapatye tu mahāgaṇapatiṃ tathā lakṣmīgaṇapatiṃ caiva herambagaṇapaṃ tathā dakṣiṇākālikāyāstu ekārṇaṃ tryarṇameva ca daśākṣaradvayaṃ caiva tārāyāṃ ṣoḍaśākṣarī śrīvākkāmaparāruddhā trividhā tripuṭā tathā ṣaṭkūṭā saptakūṭā syādaṣṭakūṭā tu pañcamī pītāmbarāṣṭavārāhyo dīkṣāyāṃ tu parasparam jayākhyā ca navārṇā ca śāntyagnilavaṇātmikā pañcāyatanabhedaistu saure śākte ca vaiṣṇave vaiṣṇavāṣṭakamadhye tu hitvā svāṣṭadaśākṣaram śaive pāśupataṃ hitvā tatra traiyambakaṃ kṣipet gāṇapatye gaṇānāṃ tvā hitvocchiṣṭaṃ gaṇeśvaram etadāyatanānāṃ cāpyaṅgāṅgitvaṃ parasparam ṣaṭśāmbhavopadeśe tu hyaṅgāṅgitvaṃ parasparam siddhalakṣmī rājyalakṣmīrvānyadbhedatrayaṃ punaḥ anyavidyāsu mantreṣu tattadbhedaiḥ parasparam pañcāyatanadīkṣāyāṃ pūjāyāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ mahāgaṇeśamantreṇa ghṛṇimantreṇa saṃyutā saṃyojya ṣoḍaśārṇāṃ tu dīkṣāyāṃ japapūjanāt
