māṇikyali(khya ? khi)taṃ yantraṃ rājyadaṃ bhuktidaṃ matam kḷptaṃ marakate yantraṃ sarvaśatruvināśanam tanme vadasva kṛpayā yadyahaṃ tava vallabhā tāmrasya ravibhāgena pīṭha kuryānmanoharam śāntidaṃ puṣṭidaṃ proktaṃ sarvaśatrunivarhaṇam pātālavāsināṃ devi prastāro nimnarekhakaḥ svargalokādivāsānāṃ yantrāṇmerusaṃjñakaḥ kramātsamunnataṃ sarvaṃ merurūpaṃ mayoditam nimnarekhāsamāyogādbhūprastāro mayoditaḥ gopitavyaṃ tvayā bhadre svaguhyamiva santatam unnatonnatamāmadhyāccakraṃ syānnidhanaṃ dhanam ekadviṣaṭkramonnāmaṃ śriyai kīrtye ca kalpate bhūcakraṃ ṣoḍaśāraṃ cāpyaṣṭāraṃ ca samaṃ bhavet caturasraṃ samaṃ devi ṣoḍaśārādibindukam caturasraṃ samārabhya bindvantaṃ samarekhakam phalakāyāṃ paṭe bhittau sthāpayenna kadācana kulaṃ vittamapatyaṃ ca nirmūlayati sarvathā palapramāṇaṃ kartavyamarcāpīṭhaṃ manoharam tasmin pīṭhe ca nirmāṇaṃ śrīcakrasya tu kārayet agniraṃgulavistāro yavārdhenocchritirbhavet sthitikrameṇa pūjā syāt sthiticakre maheśvari pratyekaṃ trividhaṃ jñeyaṃ tatsāṅkaryāt prayatnataḥ unnatonnatamāmadhyaṃ vijñeyaṃ deśikottamaiḥ samordhvarekhānavakaṃ same pīṭhe ca yadbhavet sūkṣmarekhaṃ bhavettatra sthitisthityātmakaṃ śive

ardhaṃ kramādunnataṃ yaccaturasrāditastataḥ vaiparītyena caitasya sthitisṛṣṭyātmatā bhavet kramonnataṃ tadūrdhvaṃ tu samaṃ syānnimnarekhakam layasṛṣṭyātmakatvaṃ tu proktaṃ jñeyaṃ manīṣibhiḥ layasthityātmakaṃ proktaṃ vaiparītyena tasya tu sthitisthityātmakaṃ cakraṃ praśastaṃ gṛhamedhinām sṛṣṭisthityātmakaṃ cakramaprajatvaṃ śriyaṃ labhet sthitisṛṣṭyātmakaṃ yantraṃ putrāyurdhanavṛddhidam anye proktāstu ye bhedāḥ śrīcakrasya maheśvari tasmāt sarvaprayatnena parīkṣyaiva samācaret sthiticakre tu sthityantā saṃhāre tu layāntatā prāptaṃ śrīguruṇā dattaṃ gurujyeṣṭhakaniṣṭhakaiḥ pūjāṃ tatra prakurvīta sthityantāṃ parameśvari sthāne samatale ślakṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā haṃsapadaṃ sudhīḥ vṛttaṃ tu parito bhrāntvā tanmadhye sthāpayedbudhaḥ ṣaḍaṃgulaparīṇāhamūlaṃ śilpivareṇa tu śaṃkvagracchāyāsaṃpātasthānayościhnayugmakam datvā vṛttāyatādhana sūtreṇecchādhikena vā vidhāya ca tayoḥ sandhidvayaprāpi prasārayet etasyārddhāṃśamānena kṛtvā koṇeṣu lāñchanam kṛtvā vṛtte tu yatra syācchāyāyāḥ parameśvari praviṣṭanirgatācchāyā yadā tanmadhyanāḍikāḥ antaraṃ dinayoriṣṭaiścaturādyairvibhāgataḥ nāḍībhiḥ kalpitā bhāgā guṇanīyāḥ prayatnataḥ prācīsūtraṃ pūrvabhāge uttare tūttarāyaṇe

cālyate cet sphuṭā sā syātprācī tu parameśvari vyāsārdhamāne śaṃkvardhaṃ sārdhe'sminkarṣaṇāya ca śaṃkvaṅke'rvākśroṇirevamudagvyatyasya cāṃsakau daṇḍayoragranaikaṭye'nyastiryamadhyacihnataḥ mūladeśe lambasūtramaspṛśadbhāravadbhuvam skhalettatpūrayedanyannimnayedvāpi yuktitaḥ bhānorgatyā diśo jñātvā puṇyāhaṃ vācayet sudhīḥ jyeṣṭhamadhyādhamatvena tanmānaṃ trividhaṃ matam hastairviṃśatibhiḥ kecinmānamuttamamūcire adhamaṃ daśabhirhastairmitamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ hastairmittaṃ vadantyeva vistārāyāmasaṃyutam dikṣu dvārāṇi catvāri sāṣṭāṃgulakaradvayāt tato maṇḍapasūtraṃ tu triguṇaṃ parikalpayet iṣṭakābhirmṛdā vā sā kāryā darpaṇasannibhā te cottame tadardhoccā madhyamādhamayoḥ punaḥ ṛjavaḥ pañcahastāste saśikhāstu samantataḥ samāntarālāḥ sarve te sthāpyāḥ ṣoḍaśa deśikaiḥ madhyastambhacatuṣkāgrādekībhutāgrakaṃ punaḥ śobhitaṃ kalaśenātha mukhasthena sudārujam ācchādayettato vaṃśaiḥ kaṭaiḥ karadalaiśca tam aśvatthodumbaraplakṣavaṭotthaṃ toraṇaṃ nyaset viśālatā ca tasyātha daśabhistvaṃgulairmatā madhyabhāge toraṇayostiryak kāṣṭhaṃ pravinyaset agnimīlītimantreṇa vinyaset pūrvatoraṇam agna āyeti mantreṇa paścimasya niveśanam

ūrdhve dhvajaṃ ca badhnīyāt ghaṇṭācāmarabhūṣitam tatastu lokapālānāṃ patākā bāhusammitāḥ pītāraktaśyāmadhūmrāśvetadhūmrāsitārjunāḥ yathāyogyaṃ daṇḍayutāstattanmantreṇa tānnyaset dukūlaveṣṭitastambhaṃ nānādīpādyalaṃkṛtam veṣṭitaṃ darbharajjvā ca vidadhyānmaṇḍapaṃ śubham aṣṭottaraśatairhastaiḥ śatahastairathāpi vā ṣaṣṭihastairaṣṭacatvāriṃśadbhirhastakaiḥ kramāt caturviṃśatihastairvā maṇḍapaṃ kārayedbudhaḥ trikoṇamaṣṭapatrābhaṃ navakoṇaṃ dvikoṇakam dvādaśaṃ ṣoḍaśaṃ cāṣṭādaśaviṃśatikoṇakam dvātriṃśatkoṇakaṃ caiva ṣaṭtriṃśatkoṇakaṃ tathā śūrpakuntāsiśṛṅgāṭadhanurmudgarakākṛtiḥ pūrṇābhiṣeke dīkṣāyāmabhiṣekādiśāntiṣu kartavyāni viśeṣeṇa tattakarmaṇyatandritaiḥ teṣu sūkṣmā visarpante reṇukāstrasareṇavaḥ te'ṣṭau keśāhvayāste'ṣṭau likṣā yukāstadaṣṭakam sā tūttamāṃguliḥ saptayavā saiva tu madhyamā vinyastaistiryagaṣṭābhiryavairmānāntarāṃgulam ācāryadakṣiṇakare madhyamāṃgulimadhyagam vināṃguṣṭhena śeṣābhirmuṣṭimaṃgulibhiḥ kṛtam yaṃ kaṃcitpauruṣāyāmaṃ vibhajya daśadhā punaḥ dehalabdhāṃgulaṃ nāma jānīyāt tasya tatpunaḥ mahāmānāṃguliriti mātrāṃgulirihocyate vedikāpīṭhaśivikārathādīnāṃ vidhiḥ punaḥ

yāgopakaraṇānāṃ ca kuryānmānāṃgulena vai dehalabdhāṃgulenaiva pratimāṅgāni kalpayet catuṣkuṇḍī madhyame syātkaniṣṭhe'pyekakuṇḍakam śūle navāṃgulaṃ dairghya turīyāṃśena vistṛtiḥ hīne caivaṃ samākhyātaṃ dvyaṃgulaṃ ropayettathā prāgādikramayogena nyasetteṣāṃ svadārujam navaikādaśabhāgaistāmiṣṭakābhiḥ prakalpayet tato bhūmitale śuddha tuṣāṅgāravivarjite pañcibhaḥ saptabhirhastairnavabhirvā mitāntaram aṣṭahastasamucchrāyāḥ saṃsthāpyā dvādaśābhitaḥ tatpañcamāṃśaṃ nikhanenmedinyāṃ tantravittamaḥ dvāreṣu toraṇāni syuḥ kramāt kṣīramahīruhām daśāṃgulapramāṇena tatparīṇāha īritaḥ śūlāni kalpayenmadhye toraṇe hastamānataḥ vitānadarbhamālādyairalaṃkurvīta maṇḍapam caturasrāṃ tato vedīṃ maṇḍalāya prakalpayet kṣetraṃ vibhajya madhyeṃ'śe pūrvādi parikalpayet caturasraṃ yonimardhacandraṃ tryasraṃ ca vartulam ācāryakuṇḍaṃ madhye syād gaurīpatimahendrayoḥ samantāt kuṇḍametat syāccaturasraṃ śubhāvaham caturasrīkṛtaṃ kṣetraṃ pañcadhā vibhajet sudhīḥ bhrāmayet koṇamānena tadānyadapi mantravit caturasrīkṛtaṃ kṣetraṃ daśadhā vibhajet punaḥ jyāsūtraṃ pātayedagre tanmānādbhrāmayet tataḥ caturdhā bhedite kṣetre nyasedubhayapārśvayoḥ

sūtratrayamadhaḥ kuryāt tryasraṃ kuṇḍamudāhṛtam bhrāmayettena mānena vṛttaṃ kuṇḍamanuttamam bhāgaṃ nyasedekamekaṃ mānenānena madhyataḥ sūtraṣaṭkaṃ tato dadyāt ṣaḍasraṃ kuṇḍamuttamam ekabhāgaṃ bahirnyasya bhrāmayettena vartulam padmakuṇḍamidaṃ proktaṃ vilocanamanoharam bhāgamekaṃ bahirnyasya caturasraṃ prakalpayet bāhyasya caturasrasya koṇābhyāṃ parilāñchayet aṣṭāsraṃ kuṇḍametaddhi tantravidbhirudīritam kṛtvā tatpūrvataḥ paścāddvādaśāṃgulamānataḥ kuryāddhaṃsapadaṃ koṣṭhānyabhitasteṣu pātayet prākpratyakcihnamānena tayorevāvalambataḥ prasārya sūtraṃ tasyāpi mārjayitvoktamānataḥ pūrvataḥ paścimadvandvakoṣṭhayormadhyadeśataḥ uttarāgrāvadhi tathā dakṣiṇāgrāvadhi priye vikāsitabrahmasūtrāvadhi sūtradvayaṃ bhavet tasminnevānyakuṇḍāni vadāmi samamānataḥ labhyate sarvakuṇḍeṣu tena sarvāṇi sarvataḥ śeṣāṃśāṃśakamānena tanmadhyādbhrāmayet tathā pratyekaṃ paścimaṃ sūtraṃ tanmānenātha sūtrayoḥ tiryaksūtrādbahistena mānena bhramayettathā tena mānena ca tathā kṛtvā vṛttamatisphuṭam tatra ṣaṭsūtrapātena bhavet kuṇḍaṃ ṣaḍasrakam aṣṭamāṃśapramāṇena karkaṭena tu madhyataḥ aṣṭamāṃśadvayenaiva madhyato vartulaṃ bhavet

caturthaṃ tu bhavet kṣetraṃ vyāsatulyena ca bhramāt tasyaikaṃ bhāgamādāya bhaktvā ṣoḍaśadhā punaḥ bhāgamādāya tadbāhye pañcamaṃ maṇḍalaṃ śive śāstroktavidhinā devi tataḥ padmaṃ samālikhet tanmānaṃ karkaṭaṃ kṛtvā kesarāgre vidhāya ca likhitvā kṛtihastena patrāgrāṇi samālikhet likhenedavaśiṣṭaṃ tu kesarāṇāṃ ca maṇḍalam patrākārā yathā samyagjāyante parameśvari vidhāya caturasra tu pūrvakoṇārdhamānataḥ teṣu cihneṣu kṛtvāṣṭasūtrāṇi paritaḥ śive mānena parito bhrāntyā kṛtvā vṛttaṃ yathā tataḥ pātayet pañca sūtrāṇi tat syātpañcāsrakuṇḍakam tena mānena saṃbhrāntyā kṛtvā vṛttaṃ tathā tataḥ vṛtte vidhāya cihnāni sapta sūtrāṇi pātayet bhogāḥ putrā yonikuṇḍe hyardhacandraṃ śubhāvaham ripughātakaraṃ kecidvṛttaṃ śāntikaraṃ jaguḥ vṛṣṭidaṃ puṣṭidaṃ vāpi padmakuṇḍaṃ vidurbudhāḥ pañcakoṇaṃ cābhicāraśamane bhūtakṛntane caturasraṃ vṛttamardhacandraṃ tryasramiti kramāt nirmāṇaṃ sakalaṃ vakṣye yathāvidhi tavānaghe vidadhyādvṛttakuṇḍāni cararāśicatuṣṭaye vidadhyāccaturasrāṇiḥ tataḥ kuṇḍānyanukramāt ubhayātmasu kurvīta yonikuṇḍāni maṅgale sthireṣvapi trikoṇāni pareṣu tu catuṣṭaye kulīrasiṃhāvatha tannir-ṛtyāṃ kanyakā tathā

nakrakumbhāvuttarato mīnamīśe tu saṃsthitam yāmyasaumyakarau kuṇḍamudaraṃ paścime tathā aratnimātraṃ tu śate sahasramitahomake caturhastamitaṃ lakṣe ṣaṭkaraṃ daśalakṣake tathaikahastamārabhya daśahastaṃ vivarddhayet dvihastasya ca kuṇḍasya tato dvaiguṇyamiṣyate śatāni pañca vidyante tanmūlaṃ brahmasūtrakam aṃgulāni dvipañcāśadekādaśaśatāni ca catasraśca tathā yūkā yavāḥ sapta tathaiva ca saptadaśaśatānyaṣṭāviṃśatistvaṃgulāni ca tanmūlamaṃgulānyekacatvāriṃśaccaturyavāḥ caturaṃgulayuktāni trayoviṃśacchatāni ca mūlaṃ tasyāṃgulānyaṣṭacatvāriṃśanmitaṃ bhavet dvisahasraṃ śatānyaṣṭāvaśītirbījamucyate tanmūlamaṣṭapañcāśadaṃgulāni ca ṣaḍyavā vedasaṃkhyāsahasrāṇi dvāviṃśatsahitāni ca brahmasūtraṃ tataścāṣṭahastakṣetrāṃgulāni ca aṃgulāni tathā saptaṣaṣṭiḥ sapta yavāḥ punaḥ śatāni tvekapañcāśaccaturbhiradhikāni ca dvāsaptatiraṃgulāni mūlamasya prakīrtitam sahasrāṇīṣusaṃkhyāni munisaṃkhyaśatāni ca vardhayet pañcasaptatyādhikaiḥ saptayavaistathā atiyatnaṃ samāsthāya kuṇḍānyāracayet sudhīḥ prathamaṃ tatpramāṇānāṃ trasareṇuṃ pracakṣate trasareṇuraṣṭaguṇau rathareṇustu saṃsmṛtaḥ

bālāgrāṇyaṣṭa likṣā tu yūkā likṣāṣṭakaṃ smṛtam ratniraṃguliparvāṇāṃ vijñeyastvekaviṃśatiḥ catvāri viṃśatiścaiva hastaḥ syādaṃgulāni tu kāryāḥ hastamānena tanmadhye tāvannimnāyataṃ khanet tṛtīyāṃśo bhavedatra tantre sarvatra cāṃguliḥ aratnistaddvayena syāddhastastaddvayataḥ śive ṣaṇṇavatyaṃgulā sā syāt tanmānaiḥ kuṇḍakalpanam ekā saḍaṃgulotsedhavistarā mekhalā matā tasmātsamyak parīkṣyaivaṃ kartavyaṃ śubhamicchatā vakrakuṇḍe tu santāpo maraṇaṃ chinnamekhale bhāryāvināśakaṃ kuṇḍaṃ proktaṃ yonyā vinā kṛtam śṛṅgārarahitaṃ yacca yajamānavināśakṛt vāgrodhaḥ kaṇṭhahīne syādasiddhirnyūnakhātake vyādhayaḥ saṃpravartante viyonau syādapasmṛtiḥ caturviṃśatikaṃ bhāgamaṃgulaṃ parikalpayet yoniṃ suśobhanāṃ kiñcinnimnāmunnālikāṃ śanaiḥ kumbhadvayasamāyuktāmaśvatthadalasannibhām aṣṭāṃgulaiśca vistīrṇā cāyatā dvādaśāṃgulaiḥ mekhalārthaṃ pṛthagbhūmirna grāhyā bāhyataḥ priye vibhajya tena kartavyā mekhalākaṇṭhanābhayaḥ pañcamasyāpi kuṇḍasya yonirdakṣiṇadiksthitā tridvyekāṃgulavistāraṃ kramānnyūnāgramiṣyate aṣṭacchadaṃ sarojaṃ tu vidadhyāccāruvigraham vistārādapi cotsedhaṃ ṣaḍbhiḥ ṣaḍbhirudāhṛtam

tattatkuṇḍānurūpaṃ vā mānamasya nigadyate dvitrivedāṃgulopetaḥ kuṇḍeṣvanyeṣu vardhayet nābhikṣetraṃ tridhā bhittvā tataḥ kurvīta karṇikām purā tasya vadhāyaiva sarve devāḥ samudyamam āvayostannirāsāya māmetyākathayaṃstathā darpaśāntirna cedasya viśvamāsīdupadrutam khātvā tamavanau tasya śarīre sthāpayettathā niyojya teṣāṃ ye pūjāvimukhāstaiḥ kṛtāni tu tasmātteṣāmarcanaṃ tu pratyabdaṃ kurvatāṃ sadā kṛtvā samalatāṃ bhūmiṃ caturasrākṛtiṃ śubhām catuṣpadayute tasyāṃ madhyakoṣṭhe ca deśikaḥ prādakṣiṇyena pūrvādi yajet koṣṭhacatuṣṭaye koṇārdhakoṣṭhayorekamekaṃ mantrī samarcayet sāvitraḥ savitā śakra indrajidrudratajjitau koṇārdhakoṇapārśveṣu vahnyādīśāntamarcayet carakiṃ ca vidāriṃ ca pūtānāṃ caiva deśikaḥ īśānaścā (tha parjanyo jayantaḥ śakrabhāskarau agniḥ pūṣā ca vitatho yamo'tha gṛharakṣakaḥ nir-ṛtiśca) tathā dauvārikaḥ sugrīvakastathā paścimāśāsthakoṣṭheṣu pūjyā ete yathākramam argalo ditirapyevamaditiśca yathākramam citrai rajobhirāpūrya devatānāṃ padāni vai aṣṭottaraśataṃ cāṣṭottaraviṃśatimeva vā baliṃ ca teṣāṃ kurvīta pāyasairvyañjanānvitaiḥ svagehe vāstupūjāyāṃ maṇḍale tu samācaret

na sarpapīḍā nānyonyakalahādyaśubhāni ca arogī vijayī khyātaḥ ciraṃ jīvati tadgṛhe sacivāmātyasenānībhavaneṣu pure tathā na ceduktānyathārūpaphalaiḥ kleśo'niśaṃ bhavet bījāropaṇakarmedaṃ kartavyaṃ sarvakāmadam bhavane maṇḍale kuryādeke prāgvaruṇāyatam padāni dvādaśātra syusteṣu sthānatrayaṃ bhavet pītaraktasitaśyāmai rajobhirvahnipūrvakam vaiṣṇavyaḥ pālikāḥ proktāścaturviṃśāṃgulocchritāḥ śaivāḥ śarāvāścatvāro bhānvaṃgulasamucchrayāḥ śālipūrṇeṣu gandhādidarbhakūrcayuteṣu ca śaṅkhasvanena nādaiśca pañcabhirbrāhmaṇāśiṣā tāni priyaṃguśyāmākatilasarṣapaśālayaḥ haridrābhiśca saṃsicya vastrairāchādayedguruḥ trividhasyāpi pātrasya saptasvapi dineṣu ca dadhisaktvannamityuktaṃ pitṛbhyastilataṇḍulāḥ caturthe'hani nāgebhyo nārikelaghṛtāplutam padmākṣatāśca ṣaṣṭhe'hni śivāyāpūpasaṃyutam yadi syānnavarātraṃ ca tadobhayadine balim praṇavādyairhṛdantaiḥ svanāmabhirbalimantrakaḥ jyaiṣṭhe mṛtyupradā sā syādāṣāḍhe bandhunāśinī āśvine sarvasiddhiḥ syāt kārtike jñānadāyinī māghe suvarṇalābhaḥ syāt phālgune sarvasiddhidā maraṇaṃ bhavati jyaiṣṭhe cāṣāḍhe bandhunāśanam prajānāmāśvine māse sarvataḥ śubhameva hi

pauṣe jñānakṣayo māghe bhavenmedhāvivardhanam mārgaphālgunake śreṣṭhā jyaiṣṭhe caiva tu sādhamā ānandadā śrāvaṇe sā pauṣe bhādre ca ninditā śukle sarvasamṛddhiḥ syāt kṛṣṇe madhyamato bhavet hastacitrāsvātimaitraviśākhāśca dhaniṣṭhayā svātīrādhe revatī ca tathā cāpyuttarātrayam pūrvāyāṃ daṇḍayedrājā maghāyāṃ mṛtyumādiśet pūrvāṣāḍhe bhayaṃ proktaṃ śravaṇe'nekarogadā trayodaśī ca daśamī praśastāa sarvakāmadā dvādaśyāmapi kartavyaṃ trayodaśyāmathāpi vā daśamī śuklapakṣasya dvādaśī ca viśeṣataḥ saptamyāṃ dhanalābhaḥ syādaṣṭamyāṃ gurunāśanam ekādaśyāṃ bhavellābho dhanasya vṛṣabhasya ca śiṣyahāniścaturdaśyāṃ paurṇamāsī tu siddhidā caturdaśī śivasyoktā vācaḥ proktā trayodaśī caturthī gaṇanāthasya bhānoḥ proktā tu saptamī śanau mṛtyuḥ kṣayaṃ bhaume some sarvatra niṣphalam iti jñātvā varārohe mantraṃ dadyādvicakṣaṇaḥ budhe'bhiyogarahitā gurau putrānvito bhavet iti jñātvā varārohe dīkṣāṃ dadyādviśāladhīḥ sukarmā ca dhṛtirvṛddhirdhruvaḥ siddhiśca harṣaṇaḥ pūrvābhādrapadā ṣaṣṭhī daśamī rohiṇī tathā nakṣatralumpā ityete devānāmapi nāśadāḥ śakunyādīni viṣṭiṃ ca viśeṣeṇa vivarjayet vṛṣe maraṇamāpnoti mithune'patyanāśanam

kanyā lakṣmīpradā nityaṃ tulāyāṃ sarvasiddhayaḥ makaraḥ putradaḥ proktaḥ kumbho dhanasamṛddhidaḥ meṣe sarvasamṛddhiḥ syāt kanyā ratnapradā bhavet makare putralābhaḥ syātkumbhe paśusamṛddhayaḥ evaṃ lagnaphalaṃ jñātvā mantraṃ dadyād viśāladhiḥ sukhadaṃ śubhadaṃ nityaṃ kanyādyaṃ sarvasiddhidam dīkṣāyāṃ tu śubhāḥ sarve randhrasthāḥ sarvanāśakāḥ kṛṣṇe tārābalaṃ kuryāt svanāmādivicintanam madhyāhne sarvasiddhiḥ syāt sāyāhne sarvato bhaved divā sarvaṃ prakurvīta siddhidaṃ paramaṃ smṛtam kṣepo dyūtabilapraveśagaṇanārambhāḥ prasiddhyanti ca grahaṇāddevadeveśi kālaḥ sapta dināvadhi kālacarcā na kartavyā grahaṇe candrasūryayoḥ mantradīkṣāṃ prakurvāṇo māsarkṣādīnna śodhayet sūryagrahaṇakālena samo nānyaḥ kadācana na māsatithivārādiśodhanaṃ sūryaparvaṇi siddhirbhavati mantrasya vinābhyāsena vegataḥ janakasya tu dīkṣā dāridryaṃ saptajanmasu mantramātrasya kathanamupadeśaḥ sa ucyaye yābhirvinā na labhyante sarvamantraphalāni vai tena dīkṣā iti proktāstāsāṃ tattvavicārakaiḥ kalāmayī vedhamayī catasro jñānadāḥ śubhāḥ pañcavādyaninādaiśca vedaghoṣaiḥ suhṛdvṛtaḥ datvā varaṇasāmagrīṃ saṃkalpya vṛṇuyādgurum gurutveneti sambhāṣya tvāmahaṃ ca tato vṛṇe

yathocitaṃ guro karma kuruṣveti vadecchiśuḥ tataḥ śiṣyeṇa sahito yāyādyāgagṛhaṃ guruḥ hārakuṇḍalakeyuramudrikāṅgadabhūṣaṇaiḥ mahārghavastratāmbūlaiḥ phalapuṣpasugandhakaiḥ ṛtvijo'pi tathābhyarcya vṛṇuyāduktasaṃkhyakān śrīparṇīvṛkṣapīṭhāni hastamānāniḥ mānataḥ saptaviṃśatidarbhāṇāṃ veṇyo'gre granthibhūṣitāḥ sukhoṣṇodakasampūrṇāḥ pādyārthe tāmragaṇḍakāḥ dūrvodakasamāyuktāḥ sthāpanīyāḥ pṛthakpṛthak sampuṭā madhuparkārthaṃ kāṃsyā daghyādipūritāḥ mayūrapatracchatrāṇi soṣṇīṣāṇi samāharet anyatsmārte yadapyuktaṃ madhuparkasya pūjane anyebhyo madhuparkasya viprebhyaḥ pūjanaṃ smṛtam anyairdvijaiḥ samaṃ yatra deśikasya prapūjanam deśikendro vidhānena snātvā nirvatitāhnikaḥ ācāryaḥ pūrvadivase upaveśya samāsane dantān viśodhya purataḥ sthaṇḍile hastamātrake īśānāgre jñānalābhaḥ prāgagre bhūtiruttamā rākṣasāgre mṛtyubhayaṃ vāruṇyagre manaḥśucam amaṅgalasthānapāte prāyaścittaṃ samācaret krūrasvapne'dhamā dīkṣā hyakrūre madhyamā matā vidhāyācamanaṃ tatra sāmānyārghyaṃ vidhāya ca tataśca deśiko vighnān divyānālokanena ca pārthivān pārṣṇighātaistattribhirutsārya yatnataḥ utsāritānāṃ bhūtānāṃ dadadvartma tu dakṣiṇe

arghyāmbunā ca gavyena yāgasthāne susecite samvīkṣya mūlamanunā hyastreṇa prokṣayet tataḥ śrīkhaṇḍāgarucandraiśca bhūṣite'streṇa saptadhā sajalān vikirenmantrī pratyūhaghnān hi maṇḍalam āsanāya tu vārddhānyā īśāne sthāpayecca tān vedikāyāṃ likhet paścāt sarvatobhadramaṇḍalam deśiko vedikāmadhye gomayenopalepite catuṣkoṣṭhasamāyuktaṃ karṇasūtravibhūṣitam koṇasthakoṣṭhamadhyeṣu dṛśyante matsyakā yathā makareṣveṣu sūtrāṇi dadyāccatvāri mantravit makarān pūrvavat kuryāt tatra sūtrāṇi pātayet prādurbhavanti ramyāṇi sūtrāṇyevaṃ vikāśayet tadbahiḥ paritaḥ pīṭhamekapaṃktyā prakalpayet tato'nyapaṃktiyugmena dvāraśobhā vidhānataḥ atha vakṣye vidhānena sarojalekhanakramam tato vṛttatrayaṃ madhye kuryāt samyag yathāvidhi antyavṛttena patrāṇi patrāgrāṃstyakta bhāgataḥ kiñjalkāgreṣu saṃsthāpya pārśvatastvardhacandrakān dalāgramānato vṛttaṃ kuryāt samyag vicakṣaṇaḥ bahirekena kurvīta patrāgrāṇi vidhānavit sāmānyaṃ kamalaṃ hyetacchāstre sarvatra gīyate atiriktaiḥ padaiḥ pīṭhagātrāṇi racayettataḥ koṣṭhadvayena caikena pratyekaṃ dvārapārśvayoḥ upaśobhāstataḥ koṣṭhaiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ koṇāni kalpayet niśārajo bhavetpītaṃ śuklaṃ taṇḍulajaṃ smṛtam

pulākadāhasaṃbhūtaṃ śyāmaṃ bilvacchadotthitam utsedhatārako rekhāḥ śuklā aṃgulamānataḥ pītavarṇena cūrṇena karṇikāṃ pūrayettataḥ śyāmena rajasā sandhiṃ mantraviccābhipūrayet kiñjalkān pītaraktena pīṭhagātrāṇi śubhrataḥ patramūlaphalākāramaṇḍitā hṛdayaṅgamāḥ śubhreṇa rajasā dvāracatuṣkaṃ pūrayettataḥ kṛṣṇavarṇena koṇāni bahī rekhātrayaṃ tataḥ sāmānyaṃ sarvatobhadraṃ maṇḍalaṃ hyetaduttamam pūrvokte caturasre tu tāvat sūtrāṇi pātayet vedānvitaṃ tu tanmadhye padmaṃ ṣaṭtriṃśatā śubham pūrvavadvāraśobhā syādupaśobhātra nāsti vai anyatsarvaṃ vidhātavyaṃ proktamaṇḍalavacchubham pātayet kramaśaḥ sūtraṃ yāvatkoṣṭhāni sarvataḥ padmaṃ caturbhiḥ koṣṭhaiḥ syāt kuryāt tatparitaḥ punaḥ catuṣkeṣu tu padmāni vidadhyānmantravittamaḥ yāvatṣoḍaśa koṣṭhāni bhavantyetāni mārjayet rajobhiḥ śuklahāridraraktanīlaiḥ prapūrayet uditaṃ maṇḍalaṃ hyetannavanābhaṃ suśobhanam maṇḍalaṃ syāttu pañcābjaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam etanmaṇḍalamadhye tu kuryādanyatamaṃ budhaḥ vedikāyāmāsane sa prāṅmukhaḥ saṃviśedatha deśikendrastu saṃsthāpya pūjopakaraṇāni tu sugandhijalapūrṇaṃ ca hastaprakṣālanāya ca vyajanaṃ mukuraṃ chatraṃ cāmaraṃ dikṣu mantravit

karaśuddhiṃ vidhāyātha kuryāt tālatrayaṃ budhaḥ mahastu tata utpannaṃ rakṣayettaṃ hi sarvataḥ nyāsādikaṃ tataḥ kuryāddeśiko yatamānasaḥ devatāṃ hṛdaye nyasya mūlamantrasya deśikaḥ yasya mantrasya pañcāṅgaṃ netraṃ tasya vihīyate tattanmantroktamārgeṇa nyāsānanyān samācaret dehātmake tataḥ pīṭhe dhyāyenmantrasya devatām jalena pūritāṃ dakṣe prokṣaṇīṃ sthāpayet tataḥ pādyamācamanīyaṃ ca madhuparkaṃ ca mantravit svātmānaṃ maṇḍalaṃ cānyatpūjopakaraṇādikam yogapīṭhaṃ samabhyarcya nyāsamārgeṇa mantravit devatātmā tataḥ pañca kuryādvā sumanoñjalīn pūjayecca nivedyena rahitaiścandanādibhiḥ samāpayedidaṃ sarvaṃ prokṣaṇyadbhiḥ samācaret upacāraiścandanādyairmaṇḍalaṃ pūjayedguruḥ darbhāṃ nyaseduparyeṣāṃ sākṣataṃ kūrcakraṃ tataḥ brahmagranthiyutāstvagradeśe kūrca ihocyate svarṇādiracitaṃ tatra kalaśaṃ chidravarjitam candanāgurukarpūrairmadhye samyakpradhūpitam nava ratnāni niḥkṣipya kumbhe kūrcamathopari puṣpaṃ nīlaṃ ca vaiḍūryaṃ vidrumaṃ mauktikaṃ tathā mauktikāni ca ratnāni deśikastantravittamaḥ mūlamantraṃ japannante cintayannaikyamātmanaḥ pañcāśadoṣadhikvāthaiḥ pūrayettadanantaram gandhapaṅkaprasūnādivāsitairvā śubhairjalaiḥ

gandhāṣṭakaṃ śubhaṃ mantrī sarvasamaptatpradāyakam kalādidevatārūpaṃ śaṅkhanīraṃ ghaṭe kṣipet sasihlakajaṭāmāṃsīsaṭībhiḥ śaktisambhavam sevyakaṃ ca jaṭāmāṃsī vaiṣṇavaṃ tadudīritam surabhirbhūtagandhā ca kuṭhī gandhakuṭhī smṛtā tamālāgarukarpūraiḥ śāmbhavaṃ cāṣṭagandhakam saśaktikaṃ jalaṃ kumbhe bhavedeva na saṃśayaḥ kalādvādaśakaṃ sauraṃ pūjayet tadanantaram vedādibhedasañjātāḥ kalāḥ pañcāśatairyutāḥ madhye madhye ṛcaḥ pañca pūjanīyā imā api vasurantamantrapadaṃ rikṣasaddhopadaṃ tataḥ roṇasatpadamuccārya nṛṣadvarapade vadet vadejjā ṛtajetyasmādadrijāśabdamuccaret uktvā bṛhatpadaṃ vānte prathamo mantra īritaḥ uktvā ṣṇuḥ stavate paścādvīryeṇa mṛpadaṃ vadet yasyoruṣu triṣu padaṃ tato vikramaṇeṣvadhi toyastho mādhavaḥ paścādvāntaṃ syāttāyaśāntiyuk caturmukhaḥ sacandrārdhastataḥ syācca yajāmahe padamurvārukamiva bandhanānmṛpadaṃ vadet toyasthā śālmalī proktā sahajāḍhāntaviṣṇuyuk yatu tvaṣṭāpadaṃ paścāt tato rūpāṇi piṃśatu garbhaṃ dadhātviti padamāṣāḍhī padmanābhayuk āvāhyādau kalāḥ paścāt sannidhāpya ca deśikaḥ yatra yatra kalāpūjāvidhistatraivameva hi kalādaśakamāvāhya sṛṣṭyādyāḥ sannidhāpya ca

prāṇasaṃsthāpanaṃ kṛtvā kalānāṃ pūjayecca tāḥ nivṛttyādyāścāpi yajeduktayuktyā vicakṣaṇaḥ śaktisāntāvamī sapta dhruvabhedāḥ samīritāḥ sutrāmavallarīnaddhaiḥ kalpavṛkṣamanīpayā paścādakṣatasaṃyuktāṃ saphalāṃ śubhacakrikām kalpavṛkṣaphalānāṃ hi matyā viśadadhīrguruḥ pradhānakumbhaṃ saṃsthāpya vedyāmevaṃ gurūttamaḥ prāgvanmaṇḍalamālikhya padmaṃ cāṣṭadalaṃ śubham dhruvaṃ dharāṃ vākpatiṃ ca vighneśaṃ teṣu pūjayet amṛtaṃ durjayaṃ caiva siddhārthaṃ maṅgalaṃ tathā pūrvādiṣvaṣṭakumbheṣu teṣāṃ mantraistu vaidikaiḥ airāvataṃ puṇḍarīkaṃ vāmanaṃ kumudāñjanau punarvedyāṃ gururgatvā upaviśya nijāsane tasyāṃ mūrtau samāvāhya pūjayediṣṭadevatām nirgamayya ca caitanyaṃ nāsikāgravinirgatam mastakāntaṃ samutthāpya tasyāmāvāhayet tataḥ sannirodha ca sakalīkaraṇaṃ tvavaguṇṭhanam āsanādiprasūnāntānupacārān prakalpya ca sarvānte lokapālānāṃ tadastrāṇāṃ ca pūjanam maṅgalāṃkurapātrāṇi sthāpanīyāni mantriṇā saṃsthāpya vahniṃ saṃskṛtya vaiśvadevaṃ samācaret mūlāṇunā tato hutvā sājyena haviṣā sudhīḥ sampūjya tāṃ candanādyaiḥ pīṭhamūrtau tu yojayet pārṣadebhyaścandanādipuṣpākṣatasamanvitam punaryajeccopacāraiḥ pañcabhirdarśayet tataḥ

devatāyai nivedyātha taṃ japaṃ saṃpade tataḥ suvarṇavastrasaṃyuktaṃ karakaṃ jalapūritam paścimāsyāṃ khaḍgakheṭadhāriṇīṃ siṃhasaṃsthitām bhramedantastu rakṣeti lokeśānāmitīrayan svasthāne sthāpayettaṃ tu phaṇmantreṇa tato'rcayet tato vahniṃ susaṃskṛtya caruṃ gopayasā pacet mūlāṇunābhimantryātha taṇḍulāñśālisambhavān prakṣālitena pātreṇa pātravaktraṃ pidhāya ca paced guruḥ prāṅmukhastu svinne tamabhidhārayet huṃmantreṇāstrasaṃjapte kuśāstīrṇe vibhajya tat śiṣṭaṃ śiṣyeṇa sahito gururbhuñjīta mantravit prādeśamātraṃ hṛñjaptaṃ yathoktaṃ dantadhāvanam gadito'dhivāsaḥ mṛṇmayyaudumbarī vāpi carusthālī praśasyate nacātiśithilaḥ pācyo na ca vītaraso bhavet niṣpannasya ca te sarve vidheyāḥ syuḥ krameṇa vai susaṃskṛte guroḥ kuṇḍe saṃskāraiśca yathāvidhi mūlāṇunā ca saṃvīkṣya saṃprokṣyāstrāṇunā tataḥ khananaṃ syācchareṇātha tenaivoddhāra īritaḥ kavacenātha śastreṇa kuṭṭanaṃ varmaṇā matam kuryāt trisūtrīkaraṇaṃ namomantreṇa pūrayet kavacenendriyāṇāṃ cāpyudghāṭanamathācaret saṃskuryādathavā tāni caturbhiḥ prathamoditaiḥ aṃguṣṭhānāmikābhyāṃ tu hṛdayenātha pūrayet trisūtrīparidhānaṃ ca varmaṇābhyukṣaṇaṃ hṛdā

tenaiva vidhinā nābhiṃ pūjayeccandrasannibhām kuṇḍabhittigaṇaṃ sarvaṃ varmaṇā paribhūṣayet udaṅmukhāgrarekhāṇāṃ brahmasūryendavaḥ kramāt udagagraṃ puraḥsaṃsthaṃ paścimārambhamālikhet bhūmāvabhyantare kuṇḍe dakṣiṇāśāditaḥ kramāt pratyagbhāgātsamārabhya yāvatpūrvāvadhiṃ tathā atīndriyābhāṃ sakalajagadātmasvarūpiṇīm śaktimantreṇa tāṃ śaktimīśānaṃ mūlamantrataḥ kulīnadvijagehotthaṃ pātre hutavahaṃ tataḥ devāṃśa mūlamantreṇa sthāpayedagrataḥ sudhīḥ pradīpakalikākāraṃ teja āvāhya yatnataḥ smṛtvāgnibījakenāsya caitanyaṃ yojayedatha saṃrakṣya ca śareṇātha kavacenāvaguṇṭhayet praṇavena tataḥ svasya sammukhaṃ svīyakuṇḍake śivabījamiti dhyātvā nikṣipedāśuśukṣaṇim lakṣmyākṛtipadaṃ prāptā amṛtāmṛtajīvanī tayoḥ saṃgamayogena vahniḥ sañjātasaṃsthitiḥ grāmyadharmeṇa sañjātamagniṃ tatra vicintayet agnipraṇayanaṃ kuryāccharāve tādṛśe'pi vā kravyādāṃśaṃ ca nair-ṛtyāṃ tyajedastreṇa pārvati nāgnipraṇayanaṃ kuryādvyādhihānibhayāvaham dahayugmaṃ ca sarvajñaṃ ājñāpaya tato dviṭhaḥ suvarṇavarṇamamalaṃ samiddhaṃ sarvatomukham saliṅgagudamūrdhāsyanāsānetreṣu ca kramāt hiraṇyā kanakā raktā kṛṣṇā caiva tu suprabhā

analerārghibindvantasādiyāntākṣarānvitāḥ vinyasedatiraktāntāḥ sarvāṅgebahurūpiṇīm sahasrārciḥ svastipūrṇa uttiṣṭha puruṣastathā aṅgamantrān kramādaṣṭa mūrtīścāpi pravinyaset pradakṣiṇyena vinyased yathāvaddeśikottamaḥ aśvodarajasaṃjñaśca savaiśvānara eva ca syuraṣṭa mūrtayo vahneragnaye padapūrvikāḥ mekhalopari saṃśuddhaiḥ punardarbhacatuṣṭayaḥ nikṣipet paridhīn brahmaviṣṇavīśāṃstatra pūjayet dvimekhale dvitīyāyāṃ madhyamāyāṃ trimekhale randhraṃ kuryāttathā vidvān madhyasthamekhalopari svagṛhyoktavidhānena vāyudeśāttato mune tānyavokṣya pavitreṇa cottānāni vidhāya ca dattvākṣatān pavitraṃ ca tadutpūya nidhāpayet tataḥ kiñcit praṇītāmbu prokṣaṇyādāya tajjalaiḥ tadbāhye vasumūrtīśca madhye vahniṃ tato yajet aṅgamantraistato bāhye cāṣṭabhiḥ mūrtibhiḥ kramāt vaiśvānara jātaveda proktvā cehāvaheti ca brūyācca sādhayetyantaṃ vahnijāyāntiko manuḥ kṛśānum aṅgāni mūrtayaḥ śaktisvastikodyatadordvayāḥ hiraṇyādyāḥ sthitā vahne rasanāḥ ṣaḍanukramāt hiraṇyā taptahemābhā śūlapāṇidiśi sthitā taruṇādityasaṅkāśā raktā jihvāgnisaṃsthitā suprabhā padmarāgābhā vāruṇyāṃ diśi saṃsthitā

bahurūpā yathārthābhā dakṣiṇottaramadhyagā karālā lelihā ceti kuṇḍaṃ vyāpya vyavasthitāḥ rakṣovāruṇavāyavye marīcyādyaṃ trayaṃ tathā raktāgneyī nair-ṛtī ca kṛṣṇānyā suprabhā matā p. 254) māraṇe nigaditā bhuvi kṛṣṇā suprabhā budhavarairiha śāntyām vyāhṛtyanantaraṃ tena juhuyānmanunā triśaḥ ghṛtaṃ tatra samāpūrya vīkṣaṇādisusaṃskṛtam tāpanaṃ tu samuddiṣṭaṃ kuśadvayamataḥ kṣipet pavitrīkaraṇaṃ darbhadvayena jvalitena tu abhidyotanametat syāduddyotanamathocyate vahnābudvāsya ca ghṛtamaṅgārānagniṣu kṣipet astramantraṃ japanmantrī kuśau prādeśamātrakau tato hṛdā kuśābhyāṃ tu svābhimukhyena samplavet adhamaṃ chāgalījātaṃ tasmādgavyaṃ praśasyate svakāṃ brahmamayīṃ mūrtiṃ sañcintya paritāpayet ghṛtābhyāṃ saṃmukhaṃ vahnerastreṇotpavamācaret pratāpyāgnau tridhā darbhamūlamadhyāgrakaiḥ spṛśet kramāttattvatrayaṃ nyasyet hrāṃhrīṃhrūṃbījakaiḥ priye trisūtraveṣṭitagrīvau pūjitau kusumādibhiḥ bhūyo'gnau tau pratāpyātha kuśānagnau nivedayet mūlamadhyāgrake nyasecchaktīricchādikāḥ kramāt sagranthi kṛtvā sāgraṃ dvau śuklakṛṣṇau vicintayet suṣumnāṃ saṃsmarenmantrī tato homaṃ samācaret juhuyāddakṣanetre'gneḥ svāhāntāyāgnaye tataḥ juhuyācca hṛdā somāya svāheti ca deśikaḥ

hṛdāṇunāgnīṣomābhyāṃ svāheti juhuyāt sudhīḥ vaktre vahneḥ sviṣṭakṛte svāheti ca tato guruḥ juhuyādagnimantreṇa trivāraṃ deśikottamaḥ kriyāstāreṇa vai kuryādājyāhutyaṣṭabhiḥ kramāt nālāpanayanaṃ kṛtvā tataḥ saṃśodhya sūtakam pitrorvisarjanaṃ kṛtvā cūḍopanayanādikam jātakarma tato nāmakaraṇaṃ copaniṣkramam mahānāmnyaṃ mahāpūrvavrataṃ ca tadanantaram samāvartanamudvāhaḥ saṃskārā maraṇāntikāḥ sampādayāmi svāheti sarvakarmasvayaṃ vidhiḥ juhuyādrasanāṅgāṣṭamūrtimantraiḥ sakṛdghṛtaiḥ tannāmānte niśitadhīḥ svāhāntaiśca yathākramam svāhāvasāne juhuyāddhyāyanvai mantradevatām nenaiva tāṃ pidhāyāgnau hunettiṣṭhan guruḥ svayam tārādyairdaśabhirmantraiḥ pūrvapūrvasamanvitaiḥ juhuyācca caturvāraṃ samastenaiva tena tu juhuyāt sarvahomeṣu sudhīranalatṛptaye tārādibījaṣaṭkeṣukaraṇeṣvadrivarṇakaiḥ agnirūpadharāṃ tatra pūjayediṣṭadevatām hunenmantrī cā (jya ? gni) mukhe vaktraikīkaraṇaṃ matam ekādaśātha mūlena hunedājyena cāhutīḥ aṅgaprabhṛtyāvṛtīnāmekaikāmāhutiṃ hunet gururvahni praviharet saṃskṛteṣūktavartmanā sarvāvaraṇasaṃyuktāṃ mūlena juhuyustataḥ tattaddravyeṇa hotavyaṃ tīrthenārṣeṇa vā tathā

mandāgnirāmayāvī ca daridraścopajāyate nakṣatrāṇāṃ savārāṇāṃ sarāśīnāṃ yathākramaṃ tārāṇāmaśvinyādīnāṃ rāśiḥ pādādhikaṃ dvayam devatābhyaḥ padaṃ proktvā divānaktaṃ vadettathā evaṃ rāśau tu sampūrṇe tasmiṃstadvat prayojayet saptānāṃ karaṇānāṃ ca dadyānmīnāhvameṣayoḥ punarnivedyamuddhṛtya pūrvavat paripūjya ca stutvā yathāvat praṇamedbhaktiyuktastu sādhakaḥ kulīrasiṃho ca tathā nair-ṛtyāṃ kanyakā sthitā nakrakumbhāvuttarato mīnamīśe tu saṃsthitam dvādaśaḥ śvāsaḥ punaḥ sādhyena manunā aṣṭottarasahasrakam śiṣyaṃ snātaṃ pañcagavyaṃ pāyayenmantravittamaḥ hṛtpuṇḍarīkāccaitanyaṃ tasya svātmani yojayet te kalātattvabhuvanārṇapadā mantrapūrvakāḥ kalā nivṛttiprasukhāstadadhvā pañca kīrtitāḥ tatra śaivāni tattvāni ṣaṭtriṃśatpramitānyatha vidyā caitāni śuddhāni śuddhāśuddhāni sapta ca puruṣaścāpyaśuddhāni prakṛtirbuddhyahaṃkṛtiḥ uktāni śaivatattvāni ṣaṭtriṃśanmantravedibhiḥ vakṣyante jīvasahitaḥ prāṇo buddhirmanastataḥ hṛtpadmaṃ tejasāṃ caiva trayaṃ catvāra eva ca tanmātrāścendriyāṇi syurmano'haṅkārabuddhayaḥ (nivṛttyādyāḥ kalāḥ pañca tato bindukalā punaḥ sapta tattvāni proktāni tantrajñaistripadātmanaḥ)

sarvatattvaṃ ca samproktāstattvādhvānastu deśikaiḥ rasātalaśca tadanu talātala iti smṛtāḥ satyalokaśca samproktā lokā ete yathākramam padādhvā varṇavṛndaṃ syānmantrādhvā padasaṃcayaḥ kūrcena ca guruḥ śiṣyaṃ spṛśan kuṇḍe svake hunet śodhayāmi dviṭhāntena mantreṇāṣṭāhutīḥ pṛthak pādodakapradānādyaiḥ kuryāt pāpavimocanam sṛjet sṛṣṭyā vilīnāṃstāñ śivāntāṃśca gurūttamaḥ taccaitanyaṃ sthitaṃ tasmiṃstasminneva niyojayet aṅgaprabhṛtyā vṛtīnāṃ hunedbhūyo ghṛtena vai bhuvaḥ syādvāyave cāntarikṣāya ca yuto manuḥ bhūrbhuvaḥsvaścandramase nakṣatrebhyaśca pūrvataḥ mahate ca dviṭhāntāḥ syurmahāvyāhṛtimantrakāḥ juhuyādāhutīraṣṭau kevalājyena mantravit dehadharmādhikāraṃ ca jāgratsvapnasuṣuptiṣu karmaṇā caiva hastābhyāṃ padbhyāmuktvodareṇa ca uktaṃ ya yatkṛtaṃ tacca sarvaṃ brahmārpaṇaṃ bhava hutvā pūrṇāhutiṃ mantrī srucā mūlāṇunā tataḥ nyūnātiriktapūrṇārthaṃ dadāmi saghṛtaṃ tilam yānulomāṣṭamaṃ varṇaṃ ṣaṣṭhopāntyasvarākulam sahasrārcirmahātejaḥ namaste bahurūpadhṛk (t) tvaṃ raudro raudrakarmā ca ghorahā tvaṃ namāmi te sarpiṣā srucamāpūrya puṣpaṃ coparyadhomukham savyottarakarābhyāṃ ca sampuṭābhyāṃ ca śaṅkhavat pūrṇādarvīti mantreṇa mūlena ca susaṃyataḥ

nidhāya puṣpaṃ tasyāgre sruveṇādhomukhena tām vauṣaḍantena juhuyāddhārāṃ japasamanvitām vauṣaḍantena mantreṇa vaiṣṇavena surottamam tasyopari ghṛtaṃ dadyāttadūrdhvaṃ kusumādikam tadūrdhve'dhomukhaṃ kṛtvā sruvamutthāya mantravit mūlaṃ namontamuccārya vāmapādapuraḥsaram karmāntare'pi saṃprāpte sannidhiṃ kuru sādaram kuṇḍādudvāsya cācāryo devatāṃ kalaśe nyaset saptavyāhṛtyāgnijihvādīnāmekāhutiṃ kramāt dvātriṃśatpalatāmreṇa nirmitaṃ tāmrapātrakam gururvṛtāya tattasmai pūrṇapātraṃ vidurbudhāḥ tataḥ paristarānagnau paridhīn nikṣipannatu vastreṇa netramantreṇa śiṣyanetre nibadhya ca sumanobhiḥ prapūryāsya hyañjali kṣepayedghaṭe netrabandhamapāsyopaveśayet kuśasaṃstare ajñānatimirāndhasya jñānāñjanaśalākayā ataḥ pūjāvidhānena saṃharejjanayecca tam pañcopacārairabhyarcya kalaśastheṣṭadevatām athopaveśayecchiṣyaṃ bhūṣitaṃ maṇḍalāntare atha pañcaninādaiśca viprāśīrvacanaiḥ saha yena prakāreṇa purā pūritaśca sudhārasaiḥ tathaivainaṃ cābhiṣiñcedāśu saṃpadavāptaye tattoyairabhiṣiñcet taṃ rakṣāyai deśikottamaḥ taddevatāsvarūpaṃ ca vidadhyāt sakalīkṛtim ācamya nikaṭe tasya niviśedvāgyataḥ śiśuḥ

aikyaṃ gururvinītasya samyak tasya manuṃ triśaḥ anyebhyastu vadedevamevaṃ mantrī vicakṣaṇaḥ āgatāṃ bhāvayecchiṣyo dhanyo'smīti viśeṣataḥ aṣṭāviṃśativāraṃ vā hyaṣṭakṛtvo'thavā japaḥ praṇāmaṃ vibhave kuryāt sādhako bhaktimān muhuḥ hastābhyāṃ caraṇābhyāṃ ca jānubhyāṃ vakṣasā tathā hastajānuśirovākyadhībhiḥ pañcāṅga īritaḥ alaṃkārāṃśca vāsāsi dadyādṛtvigbhya ādarāt pradadyādgurave śiṣyo vicāryārdhaṃ tadardhakam tadadhīnamanā nityaṃ taccittastatparāyaṇaḥ sarvasvaṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā tadājñayā gajāśvamahiṣīmeṣapaśudāsīmahīyutam svadehaṃ svātmaprāṇāṃśca dadyāt svaśaktibhaktitaḥ brāhmaṇān bhojayetpaścāt pradadyādbhūridakṣiṇām puṃsprakṛtyātmakatvaṃ hi varṇānāṃ samudīritam tatastanau śiśornyasedvarṇān deśikasattamaḥ deśikendrasya sāmarthyādājñayā devatātmanaḥ tatastu śiṣyacaitanyaṃ paramātmani yojayet tasmiṃśca sṛṣṭikramatastaccaitanyaṃ punarnyaset jñānadārṇamayī dīkṣā kathitā sarvasiddhidā kalā nivṛttipramukhā bhūtānāṃ pañca ceritāḥ pādādijānuparyantaṃ nivṛttiḥ saṃsthitā kalā nābhitaḥ kaṇṭhaparyantaṃ vidyākhyā saṃsthitā kalā bhālācchirovadhi proktā śāntyatītā kalā tathā sthāneṣvīśājñayā caiṣā kalādīkṣā samīritā

caturdale smaret patre mūlādhāre śiśostanau trirāvartamayīṃ devīṃ vidyutpuñjasvarūpiṇīm aṇoraṇīyasīṃ devīṃ cakraṣaṭkaprabhedinīm sāntān vādīn dalasthārṇān padmayonau samāharet svādhiṣṭhāne guruḥ samyag yojayitvā tu vedhayet phāntaḍādyarṇasaṃyukte digdale vedhayet svayam ṭhāntakādyarṇapatrābje vedhayedīśvare svayam kalāmayadale padme svarān saṃyojya yatnataḥ dvidale hakṣasaṃyukte vedhayitvā tu deśikaḥ kalāṃ nāde samāyojya nādaṃ nādāntake punaḥ viṣuvaktraṃ svake vaktre saṃhared deśikaḥ svayam deśikājñāvaśācchiṣyo dagdhājñānastadā kṣitau sadāśivaḥ svayaṃ bhūyāt satyameva na saṃśayaḥ catasrastvevamuddiṣṭā dīkṣāḥ samyak śubhāvahāḥ guruḥ spṛśecchiṣyatanuṃ sparśadīkṣā bhavediyam uccaret saṃhatān mantrān vāgdīkṣeti nigadyate samyakpaśyedguruḥ śiṣyaṃ dṛgdīkṣā sā bhavet priye sadyaḥ saṃjāyate jñānaṃ sā dīkṣā śāmbhavī matā antareṇopadiṣṭā ye mantrāḥ syurviphalā yataḥ gurumantrāgamābhijñaṃ samayācārapālakam kañcitkālaṃ vidhāyaitat suśiṣyāyā samarpayet tatastu śāśvatī muktiriti śaṅkarabhāṣitam sampradāyamavicchinnaṃ sadā kuryādguruḥ priye paścādupadiśenmantramanyathā niṣphalaṃ bhavet dadato gṛhṇato devi kulaśāpo bhaviṣyati

upadeśaṃ dadadgṛhṇan tau prayātāṃ piśācatām bhuñjāte tāvubhau ghorān narakānekaviṃśatim vinyasyati ca taṃ mantraṃ saikate śālibījavat tasmāt parīkṣya vaktavyamanyathā niṣphalaṃ bhavet tat prāpayati tattattvaṃ gauḥ kṣīrāttu ghṛtaṃ yathā devatāśāpamāpnoti kṛtaṃ ca vikṛtaṃ bhavet vinā yenābhiṣekeṇa sādhakaḥ pūrṇabodhatām tasmād guruḥ priyaṃ śiṣyaṃ bodhayitvābhiṣecayet khārītoyabhṛtaṃ kumbhaṃ sthāpayeccakramadhyataḥ daleṣu vidhivat sthāpya tatrābāhyeṣṭadevatām śiṣyasya janmanakṣatre prāgvat tairabhiṣecayet caturbhiḥ kuḍavaiḥ prasthamāḍhakaṃ taiścaturguṇaiḥ kumbhaistairaṣṭabhiḥ khārī -------------------------- sindūravarṇaṃ tapanīyabhūṣaṃ vahniṃ jaṭābhūṣitamaulimīḍe avighnaṃ kuru me deva sarvakāryeṣu sarvadā devasenā svadhā svāhā mātaro lokamātaraḥ brāhmī māheśvarī caiva kaumārī vaiṣṇavī tathā sthānaṃ tyaktvā tu tatsarvaṃ yatrasthaṃ tatra gacchatu sarveṣāmavirodhena brahmakarma samārabhe atrigotrastu viprendra śāntipāṭhaṃ makhe kuru saṃvījyamāno'psarasāṃ gaṇena rakṣādhvaraṃ no bhagavan namaste śatayajñādhipo devastasmai nityaṃ namonamaḥ tejovatā lokagaṇena sārdhaṃ mamādhvaraṃ pāhi kave namaste dhūmraketurajo'dhyakṣastasmai nityaṃ namonamaḥ kāśyapeyastu viprendra śāntipāṭhaṃ makhe kuru

śubhāśubhānandaśucāmadhīśa śivāya naḥ pāhi makhaṃ namaste āvāhayāmi yajñe'smin pūjā me pratigṛhyatām mamādhvaraṃ pāhi piśācanāya lokeśvarastvaṃ bhagavan namaste nīlaṃ rakṣogaṇairjuṣṭaṃ nīlābharaṇabhūṣitam āvāhayāmi yajñe'smin pūjā me pratigṛhyatām bhāradvājastu viprendra śāntipāṭhaṃ makhe kuru vidyādharendrāmaragīyamāna pāhi tvamasmān bhagavan namaste āvāhayāmi yajñe'smin varuṇāya namonamaḥ prāṇādhipaḥ kālakaveḥ sahāya gṛhāṇa pūjāṃ bhagavan namaste āvāhayāmi yajñe'smin pūjeyaṃ pratigṛhyatām tasmai pūjyāya jagatī vāyave'haṃ namāmi ca vaiśampāyana viprendra śāntipāṭhaṃ makhe kuru sarvauṣadhībhiḥ pitṛbhiḥ sahaiva gṛhāṇa pūjāṃ bhagavan namaste tasmai somāya devāya nakṣatrapataye namaḥ lokeśa yajñeśvara yajñasiddhyai gṛḥāṇa pūjāṃ bhagavan namaste āvāhayāmi yajñe'smin pūjā me pratigṛhyatām śūlapāṇirvirūpākṣastasmai nityaṃ namonamaḥ yakṣoragendrāmaralokasaṅghairananta rakṣādhvaramasmadīyam padmaśaṅkhadharordhvādhodakṣabhāgakaradvayam puṣpavaddhārayenmūrdhni tasmai nityaṃ namonamaḥ sarvasya dhātāsyamitaprabhāvo viśādhvaraṃ naḥ satataṃ śivāya yajñādhyakṣaścaturvaktrastasmai nityaṃ namonamaḥ brahmaviṣṇuśivaiḥ sārdhaṃ rakṣāṃ kurvantu tāni me ṛṣayo manavogāvo devamātara eva ca brahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca kṣetrapālā gaṇaiḥ saha

sthaṇḍile nityapūjāyāṃ hastamātraṃ praśasyate ihāgacchatetyāvāhyeha tiṣṭhateti sthāpayet aśvināvihāgacchateha tiṣṭhateti ketordakṣiṇe'śvinau viṣapāpaharo nityamataḥ śāntiṃ prayaccha me mūle tasya sthito brahmā madhye mātṛgaṇāḥ smṛtāḥ ṛgvedo'tha yajurvedaḥ sāmavedo hyatharvaṇaḥ atra gāyatrī sāvitrī śāntiḥ puṣṭikarī tathā devadānavasaṃvāde mathyamāne mahodadhau tvattoye sarvatīrthāni devāḥ sarve tvayi sthitāḥ śivaḥ svayaṃ tvamevāsi viṣṇustvaṃ ca prajāpatiḥ tyayi tiṣṭhanti sarve'pi yataḥ kāmaphalapradāḥ sānnidhyaṃ kuru me deva prasanno bhava sarvadā sarvāśine sarvagata pāvakāya namo'stu te viṣṇustvaṃ lokapālo'si śāntimatra prayaccha me karmāntare'pi samprāpte sānnidhyaṃ kuru sādaram cakṣurunmīlitaṃ yena tasmai śrīgurave namaḥ vikāśāśca śikhāścaiva saṃvedyāḥ karmasiddhaye bālārkavarṇo hutabhugjapābhaḥ śasyate budhaiḥ śakracāpanibhaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ kusumbhābhastathaiva ca āyurdaḥ padmagandhaḥ syādbilvagandhaśca suvrataḥ padmendīvarakahlārasarpiguggulasannibhaḥ śabdo'gneḥ siddhaye hoturanyathā syādasiddhidaḥ vimānānāṃ hayānāṃ ca prāsādānāṃ vṛṣasya ca tadākṛtiḥ sadā vahniḥ sadyaḥ siddhikaraḥ smṛtaḥ yadrūpaṃ kathitaṃ caitadyadi tasya pratīkṣaṇam

hrasvā hrasvonnatā dīrghāgnijvālāḥ siddhidāḥ smṛtāḥ śubhadā yajamānasya rājyasyāpi viśeṣataḥ hṛdye tuṣṭiprade caiva hotavyaṃ siddhimicchatā nityamevaṃ śubhakaro yadanyairvarjito'guṇaiḥ dhūmāvalīḍhajvālaśca kṛśānurnaiva siddhidaḥ bhūmiṃ ca vilikhedyastu so'pi dadyāt parābhavam śveto rāṣṭraṃ nihantyāśu vāyasasvarasaṃnibhaḥ pūtigandho hutavaho hoturduḥkhaprado bhavet śukapakṣanibho dhūmaḥ pārāvatasamaprabhaḥ rūkṣaścaṭacaṭāśabdastvapasavyagatistathā neṣyate'sau muniśreṣṭha śāstre'smin pārameśvare mūlenājyena juhuyāt pañcaviṃśatimāhutīḥ bhadralohitā | caturthī lohitā śvetā dhūminyanyā karālikā sphuliṅginī dhūmravarṇā caturthī tu manojavā kālī ca saptamī proktā jñātavyāḥ kāryabhedataḥ gandharvayakṣanāgāśca piśācā rākṣasāstathā tṛptā dadyustato devā vāñchitāṃ siddhimuttamām śayānamājyahomeṣu niṣaṇaṃ śeṣakarmasu cakṣuḥkarṇādikaṃ jñātvā homayed deśikottamaḥ nāsikāyāṃ mahadduḥkhaṃ cakṣuṣornāśanaṃ bhavet yatra kāṣṭhaṃ tatra karṇau yatra dhūmastu nāsikā yatra prajvalito vahnistatra jihvāḥ prakīrtitāḥ karṇahome bhavedavyādhirnetre tvandhatvamīritam sadhūmo'gniḥ śiraḥ proktaṃ nirdhūmaścakṣureva ca agnirvijāyate yatra śuddhasphaṭikasannibhaḥ

candanadvayadevadruvikaṅkataśamībhavau bakulāśokapunnāgaplakṣanyagrodhacampakaiḥ gṛhītvā vibhajeddhastamātraṃ ṣaṭtriṃśatā punaḥ ekāṃśena mitaḥ kaṇṭhaḥ saptabhāgamitaṃ mukham agraṃ kaṇṭhasamānaṃ syānmukhe mārgaṃ prakalpayet vedīmadhye vidhātavyā bhāgenaikena karṇikā tasya khātaṃ tribhirbhāgairvṛttamardhāṃśato bahiḥ mekhalā mukhavedyoḥ syāt parito'rdhāṃśamānataḥ da (ga) ṇḍīyugaṃ yamāṃśaiḥ syāddaṇḍasyānāha īritaḥ haṃsasya vā hastino vā potriṇo vā mukhaṃ likhet srucaścaturviṃśatibhirbhāgairārarcayet sruvam caturbhiraṃśairānāhaḥ karṣājya grāhi tacchiraḥ daṇḍamūlāgrayorgaṇḍī bhavet kaṅkaṇabhūṣitā vidadhyādvāśvatthapatre saṃkṣipte homakarmaṇi uktāni pañcagavyāni tatsamāni maniṣibhiḥ dadhi prasṛtimātraṃ syāllājāḥ syurmuṣṭisaṃmitāḥ guḍaṃ palārdhamānaṃ syāccharkarāpi tathā smṛtā ekaikaṃ patrapuṣpāṇi tathāpūpāni kalpayet mātuluṅgaṃ catuḥkhaṇḍaṃ panasaṃ daśadhākṛtam tridhākṛtaṃ bilvaphalaṃ kapitthaṃ khaṇḍitaṃ dvidhā phalānyanyānyakhaṇḍāni samidhaḥ syurdaśāṃgulāḥ vrīhayo muṣṭimātrāḥ syurmudgamāṣayavā api godhūmā raktakalamā vihitā muṣṭimānataḥ śuktipramāṇaṃ lavaṇaṃ maricānyapi viṃśatiḥ candanāgurukarpūrakastūrīkuṃkumāni ca

dvau śāṇau ghaṭakaḥ kolo badaraṃ ikṣaṇaśca (?) saḥ picurbiḍālapadakaṃ tinduko'kṣaśca taddvayam muṣṭirāmraṃ praguñjo'tha dve pale prasṛtistathā viśīrṇā dvidalā hrasvā vakrāḥ sthūlāḥ kṛśā dvidhā viśīrṇāyuḥkṣayaṃ kuryāt dvidalā vyādhisambhavā sthūlābhiharate lakṣmīṃ kṛśāyāṃ jāyate kṣayaḥ dveṣaṃ prakurute dīrghā prāṇaghnyo nistvacaḥ kṛtāḥ ārdratvacaṃ samacchedā jarjharyaṃgulavartulām śraute smārte ca tantrokte samidhaḥ parikīrtitāḥ avakrā na svayaṃ śuṣkāḥ satvaco nirvraṇāḥ samāḥ prādeśamātrā vā lābhe hotavyāḥ sakalā api piśācatvamavāpnoti narakaṃ ca prapadyate pañcaṣaṭkūṭavidyābhyāṃ śodhitaṃ bahuvāsaraiḥ ādhāre hṛdaye mūrdhni cakraṃ sañcintya madhyataḥ triśo vidyāṃ japetkarṇe devyātmā pūrṇamānasaḥ śataṃ japettadagrastho nikaṭe tridinaṃ vaset tasmāttadantike tasya pūjādeśādikṛdvaset tatastadā samārabhya tadāyatto dhanādibhiḥ anugrahādi kurvīta siddhye nānyathā bhavet kvāthodakaiḥ samāpūryābhiṣicyābhivadenmanum dvitīyamabhiṣekaṃ tu kuryād devyātmasiddhye trikoṇāni vidhāyātra madhye kumbhaṃ tu vinyaset pūritaṃ khāritoyena kathitenākṣarauṣadhaiḥ hiraṇyāni satāmrāṇi vāsobhyāmabhiveṣṭayet śatakratulatābaddhairmātuluṅgaphalānvitaḥ

sārdhaṃ sahasraṃ ṣaṭtriṃśatpañcasaṃkhya kramoditāḥ kālātmanityāmantrāṃśca japitvā pūrvavāsare sahasraṃ prajapet paścāddhomaṃ kṛtvā samantataḥ muditairyoginīvṛndairekaikaṃ devatātmabhiḥ svakramaṃ tasya kathayettadā prabhṛti so'pi tam sahasraṃ prajaped vidyāmabhiṣekasamanvitam teṣu śaktīḥ samāvāhya sampūjyaivābhiṣecayet evaṃ naimittikaṃ nityamavicchinnaṃ samācaret trikuṭāśca catuṣkuṭāḥ pañcakūṭāstathaiva ca daśaikādaśakūṭāśca ravikūṭāstathaiva ca tathā pañcadaśākhyāśca tathā ṣoḍaśakūṭakāḥ pañcāyatanavidyāśca nyāsajālaṃ tathaiva ca tā vidyāḥ prajapecchiṣyaḥ kramaprāptāḥ krameṇa vai kramaprāptamahāvidyānicaye bhaktiśālini prākproktavidhinā samyaṅmaṇḍapaṃ kārayedbudhaḥ sudine śubhanakṣatre sumuhūrte śubhodaye prākproktavidhinā samyak kuryāt puṇyāhavācanam brāhmaṇān pūjayet paścāt svastivācanapūrvakam dadājñayānyaviprāṃśca vṛṇuyāt svarṇavastrakaiḥ brāhmaṇān navasaṃkhyāṃśca hyaṣṭau ca dvārapālakān svavidyopāsakān bhaktyā svarṇaratnāṃgulīyakaiḥ śrīgurūktaprakāreṇa samasūtraṃ manoharam saptasaptatikoṇeṣu yoniṣu pratiyoni ca sarvatra śālipuñjeṣu kalaśān sthāpayedbudhaḥ prasthamātragrāhighaṭān itareṣu nidhāpayet

aṣṭāyudhānāṃ sthāneṣu pratiheti ca ṣoḍaśa pārśvayorekamekaṃ ca devyāḥ pṛṣṭhe ghaṭatrayam gurumaṇḍalanirmāṇaṃ ṣaḍkoṇāṣṭābjamadhyataḥ grahamaṇḍalamīśāne sarvatobhadramaṇḍalam āgneyapūrvamadhye tu kūryānnakṣatramaṇḍalam yāmyanair-ṛtamadhye daddinanityāprapūjane vṛttatrikoṇamadhye tu dhātudaivatamaṇḍalam āgnaye kurukullāyā vārāhyā vāyugocare tena teṣāṃ pūjārthaṃ vakṣye taddhāmamaṇḍalam sudhāvyañjanarūpaṃ syāditare tanmayā yataḥ teṣāṃ navānāṃ pūjāsu tanmayaṃ navamaṇḍalam krameṇa śṛṇu deveśi sarvaśreyaskarātmakam trihastamātre janayennava koṣṭhāni teṣu vai tanmadhye tiryagūrdhvaṃ ca sūtradvayanipātanāt vātādyaṣṭasvarān madhye praṇavaṃ nabhasā yutam tatrārkamarcayet tasya nāmabhirdvādaśoditaiḥ somasyādyaṃ svasaṃyuktaṃ kṛtvā tena tathārcayet ṣoḍaśasvarayuktaṃ ca mātṛkāṃ ca svayogataḥ dāhavahnisvasahitamarcayettatra maṇḍale nivedya śarkarādugdhapāyasaiścopacārakaiḥ tattadvargādivarṇaṃ ca svaraistāṃ mātṛkāmapi tattadvargākṣarāṇyākhyātryakṣarairālikhedapi evaṃ kṛteṣu navasu pūjayecca nava grahān tryakṣarāṇi caturthyantānyarccayettaiśca tāniti ketumetaistu sarvatra mantrānuktau ca pūjanam

teṣveva teṣāmarcātaste kuryustadanugraham svoccayoḥ sthitayoḥ pūjāṃ maṇḍalaṃ śṛṇu pārvati rekhābhirnavabhirmadhye tvekāśītipadaṃ likhet māyantāśītisaṃkhyātān madhye dāvagataṃ ca tata pañcabhiścālikhettatra bimbe somaṃ samarcayet raktacandanasindūragairikeṣvekato raveḥ dvivṛttāntastiryagūrdhvaṃ kṛtvā rekhāḥ samāntarāḥ prāṇādikānnamontāṃstu svairupetān svarairyutān svarairbhāntayutairvahnidaśārṇairgrathitāṃ lipim tanmadhye bhānumāvāhya pūjayet prāgvadīśvari susame'nāvṛte kṛtvā bimbāyuktāni pūjayet viśeṣādeśarahite tatra tatkramato'rcayet ravau sūryaśivau devi candre somāmbike tataḥ pare gurucaturvaktrau bhṛgau śukrapurandarau indraśca vasavo nāgā dharmaḥ śivadivākarau darśe tu pitaro devi pūjyāḥ sarvopacārakaiḥ guruḥ sarpāśca pitaro bhago'ryamadineśvarau nir-ṛtiścaiva toyaṃ ca viśvedevāḥ prajāpatiḥ ahirbudhnyaśca pūṣā ca proktā nakṣatradevatāḥ praṇavādyaiścaturthīhṛdantairnāmabhirīśvari dviruktaistaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgāni kuryādarṇaiḥ karāṅgayoḥ raktā raktāmbarā raktabhūṣaṇasragvilepanāḥ tadāvṛtīnāṃ pañcānāṃ śaktīstatsadṛśīḥ smaret aṣṭapatrāmbujaṃ madhye navayonau ca tāṃ yajet pṛṣṭhato gurupaṃktiṃ ca koṇeṣvaṣṭasu ca kramāt

rūpiṇīśaktisahitairmāyāsaptākṣarīyutaiḥ āsāṃ balipradānaṃ ca karotu kurukullayā madhye ca tatra tāṃ nityānityāṃ gandhādibhiryajet bāhyeṣvapi ca tāḥ prāgvat proktavarṇāḥ samarcayet ṣaṭtriṃśattāḥ samā devyāḥ sarvarūpāyudhādibhiḥ pareṣu yavalakṣārṇarahitaistaistathārcayet pūjā nigrahasaṃjñā syātsā śatrūṇāṃ vipattaye bījadvayādyaiḥ saptākṣaryyantaiḥ pañcadaśākṣaraiḥ teṣāṃ bījadvayaṃ varṇā rūpakṣetreśasaṃyutāḥ catuṣṣaṣṭipade madhyacatuṣke dinavidyayā ghaṭikākramayogena hṛnmāyāmadhyage'rcayet evaṃ maṇḍalamāsārdhātprāpnotyevābhivāñchitam samastavāñchitaprāptiḥ sadā bhavati sarvataḥ kāmīśvarīti tāṃ sarvakāmadāṃ śṛṇu tattvataḥ śūnyamagniyutaṃ paścādrayo vyāptena saṃyutaḥ nabho gotrā punaścaiṣā dāhena samayojitā eṣā kāmeśvarī nityā kāmadaikādaśākṣarī kāmeśvarīdevatā syādbrahmabījaṃ tu bījakam ekena hṛdayaṃ śīrṣaṃ tāvatātho dvayaṃ dvayāt dikśrotranāsādvitaye jihvāhṛnnābhiguhyake nyasedvidyākṣarāṇyeṣu sthāneṣu tadanantaram atha dhyānaṃ pravakṣyāmi nityapūjāsu coditam bālārkakoṭisaṅkāśāṃ māṇikyamukuṭojjvalām maṇḍitāṃ raktavasanāṃ raktābharaṇaśobhitām pañcāṣṭaṣoḍaśadvandvaṣaṭkoṇacaturasragām

pāśāṃkuśau ca puṇḍrekṣacāpaṃ puṣpaśilīmukham evaṃ dhyātvārcayed devīṃ nityapūjāsu siddhaye madanonmādanau paścāttathā dīpanamohanau kusumā mekhalā paścānmadanā madanāturā tato bhuvanapālā syācchaśirekhā tvanantarā śraddhā prīti ratiścaiva dhṛtiḥ kāntirmanoramā madanonmādinī paścānmohinī śaṅkhinī tataḥ sasvarāḥ ṣoḍaśa proktāḥ priyadarśinikāntikāḥ pūṣā ceddhā sumanasā ratiḥ prītirdhṛtistathā śaśinī cāṅgirā cchāyā tataḥ sampūrṇamaṇḍalā soḍaśasvapi patreṣu pūjayettā yathākramam tadbahiścaturasrasthalokeśāstatsamā yajet agnyādyasreṣu vidyādisaptākṣaryyantarāsthitaiḥ tatastāmaṅgavidyābhyāṃ kḷptārghyaḥ pūjayecchivām ghṛtāktairmadhurāktairvā prasūnairaruṇaiḥ śubhaiḥ śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi sāṅgāṃ sāvaraṇām kramāt dharāyuk sacarā paścāt sthirā paścādrasaḥ smṛtaḥ sthirā bhūsahitā gotrā sadāho'gnī rasaḥ sthirā tato rasaḥ sthirā paścānmarutā saha yojitā sthirā dharānvito haṃso vyāptena ca careṇa tu rasaḥ sthirā tataḥ sāgniḥ śūnyaṃ javiyuto marut rasaḥ sthirāmbu ca viyat svayutaṃ prāṇa eva ca sacaraḥ syāñjavī pūrvavidyātārtīyataḥ kramāt hṛdambuyuk kṣmayā dāhaḥ sacaraḥ syāñjavī ca hṛt sthirā tu marutā yuktā śūnyaṃ sāgni nabhaścarau

dāho gotrā carayutā tathā dāhastathā rayaḥ rasaḥ sthirā tataḥ prāṇo rasāgnisahito bhavet śūnyayugmaṃ ca gotrā syāddāhayuktāmbunā caraḥ gotrā dāhamarudyuktā tvambu vyāptamato bhavet rasaḥ sthirāmbvagniyutaṃ vāyuyugmaṃ carānvitam grāso bhūsahito devi raso vyāptaṃ tataśca hṛt śūnyaṃ ca kevalaṃ bhadre rasaśca sacarā sthirā bhūmi rasākṣmāsvayutā pañcaikāntaritāḥ sthitāḥ tāni kramājjyā sacaro raso bhūśca nabhoyutā śūnyayugmaṃ carayutaṃ hṛddāho'mbumarudyutaḥ śūnyaṃ sāgni namaḥ kuryāccareṇa sahitaṃ priye śūnya vyāptaṃ ca hṛdyuktaṃ rayadāhasvavahnibhiḥ haṃsaḥ syād dāhavahnisvairyuktamantyamudīritam devateyaṃ tu bījaṃ tu harablemātmakaṃ priye tataścaturbhiḥ śīrṣaṃ syācchikhā tribhirudīritā aruṇāmaruṇākalpāṃ sundarīṃ susmitānanām kahlārapāśapuṇḍrekṣukodaṇḍān vāmabāhubhiḥ tathāvidhābhiḥ paritovṛtāṃ śaktibhirātmabhiḥ pañcatriṃśacchatārṇaistai rūpiṇīśaktipañcakam madanāṃ mohinīṃ lolāṃ bhañjanīmudyamāṃ śubhām sarvonmādāṃ sarvasukhāṃ sabhaṅgāmabhitodyamām etāḥ syuḥ śaktyaḥ pañcapañcāśadbhiḥ śataṃ tviti atha pūjākramaṃ devi śṛṇu sarvārthadāyakam caturasradvayaṃ kṛtyā kuryād dvāraṃ tu paścime yonidvayaṃ tato madhye tiryagrekhāvidhānataḥ

agrādvilomagāstāsu śaktīḥ saṃsthāpya pūjayet niṣpādya tāvatīryonīrmadanādyāḥ samarcayet tanmadhye bhagamālāṃ tāmāvāhyoktasvarūpiṇīm arghyāmaṅgaiśca mūlena saṃsthāpyābhyukṣya mūlataḥ śabdasparśau tathā rūpaṃ rasaṃ gandhaṃ ca pūrvavat tadantarbhagamālāyāṃ madanādyāstathārcayet tato devīṃ ṣoḍaśabhirupacārairudīritaiḥ japedaṣṭottaraśatamagre devyāstu nityaśaḥ saṃyojya bindau tāṃ prāgvanmūlenābhyarcya tāṃ tathā devyātmā vaśayedviśvaṃ naranārīnarādhipān nityaklinnābhidhānāṃ tāṃ tanmantraṃ prāgudīritam kāmeśvaryāstṛtīyādivarṇānāmaṣṭakaṃ bhavet ekādaśākṣarī nityaklinnā nityā samīritā nityaklinnā devatoktā vanitā drāviṇī parā tato dvābhyāṃ punardvābhyāṃ dvābhyāṃ dvābhyāṃ dvayena ca tantre ṣaḍaṅgaṃ yatroktaṃ tatra tatra karadvaye śeṣaṃ taladvaye nyasya hṛddṛkśrotranasordvayoḥ aruṇāmaruṇākalpāmaruṇāṃśukadhāriṇīm netratrayollasadvaktrāṃ bhāle dharmāmbumoktikaiḥ caturbhirbāhubhiḥ pāśamaṃkuśaṃ pānapātrakam dhyātvaivaṃ pūjayennityaklinnānityāṃ svaśaktibhiḥ nityā nirañjanā klinnā kledinī madanāturā madābilā maṅgalā ca manmathārtā manasvinī caturasragatāḥ pūjyā madāruṇacalekṣaṇāḥ caturasradvayaṃ kṛtvā prākpratyakdvārasaṃyutam

arghyaṃ ṣaḍaṅgamūlābhyāṃ kṛtvā tāṃ prāṅmukho'rcayet dvārapārśveṣu koṇeṣu dikṣu tā daśa pūjayet arcayedaṣṭaśaktīstāstadantaryonikoṇagāḥ karṇikāyonimadhyasthadeśe vāyvīśavahniṣu tato devīṃ tu tāṃ nityāṃ nityaklinnāmudīritaiḥ tadagrato japedvidyāṃ sahasraṃ yadi vā śatam ājyasiktāndhasājyena puṣpairvā saurabhānvitaiḥ abhyarcya devīmatha tāṃ svātmanyudvāsya pūrvavat tadvidhānaṃ śṛṇu prājñe kathayāmi yathāvidhi raso dāhena tadyuktaṃ prāṇo dāhavanasvayuka jyā ca dāhena tadyuktā nityaklinnāntato dvayam devateyaṃ varārohe tṛtīyaṃ bījamucyate randhrājñāmukhakaṇṭheṣu hṛnnābhyādhārapaddvaye tataḥ śaktīsavṛtisthā dhyānaṃ ca śṛṇu pārvati tadantaraṣṭapatreṣu vijayāṃ vimalāṃ śubhām tadantaraṣṭakoṇeṣu kamalāṃ kāminīṃ tathā kalyāṇīṃ kākakolāṃ ca pūjayeduktayogataḥ śākinīṃ hākinīṃ ṣaṭsu koṇeṣu kramato'rccayet aṣṭakoṇāntarāleṣu pūjayedāyudhāṣṭakam tadantaraṣṭapatrābjaṃ vṛttayugmamathāntarā tadantastādṛśaṃ kuryāt ṣaṭkoṇaṃ vā tu vigraham bheruṇḍāṃ pañcamīṃ nityāmuktaśaktibhirāvṛttām baliṃ ca ṣoḍaśārṇena dadyādādyantayoḥ kramāt tadāvṛttisthaśaktīnāṃ krameṇa śṛṇu pārvati cārusmitāñcitamukhīṃ divyālaṅkārabhūṣitām

rasānānūpurormyādibhūṣaṇairatisundarīm karairdadhānāmāsīnāṃ pūjāyāmanyadāsthitām pūjayettadvadabhitaḥ smitasaumyamukhāṃ sadā balirmādyantayordadyāt pūrvoktavidhinā yutam sā vidyā vahnivāsinyāḥ kathitābhūnnavākṣarī tato'mbu śūnyaṃ haṃsāgniyutambu marudyutam śūnyaṃ namaḥ śaktiyutaṃ navārṇeyamudīritā ādyantaṃ bījaśaktī syāt kīlakaṃ madhyamena ca māyāntān ṣaḍbhirevāṅgānyācaret svakarāṅgayoḥ vyāpakaṃ tu samastena kuryād devyātmasiddhaye tena tattanmayo būyāt sādhakastena siddhayaḥ mātṛkāyāḥ ṣaḍaṅgaṃ ca mātṛkānyāsameva ca lalitāyāstu vargaistat proktamaṣṭābhireva ca taptakāñcanasaṃkāśāṃ navayauvanasundarīm aṣṭābhirbāhubhiryuktāṃ māṇikyābharaṇojjvalām pītakauśeyavasanāṃ raktamañjīramekhalām raktābjakambupuṇḍrekṣucāpapūrṇendumaṇḍalām puṣpeṣu mātuliṅgaṃ ca dadhānāṃ dakṣiṇaiḥ karaiḥ evaṃ dhyātvārcayedvahnivāsinīṃ viśvavigrahām kanakā kitavā viśvā vividhā ceti śaktayaḥ daleṣu dvādaśasvetā rāśiśaktīḥ samarcayet ghasmarā sarvabhakṣā ca viśvā ca vividhodbhavā acintyavaibhavā raktā daśamī parikīrtitā yatra noktā devatā tu balikarmaṇi tatra tām vṛttayornavayoniṃ tu kṛtvā tadbahirambujam

tadbahiścaturasre dve dvāradvayasamanvite tasyā vidhānaṃ vakṣyāmi śṛṇu sarvārthasādhakam tadaṅgāni lipinyāsaṃ dhyānaṃ śaktibhirarcanam pañcamaṃ bhagamālādyaṃ bheruṇḍāyā dvitīyakam aṣṭamaṃ navamaṃ ca syādetadādyamitīritam māyayā puṭitaṃ kṛtvā kuryādaṅgāni ṣaṭ kramāt dṛkśrotranāsāvāgvakṣonābhiguhyeṣu ca kramāt caturbhujāṃ trinayanāṃ māṇikyamukuṭojjvalām dadhānāṃ bāhurbhirnetrairdayāmadasuśītalaiḥ cakramadhye sukhāsīnāṃ smeravaktrasaroruhām siṃhāsane'bhitaḥ preṅkhatpotasthābhiśca śaktibhiḥ kurvāṇamaruṇāmabhodhau cintayenmantranāyikām ḍākinyādyāḥ ṣaḍasrasthā padmadvādaśapatragāḥ nirañjanā rāgavatī tathaiva madanāvatī tataḥ ṣoḍaśapatrasthāḥ śaktīrākarṇayāmbike kirātāṃ kālakadane kauśikīṃ kambuvāhinīm caturasrasthāśca śaktīrākarṇaya ca tāḥ kramāt ratiḥ śraddhā bhogalolā madonmatte manasvinī dvādaśaitāmahādevyāścaturasrābhito yajet śoṇābdhiṃ hemapotaṃ ca siṃhāsanamataḥ param māyāsaptākṣarīmadhyagatairnāmabhirarcayet devyāstu kurukullāyā homaṃ kuryādyathāvidhi prāgvat samāpayeditthamarcanaṃ te samīritam tadvidhānaṃ śṛṇu prājñe samīhitaphalapradam tathāvaraṇaśaktīśca taddhyānaṃ tatprapūjanam

ambu syānmarutā yuktaṃ gotrā kṣmāsaṃyutā tataḥ antyarṇau vahnivāsinyā dūtī nityā samīritā tenaiva puṭitairarṇairnyasecchrotrādipañcasu prāgvadarghya samuddiṣṭaṃ tacchaktīḥ śṛṇu pārvati vinodā kautukā puṇyā purāṇā caturasragāḥ vīrā vighnaharā vidyetyuktvā yantrāṣṭaśaktayaḥ samayā sarvagā vidyetyuktāstvaṣṭāsraśaktayaḥ mūladevīsamākāravarṇākāra (yudha) samanvitāḥ nādāṃ manonmanīṃ ṣaṭsu patreṣu parito'rcayet madhye devīṃ hetivṛtāṃ pūjayedaṣṭamīṃ śivām tathāpi bhaktasarvāṇahetoḥ kḷptāṃ parāṃ tanum navaratnakirīṭāṃ ca trīkṣaṇāmaruṇāmbarām śucismitāmaṣṭabhujāṃ stūyamānāṃ maharṣibhiḥ dakṣiṇairaṃkuśaṃ khaḍgaṃ kuṭhāraṃ kamalaṃ tathā dhyātvaivaṃ pūjayed devīṃ dūtīṃ durnītināśinīm (tathā ṣaḍasramaṣṭāsraṃ tadvaṣṭadalāmbujam) āvāhyābhyarcya tacchaktīḥ prāguktavidhinā sthitāḥ proktaiva tvaritā vidyā prāgeva dvādaśākṣarā yena mantrī manmathābho vikṣobhayati bhūtalam haṃso dharāsvasaṃyuktaḥ tejaścarasamanvitam hṛdā rayeṇa dāhena vahniḥ syādaṣṭamaṃ priye dyutirnādayutā nityā tvaritā dvādaśākṣarī kavacaṃ strī śaktibīje kṣeca kīlakamīritam kuryādaṅgāni yugmārṇaiḥ ṣaṭ krameṇa karāṅgayoḥ ūruyugme tathā jānuyugme jaṅghādvaye tathā

dvitīyopāntyamadhyasthairmantrārṇairitarairapi śyāmavarṇāṃ śubhākārāṃ navayauvanaśobhinīm tāṭaṅkamaṅgadaṃ tadvadraśanānūpurānvitaiḥ pallavāṃśukasaṃvītāṃ śikhipucchakṛtaiḥ śubhaiḥ barhibarhakṛtāpīḍāṃ tacchatrāṃ tatpatākinīm trinetrāṃ cāruvadanāṃ mandasmitamukhāmbujām dhyātvaivaṃ totulāṃ devīṃ pūjayecchaktibhirvṛtām prasāde phaladāne ca sādhakānāṃ tvarānvitām kṛṣṇavarṇo gadāpāṇirvarvarordhvaśiroruhaḥ taddvārapārśvayoḥ pūjye jayāvijayasaṃjñike huṃkārī khecarī caṇḍā chedinī kṣepiṇī tataḥ pūjyāḥ padmāṣṭapatreṣu sthitā mantrārṇaśaktayaḥ śṛṇu pūjāvidhiṃ tasyāstvaritāyā maheśvari āsane hemaracite vidadhyāt bhūpuradvayam tadantaraṣṭapatrābjaṃ vidhāyātra parāṃ śivām mudrādarśanapūrvaṃ tu pūjayettāṃ yathoditām kiṅkarasya baliṃ dadyād devyagre prāgudīritaiḥ evaṃ pūjāṃ vidhāyāgre japedvidyāṃ sahasrakam vidyoktā kulasundaryāstasyāḥ pūjāvidhiṃ śṛṇu prāṇo dvitīyaḥ svayuto vanahṛcchaktibhiḥ paraḥ chandaḥ paṃktistu vijñeyaṃ mukhe vinyasya devatām vāgbhavaṃ bījamityuktaṃ śaktistārtīyamīritam ādyamadhyāvasāneṣu pūjājapavidhau kramāt kuryāt karāṅgavaktrāṇāṃ nyāsaṃ proktaṃ yathāvidhi śucinatyantarasthaistaistadātmasu yathākramam

tṛtīyaṃ śrotracibuke caturthaṃ ghrāṇatāluṣu mūlamadhyāgrato nyasyennavadhā mūlavarṇakaiḥ lohitāṃśukabhūṣāsraglepanāṃ ṣaṇmukhāmbujām anarghyaratnaghaṭitamāṇikmukuṭojjvalām ratnastabakasaṃbhinnalasadvakṣaḥsthalāṃ śubhām bhujairdvādaśabhiryuktāṃ sarveśīṃ sarvavāṅmayīm ratnapūrṇaṃ tu caṣakaṃ luṅgīṃ vyākhyānamudrikām haimīṃ ca lekhanīṃ ratnamālāṃ kambu varaṃ bhujaiḥ yakṣarākṣasadevarṣisiddhavidyādharādibhiḥ sitāṃ kevalavāksiddhyai lakṣmyai hemaprabhāmapi nīlāṃ ca mūkīkaraṇe smarettattadapekṣayā bahurūpā citrarūpā ramyāpyānandakautuke bahiraṣṭacchadāmbhoje brāhmyādyāstāḥ samarcayet indrāgniyamarakṣorbhirvaruṇānilasomakān śaktyāntairnāmabhiḥ prāgvat pūjayet sarvasiddhaye tanmadhye vṛttayugmasthaṃ kuryādaṣṭacchadāmbujam kṛtvātra tāṃ samāvāhya prāgvat samyagathārcayet tathaiva lokapālāntaśaktī dvāradvaye'rcayet saptākṣaryā baliṃ dadyāt pūjānte kurukullayā nityānityāṃ śṛṇu prājñe tadāyattamidaṃ jagat yāsau samastabhūtānāṃ dehasthitividhāyinī vidyayā kulasundaryā yojitaḥ sampradāyataḥ bhrūmadhye kaṇṭhahṛnnābhiguhyādhāreṣu ca kramāt vyāpakaṃ tu samastena vidhāya vidhinā yutam udyadbhāskarabimbābhāṃ māṇikyamukuṭojjvalām

cārusmitalasadvaktraṣaṭsarojavirājitām pāśākṣaguṇapuṇḍrekṣucāpakheṭatriśūlakān puṣpeṣu maṇḍalāgraṃ ca kapālamabhayaṃ tathā anantāḥ śaktayo devyāstvākarṇaya vadāmi te pūrṇamaṇḍalavarṇāḥ syurante śaktītisaṃyutāḥ ṣaṭsaptatyā pañcaśataṃ yajettābhirvṛtāṃ śivām rakṣonilendravahnīśavaruṇeṣu kramācca tāḥ śākinī hākinī mūladevīsadṛśavigrahāḥ kṛtanyāsārdhasaṃkalpaḥ pūjayedīritakramāt ṣaṭkoṇādbahirabjaṃ tu śatārdhaikadalānvitam dvicatuṣṣaḍdalaśatairdvādaśāṣṭadalacchadaiḥ caturasradvayaṃ bāhye caturdvārasamanvitam brāhmyādilokapālākhyāḥ ṣoḍaśadvārasaṃsthitāḥ tasyā nīlapatākāyā vidhānaṃ sarvasiddhidam hṛcca dāhakṣmāsvayutaṃ (vajreśīpañcamaṃ tataḥ bhūmī rasākṣmāsvayutā) vajreśī ṣaṣṭhataḥ kramāt dyutirdāhacarasvena asyā ādyamanantaram nityā nīlapatākākhyā hrīṃbījaṃ hrīṃ ca śaktikam dvicatuṣṭayaṣaṭtryarṇaiḥ krameṇa ṣaḍītiritaiḥ nābhāvādhārake pādasandhiṣu triṣu ca kramāt vyāpakaṃ samastena vidadhyācca yathāvidhi pañcavaktrāṃ trinayanāmaruṇāṃśukadhāriṇīm ratnastavakasambhinnadehāṃ cārusmitānanām dadhānāṃ vāmapārśvasthaiḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaiḥ dadhānāṃ dakṣiṇairhastairāsīnāṃ padmaviṣṭare

śaktivṛndairvṛtāṃ dhyāyeddevīṃ nityārcanakrame dvya(a)ṣṭāraṃ bhūpuradvandvād vṛtte tatpurayugmakam kṛtvā tāmāvṛtāṃ śaktigaṇaistatrārcayecchivām agrāt pradakṣiṇenaiva yajedāvṛttipañcakam) brāhmyādīraṣṭapatreṣu tatkoṇeṣu bahistathā balidvayaṃ ca kurvīta pūjāṃ prāgvat samāpayet tilataṇḍulakairvāpi proktaṃ dravyānudīrite tadvidhānaṃ śṛṇu prājñe vidyā prāguditā tava svena yuktā bhavennityā vijayaikākṣarā matā śeṣābhyāṃ ca dvayaṃ kuryāt ṣadaṅgāni karaṅgayoḥ akṣarāṇi kramādbinduyutātvanyattu pūrvavat bhāsvanmukuṭavinyastacandrarekhāvirājitām udyadbhāsvadbimbatulyadehakāntiṃ śucismitām cakraṃ tathāṃkuśaṃ khaḍgaṃ sāyakaṃ mātuluṅgakam (upāsane'tisaumyāṃ ca siṃhopari kṛtāsanām) samare pūjane'nyeṣu prayogeṣu sukhāsanām sarvā devyāḥ samākāramukhapāṇyāyudhā api śākhāṣṭakasamopetaṃ tatra prāgvat samarcayet tadantaśca tathā padmaṃ ṣoḍaśacchadasaṃyutam tattacchaktyāvṛtāṃ samyagupacāraistathārcayet balidvayaṃ prakurvīta pūjāṃ cāpi samāpayet candrakhaṇḍalasanmauliyutāḥ sā tanmayī sadā tadāvaraṇagāḥ śaktīstatsamākārahetikāḥ tāsāṃ krameṇa nāmāni śṛṇu vakṣye yathāvidhi brāhmyādilokapālāśca ṣoḍaśadvārasaṃsthitāḥ

jayāṃ ca vijayāṃ durgāṃ bhadrāṃ bhadrakarīmapi tadantaḥ ṣoḍaśadaleṣvarcayet ṣoḍaśābhitaḥ vidārikāṃ viśvamayīṃ viśvāṃ viśvavibhañjikāma vītaśokāṃ viṣagrīvāṃ vipulāṃ vijayapradām tadantaraṣṭapatreṣu śaktīraṣṭābhito yajet manoharāṃ maṅgalāṃ ca madotsiktāṃ manasvinīm evaṃ pūjājapadhyānahomopāsanato vaśī ekākṣarā tu sā proktā vidyā sā sarvamaṅgalā pūjākramaṃ sādhanaṃ ca viniyogādikān kramāt ekākṣaryānayā siddho jāyate khecaraḥkṣaṇāt tāni tatsvarabhinnāni tāni ṣaṭsumanovadhi māṇikyamukuṭāṃ netradvayapreṅkhaṅkhaddayāparām patrairupete sacaturdvārabhūsadmayugmake vāmena nijabhaktānāṃ prayacchantīṃ dhanādikam ṣaṭsaptatibhiranyābhirakṣarotthābhiranvitām tāḥ śaktīḥ śṛṇu deveśi yā nityāvaraṇasthitāḥ kuṃkumāṃ kamalāṃ kalpāṃ pūjayedaṣṭapatrake aśokāmamalāṃ pūrṇāṃ puṇyāṃ bhāgyāmathodyatām pūjayedabhitaḥ śaktīḥ prādakṣiṇyakrameṇa vai gaurīṃ śivāmameyāṃ ca vimalāṃ vijayāṃ parām aśeṣarūpāmānandāmambujākṣīmaninditām vandyāṃ vāgīśvarīṃ satyāṃ saṃ (ñjā?ya) tāṃ ca sarasvatīm prāgvadgandhādibhiḥ sarvāḥ kramādatvarthasaṃjñitāḥ paścimādi caturdikṣu catasraḥ proktavigrahāḥ balidvayaṃ ca homaṃ ca kuryāt prāgvat samāpanam

tadvidhānaṃ śṛṇu prājñe jvālāmālinyudāhṛtā rayo'gninā yuto jyāmbu marudyuktā rasā marut gotrā caraṇe sahitā ambu pūrvākṣaraṃ tathā haṃsaśca marutā dāhaḥ prāṇaśca marutā yutaḥ careṇāmbu ca gotrā hṛtsāgni jyāmburasā svayuk dāhenānena te dviḥ syāt haṃso dāhamarutsvayuk sapta dāhāstato'syāḥ syuraṣṭamādyāstu pañca vai tvaritāntyaṃ ca bheruṇḍā aṣṭamaṃ navamaṃ tathā rephāstre bījaśaktī tu kīlakaṃ kavacaṃ priye kuryādaṅgāni mūlārṇairāditaḥ ṣaṭ karāṅgayoḥ ṣaḍvaktrāṃ dvādaśabhujāṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitām śūlavahnī varābhītī dadhānāṃ karapaṅkajaiḥ cārusmitalasadvaktrasarojāṃ trīkṣaṇānvitām caturasradvayaṃ kṛtvā caturdvārasamanvitam ṣaṭkoṇaṃ madhyatastryasraṃ vidhāyātra śivāṃ yajet ḍākinyādyāśca ṣaṭkoṇe tvaṣṭāsre ghasmarādikāḥ sarvabhakṣā sahasrākṣī niḥsaṅgā saṃhṛtipriyā acintyāmaprameyāṃ ca pūrṇarūpāṃ durāsadām bahirdvāreṣu koṇeṣu pūjayet prāgudīritāḥ balihomāvasānāntamiti samyak samīritam proktā tatkalpamadhunā śṛṇu sarvārthasiddhidam dhyānaṃ śaktīḥ pūjanañca sādhanaṃ tatphalāni ca ṣaḍaṅgāni yathāpūrvaṃ mātṛkāṃ vidyayā nyaset navaratnakirīṭāṃ ca citrapaṭṭāṃśukojjvalām sarvānandamayīṃ nityāṃ samastepsitadāyinīm

dadhānāṃ maṅgalāpadmakarṇikānavayonigām navayonāvaṣṭavargayutā brāhmyādikā yajet hetiśca parito devyāḥ pūjayet tadbhujāntike pūjayet tattadakārāṃstattanmantrairyathāvidhi sarvāsāmapi nityānāṃ yadādyāsyandajā imāḥ sā vidyā kurukullāyāḥ pañcaviṃśākṣaro manuḥ vyāptaṃ marucchaktiyutaṃ bhūḥ svayuktā tatastrayam dāhena vahniśaktibhyāṃ yuto haṃsastataḥ param ambu paścādviyadyuktaṃ marutā tu nabhaḥ priye asya ṣaṣṭhādipañcārṇādantyau syādādya īritaḥ tṛtīyaḥ pañcaviṃśārṇaḥ proktā mantrā iti kramāt oṃ kurukulle svāhā iti saptākṣarī kurukullāyāḥ oṃkurukulle hrīḥ svāhā iti trayodaśākṣarī svāhā iti pañcaviṃśākṣarī saptabhiḥ prathamā proktā trayodaśayutā parā evaṃ sā tribhirapyetairvidyārūpairabhīṣṭadā dvīpe tāṃ lalitāṃ nityavinodānanditāṃ yajet tatsāgareṣu parito ratnapotacarīṃ yajet balicakraṃ ca tenaiva tanmadhye tu samarcayet kṛtvā tadantaḥ padmaṃ ca sāṣṭapatraṃ sakarṇikam ṣaḍaṅgaṃ bālayā kṛtvā tenārghyamapi sādhayet dhyātvaivaṃ parivāraistāṃ devīṃ gandhādibhiḥ kramāt dadhānāṃ cintayedbāṇacāpapāśasṛṇīḥ karaiḥ ṛtusnātāḥ sphuradyonyaḥ sadānandāruṇekṣaṇāḥ tatastadājñayārohed bhrāmiṇīṃ drāviṇīṃ yajet

sūryaṃ somaṃ tithiṃ vāraṃ yogarkṣakaraṇānyapi prāṇaṃ buddhiṃ tathā śaktimaṣṭapatreṣu pūjayet tato bāṇān dhanuḥ pāśamaṃkuśaṃ cābhito yajet śaktīryaṣṭvātha tanmadhye saṃvidāsanamarcayet tatastadājñayā potaparītaṃ dvīpamāgataḥ parīyamāṇe dikṣvetānarcayet tatra tatra vai namontairnāmabhiḥ pūrvamarcayedgandhapuṣpakaiḥ evaṃ samarcitaṃ devyā lalitāyāḥ priyaṅkaram prasīdati yatastasmāt pūjayedevamīśvari pañcaviṃśārṇamūlena pūjānte parameśvari tāṃ śṛṇu tvaṃ priye! vacmi tārāvidyāṃ daśākṣarīm rayo dharānvitaḥ paścādrayayugmaṃ marudyutam ṣaṣṭhaṃ tadaṣṭamaṃ vidyād hṛdambumarudanvitam dhyānaṃ devyāḥ śṛṇu prājñe samastāpannikṛntanam śyāmavarṇāṃ trinayanāṃ dvibhujāṃ varapaṅkaje śaktibhiḥ smeravadanāṃ raktamauktikabhūṣaṇām navayonāvaṣṭavargayutā brāhmyādikā yajet hetiśca parito devyāḥ pūjayet tadbhujāntike pūjayet tattadakārāṃstattanmantrairyathāvidhi sarvāsāmapi nityānāṃ yadādyāsyandajā imāḥ sā vidyā kurukullāyāḥ pañcaviṃśākṣaro manuḥ vyāptaṃ marucchaktiyutaṃ bhūḥ svayuktā tatastrayam dāhena vahniśaktibhyāṃ yuto haṃsastataḥ param ambu paścādviyadyuktaṃ marutā tu nabhaḥ priye asya ṣaṣṭhādipañcārṇādantyau syādādya īritaḥ

tṛtīyaḥ pañcaviṃśārṇaḥ proktā mantrā iti kramāt oṃ kurukulle svāhā iti saptākṣarī kurukullāyāḥ oṃ kurukullehrīḥ svāhā iti trayodaśākṣarī saptabhiḥ prathamā proktā trayodaśayutā parā evaṃ sā tribhirapyetairvidyārūpairabhīṣṭadā dvīpe tāṃ lalitāṃ nityavinodānanditāṃ yajet tatsāgareṣu parito ratnapotacarīṃ yajet balicakraṃ ca tenaiva tanmadhye tu samarcayet kṛtvā tadantaḥ padmaṃ ca sāṣṭapatraṃ sakarṇikam ṣaḍaṅgaṃ bālayā kṛtvā tenārghyamapi sādhayet dhyātvaivaṃ parivāraistāṃ devīṃ gandhādibhiḥ kramāt dadhānāṃ cintayedbāṇacāpapāśasṛṇīḥ karaiḥ ṛtusnātāḥ sphuradyonyaḥ sadānandāruṇekṣaṇāḥ tatastadājñayārohed bhrāmiṇīṃ drāviṇīṃ yajet sūryaṃ somaṃ tithi vāraṃ yogarkṣakaraṇānyapi prāṇaṃ buddhiṃ tathā śaktimaṣṭapatreṣu pūjayet tato bāṇān dhanuḥ pāśamaṃkuśaṃ cābhito yajet śaktīryaṣṭvātha tanmadhye saṃvidāsanamarcayet tatastadājñayā potaparītaṃ dvīpamāgataḥ parīyamāṇe dikṣvetānarcayet tatra tatra vai namontairnāmabhiḥ pūrvamarcayedgandhapuṣpakaiḥ evaṃ samarcitaṃ devyā lalitāyāḥ priyaṅkaram prasīdati yatastasmāt pūjayedevamīśvari pañcaviṃśārṇamūlena pūjānte parameśvari tāṃ śṛṇu tvaṃ priye! vacmi tārāvidyāṃ daśākṣarīm

rayo dharānvitaḥ paścādrayayugmaṃ marudyutam ṣaṣṭhaṃ tadaṣṭamaṃ vidyād hṛdambumarudanvitam dhyānaṃ devyāḥ śṛṇu prājñe samastāpannikṛntanam śyāmavarṇāṃ trinayanāṃ dvibhujāṃ varapaṅkaje saktibhiḥ smeravadanāṃ raktamauktikabhūṣaṇām taddvidhā kathitā pūrvaṃ tadaṅgāni ca pūjanam homairyantraiśca vakṣyāmi samastābhīṣṭasiddhaye ambu paścādrayaḥ sāgnirmarutāmburayau tathā dāhaśca marutā haṃsastvagniretattrayaṃ punaḥ tejo'gninā yutaḥpañca vātaḥ svena samāyutaḥ śūnyaṃ vyāptena śucinā śūnyaṃ śaktyā nabhoyutam etatpūrvamadhaḥ proktacatuṣṭayamataḥ param raso'gninā punaḥ proktacatuṣkāt trayamantataḥ haṃso'gninā prāk tritayaṃ hṛdayaṃ svasamāyutam paścāduktatrayaṃ vāto dharayā ca nabhaḥ priye vyāptametattrayaṃ paścād hṛd dāhenāmbusaṃyutam dāhena pūrvaṃ pūrvaṃ ca pūrvaṃ ca marutā yutam sparśo marutsvasahito hṛd dāhenāmbunā yutam hṛdayena svena yutaṃ rasaśca svena saṃyutaḥ vārdāhayuktamambu syādviyad vyāptasvasaṃyutam sthirā rasā vanasvena dāvau haṃso dharāsvayuk haṃsaśca marutā vidyā daśottaraśatākṣarī daśabhiḥ saptabhiḥ saptasaṃkhyairjātibhiranvitam vidhāya cakraṃ tatraiva svanāmnāvāhya pūjayet sarvamadhye samabhyarcya vāmadakṣāgrakoṇataḥ

ādyabījāntyasaprāṇairupetāmatha pūjayet vṛtte caiva mahālakṣmīṃ pañcamīṃ madhyatastathā ākaṇṭhavanitārūpāṃ jvalatpiṅgaśiroruhām pāśaṃ ca musalaṃ sīramabhayaṃ varadaṃ tathā tantre caturdaśaḥ śvāsaḥ śrīmattripurasundaryā jananyā jagatāṃ sadā prātastripurasundaryā namāmi caraṇāmbujam (prātastripurasundaryā namāmi padapaṅkajam) prātaḥ pāśāṃkuśaśarapāśahastāṃ namāmyaham prātarnamāmi pādābjaṃ yayedaṃ bhāsate jagat yaḥ ślokapañcakamidaṃ prātarnityaṃ paṭhennaraḥ ādhāre hṛdaye śīrṣe vahnau sūrye niśākare nyasecca mātṛkāsthāne tadā taddehaśuddhaye prauḍhā ca niṣkalāceti sandhyā devi prakīrtitā kāmeśvarī ca madhyāhne sāyāhne purabhairavī taḍitkoṭisamābhāsāṃ bālāmakṣasragujjvalām vāgbhavāṃ vāgbhavaudbhūtāṃ trīkṣaṇāṃ sasmitāṃ smaret vāgbījarūpāṃ nityāṃ tāṃ vidyutpaṭalabhāsvarām svecchāgṛhītavapuṣaṃ yuganityākṣarātmikām jñānamudrāvarakarān vāgbhavopāstitatparān kartavyā matriṇā nityaṃ mantrasiddhisamṛddhaye aśuddhaḥ sa durācāraḥ sarvakarmabahiṣkṛtaḥ homān kṛtvā maheśāni nārakī jāyate naraḥ kurvannakāraṇaṃ viprastyajañ śvā ca bhaveddhruvam sandhyānāmapi sarvāsāṃ prātaḥsandhyā garīyasī

ekaikaṃ mātṛkāvarṇāḥ pañcāśad parivṛttitaḥ kāmarājātmikāṃ devīmarkakoṭisamaprabhām paritaścātmamukhyābhiḥ ṣaṭtriṃśattattvaśaktibhiḥ yuganityākṣaramayīṃ ghaṭikāvaraṇāṃ smaret hṛtpaṅkaje ca tāḥ kāmarājopāstiparāyaṇāḥ śaktibījātmikāṃ cāpavāṇapāśāṃkuśānvitām cintayitvā bhagavatīṃ nityābhiḥ parivāritām nityāḥ ṣoḍaśa cājñāyā.ṃ sāyaṃkāle tu saṃsmaret dīkṣitaḥ sandhyayā hīno na dīkṣāphalamaśnute vidhāyottarasaṃdhyāyāḥ kriyāṃ kuryat samāhitaḥ dadhānāṃ kāmarājāṅke yantritāṃ muditāṃ smaret navaratnamayaiścitraiḥ stavakaiścopaśobhitām virājamānāṃ tāṃ divyāṃ divyāṃśukavidhāriṇīm sahajāsavasaṃbhogaiḥ sañjātānandavigrahām parito bhūṣaṇaiścitraiḥ kārṣṇacāmarakādibhiḥ śaktibhirdarśitānagre paśyantīmabhitotsavām madhyapradhānadevyāstu samullāsātmakatvataḥ kāmāṅkayantrādanyatra bhūṣāvarṇāyudhādikam pradarśayet || iti prathamāvaraṇam sarvavidrāviṇīmudrāṃ pradarśayed || iti dvitīyāvaraṇapūjā sarvākarṣiṇīmudrāṃ pradarśayet | iti tṛtīyāvaraṇapūjā iti caturthāvaraṇapūjā pañcamāvaraṇapūjā ṣaṣṭhāvaraṇapūjā saptamāvaraṇapūjā

ityaṣṭamāvaraṇapūjā navamāvaraṇapūjā varṇaistajjanitairmantrairyantraiḥ kālātmatāṃ kramāt yajjñānopāstibhedābhyāṃ mantrāḥ siddhyanti varṇinaḥ mātṝṇāṃ tu svaraireko vargaḥ pūrvavaduttaram ṣaṭsaptatyā pañcaśataṃ tāvadabdaistu pūrṇatā trisahasrasamāvṛttyā proktā kṛtayugāvadhiḥ māyādharāgnivātasvaiḥ kṛtādyarṇāḥ samīritāḥ dinārṇeṣu svarā nyāse bindurūpā anukramāt tattadyugārṇāṃstatsthāne svarūpeṇa vyavasthitāḥ sarvatra yantravinyāsapratiṣṭhārcādyanugrahe ārabhya bhānorudayamekaśo ghaṭikākramāt divasaiḥ pañcabhistasyāḥ ṣaḍāvṛttirudīritā yonau trikoṇamālikhya tasmin yoniṃ samālikhet yugārṇaṃ ghaṭikārṇena madhye vinyasya tatra vai uttamā nityanityaṃ hi madhyamā parvaparvaṇi pūrṇamaṇḍalavarṇāḥ syuḥ prathame tvāditaḥ kramāt tṛtīyā sarvato vahnirevaṃ vidyāstu tryakṣarāḥ etāḥ pustakamāropya pīṭhe saṃsthāpya pūjayet bhūtāpamṛtyukṛtyādyā na bhavanti purādike saṣaṭtriṃśatsaptaśataṃ sahasrāṇi ca viṃśatiḥ stambhanādyeṣu tadvarṇāstadrūpā hetivāhanaiḥ nāthāvṛttirmantrarāśau dvisahasraṃ śatatrayam pūrṇamaṇḍalasaṃkhyayaiva nityāvṛttiḥ sahasrataḥ mātṛbhairavagāṃ vande devīṃ tripurabhairavīm

aṣṭaśaktyāvṛtāṃ vande devīṃ tripurabhairavīm ṣaṭtriṃśattattvagāṃ vande devīṃ tripurabhairavīm kāditattvāntarāṃ vande devīṃ tripurabhairavīm sarvātmikāṃ parāṃ vande devīṃ tripurabhairavīm liṅgatrayātigāṃ vande devīṃ tripurabhairavīm prācyāṃ pratyakcitiṃ vande devīṃ tripurabhairavīm śaktiṃ viśveśvarīṃ vande devīṃ tripurabhairavīm japanto vāramekaṃ tu vidyā nityātmikāstutāḥ labhante lalitā yābhiḥ saṃpradāyavatī bhavet madhyāhne tu samārabhya madhyarātrau samāpayet vaśinyāḥ prathamaṃ varga kāmeśvaryā dvitīyamkam dineṣu modinīvargādekaikaṃ prajapet sudhīḥ paṃktidvayasthā vidyāstu prajapet prativāsaram pūrṇāsu prajapedvidyāścatuṣpaṃktibhavāḥ sudhiḥ naitābhiḥ sadṛśī kāpi vidyā lokeṣu vidyate yadyannijopsitaṃ tattadduḥkaraṃ sukaraṃ bhavet pañcāśadvāramāvartya vidyā bhaktisamanvitaḥ śatavāraṃ samāvartya vidyāvibhavavaibhavāḥ adhyardhaśatavāraṃ tu vidyā āvartya bhaktitaḥ tāvadāvartya kanyā vā patiṃ sarvaguṇānvitam dviśataṃ tāḥ samāvartya dāridryānmucyate dhruvam pañcabhiśca śatairbhūpo bhavet ṣaḍbhiḥ śatairnṛpaḥ aṣṭabhistu śataistāsāṃ nṛpāḥ sarve'tha kiṃkarāḥ evaṃ navaśataṃ japtvā sarvān kāmānavāpnuyāt devīṃ mantramayīṃ naumi mātṛkāṃ pīṭharūpiṇīm

kālahallohalollolakalanāśamakāriṇīm ravitārkṣyandukandarpaśaṅkarānalaviṣṇubhiḥ vande sarveśvarīṃ devīṃ mahāśrīsiddhamātṛkām brahmāṇḍādikaṭāhāntaṃ tāṃ vande siddhimātṛkām brahmāṇḍādikaṭāhāntaṃ jagadadyāpi dṛśyate jyeṣṭhāṅgabāhuhṛtpṛṣṭhakaṭipādanivāsinīm praṇamāmi mahādevīṃ paramānandarūpiṇīm keyaṃ kasmāt kva keneti svarūpārūpabhāvanām devīṃ kulakalollolaprollasantīṃ paraulijām vande tāmaṣṭavargotthamahāsiddhyaṣṭakeśvarīm caturājñākośabhūtāṃ naumi śrītripurāmaham devyāstvakhaṇḍarūpāyāḥ stavanaṃ tava tadyataḥ bhūtapretapiśācādipīḍāśāntyai sukhāptaye caurasiṃhadvīpigajagavayādibhayānake salilāgnimarutpīḍāsvabdhau potādisaṃkaṭe sukhī jivati nirdvandvo niḥsapatno jitendriyaḥ yenāhamapi yuddheṣu devāsurajayī sadā kāmeśī purataḥ pātu bhagamālā tvanantaram nityaklinnā tu bheruṇḍā diśaṃ pātu sadā mama mahāvajreśvarī rakṣedanantaradiśaṃ sadā pālayettu diśaṃ vātyāṃ rakṣetmāṃ kulasundarī nityā nīlapatākākhyā vijayā sarvataśca mām dehendriyamanaḥprāṇān jvālāmālinivigrahā kāmāt krodhāt tathā lobhānmohānmānānmadādapi staimityācca samudyogādaśubheṣu tu karmasu

rakṣantu māṃ sarvadā tāḥ kurvantvicchāṃ śubheṣu ca tathā hayasamārūḍhāḥ pāntu māṃ sarvataḥ sadā rathārūḍhāśca māṃ pāntu sarvataḥ sarvadā raṇe bhūgatāḥ sarvadā pāntu māṃ sarvatra ca sarvadā drāvayantu svaśaktīnāṃ bhīṣaṇairāyudhairmama asaṃkhyāḥśaktayo devyaḥ pāntu māṃ sarvataḥ sadā kadācinnāśubhaṃ paśyenna śṛṇoti ca tatsamaḥ caturbhiḥ kuḍavaiḥ prasthaḥ prasthāścatvāra āḍhakaḥ kumbho droṇadvayaṃ śūrpaḥ khārī droṇāstu ṣoḍaśa vṛttaṃ ṣaṭtriṃśadasraṃ ca tadvadaṣṭādaśāsrakam caturasramatha tryasramiti bhedā nava kramāt tena dvāsaptatirbhedāsteṣu nityārṇabhedataḥ eteṣvādyasya vṛttasya vinyāsenānyadunnayet evaṃ punaḥ punaḥ kuryādekaikāṃgulato bahiḥ ṣaṭtriṃśadbhistatasteṣu nyasedvarṇāstathāditaḥ bāhyāntaraparāvṛttī tathā vyākīrṇamityapi yojayedvāhyakoṣṭhasthaiḥ prāguktavidhinā kramāt aṣṭāsre ṣoḍaśārāḥ syuḥ ṣaṭtriṃśadvṛttamanyavat kṛtvā daleṣu kramaśo vāgdevyaṣṭakamālikhet vidhāta pūjayennityaṃ pustapūjoktasiddhaye na kadācicchriyo hānirbhaviṣyati ca tatkule tatra devīṃ samāvāhya saṃpūjya vidhivanniśi saṃpūjya śiṣyaṃ saṃsthāpya bhaktyā tamabhiṣecayet kuryāt karṣasuvarṇasya mudrikā gauśca dakṣiṇā pārthivastasya vandyo vā bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ

varṣatrayābhiṣekeṇa siddhyā vidyādharo bhavet pañcavarṣābhiṣekeṇa pañcatvaṃ nādhigacchati saptavarṣābhiṣekeṇa divākarasamo bhavet navavarṣābhiṣekeṇa devīsārūpyamāpnuyāt āvṛttirjapahomārcātarpaṇaiḥ sādhu sadhayet tathotpāteṣu sarveṣu tathā rogādyupadrave tathā kṛtyāsamutpattāviyaṃ sarvārthasiddhidā etaccakrāravinyāsarūpā bhūmiśca dṛśyate sarve manorathāḥ siddhā bhajanaiḥ saṃpradāyataḥ japatarpaṇahomārcāsnapaneṣvapyayaṃ kramaḥ kṛtyotpattau śatrubhaṅge nigrahe pratilomakam vaśīkaraṇarakṣāsu saṃpuṭadvitayaṃ kramāt gobhūhiraṇyavāhādilābheṣu ca samīritaḥ etadvidhānaniṣṇātaṃ praṇamanti surāsurāḥ pratyutaiva parāvṛttāḥ kartāraṃ nāśayanti vai śmaśāne parvate śūnye vipine kṣudrapīḍane sarvavyākīrṇacakreṇa sthāpitenāmarāvatī śilāyāṃ tāmrapaṭṭe vā rājate hemanirmite kṛtvā devālayaṃ tatra cakraṃ saṃsthāpya tasya vai grāmādirakṣaṇe tatra madhye cāṣṭasu dikṣvapi samāvāhyābhipūjyāntaḥ sthāpayenmūlavidyayā nityaśaḥ pūjayedgandhapuṣpadhūpādibhiḥ samam tatkāloktāni kuṇḍāni nava homeṣu sarvataḥ yadyannijepsitaṃ tattad duṣkaraṃ sukaraṃ bhavet anyathā bhajanaṃ cecchan karotyāpatparamparām

tadvidhānamato vakṣye caitrādyaṃ phālgunāvadhi ubhayoḥ kāmyakarmāṇi ceti śāstrasya nirṇayaḥ pūrvapakṣacaturdaśyāṃ niśi saṃsthāpya vidyayā asmin māse ca pūrṇāyāṃ vasantotsavapūjanam saugandhikaiḥ sakāśmīraiḥ pūjāṃ pūrvaduvajjvalām api vā candrakastūrīcandanaiḥ śiśirodakaiḥ phalaistu pūjayeddevīṃ pūrvavat sarvasiddhaye elākakkolajātībhirupetaiḥ pūjayecchivām tadvidhānamidaṃ bhadre śṛṇu saubhāgyadāyakam kārpāsasaṃbhavai raktairnavadhā guṇitaiḥ śubhaiḥ navāṃgulairvā tatsaṃkhyasaragranthyādisaṃyutam kṛtvādhivāsapūrvaṃ tu pūjayet tairyathākramāt aṣṭottaraśataiḥ sūtraiḥ kuryācchaktyavatārakam vārāhīkurukullādiśaktīnāṃ mūlaśaktivat kramāgamajñaśiṣyāṇāmātmavat samudīritam paridhānapramāṇena maṇḍapasyaikasūtrataḥ kṛtvā pavitratritayaṃ tāni devyai samarpayet na kuryānmānasāṅkarya yadi kuryādvinaśyati hīno bhādrapado māsaḥ pakṣau sitasitetarau caturdaśyaṣṭamīpūrṇamāsītithiṣu vai yajet prasūnairarcayaid devīṃ pūrvoktavidhinā yutam ārabhya pūjayed devīṃ gandhapuṣpopahārakaiḥ sahasraṃ juhuyānnityaṃ japaṃ caiva samācaret hutvā bhūṣaṇavastrādidakṣiṇāṃ ca samudvaset tena viddhān bhavet siddho nṛpatiṃ kurute'rcakam

gandhapuṣpaphalādīnāṃ prītistasyā na vidyate pūjayeduktamāgreṇa tasmāt sādhakasattamaḥ ekavaṃśasamudbhūtāṃ kanyāṃ samyak prapūjayet granthisphuṭitaśīrṇāṅgīṃ raktapūyavraṇāṅkitām saṃtyajed rogiṇīṃ kanyāṃ dāsīgarbhasamudbhavām lābhārthe vaiśvavaṃśotthāṃ sutārthe śūdravaṃśajām śaṅkāhīnā bhaktiyuktā gūḍhaśāstropayoginī gurudaivatasadbhaktā sucittā kaulikapriyā mantratantrasamāyuktā samayācārapālikā durācārā parādhīnā bhāvahīnā durālasā durgandhā duḥkhitā mūrkhā vṛddhonmattā rahasyabhit virūponmārgagā kruddhā paṅagvandhā vikṛtānanā rātrau pradīpakairhomaṃ kuryād ghṛtasamedhitaiḥ śaktīnāmekamekaṃ tu sthāpayet tattadagrataḥ kṛtvā nivedayenmūlavidyayā saprasūnakam nivedyābhyarcayenmāṣapiṣṭāpūpairyathāvidhi pūjayediṣṭasaṃsiddhyai gavyaṃ dugdhaṃ nivedayet pūjayeddugdhanaivedyaiḥ sitāpupādibhiḥ sadā cūtasaugandhimadhukaiḥ pūjayedīpsitāptaye kuryādvaiśeṣikaṃ puṇyeṣvāgamokteṣu teṣvapi lepaṃ vilīnayed dehe repho binduriti smṛtaḥ vyāpyamānā mahāśaktiḥ kāminīnāmṛtukrame puṣpībhūte bhage puṣpaṃ māsapakṣādiṣu kramāt nyastaṃ vāpyatra deveśi trailokyaṃ sacarācaram devī rakṣatu divyāṅgī divyātmā bhogadāyinī

madīyaṃ madirānande āpādatalamastakam na guroḥ sadṛśaṃ vastu na devaḥ śaṅkaropamaḥ naca śānteḥ paraṃ jñānaṃ naca kṣānteḥ paraṃ sukham darśaneṣu samasteṣu pākhaṇḍeṣu viśeṣataḥ dehi me devadeveśi (varaṃ ni)tyamabhīpsitam netrayugmaṃ mahākālī karṇau rakṣatu kuṇḍalī dantān rakṣatu cāmuṇḍā cibuke meruvāsinī jihvāṃ sarasvatī rakṣet tāluka tāluvāsinī kukṣau vināyakī sthātu jayānandā stanadaye brahmāṇī nābhideśe tu sthātu jvālāvatī gude nāḍīcakre mahāyogā udbhaṭā dakṣiṇe kare vaiṣṇavī vāmapāde ca sthātu cakrāyudhānvitā pādāṃgulīṣu kauverī romakūpe mahādbhaṭā jālandharī jalasthāne kāmākṣī kāmamadhyagā pṛṣṭhavaṃśe jayādevī asthisandhiṣu carcikā raktamadhye mano'nte ca sthātu me hiṃsinī śubhā vāmadakṣiṇayoścaiva vīrālī kaṭisandhiṣu pṛthivyāpastathā tejo vāyurākāśameva ca rājyaṃ dadātu me caindrī prajāṃ caiva prajāvatī raṇe rājakule caiva śatrumadhye mahāvane samayā samayaṃ rakṣedvidyāṃ vidyā kulāgame prāṇā karotu me siddhiṃ trailokyavijayā sukham saptakoṭisahasrāṇāṃ mantrāṇāṃ nāyikā tu yā ulkāmukhā mukhe sthātu mārjārī dehasandhiṣu trikoṇaṃ ca tridhāvartaṃ traipuraṃ cakramuttamam

pūrvoktā traipurī śaktiḥ sthātu me manmathotthitā nivāsaṃ kuru me dehe sāṃprataṃ divyayoginī śatrūṇāṃ ghātanārthāya jetṝṇāṃ bhogadāyinī māhendrī ca sikhāṃ sthātu yonimadhye gaṇeśvarī ḍākinī pūrvabhāge ca mama saukhyaṃ prayacchatu vāmabhāge mahāmāyā karotu kuśalaṃ mama yā viśālā viśālākṣī nirmalā malavarjitā yā kālakalpitā kālī kālarātrī tu kathyate yā niśācararājanyapūjitā ca niśācarī yā cordhvakeśikā nāma muktakeśī mahābhayā yā vīreti samākhyātā vīrāṇāṃ jayadāyinī yā mālinī samākhyātā nāsāgre vidrumājinī yā kaṅkālakarālāṅgī caṇḍakaṅkālakuṇḍalā pracaṇḍā ca virūpākṣī virūpā viśvarūpiṇī khaṭvāṅgī kathyate yā ca raudrī rudreṇa pūjitā kaliyāginī prasiddhā ca yā loke śrūyate kalau pretākṣī kathyate yā ca phetkārokaṭavarjitā(?) dhūmrākṣī yā samākhyātā śāstre'smin yoginīmate ghorarūpā mahādevī kathyate yā kulāgame viśvarūpā viśeṣeṇa karoti ca jagattrayam bhayaṅkarī samādiṣṭā yā coktā vai kulāgame kapālamālikā proktā yā devī muṇḍadhāriṇī bhīṣaṇā bhairavī nāma yā devī bhīmavikramā nyagrādhavāsinī yā ca kathyate ca surārcitā bhairavī bhīṣaṇī yā ca bhairavāṣṭakavanditā

procyate dīrghalamboṣṭhī mahāmāyā mahābalā khaṭvāṅgī yā mahāśaktiḥ saṃsārārṇavatāriṇī samasteṣu mantreṣu procyate mantravādinī kālaghnī kathyate yā ca yugānte parameśvarī grāhiṇīti samākhyātā surāsuramahoragaiḥ cakriṇī gadyate yā ca ekapādā trilocanā yā viśvabāhukā devī viśvanāthapriyā sadā darśaneṣu samasteṣu viditā parameśvarī kaṇṭakocchedanārthāya śāstre yā kaṇṭakī smṛtā kīlakī kathyate yā ca saptahastā mahābalā saṃgrāme yā mahādevī mahāmārīti kathyate yamadūtīti vikhyātā yā surāsurapūjitā karālinīti yā devī mahāvidyā mahābalā lalitāmbā mahārājñī sarvacakraikanāyikā nāsāgre kaulikā sthātu madanasyā tathā mukhe sā yoginī mahāmāyā sthātu śrīrmastake mama raudrakarmā mahāghaṇṭā camarī tvaritā mataiḥ kapālakuṇḍalo dīrghā kapālī kulagāminī bhumirāpastathā tejo vāyurākāśameva ca rājyaṃ dadātu me caindrī prajāṃ caiva prajāvatī raṇe rājakule caiva śatrumadhye mahāvane samayā samaye rakṣet vidyāṃ vidyā kulāgame dvijaṭī trijaṭī proktā kandalī lalitākhilā mādinī madanonmādā mandārī madanāturā kṣudhā tṛṣṇā tathā nidrā kāntirbuddhistathā dyutiḥ

suranātheti vikhyātā nagaretaradevatā kāverī narmadā caiva gaṅgeti yamunocyate trailokye'pi mahādevī strīnāmnī yā prakāśitā suvarṇarekhiṇī proktā vidyā yā procyate kila kurukulleti vikhyātā pakṣirājamukhodbhavā oṃkāriṇīti vikhyātā dehe sthātu sadā mama bheruṇḍā sthātu me kaṇṭhe toralā sthātu mastake jāṅgalī viṣanāśāya vācāṃ siddhiṃ karotu me ahaṃ brahmā ahaṃ viṣṇurahaṃ devo maheśvaraḥ śaktinyāsena pūtena śarīreṇa surāsurāḥ yatkiñcidyoginīrūpaṃ trailokye cāsti śaṅkara kāminī kurute cāpi yā nyāsaṃ bhaktinirmitam namo'stu te jaganmātarnamo'stu bhuvaneśvari prakaṭā gopitāḥ sarvā nirvāṇā bhairavī śivā yakṣiṇī cūḍakanyā ca tathā cākāśagāminī catuḥṣaṣṭyāśrayā devī yoginyo yena cintitāḥ lalāṭe maṇḍalā sthātu virajā sthātu mastake jayantī sthātu me kukṣau kaṭyām kandarpakuṇḍalī ambikā pṛṣṭhavaṃśe ca pārśvayoḥ sthātu medinī vyāghrī cakrī ca jaṅghāyāṃ syātu pādatale mahī kālindī mūlajihvāṃ ca raktaṃ rakṣatu raktinī mañjinī dehamañjāṃ tu śukraṃ śukreśvarī tathā rudghaṭā kurute śāntiṃ sadaiva mama vigrahe corāgnirājasarpebhyo bhayādrakṣatu bhairavī cāpeṭī nāma yā vidyā sā me karotu maṅgalam

ghurghurā kīrtivikhyātā vande vidyācatuṣṭayam vighnarājaistato nāma tuṣṭā santānarūpiṇī daśaitā mantravidyāstu tiṣṭhantu mama mastake vāmāṅgaṃ ratikāle ca paścime sthātu śṛṅkhalā kavace kavacāṅgī ca netre netrakṛtotsavā yoginyo yāstu tāḥ sarvā dehaṃ kurvantu me vapuḥ śaktinyāsamidaṃ deyaṃ na deyaṃ yasya kasyacit yaḥ karoti mahānyāsaṃ ṣoḍhānyāsādikaṃ vibho śaktinyāse kṛte jīved yaḥ kaścicchedako bhavet tantre pañcadaśaḥ śvāsaḥ kiṃ homaiḥ kiṃ japaiścaiva kiṃ mantranyāsavistaraiḥ puraskriyā hi mantrāṇāṃ pradhānaṃ bījamucyate puraścaraṇahīno'pi tathā mantraḥ prakīrtitaḥ purataścaraṇīyatvād viniyogākhyakarmaṇām phalāya mantrasevāyā rājasevā yathā tathā anarcito haretkāmāṃstasmāt tritayamācaret pañcāṅgopāsanenaiva puraścārī sukhaṃ vrajet || 1 || iti || svābhiṣekaśca viprāṇāmārādhanamapīśvari pañcāṅgopāsanaṃ loke puraścaraṇamucyate sūryārghya jalapānaṃ ca praṇāmaṃ devapūjanam daśāṃśo (ṅgo) pāsanaṃ bhaktyā puraścaraṇamucyate tāsāmapi yadā nāsau kṣobhaṃ yāti manāgapi yadi na kṣubhyatītthaṃ hi sādhakasya mano manāk tāsāmapi yadā nāsau kṣobhaṃ yāti manāgapi evaṃ lakṣatrayaṃ japtvā vratasthaḥ sādhakottamaḥ

svayambhūrbāṇaliṅgaṃ vā vṛṣaśūnyaṃ jalasthitam śaktikṣetreṣu gaṅgāyāṃ nadyāṃ parvatamastake tatra sthitvā japellakṣaṃ sākṣāddevīsvarūpavān evaṃ japaṃ yathāśakti kṛtvādau sādhakottamaḥ kusumbhakusumairvāpi madhuratrayamiśritaiḥ sarvakāmapradaṃ rājyabhuktimuktiphalapradam yasya vijñānamātreṇa kartā hartā sadā śivaḥ pūjyate tatra sakalaṃ vaśīkuryānna saṃśayaḥ yoṣitaḥ sakalā vaśyā jvalatkāmāgnipīḍitāḥ taddarśanena deveśi jāyante sarvayoṣitaḥ atha muktāphalamayīṃ vāṅmokṣaphaladāyinīm yathā muktāphalamayīṃ tathā sphaṭikanirmitām pravālamālā vaśye tu sarvakāryārthasādhikā putrajīvakamālā tu vaśyadā bhogadā bhavet samāśritya japedvidyāṃ lakṣamātraṃ yadā śuciḥ tadā dvitīyalakṣaṃ tu prajapet sādhakottamaḥ tāsāṃ kaṭākṣajālaistu na mohaṃ yāti sādhakaḥ tṛtīyalakṣe samprāpte grāvayanti surāṅganāḥ sādhakaṃ drāvayantyeva tataścāsau manaḥsthiraḥ evaṃ lakṣatrayaṃ japtvā vratasthaḥ svasthamānasaḥ puruṣā yoṣito vaśyāścarācaramapi priye śamīdūrvāṃkurāśvatthapallaverarkasambhavaiḥ sahasrajanmajaṃ pāpaṃ hanti māsena deśikaḥ lakṣadvayena pāpāni saptajanmakṛtāni ca japtvā lakṣatrayaṃ mantrī yantrito mantravigrahaḥ
