japtvā vidyāṃ caturlakṣaṃ mahāvāgīśvaro bhavet japtvā ṣaḍlakṣametasyā mahāvidyādhareśvaraḥ aṣṭalakṣapramāṇaṃ ca japtvā vidyāṃ maheśvari navalakṣapramāṇaṃ ca japtvā tripurasundarīm kartā hartā svayaṃ gauri loke cāprahataḥ prabhuḥ taddaśāṃśena homaṃ tu pūrvoktavidhinācaret tatra tu sarvamantrāṇāṃ saṃkhyāvṛttiryugakramāt dvāpare triguṇā proktā kalau saṃkhyā caturguṇā upoṣya śukladvādaśyāmārabhyāṣṭākṣaraṃ japet śuklācāraḥ śuciḥ snāto vāgyato vijitendriyaḥ tato hi dviguṇābhyāsādaihikyāmūṣmikī ca sā tretāyāṃ dviguṇaḥ prokto dvāpare triguṇastathā aśvatthabilvamūle vā sindhutīre jalāśaye deśāḥ puṇyā japasyaite yatra vā jāyate ruciḥ gurorvā saṃnidhau goṣṭhe vṛṣaśūnye śivālaye abhīṣṭadevasāṃnidhye japenmantraṃ samāhitaḥ harervivikta ityete deśāḥ syurmantrasiddhidāḥ viprāṇāṃ ca gavāṃ caiva saṃnidhau śasyate japaḥ gṛhe japaḥ samaḥ prokto goṣṭhe daśaguṇastu saḥ ayutaṃ parvate puṇye nadyāṃ lakṣaguṇastu saḥ ekānte pāvane nindārahite bhaktisaṃyute ramye bhaktajanasthāne nivasenna parāśraye caranti yena mārgeṇa na vasettatra tattvavit nadīkūlādrikūleṣu bhūchidrādiṣu no vaset brūyādamukamantrasya puraścaraṇasiddhaye

bhūmeḥ parigrahaṃ kṛtvā parimāṇaṃ ca sarvataḥ grāme krośamitaṃ sthānaṃ nagare taddvayaṃ smṛtam nikhaneddaśadigbhāge teṣvastraṃ ca prapūjayet kṣetrapālādikāṃstatra pūjayedvidhivittamaḥ kūrmacakramavijñāya yaḥ kuryājjapayajñakam prāpnoti sakalānyuktānyanyathā nāśameti ca sa caturdhā sthito loke tatprakārastathocyate grāmago gṛhagaśceti caturdhā sa vyavasthitaḥ prāgādipaścimāntaṃ tu kādimāntāni vinyaset īśe dvayamatho madhye svarān prāgādi vinyaset tanmukhaṃ pārśvayoḥ pāṇī kukṣiḥ pādau tatastataḥ mukhe sarvārthasiddhiḥ syāt karayoḥ sarvasiddhayaḥ pucche mṛtyustu niyataṃ sarvārthasiddhayaḥ arṇaṃ binduyutaṃ kṛtvā sveṣṭamantraṃ japetsudhīḥ kṣārṇaṃ merumatho tatra kalpayejjagadīśvari anayā sarvamantrāṇāṃ japaḥ sarvārthasādhakaḥ ekaikāntaritaṃ mantraṃ japedevaṃ phalapradam tadābhimukhyacihnāni vighnāni prāktanādyataḥ yena martyo'pi siddhyeta jīvanmukto bhavanmayaḥ guruṃ vittena saṃtoṣya raktāgare kramaṃ bhajet mocāguḍasitāpetaṃ payaḥ pāyasamarpayet homaṃ daśāṃśataḥ kuryāttarpaṇaṃ cendumajjalaiḥ kuryāttena bhavet pūrṇaṃ lakṣaṃ pūrṇāntamīśvari tretāyāṃ dviguṇaṃ tadvaddvāpare triguṇam smṛtam tārtīyasaptasaṃkhyā sā tena syādekaviṃśatiḥ

vanītākṣobhato bhogānna vighna yadi jāyate varjyāni śṛṇu deveśi taddineṣu sadaiva hi cintāśokau tathālāpaṃ deśāntaraparibhramam śṛṇu sarvatra sarveṣāṃ sarvadā nāśakāni ca strīṣu roṣaṃ prahāraṃ ca duṣṭāsvapi na yojayet anukūlyasya cihnāni śṛṇu sādhayatastadā gajādrisaudhaśṛṅgeṣu vihāro rājadarśanam utsavaṃ sasurāmāṃsadarśanaṃ sparśanaṃ tathā kuṣṇavarṇairbhaṭaiḥ svapne prahārastailalepanam rāṣṭrakṣobho vahnivāyuja(nanī?labhī) bandhunāśanam anyamantrārcane śraddhā vighno nityārcane'niśam śraddhāsthairya saṃpradāyasiddhi nityārcane bhavet sa nāpnoti phalānyuktānyanyathā nāśakāni ca sa caturdhā sthito loke tatprakāraṃ śṛṇu priye grāmago gṛhagaśceti caturdhā tadvyavasthitiḥ prāgādipaścimāntaṃ tu kādimāntāni vinyaset īśo dvayamatho madhye svarān prāgādi vinyaset tanmukhaṃ pārśvayoḥ pāṇī kukṣiḥ pādau tatastataḥ mukhe sarvārthasiddhiḥ syāt karayoralpasiddhikṛt pucche mṛtistu niyatā pṛṣṭhe sarvārthadāyakam vyañjanaṃ deśakūrme syād gṛhakūrme svarāstathā nityaṃ pūrvamukho yasmāttena tatsiddhirīritā mantrāṇāṃ yena siddhiḥ syātsarveṣāṃ sarvatastadā vijñāya varga teṣvekaṃ nāmādyaṃ nāmni kalpayet vāstuṣvajñātarūpeṣu prasiddhaṃ nāmato bhavet

mahākāle ca kāśyāṃ ca dīpasthānaṃ na cintayet tadakṣaśāstrato jñātvā tatra samyak parityajet ṛdvayasya ṭhakāreṇa ṭhakārasyāpi tena ca odvayasya ṣakāreṇa ṣakārasyauyugena ca ḍakārasya takāreṇa phakārasya dhakārataḥ aritvameṣāṃ varṇānāmanyeṣāṃ mitrabhāvanā yathā gargasya vairī syādaṭṭahāsaṃ mahatpuram ṛjubhaṭṭasya ṭhakkākhyaṃ ḷtakasyāriḥ padmakam jyantī ṭaṅkadhārasya khaṃdhāraṃ ṛṃṝ(jhaṃjha)ṇasya ca bhadrasya ramyakaṃ caiva yajñadattasya somakaḥ anulomavilomasthaiḥ kḷptayā varṇamālayā vairimantrā api nṝṇāṃ susiddhādyāstu kiṃ punaḥ tadvarṇasaṃkhyamaṇibhirjapamālāṃ prakalpayet kṣāntaṃ saṃhārayuktaṃ paśupatigaditā yāmale mālikeyam pañcaviṃśatibhiḥ proktā maṇibhirbhuktidāyinī abhicārakarī pañcadaśabhiḥ parikalpitā aṣṭottaraśataiḥ kḷptā sarvābhīṣṭapradā matā muktipradāḥ sphaṭikajāḥ padmākṣāḥ puṣṭivardhanāḥ putrajīvabhavāḥ putrapaśudhānyasamṛddhidāḥ mauktikā muktidāḥ proktāḥ sarvasaṃpatsamṛddhidāḥ padmākṣairvihitā mālā śatrūṇāṃ nāśinī matā putrajīvaphalaiḥ kḷptā kurute putrasaṃpadam hiraṇmayairviracitā mālā kāmān prayacchati saubhāgyaṃ sphāṭikī mālā mauktikairvihitā śriyam sarvairetairviracitā mālā sā muktaye nṛṇām

nānyanmadhye prayoktavyaṃ putrajīvādikaṃ ca yat tasya kāmaṃ ca mokṣaṃ ca na dadāti priyaṅkarī miśrībhāvaṃ tato yāti caṇḍālaiḥ pāpakarmabhiḥ niśādārukṛtā vaśye lākṣayā jvarakarmaṇi gajadantasya maṇibhiḥ kuryāt sarvārthadāyinī māraṇe cāyasī proktā śrīphalairbilvakāṣṭhajaiḥ tāmasī ceti tāsvādyā śatairaṣṭottaraiḥ śubhaiḥ maṇibhiḥ sāttviko putrajīvai rajatasaṃbhavaiḥ kuśagranthibhavaiḥ kḷptā rājasī caturuttaraiḥ sauvarṇai raktatarujaiḥ pītasārasamudbhavaiḥ devadārusamudbhūtaiḥ kṛṣṇākāṣṭhasamudbhavaiḥ sā śamīnimbabimvākṣairindrabhadrasamudbhavaiḥ narāśvarāsabhebhānāṃ snāyubhirgrathitairapi mantrajñairviṣṇumantreṇa divyabhāge prayatnataḥ caturdaśyāṃ tathā kuryācchivasyāpi sureśvari pūrvāhne devi kartavyā saptamyāṃ jagadīśvari kārpāsairvaiṣṇavī mālā padmasūtrairathāpi vā kārpāsasūtrairanyeṣāṃ vidadhyāñjapamālikām rudrākṣairjapamālā tu kathaṃ kāryā maheśvara japamālā vidhānena yena sā japasiddhidā ṣaḍvaktrairvātha kartavyā (nitho) miśraistu varjayet rudrākṣasyottamaṃ proktaṃ mukhaṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ tu nimnagam badarārdhapramāṇena caṇakānmadhyamādhaye navena tantunā caitad grathanīyamasaṃspṛśat ādyaṃ sthūlaṃ tatastasmāt nyūnaṃ nyūnataraṃ tathā

brahmagranthiyutaṃ kuryāt pratibījaṃ yathāvidhi trirāvṛttyāśca madhyena cārdhavṛttyāntadeśataḥ yathākāmaṃ yathālābhamakṣānānīya yatnataḥ kīṭādibhiradaṣṭāni na jīrṇāni navāni ca gomūtraṃ tāmravarṇāyā nīlāyāśca bhaveddadhi gavāṃ varṇāstu sulabhāḥ santi deśeṣu yatra ca varṇālābhe na doṣo'sti mātrāhīnaṃ tu varjayet kṣīramaṣṭaguṇaṃ proktaṃ pañcagavye tathā dadhi āpyāyasveti ca kṣīraṃ dadhikrābṇetyṛcyā dadhi sadyojāteti mantreṇa kṣālayet pañcagavyakaiḥ dhūpayet tāmaghoreṇa kṛṣṇāgurusuguggulaiḥ sūtraṃ maṇīṃśca gandhādbhiḥ kṣālitāṃstatra nikṣipet vinyasya pūjayedājyairjuhuyāccaiva śaktitaḥ gopucchasadṛśī kāryā ekāgrā vā samerukā grathitaṃ pañcabhirmantraiḥ pūrvavacca sadā śive jitāstena surāḥ sarve brahmaviṣṇvīndradevatāḥ lokānāṃ bhayanāśāya ṛtudharmapravṛttaye cintitaṃ yanmayā putra aghorāstramanuttamam divyavarṣasahasrāṇi cakṣurunmīlitaṃ tayā te cāsrubindavo jātā mahārudrākṣavṛkṣakāḥ phalanti sarvakālaṃ hi avicchinnaphalapradāḥ vakṣasyaṣṭādhikaṃ yaḥ kalayati ca śataṃ sa svayaṃ nīlakaṇṭhaḥ kūrpare ṣoḍaśa proktā dvādaśa maṇibandhayoḥ tadardhamuraso mālā śikhāyāmekamucyate saṃkhyāhīnaṃ na kartavyamadhikaṃ naiva duṣyati

mokṣārthe pañcaviṃśatyā saptaviṃśatiḥ pauṣṭike brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vaiśyaḥ śūdraśceti caturvidhaḥ eteṣu brāhmaṇaḥ śreṣṭho japamālākṛte bhṛśam atisthūlo'tisūkṣmaśca sphuṭito bhaṃguro laghuḥ maṇau yadunnataṃ sthānaṃ mukhaṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ tu nimnakam anyonyagharṣaṇādeva japahānirbhaved dhruvam anyonyamadhyadeśe tu kartavyā granthayaḥ śubhāḥ dhāraṇasya phalaṃ teṣāṃ vakṣyate vidhivat kramāt dvivaktraṃ devadevyau tu govadhaṃ nāśayed dhruvam caturvaktraḥ svayaṃ brahmā guruhatyāṃ vyapohati ṣaḍvaktraḥ kārtikeyastu dhārayeddakṣiṇe kare saptavaktro mahānāgo hyananto nāma nāmataḥ aṣṭavaktro mahāsena sākṣāddevo gaṇādhipaḥ navavaktro bhairavaḥ syād dhārayedvāmahastake daśavaktro bhavedvatsa sākṣāddevo janārdanaḥ sambhavāni ca doṣāṇi kṣipraṃ naśyanti dhāraṇāt śikhāyāṃ dhārayennityaṃ tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu gavāṃ śatasahasrasya samyagdattasya yatphalam vaktradvādaśarudrākṣaṃ bhāskaradvādaśātmakam vaktratrayodaśaṃ vatsa rudrākṣaṃ yadi dhārayet caturdaśasuvaktraṃ vai rudrākṣaṃ yadi dhārayet pavitramayavaktrastu (?) śaśikhaṇḍaśirāḥ svayam bahulaṃ prāpyate puṇyaṃ bhāgyavān jāyate naraḥ prāyaścitte tathā śrāddhe dīkṣākāle viśeṣataḥ yo vipraḥ satataṃ kuryāt tatkarma saphalaṃ bhavet

rudrākṣadhāraṇādeva rudro bhavati mānavaḥ tatsarvaṃ saphalaṃ proktaṃ lakṣakoṭiguṇaṃ dhruvam tataḥ koṭiśataṃ puṇyaṃ labhate dhāraṇānnaraḥ gale baddhavā koṭiśataṃ mūrdhni koṭisahasrakam aprameyaphalaṃ haste surudrākṣadharo bhavet sadyo bhavati pūtātmā rudrākṣe śirasi sthite so'pi rudratvamāpnoti kiṃ punarmānuṣādayaḥ mucyate sarvapāpebhyo naro rudrākṣadhāraṇāt pāpakarmāpi yo nityaṃ rudraloke mahīyate saṃkīrṇā sā bhaved brahmaṃsteṣāṃ vaṃśaparamparā mālāṃ vidhāya vai pātre kvacidgandhādicarcitām gaṇeśasūryaviṣṇvīśadūrgāścāvāhya pūjayet tasmāduttolya tāṃ mālāṃ svarṇapātre nidhāya ca tayodhūpāntikaiḥ kṛtvā pañcāmṛtavidhiṃ budhaḥ tataścandanasaugandhikastūrikuṃkumādibhiḥ tasyāṃ navagrahāṃścāpi dikpālāṃśca prapūjayet durgāṃ ca pūjayed vidvān mālāyāṃ susamāhitaḥ tatastūttolya tāṃ mālāṃ sthāpayeddhemapātrake candanena sugandhena kastūrīkuṃkumādibhiḥ prānaṃ jīvasamārūḍhamaukārasvarabhūṣitam nava grahān pūjayitvā tato dikpālapūjanam svarṇaṃ tu dakṣiṇāṃ dadyād viprāṃstu paritoṣayet saṃhṛṣṭaḥ kārayenmālāṃ viśuddhāṃ svarṇarūpyiṇīm varṇamānena sā kāryā pañcagavye tryahaṃ kṣipet samānavarṇasūtreṇa māpayed hṛdayāṇunā

brahmagranthiṃ tato dadyānnāgapāśamathāpi vā sarvaśeṣe tato meruṃ sūtradvayasamanvitam evaṃ niṣpādya deveśi pratisṭhāṃ ca samācaret pūjayitvā yathānyāyamiṣṭadevamanukramāt juhuyācca daśāṃśena yasya devasya yatpriyam astramantraṃ tato nyasya mūlamantraṃ tato nyaset abhedarūpamāsādya mālāṃ kuryāt tadātmikām evaṃ pratiṣṭhāmāpādya mālāyāmiṣṭadevatām nānyamantraṃ japet tatra yadīcchet siddhimātmanaḥ jīrṇa sūtre punaḥ sūtraṃ granthayitvā śataṃ japet pratiṣṭhitāyāṃ tasyāṃ tu mantraṃ japyādananyadhīḥ akṣasrajā vāṃgulibhirjapet taṃ nātidrutaṃ nātivilambitaṃ ca madhyamāmūlaparyantā karamālā prakīrtitā aṃgulījapasaṃkhyājaṃ phalamekaguṇaṃ smṛtam śataṃ syāccheṣamaṇibhiḥ pravālaistu sahasrakam padmākṣairdaśalakṣaṃ tu sauvarṇaiḥ koṭirucyate śvetapadmākṣamālābhirjape syādamitaṃ phalam aṃguṣṭhena vinā japtaṃ viphalaṃ bhavati priye madhyamānāmikāmadhyaparvadvayamiha priye anāmāmūlaparvādikaniṣṭhānukrameṇa tu gaṇayecca krameṇaivaṃ kiñcit saṃkocayet talam aṃgulīnāṃ viyoge tu cchidreṣu sravate japaḥ yatastajjapamīśāni balād gṛhṇanti rākṣasāḥ meruṃ kṛtvā japed devi tarjanīmūlakāvadhi pṛthak kṛtāstaiḥ kurvīta varṇamālāṃ viśeṣataḥ

śīghraṃ siddhirbhavatyeva satyaṃ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ tadbhūtavarṇadeśake vyañjanānāṃ sureśvari tattadbhūtapradhānārṇaṃ meruṃ kṛtvā vicakṣaṇaḥ mantrārṇauṣadhicūrṇasya guṭikākṛtamālayā avyagratvamanirvedo japasampattihetavaḥ sarvathā labhate siddhimanyathā niṣphalaṃ bhavet tadeva karma kurvīta tanmanāstatparāyaṇaḥ yajet vaiṣṇavaṃ karmasthiradhīrniyatendriyaḥ dūrato'pi na siddhiḥ syāditarasya dvijottamaḥ nityaṃ triṣavaṇasnānaṃ kṣudrakarmavivarjanam naimittikārcanaṃ caiva viśvāso gurudevayoḥ saṅkalpo'dhyavasāyaśca kriyāniṣpattireva ca viparītaṃ brahmacaryametadevāṣṭalakṣaṇam japet pratidinaṃ yattu nitya eṣa japaḥ smṛtaḥ dvādaśyāṃ pūrṇimāyāṃ tu teṣu naimittiko japaḥ tasmādāśīḥ sadā grāhyā tataḥ santoṣamācaret nāstyasādhyaṃ jagatyatra suprasanne guro mune śrutismṛtipurāṇoktamantraiḥ snāyādanantaram kandamūlaphalairvāpi kuryādaśanamanvaham bhavecchuddhamatirmantrī naca drohaṃ samācaret nityaṃ goṣu prasannāsu gopālā'pi prasīdati na cchāyāmākramedvidvān vibhītakakarañjayoḥ tailābhyaṅgaṃ na kurvīta madhu māṃsaṃ ca varjayet na nagno na sugandhāḍhyo gītavādye vivarjayet strīśūdrapatitavrātyanāstikocchiṣṭabhāṣaṇam

samyairapi na bhāṣet japahomārcanādiṣu tāmbūlaṃ gandhalepaṃ ca puṣpadhāraṇameva ca asadbhāṣaṇamatyarthaṃ varjayedanyapūjanam asaṅkalpitakṛtyaṃ ca varjayenmardanādikam prokte pāmaraśabde'pi prāṇāyāmaṃ sakṛccaret kṣute caiva tathāspṛśyasthānānāṃ sparśane tathā vyāharedvaiṣṇavaṃ mantraṃ smaredvā viṣṇumavyayam kṣute'dhovāyugamane jṛmbhaṇe japamutsṛjet kṛtvā samyagjapeccheṣaṃ yadvā sūryādidarśanam dṛṣṭvācamya caret karma spṛṣṭvā snānaṃ vidhīyate darśanaṃ ca śvanīcānāṃ varjayejjapakarmaṇi jyotīṃṣi ca prapaśyedvā kuryādvā prāṇasaṃyamam ete jyotīṃṣi coktāni vidvadbhirbrāhmaṇastathā śvanī ca darśanaṃ nidrā pralāpo'mī japadviṣaḥ pūjāyāṃ nāma kṛṣṇasya saptavāraṃ prakīrtayet prāṇāyāmaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā tataḥ śeṣaṃ samāpayet snātvācamya yathānyāyaṃ kṛtvā nyāsān punarjapet nāpyatarpayato devān nāsatyamabhijalpataḥ ālasyaṃ bhāvanāśaktiḥ siddhināśāya niścitam tyajed durjanasaṃsparśaṃ sāśaṅkādibhavaṃ tyajet apavitrakaro'śuddhaḥ pralapanna japet kvacit cintāvyākulacitto vā kruddho bhrāntaḥ kṣudhānvitaḥ rathyāyāmaśivasthāne japenna timirālaye prasārya na japet pādāvutkaṭāsana eva vā uttiṣṭhati tadā nyāsaṃ ṣaḍaṅgaṃ vinyaset punaḥ

hrasvāḥ pracaraṇīyāḥ syuḥ kuśā dīrghāśca barhiṣaḥ savyaḥ sopagrahaḥ kāryo dakṣiṇaḥ sapavitrakaḥ aśūnyaṃ tu karaṃ kuryāt suvarṇarajataiḥ kuśaiḥ ājyena ca vinā homaḥ phalaṃ dāsyanti naiva te godhūmā vrīhayo muñjā daśa darbhāḥ savalvajāḥ ayātayāmāste darbhā viniyojyāḥ punaḥ punaḥ nuda pāpāni sarvāṇi bhava svastikaro mama huṃphaṭkāreṇa mantreṇa sakṛcchitvā samuddharet amūlā devakāryeṣu prayojyāśca japādiṣu anantargarbhiṇau sāgrau pādeśe tu pavitrake ekaikaparṇamutsṛjya varṇe varṇe yathākramam tribhistu śāntike kārya pauṣṭike pañcabhistathā sapavitraḥ sadarbho vā karmāṅgācamanaṃ caret yaiḥ kṛtaḥ piṇḍanirvāpaḥ śrāddhaṃ vā pitṛtarpaṇam nīvīmadhyasthitāstyājyā yajñabhūmau sthitāstathā vastrāditoyagrahaṇe na doṣaḥ pivato bhavet snāne home jape dāne svādhyāye pitṛtarpaṇe kuśābhāve tu kāśāḥ syuḥ kāśāḥ kuśasamāḥ smṛtāḥ nārdro lunīyādrātrau vā lunīyādvā na sandhyayoḥ pralapan vā japedyāvat tāvanniṣphalamucyate nagno dviguṇavastraḥ syānnagnaḥ snigdhapaṭastathā ekakacchaḥ kacchaśūnyo nagnaḥ pañcavidhaḥ smṛtaḥ proḍhapādo na kurvīt svādhyāyaṃ caiva tarpaṇam kṛtāvasakthiko yastu prauḍhapādaḥ sa ucyate antaraṅgākṣarāṇāṃ ca nyāsapūrvo japaḥ smṛtaḥ

ya uccanīcasvaritaiḥ śabdaiḥ spaṣṭapadākṣaraiḥ śanairuccārayenmantramīṣadoṣṭhau ca cālayet jihvājapaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ kevalaṃ jihvayā japaḥ uccaredarthasaṃsmṛtyā sa ukto mānaso japaḥ upāṃśuḥ syācchataguṇaḥ sāhasro mānasaḥ smṛtaḥ mānasaḥ mokṣakāryeṣu dhyāyedeva ca sarvataḥ ahiṃsayā hi bhūtānāṃ jāyate vā mahāphalam te sarve japayajñasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm prasannā vipulān bhogān dadyānmuktiṃ ca śāsvatīm te sarve japayajñasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm caturhastaṃ dvihastaṃ ca sudṛḍhaṃ mṛdu nirmalam vastrāsanaṃ rogaharaṃ vetrajaṃ śrīvivardhanam dharmārthakāmamokṣāptiścailājinakuśottare vyāghrājinaṃ ca kauraṅgamanyairnānāvidhāsanaiḥ varjayedāsanaṃ mantrī dāridryavyādhiduḥkhadam viśedyatirvanasthaśca brahmacārī ca snātakaḥ vaṃśāsanaṃ ca vastraṃ ca kevalaṃ kṣitirāsanam tṛṇāsane bhavedrogaḥ pallave cittavibhramaḥ kṣityāsanaṃ bhavet pīḍāpāpavisphoṭaduḥkhadam cintā ca prabalā hāniruccaṭo vividho jvaraḥ itthaṃ cāṣṭāsanaṃ devi varjayet sarvakarmasu tataḥ karma samārabhet kṛtābhiṣeko vidhivanmantraṃ labdhvā gurormukhāt bhojanācchādanādyaistu viprān santarpayedyathā ārabheta japaṃ paścāt tadanujñāpuraḥsaram

mañjayadvitayaṃ bhūyo tarjayadvitayaṃ tathā kṣetrapāla baliṃ gṛhṇadvayaṃ pāvakasundarī tathaiva parivārāya balimetena cāharet mantropadeśo guruṇā sādhanaṃ ca śubhāvaham puṇye muhūrte nakṣatre tithu snātvā yathāvidhi sūryādidevatābhyaśca nivedya vratamācaret niyamavyatirekeṇa sarvaṃ bhavati niṣphalam upavāsaṃ tu gṛhṇīyāt tathā saṃkalpayed budhaḥ prārabdhe sūtakaṃ na syādanārabdhe ca sūtakam nāndīmukhaṃ vivāhādau śrāddhe pākapariṣkriyā kāmataḥ pūjite mantre śāntikādau ca kutracit śatatrayamakāmācca prāyaścittavidhau japet uktasaṃkhyaṃ japaṃ kuryāt puraścaraṇasiddhaye japedekamanāḥ prātaḥkālānmadhyandināvadhi yadi nyūnādhikaṃ kuryād vratabhraṣṭo bhavennaraḥ nājaptaḥ siddhidānecchurnāhutaḥ phalado bhavet pratyahaṃ sādhakaḥ kuryāt svayaṃ cet siddhimicchati japadhyānasamāyuktaḥ śīghraṃ siddhyati mantravit yathoktakuṇḍe juhuyādyathāvidhi samāhitaḥ divasātikramāt puṃso mantrasiddhirbhavet nahi dināntare'pi prajapedanyathā siddhirodhakṛt ādyantayorvidhīyante nāsikāpuṭacāriṇaḥ nidhāya maṇḍalasyāntaḥ savyahastagatāṃ ca vā caturvargastvayi nyastastasmānme siddhidā bhava bījaṃ gaṇapateḥ pūrvamuccārya tadanantaram

hastena srajamādāya cintayan manasā śivām mantraṃ ca kaṇṭhato dhyātvā pītavarṇaṃ hiraṇmayam ājñācakre tataḥ paścād gurormantrasya cātmanaḥ tattvasvarūpamekaṃ tadyaccakraṃ pratilambhayet lambhayenmūlamantreṇa ādiṣoḍaśacakrakam cintayan sādhako devi japakarma samārabhet tatprānte tripathasthānaṃ ṣaṭkoṇaṃ caturaṃgulam kaṇṭhe trayāṇāṃ nāḍīnāṃ veṣṭanaṃ vidyate nṛṇām tatṣaṭcakramiti proktaṃ śuklaṃ kaṇṭhasya madhyagam tatsthānaṃ ṣoḍaśāraṃ syāt saptāṃgulapramāṇataḥ dhyeyānāmapi mantrāṇāṃ cintanasya japasya ca mantrastathaiva niḥsetuḥ kṣaṇāt kṣarati yajvanām pārśvayoḥ setumādāya japakarma samārabhet madhyamāyā madhyabhāge varjayitvā tu tarjanīm sthāpayitvā tatra mālāmaṃguṣṭhāgreṇa tadgatam prativāraṃ paṭhenmantraṃ śanairoṣṭhau na cālayet pūrvaṃ japaprayuktana cāṃguṣṭhāgreṇa bhairava aṃguṣṭhena bhavettasya niṣphalaḥ sa japaḥ sadā devīṃ vicintayan japyaṃ kuryādvāmena na spṛśet na spṛśedvāmahastena karabhraṣṭaṃ na kārayet japakāle sadā vidvān meruṃ naiva vilaṅghayet kaliḥ khaṭakhaṭāśabde dolamāne calanmatiḥ hastacyute mahāvighnaḥ sūtracchede vinaśyati pramādāt tarjanīsparśe bhavedāvartanaṃ tyajet na spṛśetaṃ kadācit tu spṛṣṭhe hyāvartanaṃ punaḥ

bhugnagrovonnataḥ śāntaḥ kaṇḍūnmīlanavarjitaḥ nadrutaṃ nāpi viśrāntaṃ kramānmantraṃ japet sudhīḥ vilambitaṃ ca nātīva tathā spaṣṭapadodbhavam evaṃ kṛtvā japaṃ vipra vinivedyaśca yāgavat tvaṃ māle sarvadevānāṃ prītidā śubhadā mama puṣkaraṃ śikhibījasthaṃ sūkṣmasūkṣmānvitaṃ bhavet eṣa pañcākṣaro mantro mālāyāḥ parikīrtitaḥ nivedayed vibhostacca vākkarmamanasānvitam gṛhaṇimaṃ japaṃ nātha mama dīnasya śāśvata agrato nikṣiped viṣṇormūlamantreṇa nārada mūlasyāṣṭaśataṃ japtvā na drutaṃ na vilambitam siddhirbhavatu me deva tvatprāsādāt tvayi sthitā mūlamantrārghyatoyena varahaste nivedayet tadūrdhve pūrvavat snātvā viśeṣeṇa vidhānavit pūjāgnihomaparyantaṃ tataśca japamārabhet upāsya pūrvavat sandhyāṃ devaṃ saṃpūjayet punaḥ payovratī vā niyato japedekāgramānasaḥ satkulasthānajātānāṃ bhikṣāśī vāgrajanmanām etatsaptavidhaṃ proktaṃ pavitraṃ vratabhojanam pūrvaṃ pūrvaṃ praśastaṃ syādaśanaṃ mantrasādhane aśūdrāvahataṃ padbhyāmanuttolyahataṃ ca yat tilāścaiva sitā mudgāḥ kandaḥ kemukavarjitaḥ āmramāmalakaṃ caiva panasaṃ ca harītakī avaiṣṇavamalabhyaṃ cāpyapraśastaṃ vratāntare laghumiṣṭahitāśī ca vinītaḥ śāntacetanaḥ

kalāyakaṃgunīvārā vāstūkaṃ hilamocakā kandaṃ saindhavasāmudre gavye ca dadhisarpiṣī pippalī jīrakaṃ caiva nāgaraṅgakatintiṇī atailapakvaṃ munayo haviṣyānnaṃ pracakṣate nivedayennaiva tatra hareraikāntikī ratiḥ māṣamudgamasūrādyān kodravāṃścaṇakānapi māṣāḍhakīmasūrāṃśca kodravāṃścaṇakānapi alpāśanādasaṅgācca ṣaḍbhirmantraḥ prasiddhyati nīcasaṅgācca laulyācca ṣaḍbhirmantro na siddhyati devī mantramayaṃ sākṣād dhyāyedātmānamātmani na siddhyati varārohe kalpakoṭiśatairapi kāṃsyapātraṃ ca tailaṃ ca mantravīryaharāṇi ṣaṭ tasmāt sarvaprayatnena mantrī paryuṣitaṃ tyajet phalalopo bhavennūnaṃ mantravīryaṃ hared dhruvam pittalaṃ mṛtyudaṃ nūnaṃ kṣudradhānyaṃ ca kodravam masūrī mānahantrī ca parityājyātha sarvadā mantravīryaṃ haratyāśu yadyapi syānmaheśvaraḥ tilatailaṃ mantrapūtaṃ pāvanaṃ devadurlabham varjayejjapavelāyāṃ bhojyaṃ naiva sadā budhaiḥ pācayedvaidikairmantraiḥ punarmūlena mantravit arddharātre samutthāya pādaśaucaṃ cared dvijaḥ japaṃ kuryādyathāśakti arpayecca tatheśvari tadvāsaḥ kṣālayennityamanyathā vighnamāvahet mantrite ca śivaṃ dhyāyan prākśirasko niśi svapet darbhaśayyāṃ gato rātrau dṛṣṭvā svapnaṃ nivedayet

laghvekabhug dakṣiṇapārśvaśāyī svapnaṃ parīkṣet yathopadeśam iṣṭāniṣṭaṃ samācakṣva mama svapnasya śāśvata śubhaṃ vā yadi vā śubham svapnamāṇavamantro'yaṃ śambhunā parikīrtitaḥ vāmāya viśvarūpāya svapnādhipataye namaḥ kriyāsiddhiṃ vidhāsyāmi tvatprasādānmaheśvara viśvāya viśvarūpāya svapnādhipataye namaḥ apāvakaṃ yatsvasthānāmakhyātānāṃ hi darśanam apāvakaṃ mānasaṃ ca yathārthaphalamucyate māse pākaḥ śarvarīturyayāme sadyaḥ pāko yo visargaṣu dṛṣṭaḥ guruṃ prasādasumukhaṃ nirmalaṃ candramaṇḍalam prasannaṃ tatra jānīyāt siddhiṃ svapnanidarśane homaśca jvalite vahnau saṃgrāmavijayastathā kuñjaraṃ vṛṣabhaṃ mālyaṃ samudraṃ phalinaṃ drumam evamādīni sarvāṇi dṛṣṭvā siddhimavāpnuyāt samṛddhiṃ tatra jānīyāt tasmin svapnanidarśane bhāskarodayanaṃ caiva prajvalantaṃ hutāśanam nāgāśvavṛṣabhendrāṇāṃ taruśailāgrarohaṇam lābhaḥ siddhataroścaiva devīnāṃ caiva darśanam svapne tu madirāpānamāmamāṃsasya bhakṣaṇam bhojanaṃ dadhibhaktasya śvetavastrānulepanam ratnānyābharaṇādīni svapne dṛṣṭvā prasiddhyati darpaṇaṃ śaṅkhabhīryyau ca tantrīvādyaṃ ca rocanam siddhānnamāmamāṃsaṃ ca madyastrīmadirāsavāḥ mālyamuktāphale hāraḥ pūrṇaḥ samuditaḥ śaśī

praphullapādapaḥ śālī rocanā kuṃkumaṃ madhu upapanno'pyathācāryo gāyatrī varasaṅgatā sarve svapnāḥ śubhāḥ proktāḥ siddhimokṣaphalapradāḥ garhitā lokavidviṣṭāḥ svapnāste hyaśubhāvahāḥ tailābhyaktaṃ naraṃ nagnaṃ śuṣkavṛkṣaṃ sakaṇṭhakam kevalenāthavājyena siṃhamantreṇa śāntaye astrasaṃpuṭitenaiṣāṃ nāmnā svāhānvitena ca praṇamya śirasā hṛṣṭastasmai svapnaṃ nivedayet akasmādyadi jāyeta nākhyātavyaṃ gurorvinā prakāśanīyaṃ viprendraṃ kasyacit siddhimicchatā nikaṭasthāśca tāstasya siddhayo yānti dūrataḥ nijaṃ śarīramathavā devatāmayameva hi jāyante bahavo vighnā niyamasthasya nārada tṛtīyavatsarādūrdhvaṃ rājānaśca mahībhṛtaḥ prasādaḥ kriyatāṃ nātha mamoddharaṇakāraṇam ataste muniśārdūla niṣṭhuraṃ vaktumakṣamāḥ nānāścaryāṇi hṛdaye mantrasiddhimayāni vai jaḍadhīstu kṣaṇaṃ viprakṣaṇamasti praharṣitaḥ kṣaṇaṃ ca madhuraṃ vādyaṃnānāgītasamanvitam utpatantaṃ kṣaṇaṃ vāpi paśyatyātmānamātmanā gajagovṛṣanādāṃśca śṛṇuyācca kṣaṇaṃ dvijaḥ tārakāṇi vicitrāṇi yogino nabhasi sthitān kṣaṇaṃ kilikilārāvaṃ haṃsavarhiravaṃ tathā rātrau ca divasālokaṃ sasūryyaṃ kṣaṇamīkṣate pūrṇendusadṛśaḥ kāntyā gamane vihagopamaḥ

svalpāśanenākṛśatā bahunāpi na cīyate japadhyānagato mantrī na khedamadhigacchati ityevamādibhiścihnarmahāvismayakāribhiḥ adhiṣṭhitaṃ niśyadīpaṃ nistamisraṃ gṛhaṃ bhavet yadi siddhiṃ na labhate dvistrirvā punarācaret vedyāmathāyase pātre mṛṇmaye vā nave śubhe gomayenopaliptāyāṃ bhūmau susthalarūpakam aṃgulotsedhasaṃyuktaṃ caturasraṃ samantataḥ udakprahvaḥ pradeśo vā sthaṇḍilasya sthalaṃ smṛtam tadyoṣitāṃ sa evoktaḥ śūdro yaṃ varṇamāśritaḥ tatsubhruvāṃ ca tadbhṛtya śūdrāṇāṃ ca sa eva hi tarpayāmīti mantrānte proktādbhirmūrdhni tarpayet abhiṣiñcet svamūrdhānaṃ jalaiḥ kumbhākhyamudrayā nānāvidhairbhakṣyabhojyairlehyaiścopyaistathetaraiḥ viprārādhanamātreṇa vyaṅgaṃ sāṅgatvamāpnuyāt aṅgahīnaṃ bhavedyadyat karma neṣṭārthasādhakam ta eva pūrṇatāṃ yānti samastāni bhavanti cet yāni yānyapi karmāṇi hīyante dvijabhojanaiḥ guruṃ santoṣayet paścādgohiraṇyāmbarādibhiḥ itthaṃ puraścaraṇataḥ prasannā devatā bhavet pareritaṃ vā gāthāṃ vā saṃjapedyadyanarthakṛt brahmahatyāsamaṃ teṣāṃ pātakaṃ parikīrtitam mantraṃ gurumukhāt prāptamekaṃ syāt sarvasiddhidam dūraṅgamaṃ jyotiṣāṃ jyotirekaṃ tanme manaḥ śivasaṅkalpamastu yadapūrvaṃ yakṣyamantaḥ prajānāṃ tanme manaḥ śivasaṅkalpamastu

yasmānna ṛte kiñcana karma kriyate tanme manaḥ śivasaṅkalpamastu yena yajñastāyate saptahotā tanme manaḥ śivasaṅkalpamastu yasmiṃścittaṃ sarvamotaṃ prajānāṃ tanme manaḥ śivasaṅkalpamastu hṛtpratiṣṭhaṃ yadajiraṃ javiṣṭhaṃ tanme manaḥ śivasaṅkalpamastu iṣṭāniṣṭe samācakṣva mama svapnasya śāśvata vāmāya viśvarūpāya svapnādhipataye namaḥ kriyāsiddhiṃ vidhāsyāmi tvatprasādānmaheśvara viśvāya viśvarūpāya svapnādhipataye namaḥ grahaṇe'rkasya cendorvā śuciḥ pūrvamapoṣitaḥ sparśādvimuktiparyantaṃ japenmantraṃ samāhitaḥ devaṃ dhyātvā japenmantramayutānāṃ catuṣṭayam tataḥ siddho bhavenmantraḥ * * * * * * * * anulomavilomena mantrasiddhiḥ prajāyate kramotkramāt śatāvṛttyā māsāt siddho bhavenmanuḥ siddhāḥ syurnaiva sandeho yasmātsarvaṃ tadudbhavam kramotkramāt sahasraṃ tu māsāt siddho bhavenmanuḥ puraścaraṇakṛtyena vinaivāsau prasīdati tattadvarṇoktasaṃkhyābhirguṭikāḥ mantrasiddhidāḥ tatpūjā ca tathā siddhidāyakāstu na saṃśayaḥ kakkolajātimāṃsīmurācoragranthirocanāpatrāḥ soḍumbarakāśmarikāsthirābjadarapuṣpikāmayūraśikhāḥ rohiṇaṭuṇṭukabṛhatī pāṭalacitrātulasyapāmārgāḥ dūrvā śrīdevīsahe tathaiva lakṣmīsadābhadre guṭikākaṣāyabhasitaprabhedato nikhilasiddhidāyinyaḥ kuryādatha tayoraikyaṃ śāstradṛṣṭena vartmanā

ādyante sakalaṃ nāma tataḥ praṇavamālikhet bhūrje rocanagandhādyaiḥ padmamadhye suśobhane nikṣipenmadhure tattu mṛṇmaye laghubhājane dhārayed deśikaḥ kumbhamagnikuṇḍasamīpataḥ mūlamantreṇa mantrajñaḥ sahasraṃ śatameva vā homaṃ samāpya taṃ kumbhaṃ vinikṣipya jalāśaye etadyo na vijānāti nāsau sādhaka ucyate uttamāya tu śiṣyāya putrāya ca vadedidam dāhanaṃ ca budhaḥ kuryāttataḥ siddho bhavenmanuḥ tanmantraṃ yantra ālikhya śilākarpūrakuṅkumaiḥ kṣīrājyamadhutoyānāṃ madhye taṃ likhitaṃ kṣipet drāvito'pi na siddhaścedvodhanaṃ tasya kārayet evaṃ buddho bhavet siddho nocettasya vaśaṃ kuru etaistu likhito mantro bhūrjapatre suśobhane adharottararūpeṇa padāni parijapya vai vidyāmādityadugdhena likhitvākramya cāṅghriṇā pīḍito lajjayāviṣṭaḥ siddhaścennahi poṣayet dhārayellikhitaṃ mantramathavā śoṣaṇaṃ caret bhasmanā dhārayet kaṇṭhe no ceddāhyo'gnibījataḥ likhet pālāśatailena dhārayet kaṇṭhadeśataḥ japahomādikāṅgānāṃ saṃkhyā cāṣṭottaraṃ śatam aśvatthapatranavake mantraṃ yantraṃ ca mālikām jale nikṣipya dīkṣārthaṃ śīghraṃ gurumathāśrayet mṛtyūnāṃ haraṇaṃ tadvad devatādarśanaṃ tathā parakāyapraveśaśca purapraveśanaṃ tathā

khecarīmelanaṃ caiva tatkathāśravaṇādikam ākarṣaṇaṃ surastrīṇāṃ nāgastrīṇāṃ tathaiva ca aṇimādīṃśca samprāpya kevalaṃ mokṣamāpnuyāt khyātirvāhanabhūṣādilābhaḥ sucirajīvanam sarvatra sarvalokeṣu camatkārakaraḥ sukhī pāṇḍityaṃ ca kavitvaṃ ca caturvidhamayatnataḥ aṣṭāṅgayogābhyasanaṃ bhogecchāparivarjanam ityādiguṇasampattirmadhyasiddhestu lakṣaṇam nṛpāṇāmaṅganānāṃ ca vātsalyaṃ lokavaśyatā adhamāḥ siddhayaḥ proktā mantriṇaḥ prathamabhūmikāḥ phaliṣyatīti viśvāsastat satsiddhestu lakṣaṇam kāmaṃ vā viṣa bījaṃ vā japatāṃ siddhido manuḥ sthānadhyānavihīnānāṃ koṭijāpāt phalaṃ nahi kramotkramācchatāvṛttyā tadante kevalaṃ manum niścitaṃ mantrasiddhiḥ syādityuktaṃ tantravedibhiḥ guroḥ santoṣamātreṇa mantrasiddhirbhaved dhruvam guruṃ vilaṅghya śāstre'smin nādhikāraḥ sureśvari gurorājñāṃ vinā devi siddhihāniḥ prajāyate yasya deve ca mantre ca gurau ca triṣu niścalā bhāvanārahitānāṃ ca kṣudrāṇāṃ kṣudracetasām tadānena vidhānena kartavyaṃ kulasādhānam anyonyaṃ nityatā jñeyā kuladevyāḥ prapūjane vaiśyairdhanaprayoge ca śūdraistu na kadācana dīkṣitāṃ gandhapuṣpādyairbhakṣyaiḥ pāyasasambhavaiḥ śūnye gehe samānīya cārghyādikaṃ viśodhayet

āsanaṃ prathamaṃ dadyāt svāgata ca vadet punaḥ snāpayed gandhapuṣpādbhiḥ keśasaṃskāramārabhet tataḥ sthānāntare pīṭhamāstīrya pādukāyugam bhūṣayitvānulepaṃ ca gandhaṃ mālyaṃ nivedayet carvyaṃ coṣyaṃ lehyapeyaṃ bhojyaṃ ca pañcabhakṣakam dugdhaṃ dadhi ghṛtaṃ takraṃ navanītaṃ saśarkaram nārikelaṃ kapitthaṃ ca nāgaraṅgaṃ sudarśanam nānāvanyaphalaṃ caiva nānāgandhavilepanam ṭaṅkaṇaṃ lodhrakaṃ caiva jalajaṃ vanajaṃ tathā ādāvante ca madhye ca japapūjāviśeṣataḥ pūrvārjite phalaṃ nāsti kā kathā parajanmani mamāpi krodhasantāpaśamanaṃ vighnanāśanam ṣoḍaśaḥ śvāsaḥ kuje vā śanivāre vā naramuṇḍaṃ samāhṛtam nikṣipya bhūmau hastārdhamānataḥ kānane vane ekākī prajapenmantraṃ sa bhavet kalpapādapaḥ śavamānīya taddvāri tenaiva parikhanya ca sa bhavet sarvasiddhiśo nātra kāryā vicāraṇā aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ pakṣayorubhayorapi tāvajjaptvā nirātaṅkaḥ sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavet śaratkāle caturthyādinavamyantaṃ viśeṣataḥ japedeko'pi vijane kevalaṃ timirālaye kṛṣṇāṣṭamīṃ samārabhya yāvat kṛṣṇāṣṭamī bhavet kṛṣṇāṃ caturdaśīṃ prāpya navamyantaṃ mahotsave daśamyāṃ pāraṇaṃ kuryānmatsyamāṃsādibhiryutam

caturdaśīṃ samārabhya yāvadanyā caturdaśī kevalaṃ japamātreṇa mantrāḥ siddhāḥ bhavanti hi tato nagnāṃ striyaṃ nagno gacchet kledayuto'pi ca yonikuṇḍe sthiraḥ sarpirmāṃsamatsyāyutaṃ tathā tarpaṇasya daśāṃśena cābhiṣicya jaganmayīm ādyaṃ māṃsaṃ ca matsyaṃ ca carvaṇaṃ ca nivedayet prajaptavyaṃ prayatnena sarvakāmārthasiddhaye mukte śukre ca deveśi punarmantraṃ japet sudhīḥ sarvathā naiva kartavyamanyathā sidhirodhakṛt strīgaṇeṣu sadā bhāvyamabhāve svastriyāmapi taddhastāpacitaṃ bhojyaṃ devatābhyo nivedayet divyairapi ca kartavyaṃ paśubhirnaca pāmaraiḥ dīkṣitāṃ vastrabhūṣādyairbhojyaiḥ pāyasasaṃbhavaiḥ dugdhaṃ dadhi ghṛtaṃ takraṃ navanītaṃ saśarkaram nārikelaṃ kapitthaṃ ca nāgaraṅgaṃ sudarśanam nānāvanyaphalaṃ caiva nānāgandhavilepanam ṭaṅkaṇaṃ lodhrakaṃ caiva jalajaṃ vanajaṃ tathā śūnye gehe samānīya cārghyodakaviśodhitam brāhmaṇī kṣatriyā vaiśyā śūdrā ca kulabhūṣaṇā viśeṣavaidagdhyayutāḥ sarvā eva kulāṅganāḥ arghyaṃ pādyaṃ ca pānīyaṃ madhuparkaṃ jalaṃ tataḥ dhūpayitvā tataḥ keśān kauśeyaṃ ca nivedayet dattvā tatra samānīya nānālaṅkārabhūṣaṇaiḥ tāṃ tāṃ śakti samāvāhya mūrdhniṃ tāsāṃ samānayet carvyaṃ coṣyaṃ lehyapeyaṃ bhakṣyaṃ bhojyaṃ nivedayet

tāsāṃ savyeṣu karṇeṣu tatastotraṃ samācaret kṛpayā hara me vighnaṃ mantrasiddhiṃ prayaccha me kṛpayā hara me vighnaṃ mantrasiddhiṃ prayaccha me kṛpayā hara me vighnaṃ mantrasiddhiṃ prayaccha me kṛpayā hara me vighnaṃ mantrasiddhiṃ prayaccha me kṛpayā hara me vighnaṃ mantrasiddhiṃ prayaccha me kṛpayā hara me vighnaṃ mantrasiddhiṃ prayaccha me kṛpayā hara me vighnaṃ mantrasiddhiṃ prayaccha me kṛpayā hara me vighnaṃ mantrasiddhiṃ prayaccha me eke bahuvidhe devi viśvarūpe namo'stu te vidagdhāṃ vā samālokya tasya vighnaṃ na jāyate dīkṣākāle nityapūjāsamaye nārcayedyadi yadi vrīḍāparā sā tu bhojane tadgṛhādvahiḥ ācamya mukhavāsādi tāmbūlaṃ ca nivedayet visṛjya pradakṣiṇīkṛtya varaṃ prārthya sukhī bhavet agrajāṃ mātulānīṃ vā mātaraṃ tatsapatnikām sarvābhāve hyekatarā pūjanīyā prayatnataḥ sarva eva surāḥ pūjyāḥ satyaṃ brahmaśivādayaḥ sarvā eva parādevyaḥ pūjitāḥ kulabhairava prāpnoti paramāṃ siddhiṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā nirbhayeṇeva śucinā bhūtvā sarvārthasiddhidam bhairaveṇa purā proktaṃ sarvakāmārthasiddhidam tadbāhye ca punarvastraṃ mūlenāṅgavilepanam iṣṭadevaṃ guruṃ natvā yātrā praharamadhyataḥ akṣubdho bhuktabhojyastu bhuktvā sādhanamācaret

bhaumavāre tamisrāyāṃ sādhayet siddhimuttamām niśāyāṃ mṛtahaṭṭe ca unmattānandabhairavaḥ bhadre puṣkarasaṃyoge tasyāṃ vīravarottamaḥ tretāyāṃ pūjayed devīṃ ghṛtena sarvajātibhiḥ pūjanīyā kalau devī kevalairāsavaiśca taiḥ gauḍī tu yā kṣatriyeṇa mādhvī vaiśyena tatra vai sarvā śūdrasya saṃproktā yatra vā taddhavirbhavet bauddhe pāśupate sāṃkhye māntre kālāmukhe tathā vinālipiśatābhyāṃ ca pūjanaṃ niṣphalaṃ bhavet niṣphalaṃ tadbhaved devi bhasmamanyeva yathā hutam alipānaṃ tathā devi somavadbhogamokṣadam nārikelodakaṃ kāṃsye tāmre dadyāttathā madhu evaṃ pradānamātreṇa hīnāyurbrāhmaṇo bhavet brāhmaṇastāmrapātre tu madhu madyaṃ prakalpayet svagātrarudhiraṃ dattvā svātmahatyāmavāpnuyāt varṇāśramocitaṃ dharmamavicāryāparyanti ye nirṇītavedaśāstrārtho varadāṃ vāruṇīṃ pibet tat kathaṃ tat prakurvanti saptakoṭimunīśvarāḥ vīro'pyatra vṛthāpānād devatāśāpamāpnuyāt paśupānavidhau pītvā vīro'pi narakaṃ vrajet yo'smin śāstre pravarteta taṃ tvaṃ pīḍayase dhruvam sa mahāpātakī devi sarvadharmabahiṣkṛtaḥ na siddhayaḥ kulabhraṃśastat sarva narakāya ca sa siddhimiha nāpnoti paratra ca parāṃ gatim na tasya sadgatiḥ kvāpi tapastīrthavratādiṣu

svaprītyai āhṛtaṃ māṃsaṃ rauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajet mādhvī muktikarī jñeyā surākhyā trividhā priye tālajā stambhane śastā khārjūrī ripunāśinī mādhūkākhyā jñānakarī dāridryaripuhāriṇī kṣīravṛkṣasamudbhūtaṃ madyaṃ valkalasambhavam dravyaṃ taduttamaṃ devi devatāprītikārakam tadgandhāghrāṇamātreṇa śatakratuphalaṃ labhet māṃsasaṃdarśanādau tu surādarśanavat phalam kathayasya mahādeva sarvasiddhipradaṃ mahat sarvasiddhipradaṃ sākṣāt sarvadevanamaskṛtam brahmaviṣṇuśivādīnāṃ dikpālānāṃ ca bhāmini svataḥ siddhipradaṃ devi sarveṣāmālayaṃ mahat mahābalo mahābuddhirmahāsāhasikaḥ śuciḥ teṣāṃ kṛte mahādevi kathitaṃ nīlasādhanam kṛṣṇapakṣe viśeṣeṇa yathāvidhi ca sādhayet tadardhābhyantare samyak pūjopakaraṇaṃ balim) nānāphalaṃ ca naivedyaṃ svasvakalpoktasādhanam samānaguṇasampannaiḥ sādhako vītabhīḥ svayam bhītaścet sādhakastatra caturdikṣu ca sādhakāḥ prakṣālitāṃ citābhūmiṃ gatvā sādhakasattamaḥ astrāntamūlamantreṇa prokṣaṇaṃ yāgabhūmiṣu yoginīrmātṛkāścaiva vāmapādapuraḥsaram piśācā yakṣasiddhāśca gandharvāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ siddhidāstā bhavantvadya tathā ca mama rakṣakāḥ śmaśānādhipatiṃ paścādbhairavaṃ kālabhairavam

pādyādibhiśca mantrajño baliṃ paścānnivedayet imamante sāmiṣānnaṃ bali gṛhna tataḥ param kuru siddhiṃ me tato'nte prayaccha svāhayānvitam māyānte bhairavaṃ paścādbhayānaka tataḥ param hūmante ca mahākālāt paścāt pūrvavaduddharet śabdā (vā)nte kālaśabdānte bhairaveti padaṃ tataḥ citāmadhye tato dadyād balitrayamanuttamam gṛhāṇemaṃ baliṃ mātardehi siddhimanuttamām śabdā(vā)nte bhūtanāthānte śmaśānādhipa ityapi hūṃ sarvagaṇanāthānte dhipa caiva tathā punaḥ tārādyena baliṃ dattvā pañcagavyena sundari bhūrje vā vaṭapatre vā tatra pīṭhamanuṃ nyaset vīrārcanena deveśi loṣṭān dikṣu parikṣipet kālike ghoradaṃṣṭre ca pracaṇḍe caṇḍanāyike parabījaṃ (vīraṃ) mahāvighnaṃ chedayeti yugaṃ tataḥ anena mantritāṃlloṣṭān daśadikṣu vinikṣipet yadi pramādāddeveśi sādhako bhayavihvalaḥ arkendusitavāṭyālatūlanirmitavartikam hate tasmin mahādīpe vighnaiśca paribhūyate tattatkalpavidhānena bhūtaśuddhyādikaṃ caret kramādvyutkramayogena tārāṣāḍhā prakīrtitā ṣoḍhā vā tārakaṃ vāpi vinyasya prajapettataḥ baliṃ dadyāt tadā devi no cedante bhavedbaliḥ nimīlya cakṣuṣī paścāddevīṃ dhyātvā manuṃ japet tataḥ paraṃ tu mantrajño gajāntakasahasrakam

yadyasahyaṃ bhayaṃ karṇe netre vastreṇa bandhayet jayadūrgākhyamanunā cārghyaṃ tenaiva sarṣapān pitṝṇāṃ svargadātā tvaṃ martyānāmabhayakṣamaḥ iti kṣiptvā tilān devi caturbhāge śivāditaḥ devaṃ tatrāpi sampūjya prajapenmanumuttamam bhayeti (yādi) svapnavajjñeyaṃ pare'hni śeṣāmācaret karpūraṃ padmarāgaṃ ca kesaraṃ haricandanam jihvāgrarudhiraṃ vīraḥ śmaśāne ca samāhitaḥ nīlāṃ nīlapatākāṃ ca lalajjihvāṃ karālikām viyadastrānvitaṃ devi vāmākṣicandrabhūṣitam mūlamantraṃ tu mantrajño japet sārdhaṃ śatatrayam baliṃ bhuktvā varaṃ dehi rudhiraṃ gahane vane kāliketi samākhyātā jīvānāṃ hitakāmyayā viyadagniyutaṃ devi balamindrasamāyutam tataḥ patāke hūṃphaṭ syāt pūrvakūṭamanurmataḥ iti nīlapatākeyaṃ yojyā vā nīlasādhane padmarāgaṃ kesaraṃ ca gandhadravyaṃ viśeṣataḥ bhramatītastato vīrastaṃ vilokya japenmanum tadā svayaṃ bhairavo'sau svayaṃ viśvambharo bhavet tadbhasmatilakaṃ kṛtvā svayaṃ vīreśvaro bhavet sādhayecca tathā siddhisādhanasthānamāśrayet vīrārcanākṛte bhūmau māyāmoho na vidyate śmaśānādhipatīnāṃ tu pūrvavadbalimāharet sudarśanenātmarakṣāmubhābhyāṃ vā prakalpayet ghoraghoratarasyānte tanurūpapadaṃ tataḥ

kahadvandvaṃ vamadvandvaṃ tato bandhayugaṃ punaḥ ekapañcāśadarṇo'yamaghorāstramayo manuḥ varmāstrānto mahāmantraḥ sudarśanasya kīrtitaḥ jayadūrgākhyamanunā sarṣapān dikṣu nikṣipet yaṣṭividdhaṃ śūlaviddhaṃ khaḍgaviddhaṃ payomṛtam taruṇaṃ sundaraṃ śūraṃ bālaṃ naṣṭaṃ samūjjvalam svecchāmṛtaṃ dvivarṣaṃ ca baddhastrīgodvijaṃ tathā evaṃ cāṣṭavidhaṃ tyatkvā pūrvoktānyatamaṃ śavam cāṇḍālaṃ cābhibhūtaṃ tu śīghrasiddhiphalapradam praṇavaṃ kūrmabījaṃ ca mṛtakāya namo'stu phaṭ re vīra paramānanda śivānanda kuleśvara vīro'haṃ tvāṃ prapadyāmi uttiṣṭha caṇḍikārcane tāraṃ śaktirmṛtakāya namo'nte mantramuccaret dhūpena dhūpitaṃ kṛtvā gandhādinābhiṣicya(lipya) ca gatvā śavasya sānidhyaṃ dhārayet kaṭideśataḥ punaḥ prakṣālitaṃ kṛtvā japasthānaṃ samānayet elālavaṅgakarpūrajātīkhadirasārakaiḥ sthāpayitvā tasya pṛṣṭhaṃ candanena vilepayet madhye padmaṃ caturdvāraṃ dalāṣṭakasamanvitam dvādaśāṃgulamānāni yajñakāṣṭhāni dikṣu ca viṣamindrāya saṃlikhya surādhipataye tataḥ vighnanivāraṇaṃ kṛtvā siddhiṃ prayaccha ṭhadvayam svasvanāmādikaṃ dattvā pūrvavadbalimāharet śavādhiṣṭhātṛdevebhyo baliṃ dadyāt sureśvari pūjādravyaṃ sannidhau ca dūre cottarasādhakam

phaḍityanena mantreṇa tatrāśvārohaṇaṃ viśet dṛḍhaṃ nibaddhya juṭikāṃ kṛtasaṃkalpasādhakaḥ vīrārcanena saṃmantrya dikṣu loṣṭāni nikṣipet śavāsye vidhivaddevi devatāpyāyanaṃ caret vaśe me bhava deveśa mamāmukapadaṃ tataḥ mūlaṃ samuccaran mantrī śavapādadvayaṃ punaḥ bhīmabhīma mahābhāva bhavyalocana bhāvuka iti pādatale tasya trikoṇaṃ cakramullikhet upaviśya punastasya bāhū vistārya pārśvayoḥ oṣṭhau tu sampūṭau kṛtvā sthiracittaḥ sthirendriyaḥ śmaśāne proktasaṃkhyābhirjapaṃ kuryāt kuleśvari yadyardharātraparyantaṃ japte kiñcinna lakṣyate kṛtvopaviśya tatraiva japaṃ kuryādananyadhīḥ yatprārthayasi deveśa naraṃ vā kuñjarādikam ityukte saṃskṛtenaiva nirbhayastu punarjapet tadā satyavaśaṃ kāryaṃ varaṃ ca prārthayet tataḥ tadā punarjaped dhīmān ekāgramānasaṃ smaran yantrāntareṇa boddhavyaṃ naro vā devayonayaḥ āgatya vighnaṃ carate māyayā ramyavigrahā prabhātasamayo jātastvatpitā krośate gṛhe kadācit kenacit śāsti tadā kiṃ te kariṣyati mṛtapitṛgaṇāstatra paradeśanivāsinaḥ strīputrasevakāścaiva gṛhītvānīyate paraiḥ nijakāntāṅgasaṃsparśavastramābharaṇādikam yadi na kṣubhyate tatra tadā kiṃ vā na labhyate

ūrūṃ (huṃ huṃ) gṛhṇeti śabdaṃ vai trivārānte varaṃ labhet tadā vīrapatestasya kiṃ bhūtena na sidhyati asaṃskṛtatarā devi pāpayukte na saṃśayaḥ saiva devīna saṃdehaḥ sa devo bhairavaḥ svayam na varaṃ varayet tatra na kiñcicca vadet tataḥ na cet svayaṃ laukikoktyā varaṃ grāhyaṃ nirākulam śabdo vā jāyate samyak mṛ (ṛ) taṃ vāpi na labhyate devatākṛtayo devi bhairavākṛtabuddhayaḥ bhairavo vaṭukādyāśca kulaśāstraparāyaṇāḥ putro bhūtvā haredvidyāṃ nārī bhūtvā vimohayet satye kṛtaṃ varaṃ labdhvā santyajecca japādikam śavaṃ prakṣālya saṃsthāpya mocayet pādabandhanam śavaṃ jale vā garte vā nikṣipya snānamācaret agrime divase rātrau yeṣāṃ devānāṃ yajamāno'ham atha yairyācitaścāśvanarakuṅjaraśūkarān yavakṣodamayaṃ vāpi śālikṣodamayaṃ ca vā pare'hni nityamācarya pañcagavyaṃ pibet tataḥ pañcapañcavihīnān vā kramāccaiva daśāvadhiḥ yadi na syādviprabhojyaṃ tadā nirdhanatāṃ vrajet trirātraṃ vātha ṣaḍrātraṃ gopayet kulasādhanam gītaṃ śrutvā ca badhiro niścakṣurnṛtyadarśanāt pañcadaśadināntā hi dehe devasya saṃsthitiḥ devagobrāhmaṇādīiṃśca pratyahaṃ saṃspṛśecchuciḥ tataḥ snāyāt tu tīrthādau prāpte ṣoḍaśavāsare evaṃ śatatrayādūrdhva devatāṃ tarpayejjalaiḥ

ityanena vidhānena siddhiṃ prāpnoti niścitam asāṅgaṃ sāṅgamevāpi niṣphalaṃ saphalaṃ ca vā śavābhāve śmaśāne vā kāryā vīrasya sādhanā daśāhakramayogena bhraṣṭo bhavati sādhakaḥ kulānmantraṃ gṛhītvā tu yāvat siddhiḥ prajāyate brāhmaṇaṃ gomayaṃ kṛtvā sādhayedvīrasādhanam tāvatkālaṃ vasedghore yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam kṣudrāḥ prayogakartṛṇāṃ praśastāḥ sarvasiddidāḥ na kasyacit pravaktavyaṃ mayā prītyā tavoditam nadyāṃ samudragāminyāṃ nābhimātre'bhbhasi sthitaḥ homayettaddaśāṃśena taddaśāṃśena tarpayet aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ pakṣayorubhayorapi tāvajjaptvā nirātaṅkaḥ sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavet śaratkāle caturthyādinavamyantaṃ viśeṣataḥ ekākī vijane japyāt kevalaṃ vā śivālaye anyatra gurumārgasya laṅghanaṃ naiva kārayet praviśya mantrī vidhivattāḥ samabhyarcya yatnataḥ kevalaṃ kāmadevo'sau japedaṣṭottaraṃ śatam mantrasiddhirbhavetsadyo latādarśanapūjanāt ākṛṣṭāyāḥ kulāgāre bhāvena mantramuttamam vidhāya tatra saṃskāraṃ kṛtvā tasyai nivedya ca tāṃ visṛjya namaskṛtya svayaṃ japtvā sukhaṃ punaḥ udayāntaṃ divā japtvā sarvasiddhiśvaro bhavet kuje vā śanivāre vā naramuṇḍaṃ samāhṛtam nikṣipya bhūmau hastārdhamānataḥ kānane vane

ekākī prajapenmantraṃ sa bhavetkalpapādapaḥ śavamānīya tadvāre tenaiva parikhanya tam sa bhavet sarvasiddhīśo nātra kāryā vicāraṇā niśāyāṃ mṛtahaṭṭe ca unmattānandabhairavaḥ kapālakhaḍgahastaśca japenmātṛkāya yadi gurumānīya saṃsthāpya devavatpūjanaṃ guroḥ tatsutaṃ tatsutāṃ caiva tasya patnīṃ tathaiva ca sahasrāre guroḥ pādapadmaṃ dhyātvā prajapya ca puraścaraṇarūpeṇa saṃsiddhyai yatatāṃ naraḥ kṛte naimittike vipra nityasya pūrṇatā bhavet samudragodakāhāro japellakṣaṃ samāhitaḥ koṭijanmodbhavaṃ pāpaṃ nāśamāyāti niścitam parvatāgre yajeddevaṃ śākamūlaphalāśanaḥ dharmārthakāmamokṣāśca karasthāśca bhavanti hi śrīpuṣpairjuhuyāt tadvadvaiśākhe māsi dugdhapaḥ devāḥ sarve namasyanti bhaktyā taṃ puruṣarṣabham aṣṭottaraśataṃ kṛtvā pūjānte bhaktitatparaḥ yadyat kāmayate mantrī anāyāsena labhyate tarpayannakhilān kāmāṁllabhenmokṣaṃ ca vindati yaśase dharmavṛddhyai ca brahmacārivrate sthitaḥ tathā raktāśvamāreṇa acalāṃ bhaktimāpnuyāt brāhmaṇānāṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ vaiśyānāṃ śeṣajanmanām eteṣāṃ māsamātraṃ tu kṛtvā kāmyāni sādhayet sarvatantrānusāreṇa prayogaphalasiddhidam māraṇāntāni śaṃsanti ṣaṭkarmāṇi manīṣiṇaḥ

vaśyaṃ janānāṃ sarveṣāṃ vidheyatvamudīritam snigdhānāṃ dveṣajananaṃ mitho vidveṣaṇaṃ matam prāṇināṃ prāṇaharaṇaṃ māraṇaṃ samudāhṛtam ratirvāṇī ramā lakṣmīrdurgā kālī yathākramam īśacandrendranir-ṛtivāyvagnīnāṃ diśo matāḥ ṛtavaḥ syurvasantādyā ahorātraṃ dine dine hemantaḥ śāntike prokto vasanto vaśyakarmaṇi prāvṛḍuccāṭane jñeyā śaranmāraṇakarmaṇi vajraṃ bhadrakamityāhurāsanāni manīṣiṇaḥ musalāśanikhaḍgākhyāḥ śāntikādiṣu karmasu stambhane pṛthivī śastā vidveṣe vyoma kīrtitam tattadbhūtodaye samyak tattanmaṇḍalasaṃyutam śītāṃśusalilakṣoṇīvyaumavāyuhavirbhujām grathanaṃ ca vidarbhaśca sampuṭo rodhanaṃ tathā mantrārṇāntaritān kuryānnāmavarṇān yathāvidhi mantrārṇadvandvamadhyasthaṃ sādhyanāmākṣara likhet ādāvante ca mantraḥ syānnāmno'sau saṃpuṭo mataḥ nāmna ādyantamadhyeṣu mantraḥ syādrodhanaṃ matam mantrasyānte bhavennāma yogaḥ proccāṭane mataḥ sitaraktapītamiśrakṛṣṇadhūmrāḥ prakīrtitāḥ yantrāṇāṃ lekhanadravyaṃ candanaṃ rocanā niśā śyenāgniloṇapiṇḍāni dhattūrakarasastathā devatākālamudrādīn samyag jñātvā vicakṣaṇaḥ sthāpayenmanunā tena prāṇān sarvatra deśikaḥ mṛtā vaivasvatā bhūyo jīvahā prāṇahā tataḥ

kṣetrapratiharītyetāḥ prāṇadūtyo nava smṛtāḥ aṅkuśenāhṛtasyāpi sādhyasyāsūn samāharet tasyāṃ prāṇātmakaṃ yantraṃ sakīṭaṃ hṛdaye nyaset daleṣu vāyuvahnīndravaruṇānāmataḥ param yādīn haṃsasamāyuktān bhṛṅgākārānanusmaret evamātmahṛdambhoje bhṛṅgīrūpān dhiyā smaret ekaikāṃ sādhyahṛtpadmād bhṛṅgānekaikamānayet tantucchedaṃ prakurvīta vahnibījena saṃyataḥ evamekādaśāvṛtīḥ kuryāt sarveṣu karmasu mohavidveṣayordhūmrān kṛṣṇān māraṇakarmaṇi ākṛṣya sādhyahṛtprāṇān sthāpayedātmano hṛdi prāṇān sādhyasya maṇḍūkānātmanastu bhujaṅgamān varṇavṛtaṃ dharāḍhyam vaśayet sakalān devān kiṃ punaḥ pārthivānapi grathitaṃ tatsamākhyātaṃ vaśyākṛṣṭikaraṃ param viparītaṃ punaścānte mantraṃ tatsampuṭaṃ bhavet ardhamardhaṃ tadādyante mantraṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ abhicāreṣu sarveṣu yojayenmāraṇe'pi vā etat samastamityuktaṃ śatrūccāṭanakārakam vidarbhitaṃ tatsamproktaṃ duṣṭaghnaṃ vaśyalakṣaṇam ākrāntaṃ tadvijānīyātsadyaḥ sarvārthasādhanam sakṛtpūrvaṃ vadenmantramante caiva tathā punaḥ anyonyaprītiyuktānāṃ vidveṣaṇakaraṃ param sādhyanāma sakṛnmadhye garbhasthaṃ sampravakṣate hetinausainyadhīgarbhastambhanaṃ ca gatestathā

sakṛtsādhyaṃ bhavenmadhye tadvidyātsarvato vṛtam sarvasaubhāgyajananaṃ mṛtānāmamṛtapradam evameva tridhā kuryādbhavedyuktividarbhitam ekaikaṃ sādhyavarṇam tu kṛtvā mantravidarbhitam vidarbhagrathitaṃ nāma mantralakṣaṇamuttamam evamete prayogāḥ syuḥ siddha mantrasya siddhidāḥ huṃphaṭsvāhāvaṣaṭvauṣaṇnamaḥ pallavasaṃjñakāḥ śiraḥ pallavasaṃyukto mantro bhavati siddhidaḥ evaṃ saṃsiddhavidyāyā viniyogakramaṃ śṛṇu sādhyapratikṛtiṃ nāma likhitvā cintayet tataḥ tyaktvā lajjāṃ samāyāti athānyatkathyate priye ātmānaṃ ca tathā sādhyaṃ tadā saubhāgyasundaraḥ yasya nāmnā yutaḥ samyag sa bhaved dāsa eva hi yoni mudrādharo bhūtvā vegādākarṣaṇaṃ bhavet gorocanā kuṃkumābhyāṃ samabhāgaṃ ca candanam puṣpaṃ phalaṃ jalaṃ cānnaṃ gandhaṃ vastraṃ ca bhūṣaṇam aṅganā vā kṣaṇādeva dāsīvāsya bhavetpriye cintayan māsamātraṃ hi sādhyākhyāṃ lalanāṃ tataḥ sundūraracite cakre rājānaṃ mohayet kṣaṇāt citāṅgāreṇa cakraṃ tu likhedraktadraveṇa hi arkanimbadravābhyāṃ tu lekhanyārkasya saṃlikhet gomūtre sthāpayet tacca bhavedvidveṣaṇaṃ kṣaṇāt aṣṭottaraśatāvṛttyā mohayedbhuvanatrayam surūpāṃ pratimāṃ ramyāṃ bhūṣāḍhyāṃ paricintayet janmanāmamahāvidyāmaṃkuśāntarvidarbhitām

sādhyāśābhimukho bhūtvā śrīvidyānyāsavigrahaḥ yojayettāṃ kāmagehe candrasūryakalātmake trailokyasundarī nāma kṣaṇādāyāti mohitā cakraṃ prapūjayetsamyak vidyāṃ pūrṇāṃ ca dhārayet śrīkhaṇḍāgarukastūrīkarpūraiśca sakuṃkumaiḥ tenājarāmaratvaṃ tu sādhakasya na saṃśayaḥ cakraṃ vilikhya sādhyārṇasādhakārṇavidarbhitam kāmakūṭena deveśi sandarbhya pṛthagakṣaram svarṇamadhyagataṃ dhāryaṃ śikhāyāṃ yatra kutracit te sarve vaśyamāyānti sannipātādayo jvarāḥ catuṣpathe madhyadeśe dikṣu pūrvāditaḥ kramāt sphurattejomayīṃ pṛthvīṃ prajvalantīṃ carācaram tena kandarpasubhago loke bhavati niścayāt tathā viṣaṃ ca harati dṛṣṭyāveśaṃ karoti ca karotyākarṣaṇaṃ dūrādyojanānāṃ śatādapi yadā tadaiva loko'yaṃ vaśyo bhavati nānyathā svanāmadarbhitaṃ kuryād deśaṃ vā puṭabhedanam dhārayedvā tato mantrī puraṃ kṣobhayatīkṣaṇāt kastūryalaktasahitā ekīkṛtya tu saṃlikhet grahajaṃ vyādhijaṃ caiva ripujaṃ siṃhajaṃ tathā rocanākuṃkumābhyāṃ tu madhyagāṃ saṃlikhed budhaḥ taccakraṃ dhārayet tasmāt saptāhādvijvaro bhavet sādhyanāma vilikhyaitat pūrvasyāṃ diśi saṃkṣipet anena vidhinā nīlīrasena vilikhet tataḥ mahiṣāśvapurīṣeṇa gomūtreṇa ca saṃlikhet

sādhyanāma likhenmadhye kākapakṣeṇa sañcayet śatrūnuccāṭayedāśu haṭhoccāṭo'yamīritaḥ lākṣārasairlikheccakraṃ caturvarṇān vaśaṃ nayet saubhāgyaṃ mahadāpnoti snānapānānna saṃśayaḥ sindūralikhitaṃ cakramuttare lokavaśyakṛt mantriṇo devatā vaśyāḥ kiṃ punaryoṣitaḥ priye sādhyasya mantrahāniḥ syānmāraṇaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ stambhaṃ vidveṣaṇaṃ vyādhimuccāṭaṃ kurute naraḥ dagdhvā tadvahnimadhysthaṃ sarvaśatrūn vināśayet vidveṣaṇaṃ bhaveccakre tenaiva parameśvari sarvasādhyaṃ samārabhya madhyāntaṃ mātṛkāṃ likhet sādhakaḥ khecarī devi jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ṣaṇmāsakramayogena sākṣādrudra ivāparaḥ khaḍgaṃ vetālasaubhāgyaṃ yakṣiṇīṃ ceṭakādikam caturdaśyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ pratyaṣṭamyāṃ samāhitaḥ śrīcakraṃ pūjayet tadvat surapūjyastu sādhakaḥ kāmo bhūtvā svargabhūsthapātālatalayoṣitām tadvat kāmeśvarīśastrairdevyātmā bhuvanatraye etat kāmakalādhyānaṃ kathitaṃ bījabhedataḥ śvetābhāṃ śvetavastrāḍhyāṃ śvetapuṣpaiḥ samarcayet atha kāmakalā nāma sāmarthya śṛṇu pārvati mahākāmaśca pūrvoktāḥ pañcakāmāḥ krameṇa tu tatpuṭasthaṃ mīnaketuṃ mahākāmeśamastakam mūlādisṛṣṭisaṃhārabisatantusvarūpiṇī trikūṭā tripurā devi sarvasiddhipradā bhavet

cakrametat samāśrītya satāṃ siddhipradāḥ sadā yatrānena vidhānena sādhakena prapūjyate jvalatkāmāgnisaṃtāpapratāpottaptamānasāḥ mantrasaṃmūḍhahṛdayāḥ sphurajjaghanamaṇḍalāḥ japte lakṣaikamātre tu kṣubhyante bhūtale'ṅganāḥ saṃkṣubhyante tataḥ sarvāḥ pātāle nāgakanyakāḥ tataḥ svarganivāsinyo vidravanti surāṅganāḥ saṃkṣobhayati deveśi trailokyaṃ sacarāram nāmnā likhati saṃyuktā jvalantīṃ cintayet tataḥ bhayalajjāvinirmuktā sā'pyāyāti vimohitā sarvamātmānamaruṇaṃ sādhyamapyaruṇīkṛtam vallabhaḥ sarvalokasya sādhakaḥ parameśvari yasya nāmnaiva saṃyuktaṃ sa bhaved dāsavadvaśī viracya yonimudrāṃ ca tāmākarṣayati kṣaṇāt siddhakanyāṃ nāgakanyāṃ devakanyāṃ ca khecarīm madanodbhavavikṣobhasphurajjaghanamaṇḍalām rocanākuṅkumābhyāṃ ca samabhāgaṃ ca candanam tato yamīkṣate vakti spṛśate cintayatyalam tathā puṣpaṃ phalaṃ gandhaṃ pānaṃ vastraṃ maheśvari sadya ākṛṣyate sā tu vimūḍhahṛdayā satī likhedrocanayaikānte pratimāmavanītale tadbhālagalahṛnnābhijanmamaṇḍalayojitām sarvāṅgasandhisaṃlīnamālikhya madanākṣaram baddhvā tu kṣobhiṇīmudrāṃ vidyāmaṣṭottaraṃ japet tato vicalitā pāṅgāmanaṅgaśarapīḍitām

sakticakrojjvaladraśmikalanā kavalīkṛtām ākṛṣṭahṛdayāṃ naṣṭadhairyāmuḍḍīna jīvitām navānurāgasaṃdhānaveṣamānahṛdambujām vimūḍhāmiva vikṣubdhāmiva śrāntāmiva drutām vihastāmiva saṃkīrṇāmivākulitamānasām bhramanmantrāniloddhūtapatrākārāṃ nabhastale athavā mātṛkāṃ sarvāṃ likhitvā cakrabāhyataḥ tathaiva hi maheśāni svasaṃjñākramayogataḥ evaṃ devi vidhānena rocanāgarukuṃkumaiḥ sādhyanāmnā svanāmnā tu cakrasyāntarvidarbhitam madhyaṅgatena bījena mahākāmakalātmanā bahirapi likhedeva veṣṭayenmātṛkākṣaraiḥ śikhāyāmathavā vastre dhārayedyatra tatra vā sammohayati rājānaṃ vājinaṃ duṣṭakuñjaram śatrūn vajraśataṃ śastraṃ vetālaṃ rākṣasaṃ tathā tena mantreṇa sandarbhya purāṇāṃ nāma sundari mahān kolāhalastatra tato lokasya jāyate etanmadhyagatāṃ pṛthvīṃ saśailavanakānanām ṣaṇmāsadhyānayogena jāyate'timanoharaḥ dṛṣṭyā saṃkṣobhayennārīṃ dṛṣṭyaivāpaharedviṣam dṛṣṭyā cāturthikādīṃśca nāśayedviṣamajvarān karoti mahadākarṣaṃ sudūrādapi yoṣitām diganukramayogena tadā sarva jagadvaśe rocanāgarukāśmīrairmadhye sandarbhayet puram svanāmasahitaṃ devi yadi bhūmau nidhāpayet

śikhāyāmathavā vastra yatra tatra sthitaṃ ca vā arkakṣīraṃ kuṅkumaṃ ca dhattūrakarasaṃ tathā ekīkṛtya cakrametallikhyate yasya saṃjñayā yakṣarākṣasavetālabhūtapretapiśācakāt bhayaṃ na vidyate tasya paramanrābhicārajam na śaktā hiṃsituṃ samyagromaikamapi sarvadā adhastānnāmasaṃyuktāṃ rocanākuṅkumāṅkitām pītadravyeṇa saṃlikhya dhāraye(dindradiggatāṃ) mahānīlīrasenāpi nāma saṃyojya pūrvavat ekaṃ nīlapaṭaṃ samyak nīlasūtreṇa veṣṭayet mahiṣāśvapurīṣābhyāṃ gomūtreṇāṅkitaṃ likhet yuktvā rocanayā nāma kākapakṣeṇa saṃlikhet lambamānaṃ tadākāśe paramuccāṭanaṃ bhavet likhitvā dhārayeccakraṃ cāturvaṇyaṃ vaśaṃ nayet saubhāgyamatulaṃ tasya snānapānādibhirbhavet saptāhāt kṣobhayetsatyaṃ jvalamānāṃ vicintya tām śamīdūrvāsahāśvatthapallavairathavārkajaiḥ likhitvā pītavarṇaṃ tu cakrametadyadārcayet sindūrareṇulikhitaṃ pūjayeduttarāmukhaḥ gaurikeṇatadālikhya pūjayet paścimāmukhaḥ dakṣiṇābhimukho bhūtvā kṛṣṇaṃ cakraṃ samarcayet tadvad digantarāleṣu pūjitaṃ parameśvari rocanālikhitaṃ devi dugdhamadhye vaśaṅkaram taila madhyagataṃ cakraṃ vidveṣaṇakaraṃ param athavā devadeveśi yadekānte catuṣpathe

sarvabāhyata ārabhya yāvanmadhyaṃ maheśvari pūjayedrātrisamaye kulācārakrameṇa yaḥ pūjayitvā maheśāni tadvadekatarau girau mahābhūtadine vāpi śmaśāne yadi pūjayet pādukākhaḍgavetālasiddhadravyamahodayān yatkiñcit siddhisantānaṃ vidyate bhuvanatraye dhavalāmbarasamvīto dhavalāmbaramadhyagaḥ dhavalaireva naivedyairdadhikṣīraudanādibhiḥ sampūjya parameśāni dhyāyedvāgīśvarīṃ parām brahmagranthi vinirbhidya jihvāgre bīja rūpiṇīm śaṭho'pi yaḥ padaṃ spaṣṭamakṣaraṃ vaktumakṣamaḥ so'pi sañjāyate vāgmī vācaspatirivāparaḥ sattarkapadavākyārthaśabdālaṅkārasāravit sukumāratarasphārarītyalaṅkārapūrvakaiḥ vedavedāṅgavedāntasiddhāntajñānapāragaḥ prāṇarasavādādigāruḍānekamantravit vicitracitrakarmādiśilpānekavicakṣaṇaḥ sarvabhāṣārutajñānī samastalipikarmakṛt sarvavāṅmayavettā ca sarvajño devi jāyate tatastu śṛṇu deveśi kāmarājasya sādhanam udayādityabimbābhā samujjvalavapuḥ priye samastabhuvanābhogakavalīkṛtajīvitā krameṇa tu tato'naṅgaparyantaṃ prollasantyapi tato bhavati deveśi sarvaśṛṅgāramāninām taddṛṣṭipathagā nārī surī vāpyathavāsurī

pracaṇḍatarabhūpālakanyakā siddhakanyakā klinnā pracalitāpāṅgā vimūḍhā madavihvalā calajjalendusadṛśī bālārkakiraṇāruṇā saiva sindūravarṇābhā hṛdaye cintitā satī niyojitāthavā mūrdhni varṣantī raktabindubhiḥ athānyaṃ sampravakṣyāmi prayogaṃ bhuvi durlabham kāmasthaṃ kāmamadhyasthaṃ kāmodarapuṭīkṛtam kāmena kāmitaṃ kṛtvā kāmasthaṃ kṣobhayed dhruvam śaktibījasvarūpā tu sṛṣṭvā saṃharate yadā tato bhavati deveśi vainateya ivāparaḥ dāhināmamṛtāsāradhīradhārādharopamaḥ duṣṭavyādhigrahānīkaḍākinīrūpikāgaṇaiḥ athavā yena vidyeyaṃ paripūrṇā vicintyate kevalaiva maheśāni padmarāgasamaprabhā manasā saṃsmaratyasyā yadi nāmāpi sādhakaḥ yadaiva jñāyate vidyā mahātripurasundarī sarvāsāṃ sarvasaṃsthānāṃ yoginīnāṃ bhavet priyaḥ yadā tu parameśāni paripūrṇāṃ prapūjayet catuḥṣaṣṭiryataḥ koṭyo yoginīnāṃ mahaujasām ādau sambandhini pade madhye bījāṣṭakaṃ bahiḥ karaśuddhyādividyānāmekaikaṃ parameśvari taddhyānairmadano bhūtvā pāśāṅkuśadhanuḥśaraiḥ tathaiva śāktairdeveśi tripurīkṛtavigrahaḥ tatra śāktā mahāvajraprastārajanitāḥ śarāḥ ādyantago mahāpāśaḥ poruṣeyaḥ prakīrtitaḥ

turīyamaruṇāvargād dvitīyamapi pārvati atīva sundarīṃ ramyāṃ tanmadhye pratimāṃ śubhām cintayettu tato devi yojanaistu sahasraśaḥ rājakanyāpyadṛśyā ca bhayalajjāvivarjitā cakramadhyagato bhūtvā sādhakaścintayedyadā sādhyamapyaruṇībhūtaṃ cintayet parameśvari sarvasaundaryasubhagaḥ sarvalokavaśaṃkaraḥ cakraṃ prapūjayed yasya nāmarūpavidarbhitam cakramadhyagataṃ kuryānnāma yasyāstu yoṣitaḥ haṭhādānayate śīghraṃ yakṣiṇīṃ rājakanyakām vidyādharīṃ divyarūpāmṛṣikanyāṃ ripustriyam kāmavāṇavibhinnāntaḥkaraṇāṃ lolacakṣuṣam kṣobhayet svargabhūrlokapātālatalayoṣitaḥ atha bhāgadvayaṃ devi candanaṃ mardayetsamam aṣṭottaraśatāvṛttyā mantrayitvā vaśaṃ nayet ekaṃ gorocanāyāśca tāni piṣṭvā himāmbhasā yān spṛśet spṛśyate yairvā vaśyāḥ syustasya te'cirāt caturbhāgā jaṭāmāṃsī tāvatī rocanā matā agarurnavabhāgaḥ syāditi bhāgakrameṇa tu vidhāya tilakaṃ bhāle kuryādbhūmipatīna narān siṃhavyāghrān mahāsarpān bhūtavetālarākṣasān ye prayogāstu kathitāḥ siddhyantyeva na saṃśayaḥ yāvadātmamahāvahnau manaḥpūrṇāhutiṃ hunet pāśāṅkuśau tadīyau tu rāgadveṣātmakau smṛtau vaśyapratītijanikāḥ śaktayaśca krameṇa yāḥ

kālāddāmābhibhūtāni navacakrāṇyanukramāt vihvāsahasta pūṣpaistu pūjayetsarvasiddhaye samutpannakulajñānā bhajante māṃ dṛḍhavratāḥ devatāgurubhaktāśca niyatāścārcanapriyāḥ gurūpadeśasaṃyuktāḥ pūjayeyuḥ kuleśvarīm paiśunyatādivimukhaḥ sumukhastarpayecchivām keśasaṃkhyā smṛtā yāvattāvattiṣṭhānta raurave pīṭhasthānāni cāgatya mahāpadmavanaṃ vrajet ciccandramaṇḍale śaktisāmarasyasukhodayaḥ madhupo māṃsasambhoktā tvitare madyapāyinaḥ pare śive layeccittaṃ palāśīti nigadyate matsyāśī sa bhaveddevi śeṣāstu prāṇighātakāḥ annaṃ nānāvidhaṃ caitadetānagnau juhoti yaḥ parāśaktyātmamithunasaṃyogānandanirbharaḥ aprabuddhā parāśaktiḥ prabuddhaḥ kaulikasya yā ityādipañcamudrāṇāṃ vāsanāṃ kulanāyike pustake likhitaṃ dṛṣṭvā svayaṃ jñātvā karoti yaḥ lipyate nātra sandeho narake nivasatyasau ghṛtapūrṇairhuned devi vāgīśatvaṃ prajāyate japāpuṣpairājyayuktaiḥ karavīraistathāvidhaiḥ karpūraṃ kuṃkumaṃ devi miśraṃ mṛgamadena hi saubhāgyena vilāsena sāmarthyenāpi suvrate prāpnoti mantrī mahatīṃ stambhayejjagatīmimām rājanāgendradevānāṃ purandhrīrvaśamānayet lākṣāhomāllabhedrājyaṃ dāridryabhayapīḍitaḥ

dūrasthitānāṃ deveśi guruṇā proktamārgataḥ rudhirāktena chāgasya māṃsena niśi homataḥ pararāṣṭraṃ mahādurgaṃ samastaṃ svavaśaṃ nayet khecaro jāyate rātrau kṛtvā homaṃ catuṣpathe āyurdhanamahārogyasamṛddhirjāyate nṛṇām dadhimākṣikahomena saubhāgyaṃ dhanamāpnuyāt kamalairaruṇairhomaḥ samyak sampattidāyakaḥ nīlotpalairmahāduṣṭā vaśamāyānti nānyathā śvetaistu homātkamalairlakṣmīṃ saubhāgyamāpnuyāt pūrṇabadarahomena vaśīkuryānmahīsurān nāraṅgaphalahomena vaiśyā vaśtā bhavanti hi drākṣāphalaiḥ siddhayo'ṣṭau lakṣahomānna saṃśayaḥ vaśyāḥ syurdaśasaṃkhyākā bhavantyeva na saṃśayaḥ vaśyā viṃśatisaṃkhyākā ityājñā pārameśvarī lakṣamātreṇa mantrajño rājāpara iva priye catuḥ samudraparyantā medinīṃ vaśamānayet vaśyā bhavanti deveśi nātra kāryā vicāraṇā rājikālavaṇābhyāṃ tu duṣṭalokān vaśaṃ nayet guggulasya ca homena sarvaduḥkhāni nāśayet raktacandanahomena vaśyā hi puruṣāḥ striyaḥ kastūrihomato devi rājāno rājamantriṇaḥ tilataṇḍulahomena śāntirbhavati mandire trailokyaṃ vaśamāyāti dhānyasiddhimavāpnuyāt sopaskaraiśca vaṭakairupasargān vināśayet japāpuṣpairjagadvaśyaṃ bāṇapuṣpaiśca mohanam

daśāṅgadhūpahomena saubhāgyamatulaṃ labhet śrīphalairatulā lakṣmīḥ patrairvā suravandite vaśyā bhavanti deveśi nārikelajalena vā yena martyo'pi bhuvane prakhyāto devatāsamaḥ prokteṣu navakuṇḍeṣu tatakarmasu codite śuklapratipadārambhātpūrṇāntaṃ kamalairhunet madhuratrayasaṃsiktaiḥ puṣpairapyaruṇaiḥ śubhaiḥ teṣveva divaseṣvabjaiḥ sitaistaddhavanād ghṛtaiḥ tathaivotpalahomena śriyamāpnoti puṣkalām ketakairhavanātteṣu dineṣu śriyamāpnuyāt taiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ kuṃkumakṣodāplutaistaddinahomataḥ taiścandanāktairhavanāttaddineṣu yathāvidhi tairevendudravāktaistu homātkandarpasannibhaḥ kṛṣṇapratipadārambhād darśāntaṃ juhuyācca taiḥ teṣveva divaseṣvagno guḍaiḥ kṣaudrāplutairhunet drākṣābhirdugdhasiktābhistaddinairhavanānnaraḥ kharjūrīphalahomena trimadhvaktena taddinaiḥ kadalīphalahomena tathā taddivaseṣu ca nārikelaphalakṣodaiḥ sitākṣaudrasamanvitaḥ tairikṣuvārisaṃsiktairhavanāttaddineṣu vai sarvaiśca taistrimadhvaktairhavanācchriyamāpnuyāt mahiṣīkṣīrasaṃsiktairhomādiṣṭamavāpnuyāt nārikelaphalakṣodakṣīrāktairapi tairhuned nityaśo havanād dugdhakṣaudrasarpiḥ samanvitaiḥ gobhūhiraṇyavāsobhiḥ samṛddho jīvati kṣitau

abdādannasamṛddhiḥ syād ghṛtāktairvā madhuplutaiḥ sampannaśasyāṃ pṛthivīmavāpnoti suniścitam tairiṣṭabhūmṛṇmilitairhavanāttāṃ mahīṃ labhet śriyaṃ sakalakalyāṇanilayāṃ labhate'bdataḥ juhuyādabdamātreṇa labhate gehamuttamam guḍānvitairvā juhuyātśriyā suciramedhate havanāallabhate lakṣmīmabdādatimanoharām taddinairindirāḍhyaḥ syādvidyāhavanavaibhavāt ghṛtakṣīrasitākṣaudraguḍāpūpasamanvitam śālibhistaṇḍulairmudgairmāṣairgauretaraistilaiḥ kṣaudrasarpistilairdugdhakerondekṣurasāplutaiḥ maghādiṣu tathā homaṃ navabhiḥ syānnavasnapi māṣānnaiśca haridrānnairguḍānnaiḥ pāyasairapi tathā mūlādinavake navabhirjuhuyāttathā śālīcaṇakamudgotthairmāṣapiṣṭatilodbhavaiḥ ārogyamāyuḥ saubhāgyaṃ mānyatāṃ ca labhed dhruvam tathāmṛtākhyayogeṣu juhuyādrogaśāntaye uccayogeṣu juhuyādaruṇairutpalairapi parvatākhye hunedyoge yaddravyaistadddhi parvatam athānyamadbhutaṃ homamākarṇaya vadāmi te pāyasairghṛtasiktaistu sitāmiśraistu vidyayā tattatprokteṣu kāleṣu grahārtiḥ syānna tatkule dūrvāmṛtātilairnityaṃ yāvajjīvaṃ sukhī bhavet na tasya kutracitkaścitkadācitkleśasambhavaḥ saurabhāḍhyaiḥ prasūnaiśca pūjayedvāpi taddine

yadi syāttasya rogādipīḍā bhavati niścitam vidyāṃ japetsahasraṃ vā śataṃ vā pūjayecchivām tasmādukteṣu kāleṣu tathā kurvan sukhī bhavet māntrikatvaṃ bhavelloke śokahāsāspadaṃ bhavet havanādabdamātreṇa vāgmī syātkuṇṭhavāgapi maṇḍalāttasya patraiśca samidbhirapi mūlataḥ mūlaiśca lakṣmīsaṃsiddhyai mā tadanvayagā bhavet indirāṃ labhate ramyāṃ sarvalokacamatkṛtām āḍhyaḥ syādaprajāḥ putrānavāpnoti guṇānvitān labheta sarvasasyāḍhyāṃ bhuvaṃ bhoktā ca jāyate śataguḥ sādhakastadvattrimadhvaktairlabhettrayam tagarotthairapi tathā lājaiśca kuṭajairapi ambarāṇi vicitrāṇi mahārhāṇi ca taddinaiḥ kesaraiśca kadambaiśca kundairvicakilairapi juhuyātprathamārambhe pañcamyantaṃ madhuplutaiḥ taireva kṣīramilitairhomātsvarṇamavāpnuyāt prasūnaiḥ karṇikārotthaiḥ kṣaudrāktairhavanāddinaiḥ kahlārai raktakumudairutpalaiḥ kamaladvayaiḥ havanāllabhate lakṣmīṃ sabhūbhūṣaṇavāhanām ketakīkusumaiḥ kṣaudraplutairhomācca taddinaiḥ sitaiḥ prasūnaiḥ kṣīrāktairhomādāpnoti taddinaiḥ hunenmaruvakaiḥ kṣaudraplutairvāñchitasiddhaye yadvarṇāni prasūnāni juhuyādvidyayā priye maricaiḥ sarṣapaistailaplutairhomānniśātu vai pāṭalīkundamandāraśephālikusumodbhavaiḥ

havanādvaśayetsarvavanitāḥ kṣaudrasaṃplutaiḥ te rājyalakṣmīṃ labhate ghṛtāktairhavanānniśi anairghṛtāplutairnityaṃ havanādannavān bhavet madhyarātre tu lavaṇaiḥ suśliṣṭaparicūrṇitaiḥ tathā dadhyanvitairloṇairhomād dveṣyaṃ vaśaṃ nayet ājyaistu kevalairhomād dinairuktairdhanī bhavet snāto'nuliptaḥ sragvī ca sitagandhasragambaraḥ savatsāyāḥ sitāyā goḥ payasi dviguṇe pacet sitadugdhaghṛtopetaṃ kṛtvā vaisikthakaṃ mahat śriyaṃ me devi dehīti proktvā kāṣṭhojjvale'nale maunī tu gamayedabdāt śriyaṃ prāpnoti puṣkalām na kadāpi ramā muñcatyadbhutā mantraśaktayaḥ nivedayecca pūjāyāmabdādāḍhyatamo bhavet taddinānnaṃ tu kahlāraprasūne nikṣipettataḥ kāle tāvaddinairlakṣmīṃ bhūṣā(myā)ḍhyāṃ labhate dhruvam nidhāyādāya maunena hunedagnau bhṛgordine nṛpamānyāṃ sarvahṛdyāṃ nānābhogānvitāṃ śubhām nidhāya vikace padme karṇikāyāṃ tatastu tat karṇikārasya puṣpāṇi tathā campakajānyapi nirātaṅkāmahāryyāṃ ca rājacaurāpahārakaiḥ kevalaṃ navanītena sitopetena homataḥ bandhūkaiḥ kiṃśukaiścūtaistrimadhvaktairhutakriyā dadhyannahomādannāḍhyaḥ sādhakaḥ syāt trimāsataḥ vilikhya navanītena sametaṃ juhuyānniśi tathā palāśaparṇeṣu vilikhya daradairhunet

candanaiḥ pānase patre vilikhya juhuyāttathā hutairavāpnoti nijavāñchitaṃ proktakālataḥ tairhutaistadavāpnoti taddinaistadvidhānataḥ sitairālikhya ca sveṣṭaṃ patre padmasamudbhave nāsādhyamasti bhuvane vidyāhomairudīritaiḥ idānīṃ sthūlahomaṃ tu kathayāmyarimardanam vidhānairdveṣanidhanaroganigrahacāṭanam tadātmakagrahāṇāṃ ca sthitimaṣṭakavargakam anyathā krūrakarmāṇi kurvāṇaṃ nāśayanti hi kuryāt taddevatābhaktimāstikyaṃ vartanaṃ gurum vidadhyādanyathā śakti naiṣphalyaṃ vātmanāśanam sthāne kuryādaniṣṭāni tadvināśāya sādhakaḥ kulīrasiṃhamatha tannir-ṛtyāṃ kanyakā sthitā nakrakumbhāvuttarato mīna īśe tu susthitam kāle tu pañca pañcasyurghaṭikāḥ kramayogataḥ meṣādirāśigo yāti tathānyairgrahamaṇḍalaiḥ mūrddhāṃdicaraṇāntaṃ tu tān dvādaśasu lakṣayet śubhāśubhāni karmāṇi phalantyevaṃ kṛte dhruvam jñātvā vidadhyātputtalyāḥ prayogaṃ sarvatastathā bhrūśaṅkhamūrdhamadhyeṣu tatra bhrūśaṅkhamadhyataḥ savyakaṇṭhe stanataṭe hṛdi nābhau ca guhyake aṅgau sandhau jānuguhye nābhau ceti sitetare viṣanāḍyāṃ viṣasthāne vedhayetkaṇṭhakena tu badarādisamutthairvā tathāyaḥ sārasūcibhiḥ vyādhinā pīḍitaṃ kālādavidheyaṃ bhaved dhruvam

puttalīkaraṇaṃ vakṣye śṛṇu nigrahasiddhaye maṅgalo gurumandārkiguravoṃ'śakarāśipāḥ etāvatyaśca puttalyastvaṃśakakramayogataḥ ṣoḍaśa dvādaśa tathā mānamaṃgulisaṃkhyayā dvitīye navake'nyeṣāmadhyardhāḥ syustrayodaśa candrārkayorekavidhaḥ proktasaṃkhyākramastathā citāmṛdbhasmalavaṇaṃ śuṇṭhīpippalikāyutam gairikaṃ ceti kathitaṃ puttalīdravyamīśvari vairidehajaromādyairupetaiḥ puttalīkriyā śīrṣe trayāt kaṭerūrdhvaṃ trayāt pādadvayaṃ tathā vidhāya tantre sarvatra prayogānācarettataḥ nāśayoge ca dinajamṛtyau krakacayogake raktasthūṇe kaṇṭakākhye sthūṇe pañcārkasaṃjñake nigrahāya nirīkṣyaiva kuryāt siddhimavāpnuyāt vidadhyāt puttalīḥ samyak catasraḥ proktayogataḥ sādhyanakṣatravṛkṣeṇāpyuktalakṣaṇasaṃyutāḥ viṣṭamṛttarujāḥ khātvā sthāpayet sikthamambare evaṃ sādhāraṇaṃ kṛtvā kuryāt karma samīritam vairiyonyasṛjā kṛtvā catvare juhuyāt tathā śmaśāne nirjane deśe vidadhyādabhicārakam tatrābhito nṛpo rakṣāṃ kārayedātmasiddhye svarāṣṭrasandhau kurvīta na kurvīta svamaṇḍale tadrāṣṭraṃ pīḍayantyeva śanakairvairibhūbhṛtaḥ haimīdalarasāktaistu homācchatrūn vināśayet ripurugro'pi rogārtaḥ prayāti yamasādanam

tatpatrāmbuplutairmāsādarātirbhrāntimāpnuyāt vitastimātraisvailāktaihaivanādvairiṇo mṛtiḥ homādarātestīvreṇa jvareṇa syātmṛtirdhruvam arātīnāmathānyonyakalahānnidhanaṃ bhavet vairijanmarkṣavṛkṣāgnau maṇḍalāttanmṛtirjvarāt sarṣapāruskaraghṛtasaṃsiktairjuhuyānniśi raktasraggandhapuṣpāktairhomācchatrūn vināśayet havanādvairiṇo dāhajvaraprāptistribhirdinaiḥ havanāttattarūdbhūtasamidhā havanādapi drumakuḍyanipātena nirghātenāpi khaḍgataḥ yakṣarākṣasagandharvapiśācairbrahmarākṣasaiḥ nimbapatraiśca kārpāsabījaistatkāṣṭhakāṇḍajaiḥ nīcayoge hunedvahnau ripuvṛkṣasamedhite uccāṭitaḥ prayātyeva mantraśaktyābhitāḍitaḥ arāterdantino vāhā rogairnaśyanti niścitam prāguktakaṇṭakādyaistu yadaṅgaṃ vidhayecchanaiḥ ardhapraharake śīrṣe prahare vā śanaiḥ śanaiḥ granthibhirvā kaṇṭakādikṣatavṛddhividāraṇaiḥ gardabhīmehasalile saṃsthāpya kvāthayecchanaiḥ madhūcchiṣṭena tāṃ kṛtvā tāpayenniśi tāṃ śanaiḥ tāṃ tatkaṇṭakaviddhāṅgīṃ khanet pitṛgṛhe niśi prāguktaireva taddravyairaśeṣaiḥ puttalīṃ tathā samiddhe'gnau tatsamidbhistailāktairjuhuyānniśi pralapan śanakairdaihaṃ tyajan yāti yamālayam navamyaṅgāradivase mātṛgehe'grapīṭhake

bhūtādyaiḥ śirasi svīye nirdhātavadalakṣitam piṣṭvā sādhyarkṣavṛkṣasya śakalairapi saṃyutam tadvakṣo'ntarnidhāyārināma tālasya patragat sahasravāraṃ sādhyasya vadharkṣe'ṣṭamarāśige gṛhītvā jīvahastena tāṃ japannikṣipecchucau taddine tāpatṛṣṇādivihvalena jvareṇa saḥ prayāti nidhanaṃ tūrṇaṃ prayogabalataḥ śive vajrīkṣīreṇa vāliptāṃ baddhāṃ prāgvadadhomukhīm juhuyāttatsamidbhistu tatkṣirāktairniśāntarā yadyasti tasya rakṣecchā tāṃ taḍāgodare khanet tathā yadi na kurvīta ciraṃ rogātmako bhavet caṇḍikāyatane khātvā tadyoniṃ purato balim svagehe culyadhaḥ khātvā taduparyagnivardhanāt tāṃ tathā kḷptarūpāṃ tu rurujaṅghāsthisaṃyutām rāśau tadaṣṭame māsātprayātyuccāṭito'nyataḥ biḍālamūṣikācarmanaddhaṃ sādhyākhyayā yutam mātṛgehe nadīpūrtyāṃ vidveṣaḥ syāddvayoḥ sadā tadvidyājapasiddhāstāḥ khanedarigṛhe punaḥ evaṃ nikaṭavartīnāmabhicāra udīritaḥ vadāmi te śṛṇu prājñe sudūrasthasya vairiṇaḥ yenārirnikaṭasthāttu prāgeva nidhānaṃ vrajet tāḥ prāgvadiritakṣīradvayāsiktāḥ sasaṃjñakāḥ ekamekāṃ hunerdvairidiṅmukhastā aśeṣataḥ kathaṃ vā māntrikabalī nihantuṃ śakyatāṃ vrajet tairmāntrikaistasya pūrvaṃ vidveṣaṃ kārayettataḥ

bhāgyādikaṃ mahārakṣākaraṃ māntrikasaṃgatam tanme kathaya deveśa yadyupāyastu vidyate abhicāramarātīnāmāśu nāśakaraṃ param tairavicchinnarūpaṃ tu homayedyāmadikkramāt arātinidhanaṃ kuryādevamuktavidhānataḥ puṣpaṃ samagraṃ juhuyātkamalaṃ cāpi puṣkalam śatasaṃkhyā rājikāḥ syustilāśca śatasaṃkhyayā (cullakārdhaṃ dadhikṣīramannaṃ grāsamitaṃ bhavet manaḥ priyaiśca khaṇḍaiśca phalaṃ bhavati niścayāt) nārikelasya khaṇḍaṃ hi sthūlaṃ kuryānmanaḥ priyam drākṣāphalaṃ samagraṃ syānnāraṅgaṃ khārjūraṃ tathā guñjāsamaṃ tu karpūraṃ kastūrī ghusṛṇaṃ tathā manaḥ priyāhutīḥ kṛtvā homaṃ kuryātsulocane yathecchayā varārohe śrīvidyāṃ paritoṣayet (uktāni pañcagavyāni tatsamāni manīṣibhiḥ dadhi prasṛtimātraṃ syāllājāḥ syurmuṣṭisammitāḥ guḍaḥ palārdhamānaḥ syāccharkarāpi tathā matā ekaikaṃ patrapuṣpāṇi tathāpūpāni kalpayet mātuliṅgaṃ catuḥkhaṇḍaṃ panasaṃ daśadhākṛtam vidhākṛtaṃ bilvaphalaṃ kapitthaṃ khaṇḍitaṃ tridhā phalānyanyānyakhaṇḍāni samidhaḥ syurdaśāṃgulāḥ brīhayo muṣṭimātrāḥ syurmudgā māṣā yavā api godhūmā raktakamalā vihitā muṣṭimānataḥ śuktipramāṇaṃ lavaṇaṃ maricānyapi triṃśatiḥ candanāgurukarpūrakastūrīkuṃkumāni ca

dvau śāṇau ghaṭakaḥ kolo badaraṃ drakṣaṇaśca saḥ picubiṃḍālapadakaṃ tinduko'kṣaśca taddvayam kandānāmaṣṭamaṃ bhāgaṃ latānāmaṃguladvayam viśīrṇā dvidalā hrasvā vakrāḥ sthūlāḥ kṛśā dvidhā viśīrṇāyuḥkṣayaṃ kuryād dvidalā vyādhisambhavam sthūlābhiharate lakṣmīṃ kṛśāyāṃ jāyate kṣayaḥ dveṣaṃ prakurute dīrghā prāṇaghnyo nistvacaḥ smṛtāḥ ārdratvacā samacchedā tarjanyaṃgulivartulā śrote smārte ca tantrokte samidhaḥ parikīrtitāḥ avakrāścāpyaśuṣkāśca satvaco nirvraṇāḥ samāḥ prādeśamātrā vālābhe hotavyāḥ sakalā api bāhyamadhyagataṃ vāpi madhyaṃ vā cakramarcayet tadagre saṃsthito mantrī tato'nantaphalaṃ labhet japārambhaṃ sudhīḥ kuryānmahāpātakahā bhavet nigadaḥ parameśāni spaṣṭaṃvācā nigadyate mānasastu varārohe cintanāntararūpavān upāṃśūcāritaikena tulaṃ bhavati śailaje mānasoccāraṇāttulyamekena parameśvari lakṣamātraṃ japedyastu sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate mahāpātakamukhyāni nāśayennātra saṃśayaḥ mahāpātakakoṭīstu nāśayennātra saṃśayaḥ kubera iva deveśi pañcalakṣānna saṃśayaḥ saptalakṣajapānmantrī khecarīmelako bhavet aṇimādyaṣṭasiddhināṃ nāyako bhavati priye navalakṣapramāṇaṃ hi japettripurasundarīm

sarvairvandyaḥ sadā svasthaḥ sarvasaubhāgyavān bhavet bhavabandhaṃ nāśayantī saṃsmṛtā pāpahāriṇī duḥkhadaurbhāgyadāridryabhayaghnī pūjitā bhavet pṛthagbījatrayasyāhaṃ sādhanaṃ kathayāmi te muktāphalasphuradbhūṣābhūṣaṇaḥ śubhramālyadhṛk pūjayet śubhakusumairnaivedyamapi cojjvalam ghṛtagolakasampannanānāśubhrānnapūritam manaḥ saṃkalpaśuddho vā sādhayenmokṣavāṅmayam karpūradhavalāṃ śubhrapuṣpābharaṇabhūṣitām muktāphalāmalamaṇijapamālālasatkarām evaṃ dhyāyenmaheśāni sarvavidyādharo bhavet tasmājjyotirmayīṃ dhyāyejjihvāgre'mṛtarūpiṇīm atha kāmakalāsaktaḥ sādhakaḥ parameśvari raktavastrāvṛtaḥ samyaṅmadhye kāmakalātmakam mūlādibrahmarandhrāntāṃ sphuraddīpasvarūpiṇīm ikṣukodaṇḍapuṣpeṣuvarābhayalasatkarām cintayet parameśāni trailokyaṃ mohayet kṣaṇāt kandarpa iva deveśi yoṣitāṃ mānahārakaḥ calajjalendusaṅkāśāṃ taruṇāruṇavigrahām kiṃ punarmānuṣīṃ devi trailokyamapi mohayet ākarṣayettadā śīghraṃ rambhāṃ vāpi tilottamām tasyā mūrdhni smared bījaṃ sravatpīyūṣavarṣiṇīm kṣaṇamātreṇa deveśi trailokyaṃ vaśamānayet mohayanti jagatsarvaṃ prayogaṃ śṛṇu pārvati vidarbhyādyena kāmena manmathāntargataṃ kuru

makaradhvajasaṃjñaṃ tu sarvametadvarānane trailokyamohano nāma prayogo'yam prakīrtitaḥ sṛṣṭisaṃhāraparyantaṃ śarīraṃ cintayet param hemaprabhābhāsamānāṃ vidyunnikarasuprabhām jñānamudrāṃ ca dadhatīṃ sākṣādamṛtarūpiṇīm tasya saṃsmaraṇād devi nīlakaṇṭhatvamāgataḥ vainateyasamo mantrī viṣabhārasahasranut cāturthikajvarān sarvānapasmārāṃśca nāśayet cintitā sādhakasyāśu trailokyavaśakāriṇī padmarāgamaṇisvacchā cintitā suravandite tannāma saṃsmaran mantrī yoginīnāṃ bhavet priyaḥ putravān devadeveśi mantrī dhyānānna saṃśayaḥ catuṣṣaṣṭiryataḥ koṭyo yoginīnāṃ mahaujasām ādau sambodhanapadaṃ madhye bījāṣṭakaṃ bahiḥ pāśāṅkuśadhanurbāṇairmādanairmohayet priye tathaiva śaktibandhaiśca śastraistanmayavigrahaḥ etāmārādhya deveśi kāmyasaubhāgyasundaraḥ trailokyamohano bhūtvā sthitikartābhavat sadā candrasūryau varārohe sṛṣṭisaṃhārakārakau yasya vijñānamātreṇa kartā hartā sadāśivaḥ pūjyate tatra sakalaṃ vaśīkuryānna saṃśayaḥ yoṣitaḥ sakalāḥ vaśyā jvalatkāmāgnipīḍitāḥ taddarśanena deveśi jāyante sarvayoṣitaḥ atīva sundaraṃ ramyaṃ tanmadhye pratimāṃ varām adṛṣṭapūrvā deveśi śrutamātrāpi durlabhā

āyāti sādhakaṃ samyaṅmantramūḍhā satī priye udyatsūryasahasrābhamātmānamaruṇaṃ tathā anena kramayogena svayaṃ kandarparūpavān sarvaraktopacāraiśca mudrāsahita (sannaddha) vigrahaḥ sa bhaved dāsavad devi dhanāḍhyo vāpi bhūpatiḥ adṛṣṭāyā maheśāni yonimudrādharo budhaḥ nāgakanyāmapsarasaṃ khecarīṃ vā surāṅganām madanodbhavasantāpasphurajjaghanamaṇḍalām mahākāmakalādhyānayogāttu suravandite atha bhāgadvayaṃ devi candanaṃ mardayet samam aṣṭottaraśatāvṛttyā mantrayitvā vaśaṃ nayet mantriṇā parameśāni tatsarva tasya vaśyagam dugdhaṃ ghṛtaṃ cūrṇamātraṃ vastraṃ karpūrameva ca phalaṃ vā vastu yadyat tu sakalaṃ parameśvari sa vaśyo jāyate devi nātra kāryā vicāraṇā haṭhākarṣaṇametat te kathitaṃ nānyathā bhavet cāruśṛṅgāraveṣāḍhyāṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitām tadbhālakaṇṭhahṛnnābhi tattanmaṇḍala(janmabhūmiṣu)yojitam sarvasandhiṣu dehasya madanākṣaramālikhet tadāśābhimukhī bhūtvā svayaṃ devīsvarūpakaḥ niyojya madanāgāre candrasūryakalātmake ananyamanasaṃ premabhramamāṇāṃ madālasām bhūjapatre svarṇapatre raupyapatre'tha tāmraje tathaiva mātṛkāyuktāṃ svamājñā cakramaṇḍitām aenaiva vidhānena rocanāgurukuṅkumaiḥ

vidarbhitaṃ svanāmnā tu yasmin kasminnapi sthitam vaśīkuryānmaheśāni pādākrāntaṃ na saṃśayaḥ ekamevamavaṣṭabhya sādhyanāmākṣarāṇi hi hemamadhyagataṃ kuryācchikhāyāṃ vāmake bhuje rājendramapi deveśi dāsabhūtaṃ karoti hi vyāghrāḥ kesariṇī matā vaśyāstasya bhavanti hi madhye catuṣpathe vāpi caturdikṣu nidhāpayet tathaiva sarvaduṣṭānāṃ purasthānāṃ ca jāyate jvalantīṃ sarvarājendramaṇḍitāṃ sāgarāmbarām kaṭākṣakṣepamātreṇa nāyastasya vaśāḥ priye dṛṣṭyākarṣayate devi trailokyaṃ sacarācaram bhūtapretapiśācāṃśca jvarāṃścāturthikādikān etat sindūrasubhagaṃ rātrau sampūjitaṃ priye yadā dikṣu vidikṣvevaṃ samyag devi prapūjyate vaśamānayate śīghraṃ saputrapaśubāndhavān tanmadhye nagaraṃ deśaṃ maṇḍalaṃ khaṇḍameva ca bhūmimadhyagataṃ kṛtvā trailokyaṃ vaśamānayet yatra kutra sthitaṃ bhadre kṣobhayennagaraṃ mahat rocanākuṃkumaiścaiva lākṣālaktakasaṃyutam cakrametatsamālikhya yasya namnā maheśvari cauragrahajalāriṣṭaṃ śākinīḍākinībhavam nityaṃ samarcayed devi kālamṛtyuṃ vināśayet adhastānnāmasaṃyuktāṃ rocanākuṃkumānvitam pītadravyaiḥ samālikhya pītapuṣpaiḥ samarcayet sahasravadano devi mūko bhavati tatkṣaṇāt

jāyate devadeveśi mahānīlīrasena tu vahnau dagdhvā maheśāni mārayedvairiṇaṃ priye gomūtreṇa ca saṃlikhya nāma sandarbhya pūrvavat kṛtvā rocanayā nāma kākapakṣasya madhyagam) mahānīlīrocanābhyāṃ dugdhalākṣārasādibhiḥ anenaiva vidhānena sthāpayettīramadhyagam saubhāgyaṃ jāyate tena pānīyena na saṃśayaḥ saptāhātkṣobhayet satyaṃ jvalamānaṃ vicintayet śivāṃ sampūjayed devi sugandhaiḥ kusumaiḥ priye śamīdūrvāṃkurāśvatthapallavairathavārkajaiḥ pūrvāśābhimukho bhūtvā pītadravyaiḥ samarcayet uttarābhimukho bhūtvā candanena samālikhet paścimābhimukho bhūtvā candanena samālikhet vallabho jāyate tāsāṃ dāsīmiva vaśaṃ nayet yasya nāmāṅkitaṃ tatra mantrahāniḥ prajāyate pūrvavat parameśāni krameṇa paritoṣitam rocanālikhitaṃ cakraṃ kṣīramadhye ksipedbudhaḥ gomūtramadhyagaṃ samyak śatrūccāṭakaraṃ param jvalajjavalanamadhyasthaṃ śatrunāśakaraṃ bhavet sarvabāhyata ārabhya yāvanmadhyaṃ maheśvari pūjayedrātrisamaye kulācārakrameṇa tu girāvekatarastadvadarcayet kulamārgataḥ śmaśāne pūjayeccakraṃ mahābhūtadine tu yaḥ khaḍgasiddhiṃ ca vetālasiddhiṃ ca guṭikāṃ labhet samahāvīrasiddhiṃ tu yakṣiṇīceṭakodbhavām

saptadaśaḥ svāsaḥ pādukāsanaviṇmūtramaithunāni vivarjayet siddhaṃ siddhādhivāsāṃśca śrīpūrvaṃ samudīrayet) virūpāṃ muktakeśīṃ ca kāmārtāṃ ca na nindayet nālokayet paradravyaṃ paradārāṃśca varjayet ) naiva prasārayet pādau naitānapi ca laṅghayet asūyāmātmasammānaṃ paranindāṃ ca varjayet purāṇāgamaśāstrāṇi kalpāṃścāpi na dūṣayet śūrpaṃ sammārjanīṃ daṇḍaṃ dhvajaṃ vaiḍūryamāyudham bhogayogyāni cānyāni yāgadravyāṇi yāni ca divyoktāni padārthāni bhūtāviṣṭāni yāni vai yā goṣṭhīrlokavidviṣṭā yā ca svairavisarpiṇī pratigrahaṃ na gṛhṇīyādātmabhogavidhitsayā dhārayedārjavaṃ satyaṃ sauśīlyaṃ samatāṃ ghṛtim stambhadīpamanuṣyāṇāmanyeṣāṃ prāṇināṃ tathā etatsparśa tyajed dūre kharaśvājarajastathā saṃspṛśedyadi mūḍhātmā śriyaṃ hanti harerapi na guruṃ sādhakaṃ caiva liṅgacchāyāṃ na laṅghayet sambhave navavastraśca malayūkāvivarjitaḥ vṛthā cchinatti yaḥ keśāṃstamāhurbrahmaghātakam kacānāṃ vapanaṃ kuryād vṛthā na vikaco bhavet prayoktavyaḥ svamantraśca āpadyapi na cācaret kṛpayā parayā kuryādanātheṣu asaṃsadi bhāvayeddaivataṃ viṣṇuṃ guruṃ vipraśarīragam jñeyo viśvāśrayo viṣṇurātmā jñeyaśca viṣṇuvat

tatra tatra na vastavyaṃ prayāyātsaṃsmaran harim nāpi taiḥ saha vaktavyaṃ vastavvaṃ vā kadācana na nindyā brāhmaṇā devā viṣṇurdhenustathaiva ca gururvā vaiṣṇavaścāpi puruṣaḥ pūrvadīkṣitaḥ na tena mantro vaktavyo mudrā vā samayā api mantraguptiśca kartavyā satataṃ mantrasiddhaye pañcejyā tīrthasevā ca svādhyāyo gurusevanam brahmacārī dīkṣitaścet trisandhyaṃ devamarcayet bhaikṣyaṃ samprārthayet sākṣād dhyāyed devaṃ nirantaram na japo nārcanaṃ naiva dhyānaṃ nāpi vidhikramaḥ sannyāsināṃ mumukṣūṇāṃ mānasaḥ kathitaḥ kramaḥ ubhau tau narake ghore pacyedābhūtasamplavam dayā dānaṃ mahārhaṃ ca yena devaḥ prasīdati varṇināṃ ca vanasthānāṃ ko vadedanapekṣitam sarvabhūtahite yuktaḥ samayācārapālakaḥ mantrāṇāṃ sādhanadvāre śivabhāvanatatparaḥ anyamantrārcana śraddhāmanyamantraprapūjanam strīṣu roṣaṃ prahāraṃ ca varjayedbhaktimān sadā strīṣu dveṣo na kartavyo viśeṣāta pūjanaṃ striyāḥ peyaṃ carvya tathā coṣyaṃ bhakṣyaṃ lehyaṃ tathā sukham kulajāṃ yuvatīṃ vīkṣya namaskuryāt samāhitaḥ kutsitāṃ vā mahāduṣṭāṃ namaskṛtyā vibhāvayet kumārīpūjanād devi sarvasiddhiḥ prajāyate kṛtārthastena jāyeta svargo vā mokṣa eva vā vismitā vilayaṃ yānti paśavaḥ śāstramohitāḥ

viśuddhacittastatsiddhiṃ labhate cāpavargajām bhairavī yadi sañjātaḥ siddhistatra na saṃśayaḥ devyai niveditaṃ yadyattat sarvaṃ bhakṣayennaraḥ naivedyanindakaṃ dṛṣṭvā nṛtyante yoginīgaṇāḥ svaprītyai āhṛtaṃ māṃsaṃ rauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajed balidānaṃ vinā devyā hiṃsā sarvatra varjayet māmanādṛtya puṇyaṃ ca pāpaṃ syāt pratyavāyataḥ yairevāpyāyanaṃ dravyaiḥ siddhistaireva coditā kiṃ na paśyati loko'yaṃ brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarān pañcamudrā niṣeveta cānyathā narakaṃ vrajet tadaṅgaromasaṃkhyābhirjāyante bhūtayoniṣu dūṣakaiḥ samayabhraṣṭairna kuryād dravyasaṃgatim paśubhikṣudrakarmasthairna kuryād dravyasaṅgatim kulopadeśahīnaiśca na kuryād dravyasaṅgatim padavākyapramāṇajñāḥ śrutismṛtyarthavedinaḥ svakule'pi prasūtā ye vṛddhācārapravartinaḥ strīputramitrabandhūnāṃ snigdhānāmapi pārvati adṛṣṭapuruṣāṇāṃ ca deśāntaranivāsinām kulīnaṃ nāvamanyeta pūjayet taṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ svapātrasthitaśeṣaṃ ca na dadyādbhairavāya ca āsanaṃ bhojanaṃ pātramupānacchayanāni ca kulapūjāntarāyaṃ tu yaḥ karoti hi durmatiḥ tasmāt sarva prayatnena kulapūjārato bhavet ārādhanāsamarthaścet dadyādarcanasādhanam samyak śatakratūn kṛtvā yatphalaṃ samavāpnuyāt

dattvā ṣoḍaśadānāni yatphalaṃ labhate naraḥ sārdhatrikoṭitīrṣeṣu snātvā yatphalamāpnuyāt bahunoktena kiṃ devi yathāśaktyā dadāti yaḥ yathaivāntaścarā rājñaḥ priyāḥ syurna bahiścarāḥ samarpayanti te bhaktyā tvāvābhyāṃ piśitāsavam anadhītopyaśāstrajño gurubhakto dṛḍhavrataḥ yadi bhāgyavaśād devi kuladṛṣṭiḥ prajāyate bhagadantāṃ bhagākṣīṃ ca bhagakarṇāṃ bhagatvacām sampūjya tābhyo gandhādyairmānasairgurumeva ca bālāṃ vā yauvanonmatāṃ vṛddhā vā sundarīṃ tathā tāsāṃ prahāraṃ nindāṃ ca kauṭilyamapriyaṃ tathā striyo devāḥ striyaḥ prāṇāḥ striyaścaiva vibhūṣaṇam japasthāne mahāśaṅkhaṃ niveśyordhva japaṃ caret bhakṣaṃstāmbūlamanyāni bhakṣyadravyaṃ yathāruci na jape kālaniyamo caryādiṣu baliṣvapi bhairavī cchinnamastā ca vidyā dhūmāvatī matā etā eva mahāvidyā daśa vidyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ navā prayāsabāhulyaṃ samayāsamayādikam śuddhiṃ na cācaredatra nirvikalpamanāścaret yācayedamṛtaṃ kaulaṃ tadabhāve kulaṃ bhavet namaskṛtya ca gṛhṇīyādanyathā narakaṃ vrajet gamayed devatāpūjājapayāgastavādinā sarvadeśe sarvapīṭhe kartavyo nātra saṃśayaḥ śaktirindro raviḥ śaktiḥ śaktiścandro grahā druvaḥ pūjanaṃ mānasaṃ divyaṃ mānasaṃ tarpaṇādikam

na viśeṣo divā rātrau na sandhyāyāṃ divāniśam mahāniśi śucau deśe baliṃ mantreṇa dāpayet taddine sarvathā kāryā śāsanānmama suvrate sā mahārātriruddiṣṭā tadgataṃ cākṣayaṃ bhavet tadā vādī svasiddhāntahataḥ kṣititalaṃ vrajet kavitāṃ labhate so'pi amṛtatvaṃ ca gacchati cāmaraṃ ravibimbaṃ ca tilapuṣpaṃ saroruham mukhaprasādaṃ sumukhaṃ sulocanaṃ suhāsyakam labhate ca yathāsaṃkhyaṃ śṛṇu pārvati sādaram śūnyāgāre nadītīre niḥśaṅko viharet sadā taddrūmodbhavapuṣpeṇa pūjayedbhaktibhāvataḥ brahmatarormahāpadme devīṃ dhyātvā yathāvidhiḥ mahācīnadrumalatāveṣṭitaḥ sādhakottamaḥ tithikrameṇa saṃkhyābhirlatābhirveṣṭito yadi aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ dviguṇaṃ yadi dṛśyate yena hīnā na sidhyanti janmakoṭisahasraśaḥ tadā caret tu sarvatra vaiṣṇavācāratatparaḥ parvate vipine vāpi nirjane śūnyamaṇḍape kṣaṇaṃ dhyātvā manuṃ japtvā natvā gacchedyathāsukham kṣemaṅkarīṃ tathā vīkṣya jambukīṃ yamadūtikām kṛśodari mahācaṇḍe muktakeśi balipriye śmaśānaṃ ca śivaṃ dṛṣṭvā pradakṣiṇamanuvrajan ghoradaṃṣṭre karālāsye phiṭiśabdapraṇādini bhāgyodayasamutpanne namaste varavarṇini hastyaśvarathaśastrāṇi phalakān vīrapūruṣān

praṇamya jayadurgāṃ vā sarvavighnairna lipyate bhaktebhyo varade devi mahiṣaghni namo'stu te dṛṣṭvā ca bhairavīṃ devīṃ praṇamedvimṛśan manum namāmi varade devi muṇḍamālāvibhūṣite sarvavighnaharaṃ devi namaste haravallabhe śaktimantraṃ puraskṛtya tasya siddhirna jāyate yoginīpūjanaṃ tatra pradhānaṃ kulapūjanam tathā kulatithau durgā pūjitā varadāyinī bhaumaśukrau kulākhyau tu budhavāraḥ kulākulaḥ viṣamāścākulāḥ sarvāḥ śeṣāśca tithayaḥ kulāḥ kulāni samayugmāni śeṣamānyakulāni ca kulākhye jayino nityaṃ sāmyaṃ caiva kulākule māṃsapradhānaṃ naivedyaṃ sandhyākāle nivedayet paśurūpadharāyāti parivāragaṇaiḥ saha tadaiva maṅgalaṃ tasya nānyathā kulabhūṣaṇam nityaśrāddhaṃ tathā sandhyāvandanaṃ pitṛtarpaṇam paśurūpāṃ śivāṃ devīṃ yo nārcayati nirjane japapūjāvidhānāni yatkiñcit sukṛtāni ca ekayā bhujyate yatra śivayā deva bhairava paśuśaktiḥ pakṣiśaktirnavaśaktiryathākramāt tena sarvaprayatnena kartavyaṃ pūjanaṃ mahat śubhāśubhāni karmāṇi vicintya balimāharet śubhāśubhaphalaṃ vyaktaṃ brūhi gṛhṇa baliṃ tava yadi na bhujyate vatsa tadā naiva śubhaṃ bhavet evaṃ jñātvā mahādeva śāntisvastyayanaṃ caret

kiṃvā pakṣipataṅgādidarśane naiva kārayet niśchidramaṇḍape vāpi kartavyaṃ naca sannidhau kulaṃ kulapatiṃ caiva kulamālāṃ kulākulam prakāśāt kāryahāniḥ syāt prakāśānnidhanādikam prakāśānmṛtyulābhaḥ syānna prakāśyaṃ kadācana darśayedvaiṣṇavīṃ mudrāṃ viṣṇunyāsaṃ tathā stavam gopanādyadi vyaktiḥ syānna guptirabhidhīyate varaṃ pūjā na kartavyā vyaktirnaiva kadācana chāgalaṃparasenyasya stambhanāya viśeṣataḥ paravādimukhastambhe māhiṣaṃ śasyate palam śaśotthaṃ vaśyakarmādāvāvikaṃ kṛṣṭikārakam uccāṭe coṣṭrajaṃ śastaṃ kharotthaṃ prītināśanam āyuḥ kīrtidhanārogyaputraśrījayakāntidam mahāmāṃsāṣṭakamidaṃ devatāprītikārakam sarvamāṃsa surāyuktaṃ dadyād devyai viśeṣataḥ tasyānuṣṭhānamātreṇa svayaṃ brahmatvamāpnuyāt tatsāraṃ tu samālokya tathānyanmantrasaṃgraham na kasyāpi varārohe proktavāṃstridaśeṣvapi na tasya punarāvṛttiḥ kalpakoṭiśatairapi brahmaviṣṇumaheśādyāstathānye pitṛdevatāḥ vidhivat sukṛtī kṛtvā dūtīyāgaṃ tu pārvati yeṣāṃ vaṃśe prajāyeta dūtīyāgo maheśvari kāyena manasā vācā sarvathā na prakāśayet kuryāt prayatnataścaiva dūtikāyajanaṃ priye sarvatīrthamayaḥ proktaḥ sarvadevamayo bhavet

aśvamedhasahasrāṇi vājapeyaśatāni ca merumandaratulyāni suvarṇānyarpitāni vai tasmāt sarvaprayatnena dūtīyāgaṃ samācaret yadanuṣṭhānamātreṇa sarvamācaritaṃ bhavet atha dūtīṃ pravakṣyāmi lakṣaṇāni ca sundari paṭvī suśīlā priyavāg guruśuśrūṣaṇe ratā rūpayauvanasampannā niścalā mantratatparā nātikubjā ca hrasvā ca cārusarvāṅgasaṃyutā pūrṇagaṇḍakapolā ca raktoṣṭhī ca sudantikā subāhuvallīsaṃyuktā vṛttapīnapayodharā saralāṃgulikāyuktā sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutā pūjanīyā prayatne pañcaviṃśativārṣikā pūjitāścedvarārohe tarpaṇaṃ niṣphalaṃ bhavet tā yadā rajasā yuktāstataḥ pūjyā mahāphalāḥ tatra dveṣaparo mūrkho dāridryaṃ samavāpnuyāt tāmbūlāpūritamukho dhūpāmodasugandhitaḥ raktavastraparīdhāno lākṣāraktagṛhaṃ gataḥ pañcīkaraṇasaṃketaiḥ pūjayet kulanāyikām rajakī rañjakī caiva sairandhrī ca suvāsinī viśeṣavaidagdhyayutāḥ sarvā eva kulāṅganāḥ saṃgopanaratāḥ prāyastaruṇyaḥ sarvasiddhidāḥ sadāparigṛhītāṃ vā yadvā saṅketamāgatām viliptāṃ raktagandhena raktāmbaravibhūṣitām sadānuṣṭhānaniratāṃ sāttvikīṃ bhaktisaṃyutām cāturyaudāryadākṣiṇyakaraṇādiguṇādhikām
