sudhūpadhūpitāṃ tanvīṃ dūtīkarmasu yojayed brāhmaṇī śūdrakanyā ca tathā gopālakanyakā evaṃ bhūtāṃ yajettāṃ tu prasūnatūlikopari liṅgayonirato mantrī rauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajet svaśaktyā ayutaṃ puṇyaṃ paraśaktiprapūjane rajakyāḥ kṣurikī śreṣṭhā kṣurikyāścarmakāriṇī tato'dhikāntyasambhūtā caṇḍālī ca tato'dhikā pukkasyā akṣatā śreṣṭhā tato'tisundarī smṛtā tatparā parameśāni tanmanāḥ śubhalakṣaṇā vidagdhā tvaprasūtā ca dhairyasvātantryasaṃyutā ātmīyāśca parāścaiva śaktimātrraṃ maheśvari vividhaiḥ phalatāmbūlairvastrālaṅkārahemabhiḥ sambhogavāsanāṃ dhṛtvā yaḥ kuryācchaktipūjanam paramānandarūpeṇa deha bhāvavivarjitaḥ tadājñā tu prakartavyā tadā śreyaḥ pravartate kṛte tatropahāsādi kuṣṭhī bhavati nānyathā vyaṅgā vā vikṛtāṅgī ca kāṇākṣī badhirā tathā adīkṣitā bhaktihīnā gurusevāvivarjitā vṛddhāturā vakramukhī krodhadurgandhakaśmalā dīrghadantā ca lamboṣṭhī śuṣkastananitambini mahāsthūlātirogārtā pralambitapayodharā kaniṣṭhā kroḍadantā ca sadā svārthasamanvitā śvetāṃṅginī raudrabimbā cchāgayoniḥ piśācikā etallakṣaṇasampannāḥ śaktīryatnena varjayet ajñānāllobhato mohād datte pūjā tu niṣphalā

mātaṅgīpūjanaṃ tatra kathaṃ muktipradāyakam rajasvalā ca mātaṅgī sā dūtī sarvamaṅgalā tava vākyamabhūt brahmannetadvada pitāmaha asmin sarvajña kalpo'sau mātaṅgī munipuṅgavaḥ tena prītā mahādevī devānāṃ hitakāriṇī tacchrutvā dvijavaryastāṃ yayāce dharmasādhanam apatyatāṃ samāsādya matkulālambanaṃ kuru śyāmalāṃ cāruvadanāṃ vīṇāśukasamanvitām dhārayantīṃ viśālākṣīṃ śaṅkhatāṭaṅkaśobhinīm mātaṅgīti tadā devī vikhyātā varadāyanī tripurājjetukāmena yonipūjā tadā kṛtā yadā dṛṣṭarajā bhūtvā tāṃ vavre śaṅkaraḥ priyām praṇavena tadā śambhustayā sārdhaṃ rataṃ bhajan sarvasaubhāgyajananaṃ mālāmantramabhūt tadā mātaṅgīmantramatyarthaṃ manmathapratipādakam mātaṅgīcāntyavarṇasthā tadāsā antyajābhavat sā devī sarvavarṇānāṃ varaṃ dattvā niruttaram na doṣaḥ sarvavarṇānāmiti dattvā varaṃ tadā devīmuddiśya mokṣārthaṃ kṛtaṃ yad doṣavarjitam antaryāgamidaṃ jñeyaṃ bahiryāgaṃ ca vaidikam cakrasaṅketasamayaṃ sarvaṃ tubhyam prakāśitam tyaja śaṅkāṃ mahābhāga satyametanmayoditam yonipūjāṃ vinā pūjā kṛtāpi hyakṛtā bhavet āyurārogyavibhavānamitāṃllabhate naraḥ putrārthī labhate putraṃ dhanārthī labhate dhanam

mātaṅgīmanmathopetā sarvakāmārthasiddhaye sā devī śaktihīnā tu na dadāti manoratham kaulikānvayasambhūtāṃ dīkṣitāṃ krodhavarjitām triṃśatsaṃvatsarādhaḥsthāṃ ṣoḍaśābdādhikāmapi yonimadhyagatāṃ devīṃ kālarātrimanusmaret sakṛjjapena saṃsiddhirdvistrirvā nātra saṃśayaḥ athavā gṛhiṇī pūjyā pūtā puṣpavatīṣṭadā tāsāṃ bhojyaṃ prakartavyamiti śāstrasya niścayaḥ dūtyaśca bhaginī putrī pautrī naptrī tathā snuṣā arcane prathitā veśyā mantrayuktā manoharā rajasvalā yadā cāsīt sarvotkṛṣṭā iti smṛtā bhayalajjādisarvāṇi parityajyātha dūtikām ācāryānucarī raktā manasā sukhadāyinī cumbanāliṅgane caiva nakhadantakṣatāni ca dūtī yasya susaṃjñātā saphalaṃ tasya jīvitam sarvadā sukhamāpnoti sarvaiśvaryaṃ ca labhyate cumbane paramaiśvaryaṃ nakhadantakṣatairyaśaḥ na dadyāccumbanaṃ yastu daridro jāyate dhruvam vinā dantakṣataṃ devi loke bhavati ninditaḥ dvitīyena ca lakṣmīḥ syāt tṛtīye pārvatī bhavet āliṅganairharedrogān dhanadhānyādi cumbanaiḥ sāyujyaṃ saṅgamena syāt satyameva na saṃśayaḥ surūpāṃ ca suveśāṃ ca taruṇīṃ sundarīṃ tathā udāravaṃśasambhūtāṃ pūjāgrahaṇaharṣitām tatkāle kāryasiddhiḥ syānnātra kāryā vicāraṇā

surūpāṃ taruṇīṃ veśyāṃ yonipūjāṃ samācaret surūpāṃ taruṇīṃ dāsīṃ yonipūjāṃ samācaret mātaṅginyāḥ surūpāyāḥ suguṇāyāstathaiva ca yasyā aṅge devatāsti tasyā yoniṃ prapūjayet surūpāyastaruṇyāśca yoginyā yonipūjane madaghūrṇitanetrāyāstaruṇyā yonipūjane vidhavāyāḥ surūpāyāstaruṇyā yonipūjane paraṃ tu nirbhayo bhūtvā sarvametat samācaret tasyāstu pūjane sarvakāryasiddhirbhaved dhruvam bhagamālinimantreṇa kuryāt prārthanāpūrvakam ṣoḍaśairupacāraistu pūjā sarvatra śasyate vaśyākarṣaṇakārmāṇi manasā yadyadīpsitam aspṛśyāyāstaruṇyāstu pūjā dveṣārthamīritā tāṃstān prayogān kurvīta kāryasiddhirbhaved dhruvam meghākarṣe bhayāvāptau sarvaśatrunivarhaṇe brahmarandhrasphuradbhinnamuktālekhāvirājitām viśuddhamuktāvajrāḍhyacandralekhākirīṭinīm sūrya bhāsvanmahāratnakuṇḍalālaṃkṛtāṃ parām graiveyāṅgadapratrālīsphuratkāntivirājitām śrīkhaṇḍavallīsadṛśabāhuballīvirājitām pravālalatikākārapāṇipallavaśobhitām raktotpaladalākārapādapallavaśobhitām vāmena pāṇinaikena pustakaṃ cāpareṇatu akṣamālāṃ ca varadaṃ dakṣapāṇidvayena tu kṣīrakundendudhavalāṃ prasannāṃ saṃsmaret priye

dhyātvā tatra parāṃ parāparakalāṃ tanmadhyagāṃ cintayet uttamaṃ rajobījāni madhyamaṃ kevalaṃ rajaḥ vidhāya mātṛkānyāsaṃ kulāṅge'pi pravinyaset balādvā yatnato vāpi abhiṣekaṃ samācaret namaḥ śabdaṃ samuccārya imāṃ śaktiṃ tato vadet vahnijāyāṃ samucārya śuddhimantraḥ sureśvari trikoṇeṣu ca sampūjya vasantaṃ madanaṃ priye durgāṃ bhruvostathā lakṣmīṃ rasanāyāṃ sarasvatīm pādāntaṃ pūjayet sarvāḥ kalā vai kāmasomayoḥ manoharā manorāmā madanonmādinī tathā rañjanī caiva deveśi ṣoḍaśī priyadarśanā tataḥ somakalāḥ pūjyāḥ śivādyāścaraṇāvadhi śuddhiḥ saumyā marīciśca śailajā aṃśumālinī tathā tuṣṭyamṛte caiva kalāḥ somasya ṣoḍaśa athaivaṃ ca vidhānena ṣoḍaśairupacārakaiḥ arcayedgandhapuṣpādyaiḥ svaśivaṃ tadanantaram yajettatpuruṣāghorasadyovāmeśasaṃjñakaiḥ vajreśvarīṃ kālikāṃ ca tathā dikcaravāsinīm tadanujñāṃ tato labdhvā dattvā tāmbūlameva ca dharmādharmahavirdīpta ātmāgnau manasā srucā svāhānto'yaṃ mahāmantra ārambhe parikīrtitaḥ dharmādharmakalāsnehapūrṇāmagnau juhomyaham kulāmṛtaṃ prayatnena gṛhṇīyād durlabhaṃ naraḥ yatkāmaṃ kurute mantrī tatkṣaṇādeva siddhyati bījāmṛtaṃ paraṃ brahma japan nikṣipya sundari

śrīvidyākramamabhyarcya parabrahmamayo bhavet yuvatīṃ vā madonmattāṃ suveṣāṃ cāruhāsinīm sādhakaḥ śreyase tanvīṃ vame saṃsthāpayed budhaḥ prāṇāyāmaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā kārayitvā yathāvidhi athāntaryajanaṃ vakṣye dṛṣṭādṛṣṭaphalapradam snāyācca vimale tīrthe puṣkare hṛdayāśrite sā sandhyā kulaniṣṭhānāṃ samādhisthaiḥ pratīyate tenāmṛtena divyena tarpayet paradevatām kalāsāreṇa sampūrya tarpayet tena khecarīm kriyate tatparatvena hṛnmantreṇa tataḥ param kriyate tatparatvena śiromantreṇa deśikaiḥ kriyate nijadehasya śikhāmantreṇa deśikaiḥ sarvato varmamantreṇa kriyate dehasaṃvṛtiḥ tato'streṇa ca mantrajñaḥ karotyastra caturdiśaḥ hṛdayādimayaṃ tejaḥ syādetanmantrasaṃjñitam avidyāyāḥ svatantraṃ yatparaṃ dhāma samīritam jyotistattvamayaṃ dhyāyet kulākulaniyojanāt sadā samarasaṃ dhyeyaṃ dhyānaṃ tatkulayoginām nyāsastanmayatābuddhiḥ so'haṃbhāvena cintayet amohakamakarmatvamadveṣākṣobhakau tataḥ ahiṃsā paramaṃ puṣpaṃ puṣpamindriyanigrahaḥ ityaṣṭasaptabhiḥ puṣpaiḥ pūjayet paradevatām grathitā kuṇḍalīśaktiḥ kalānte merusaṃsthitiḥ paramātmasvarūpaṃ ca tathā jñānātmarūpakam nābhauvibhāvya tanmadhye juhuyāt sādhakottamaḥ

jñānapradīpite nityamakṣavṛttirjuhomyahaṃ svāhā suṣumnāvartmanā nityamakṣavṛtīrjuhomyahaṃ svāhā dharmādharmakalāsnehapūrṇāmagnau juhomyahaṃ svāhā vasudhādiśivāvasānam na tasya puṇyapāpāni jīvanmukto bhaved dhruvam atastvāṃ ghātayiṣyāmi tasmādyajñe vadho'vadhaḥ ābudhyasva paśotvaṃ hi nāśivastvaṃ śivo'si hi caṇḍikāprītidānena dāturāpadvināśaya gaurīrūpaṃ samāsādya mama kalyāṇado bhava paśave ca namastubhyaṃ namaste balirūpiṇe chedabhedodbhavaṃ duḥkhaṃ kṣamasva paśurūpadhṛt paripūrṇaphalaṃ naiva saphalaṃ pūjanādbhavet kumārī bhojitā yena trailokyaṃ tena bhojitam annaṃ tu mīnanayane kulācalasamaṃ bhavet vivāharahitāḥ syuśceduttarottarasiddhidāḥ suvāsinyo mahāprauḍhāḥ saṃśayaṃ tyaja suvrate kṛte yasmin mahālakṣmīracireṇa prasīdati pūjādine samāhūya kumārīmādyadevatām arcayed hemapātreṇa vāripuṣpākṣataiḥ samam upaveśya kumārīṃ tāṃ svāṅge nyāsaṃ samācaret atha dhyāyet kumārīṃ tāṃ malālakṣmīsvarūpiṇīm sakaṅkaṇāṃgulīyāni karṇālaṅkaraṇe śubhe pūjayet puṣpamālābhirdivyairdhūpaiḥ sudhūpayet bhojayedbhaktibhāvena pāyasaṃ śarkarāghṛtam phalekṣu svādu cānyacca dadyāt tasyai punaḥ punaḥ

dadyādācamanaṃ tasyai tāmbūlaṃ ca samarpayet pradakṣiṇanamaskārān kṛtvā mūrdhni kṛtāñjaliḥ anena vidhinā bhaktyā kumārīpūjayāpnuyāt kumārīpūjanaṃ kṛtvā taṃ taṃ prāpnotyasaṃśayam tatpūjanena rājendra trailokyaṃ syād supūjitam tasmāt pūjaya bhūpāla kumārīryatamānasaḥ ekavaṃśasamudbhūtāṃ kanyāṃ samyak prapūjayet granthisphuṭitaśīrṇāṅgīṃ raktapūyavraṇāṅkitām saṃtyajedrogiṇīṃ kanyāṃdāsīgarbhasamudbhavām lābhārthe vaiśyasaṃbhūtāṃ sutārthe śūdravaṃśajām prītā devyaḥ sadā naḥ śubhabalividhinā pāntu vīrendravandyāḥ mahāsetuṃ viśuddhaṃ tu sahasrāre tu coddharet svādhiṣṭhāne kāmarājaṃ rākiṇīṃ mūrdhniṃ saṃsthitām viśuddhāntaṃ smared devi visatantutanīyasīm icchākriyāsvamaniśaṃ sveṣṭadevīṃ svarūpiṇī kīdṛśo vā mahāseturnirvāṇaṃ nātha kīdṛśam vinā yena maheśāni niṣphalaṃ parameśvari pañcākṣarī kālikāyāḥ kullikā parikathyate chinnāyāstu maheśāni kullikāṣṭākṣarī bhavet saṃpatpradāyāḥ prathamaṃ bhairavyāḥ kullikā matā vāgbhavaṃ prathamaṃ bījaṃ kāmarājaṃ tataḥ param bhagavatīpadaṃ dadyādante ṭhadvayamuddharet lajjāstramantake dadyāttārā nīlasarasvatī tāraṃ kūrcaṃ samuddhṛtya paścādaṃkuśamuddharet ajñātvā kullikāmenāṃ japate yo'dhamaḥ priye

vṛthā ca tajjapaṃ sarvaṃ niṣphalaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ athātaḥ sampravakṣyāmi tacchṛṇuṣva priyaṃvade viprāṇāṃ praṇavaḥ setuḥ kṣattriyāṇāṃ tathaiva ca japtvā tvidaṃ tu deveśi sundaryā bhuvaneśvarī anyeṣāṃ tu vadhūbījaṃ mahāseturvarānane dhane dhaneśatulyo'sau vāci vāgī'svaropamaḥ jayakāraṃ bhavettasya sarvakāle na saṃśayaḥ praṇavaṃ pūrvamuddhṛtya mātṛkādyaṃ samuccaret evaṃ nirvāṇamīśāni yo na jānāti pāmaraḥ tasmāt sarvaprayatnena yadyaduktaṃ maheśvari ṛṣiśchando devatā ca tadbījaṃ śaktikīlake evaṃ yadi japenmantrī mantrarājamanuttamam sākṣāt sa eva jagatāmadhiśo nātra saṃśayaḥ sa eva nṛtyate bhūmau vicarecca yathāsukham vacanaṃ padmapadmāntare ca yādyān sabindūn saptārṇānuddhṛtya viyadoyutam amuṣya śabdamuddhṛtya prāṇā iha itīrayet amuṣya jīva iha ca sthita ityuddharet tataḥ sarvendriyāṇi ca tataḥ punaḥ pañcadaśārṇakān prāṇā ihāgatya sukhaṃ ciraṃ tiṣṭhantu ca dviṭhaḥ caturdaśottarairvarṇaimantraḥ sarvārtha siddhidaḥ chandāsi ṛgyajuḥ sāmānyāhurāgamapāragāḥ pāśo bījaṃ śaktireva śaktiḥ kīlakamaṃkuśam śrīkaṇṭhaṃ bindusaṃyuktaṃ kavarga bindusaṃyutam sabindvananto hṛnmantraḥ sūkṣmaṃ binduyutaṃ vadet

rasagandhātmane tvante trimūrtīśaṃ sabīndukam ṭavarga ca tathoddhṛtya śrotratvakcakṣurityatha jhiṇṭīśa bindusaṃyuktaṃ tavargaṃ tādṛśa vadet varmāṇubinduyuk sadyaḥ pavargo bindusaṃyutaḥ anugraho binduyukto netramantra udāhṛtaḥ uktvā manobuddhyahaṅkārāntacitātmane padam evaṃ ṣaḍaṅgamanavastārabījatrayādikāḥ nāmitaḥ pādayugmāntaṃ kaṇṭhadānābhimastakāt tato hṛtpadmamadhye tu dhyātvā vasudalāmbujam nair-ṛtyottarayāmyeṣu karṇikāyāṃ daleṣu ca ekaikaśo lavarjyāni tato devīṃ hṛdi smaret devīm juhuyād taddaśāṃśaṃ ca carubhirdhṛtasaṃyutaiḥ arcayet ṣaṭsu koṇeṣu brahmāṇaṃ viṣṇumīśvaram daleṣu mātaraḥ pūjyāstadbāhye lokanāyakāḥ iti saṃsādhito mantraḥ ṣaṭkarmaphalado bhavet sājyena caruṇā paścāt tarpaṇādi samācaret mṛtā vaivasvatā bhūyo jīvahā prāṇahā punaḥ kṣetrapratiharītyetāḥ prāṇadūtyo nava smṛtāḥ aṃkuśena hṛtasyāpi sādhyasyāsūn samāharet tasyāḥ prāṇātmakaṃ yantraṃ sakīṭaṃ hṛdaye nyaset daleṣu vāyuvahnīndravaruṇānāmataḥ param yādīn haṃsasamāyuktān bhṛṅgākārānanusmaret evamātmahṛdambhoje bhṛṅgīrūpān dhiyā smaret ekaikāṃ sādhyahṛtpadmād bhṛṅgānekaikamānayed

tantucchedaṃ prakurvīta vahnibījena sarvataḥ evamekādaśāvṛtti kuryāt sarveṣu karmasu mohavidveṣayordhūmrān kṛṣṇān māraṇakarmaṇi ākṛṣṭān sādhyahṛtprāṇān sthāpayedātmano hṛdi prāṇān sādhyasya maṇḍūkānātmanastu bhujaṅgamān varṇavṛtaṃ dharāstham vaśayet sakalān devān kiṃ punaḥ pārthivāñjanān puṣpai raktotpalairvāpi mūlena ca navāhutīḥ yādihaṃsāntavarṇotthāḥ prāṇadūtyo nava smṛtāḥ ākarṣiṇī ca grasanā bhramadā visphuliṅginī tattadvarṇādinā nāmnā tāsāṃ caiva hunet kramāt gatvā sādhyaṃ dṛḍhaṃ baddhvā pāśabījena sundari prāṇāmākṛṣya sādhyasya cānayantīṃ sadā smaret daleṣu vāyuvahnīndravaruṇānāṃ sureśvari yādīn haṃsasamāyuktān bhṛṅgākārānanusmaret evamātmahṛdambhoje bhṛṅgīrūpān dhiyā smaret ekaikān sādhyahṛtpadmād bhṛṅgānekaikamānayet tantucchedaṃ prakūrvīta vahnibījena pārvati evamekādaśāvṛtti kuryāt sarveṣu karmasu mohavidveṣayordhūmrān kṛṣṇān māraṇakarmaṇi ākṛṣṭān sādhyahṛtprāṇān sthāpayedātmano hṛdi prāṇān sādhyasya maṇḍūkānātmanastu bhujaṅgamān itthaṃ prayogakuśalo manunānena sundari vāyvagniśakravaruṇaśivarākṣasasomagān daleṣu bindusaṃyuktān kṣakāraṃ karṇikāntare

sādhyanāmasamopetaṃ vilikhedgirisaṃbhave krūrakarmasu samproktadravyairaṣṭaviṣādibhiḥ dvādaśāṃgulamānena spaṣṭāṅgīmatimañjulām likhitaṃ śavavastre ca sakīṭaṃ varavarṇini chitvā tāñjuhuyādrātrau sādhyaṃ smṛtvā citānale gṛhadhūmastrikaṭukaṃ viṣāṣṭakamudāhṛtam śaive ca gāṇapatye ca ṣaṇṇavatyaḥ kalāḥ smṛtāḥ śākte tu saptatiḥ proktāḥ śaivyaśceti ca kecana dūtyo nava daśa prāṇā yādayo nava varṇakāḥ īśvaraḥ śuddhavidyā ca māyā vidyā kalā tathā ahaṅkāraśca buddhiśca manaḥśrotratvacastataḥ upastha śabdausparśaśca raso gandho viyanmarut kāntirmanoramā caiva tataścaiva manoharā śaṃkhinī śoṣiṇī caiva vaśaṃkarī ca śiñjinī pūṣā ceddhā sumanasā ratiḥ prītirdhṛtistathā śaśinī cāṅgirācchāyā tataḥ sampūrṇamaṇḍalā amṛtādyā daśa prāṇā yādayo nava varṇakāḥ atha vakṣye vaiṣṇavākhyāḥ kalāḥ śṛṇu varānane hṛtpadmaṃ sūryasomāgnivāsudevāhvayāstataḥ śraddhādayo'tra vijñeyāḥ saurāḥ śṛṇu vadāmi te sparśo rūpaṃ raso gandhaḥ śrotraṃ tvak cakṣureva ca upasthaśca mano garvo buddhirdhīḥ prakṛtistataḥ ātmavidyāśivāścaite pratilomakramāt punaḥ śraddhādayastataḥ proktāḥ kalāḥ sarvāḥ samīritāḥ kuryādāvāhanaṃ mantrī pratimādau śubhe tathā

kalānāṃ hāsavṛddhyendoḥ kṛṣṇaśuklaprabhedataḥ gurutaḥ śāstrataḥ samyagjñātvā kūrvīta deśikaḥ divyairmanobhavairdravyairgandhapuṣpaiḥ sragādibhiḥ grāmyāraṇyādisaṃbhūtairyāgadravyairmanoramaiḥ jātamātrāṇi puṣpāṇi ghrātānyeva nisargataḥ prāṇibhiśca dvirephādyaiścoṣyante ca na saṃśayaḥ śivārthaṃ puṣpahiṃsāyāṃ na bhavet sa tu hiṃsakaḥ sarvaduḥkhapiśācebhyo mukto bhavati nānyathā pūjopakaraṇaiḥ kuryurdadyurdhānāni cārhaṇam saṃskārānna nivartante vidyātikramadoṣataḥ sadādhikāraḥ sarveṣāṃ mahāpātakināmapi prāpnoti candravadane dānahomādibhirvinā pūjayedvidhinānena kaḥ kuryādetadanvaham nāraṇyavāsināṃ śaktirna te santi kalau yuge tasmādaparihāryatvādanyathā cānupāyataḥ tāścābhigamanā copādānejyādhyāyayogakāḥ sammārjanopalepādisaṃskāro devamandire tataścāpi bhavedanyā gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ punaḥ mantrārthabhāvanāpūrvaṃ japo mantrasya kīrtanam gurudevātmanāmaikyabhāvanā yoga ucyate sāyujyamapi pañcānāṃ phalānyevaṃ viduḥ kramāt utthāya dakṣiṇāṅgena vāmapādaṃ nyasedbhuvi sañcintayanti dharmārthoṃ yāma utthāya paścime rātrivāsaḥ parityajya vāsasī paridhāya ca mārjayitvopalipyātha bhaktiyuktastu śaktibhiḥ

prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā kṛtvā nyāsaṃ vidhānataḥ arghyapādye nivedyātha dadyādvai dantadhāvanam karāsyaproñchanāyātha dadyādvāso'malaṃ śubham karpūrābhaṃ smaret tatra śrīguruṃ devarūpiṇam vāme niṣaṇātiraktakāntiṃ vāmena līlākamalaṃ kareṇa nāmabhistasya saṃketasaṃsiddhairgurukīrtanaiḥ stuvīta stutibhiḥ prīta ācārya sarvasiddhaye dṛṣṭaṃ tattena bhāvena dhyāyannāhnikamācaret japaṃ homaṃ tathā dhyānaṃ nityaṃ kurvīta sādhakaḥ gurudevatayoraikyaṃ bhāvayecca nirākulaḥ iṣṭadevasya bhūmeśca tasyāṃ śvāsānusārataḥ tata udvāsayed devān mantreṇānena deśikaḥ uttiṣṭhantvṛṣayodevā gandharvā yakṣarākṣasāḥ kṛtvā malacyutiṃ tatra vāsasā kaṃ praveṣṭya ca śaucaṃ kṛtvā yathāśāstraṃ vidhinācamanaṃ tataḥ pañcāpāne mṛttikāḥ syurekaikāntaramṛttikāḥ pādayostisṛbhiḥ śuddhirjaṅghāśuddhistu pañcabhiḥ svadehe svedadoṣaghna brāhmaṇaḥ karmasiddhaye prāvṛṇmuktāvathaitasmādekamṛdapanodanam etasmādapi caikaikāṃ mṛttikāṃ parilopayet pathi śaucaṃ vidhātavyaṃ deśakālānurodhataḥ tadardhamāture proktamāturasyārdhamadhvani priyāyeti hṛdanto'yaṃ sa manurdantaśuddhaye mohane khādiraṃ proktaṃ stambhane cūtapallavam ayaṃ kramo mahādevi trilokeṣu na vidyate

yena bhakto'bhiṣiktastu yāgahomārhatāṃ vrajet gṛhītvāstreṇa saṃcintya yāyājjalaniketanam mṛdaṃ kṛtvā dvidhā tatra ekabhāgopagaṃ tataḥ laukikaṃ gauṇaṃ madhyena bhāgenaikena yatnataḥ vinyasyāṅge ṣaḍaṅgāni prāṇāyāmapuraḥsaram ātmarakṣāṃ tataḥ kuryādvārikṣepeṇa cāstrataḥ unmajjya kumbhamudrāṃ ca baddhvā siñcet svamūrdhani sa tīrtha phalamāpnoti tīrthe daśaguṇaṃ phalam mṛdamastreṇa cādāya tena tāmabhimantrya ca mūrdhādipādaparyantaṃ vilipya ca tayā vapuḥ nimajjya tūṣṇīmutthāya nābhimātrajale sthitaḥ vinyasya ca ṣaḍaṅgāni kalpayettīrthamagrataḥ sṛṇīmantreṇa mantrajño bhittvā cāṃkuśamudrayā mūlamantreṇa saṃyojya kalpite tīrthamaṇḍale dhyātvā tanmanunābhyarcya gaṅgāmantreṇa mantrayet jalasthaṃ vyoma ṣaṭdīrghasvarabhinnaṃ sabindukam ambālike mahāmālinyehyehi bhagavantyatha śivajaṭādhirūḍhe ca gaṅge gaṅgāmbike dviṭhaḥ kavacenāvaguṇṭhyātha saṃrakṣyāstreṇa mantrayet samāvāhya jale dhyātvā tatpadadvayanirgatam tridhā devīṃ samuttīrya jalād dhaute suvāsasī toyābhāve tu yatkāryaṃ dūrge kāle tu śītale prāptāpadyatha viprendra niśābhāge tathā mune sthānaṃ daśa diśaḥ prāgvat saṃśodhyopaviśettataḥ mūlamantrāditaḥ kuryāt sarvamantragaṇena vai

prabhāsādiṣu tīrtheṣu yatphalaṃ snātakasya tu dhyānasnānamatho vakṣye dvābhyāmapi paraṃ ca yat tatpādodakajāṃ dhārāṃ nipatantīṃ svamūrdhani tayā saṃkṣālayet sarvamantardehagataṃ malam idaṃ snānaṃ varaṃ mantrāt snānaṃ śataguṇaṃ smṛtam snānapūrvāḥ kriyāḥ sarvā yataḥ sabhyāstu nārada kūrvīta mānasaṃ snānaṃ sarvatra vihitaṃ ca yat tadabhāvādadhaḥ śāṭīyogapaṭṭakasaṃyutam paridhāyottarīyaṃ ca na kuryāt keśadhūnanam ūrdhvaṃ tyajet snānavastraṃ gṛhasnāto yadā bhavet niṣpīḍya snānavastraṃ tu prātaḥsandhyāṃ samācaret vaiśyapuṇḍramardhacandraṃ śūdrāṇāṃ vartulākṛti dhārayet sarvadā śūlaṃ lalāṭe gandhavāribhiḥ dhṛtaṃ tacchūladharaṇād bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ bhakṣaṇāt sarvapāpānāṃ bhasmeti parikīrtitam tatsarvaṃ bhavati bhasma yathāgnitejasā vanam vaivāhāgnyudbhavaṃ vāpi pakvaṃ śuci sugandhi ca na līnaṃ nātikaṭhinaṃ na durgandhi nacoṣitam khaṇḍīkṛtya śivāgnau tu nikṣipenmūlamantrataḥ ādāya vāsasāloḍya bhasmādhāre vinikṣipet udvāsane kṛte yasmāccaṇḍabhasma prajāyate vāmena pātre saṃśoṣya aghoreṇa vinirdahet itthaṃ tu saṃskṛtaṃ bhasma agnirityādimantrataḥ praṇavādyaiścaturthīhṛdantairnāmabhirīśakaiḥ tripuṇḍradhāraṇaṃ kuryānmūrdhni pañcākṣareṇa ca

parigṛhyāgnirityādimantrairbhasmābhimantrayet tisro rekhā bhavantyeṣu sthāneṣu munipuṅgava madhyamānāmikāṃgulyo madhye tu pratilomataḥ tisṛṇāmapi rekhāṇāṃ pratyekaṃ nava devatāḥ ṛgvedaśca kriyāśktiḥ prātaḥ savanameva ca ukāro dakṣiṇāgniśca nabhaḥ sattvaṃ yajustathā maheśvaraśca rekhāyā dvitīyāyāśca devatāḥ jñānaśaktiḥ sāmavedastṛtīyasavanaṃ tathā etā nityaṃ namaskṛtya tripuṇḍraṃ dhārayecchuciḥ muktikāmairjanaiḥ sevyaṃ punasteṣāṃ na sambhavaḥ brahmacārī gṛhastho vā vanastho yatireva ca tathānyaiḥ kṣatraviṭśūdrastrīgohatyādipātakaiḥ vimṛjyāṅgāni saṃspṛśya punarādāya mantrataḥ lalāṭe brahma vijñeyaṃ hṛdaye havyavāhanaḥ ādityo bāhumadhye ca śaśī ca maṇibandhake maṇibandhe ca vasavaḥ pṛṣṭhadeśe haraḥ smṛtaḥ mūlamantreṇa kṛtvā tu dehe kurvīt mārjanam aṅgāni vinyased dehe karanyāsapuraḥsaram abhimantrya ca mūlena saptavāraṃ ca sādhakaḥ pratyarṇaṃ prokṣayenmūrdhni kuśairmūlena ca tridhā ādāya toyamāmantrya bījairbhūtātmakaistathā saptakṛtvastato mūlamanreṇa triḥ punaśca tat samprokṣya mūlamantreṇa dakṣahastena mūrdhani praviśyāntargataṃ sarvaṃ malaṃ saṃśodhya nirgatam vāmabhāge vajraśilāṃ dhyātvāstreṇa ca tat kṣipet

gāyatryā cātha mūlena dadyādarghyatrayaṃ sudhīḥ tridhā japtvā ca gāyatrīmaṣṭāviṃśativārakam samarpya tajjapaṃ mantrī devamudvāsya maṇḍalāt dīkṣitaḥ sandhyā hīno na dīkṣāphalamaśnute vidhāyottarasandhyāyāḥ kriyāṃ kuryādatandritaḥ aṣṭottaraśatāvṛttyā tarpayenmūlamantrataḥ tatastadaṅgāvaraṇadevatāstarpayet kramāt punaḥ sampūjya deveśaṃ sāṅgāvaraṇakaṃ tataḥ ekāntaṃ nirjanaṃ yāyānmanojñaṃ doṣavarjitam digantaraṃ na vīkṣeta (maunī) saṃruddhalocanaḥ prāpya hastau ca pādau ca prakṣālyācamya yatnataḥ pūjāvedyā bahiḥ sthitvā cuturhastāntare dhiyā praṇamediṣṭadevaṃ svaṃ dikpālānapi cetasā prāyaścitternāpanudet tadā pāpaṃ smared dhiyā yat syād dṛḍhataraṃ pāpaṃ tad dūre cāvatiṣṭhate yat syādalpataraṃ pāpaṃ tannāśamupagacchati dadyādarghyaṃ dineśāya tatprakāramihocyate sindūreṇa tataḥ paścādupaviśya nijāsane prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā sūryamantreṇa mantravit tatkalpoktavidhānena pūjayedupacārakaiḥ nidhāya tatra sādhāraṃ sajalaṃ tāmrapātrakam satilān raktapuṣpāṇi dūrvāścāpi pravinyaset abhimantrya ca tatpātraṃ samutthāpya karadvayāt japet tato yathāśakti sūryamantramananyadhīḥ smṛtvā praṇamya visṛjenmaṇḍalānte divākaram

tāvanna pūjayedviṣṇuṃ śaṅkaraṃ vā sureśvarīm dhanadhānyapaśukṣetraputramitrakalatradam tata utthāya vidhivad dvārapūjāṃ samācaret taddakṣiṇe mahālakṣmīṃ vāme caiva sarasvatīm gaṇapaṃ kṣetrapālaṃ ca śaṅkhapadmanidhī kramāt dhātāraṃ ca vidhātāramūrdhvādikramato yajet paścimadvāramārabhya dvārapālā amī kramāt tato bhṛṅgiriṭiskandāvumācaṇḍeśvarau tataḥ nandaḥ sunandacaṇḍo ca pracaṇḍabalasaṃjñakau kramādamī samabhyarcyā vaiṣṇavadvārapālakāḥ lambodaraśca vikaṭo vighnarājastataḥ param brāhmī māheśvarī caiva kaumārī vaiṣṇavī tathā etā devyāḥ kramādaṣṭau śaktayo dvārapālikāḥ dvāramudghāṭya cāstreṇa mantritān sarṣapākṣatān nārācamudrayā samyagastramantreṇa deśikaḥ astramantaṃ samuccārya maṇḍapāntarvinikṣipet paṭhitvākṣatasidhārthapuṣpāṇi vikiret tataḥ uktvāntare sarṣapamakṣatāṃśca puṣpāṇi muñcediti praviśya vighnān trividhān pātālabhvantarikṣagān vighnānutsārayed divyānastratīkṣṇāvalokanāt pañcagavyārghyatoyābhyāṃ prokṣayenmaṇḍapāntaram vitānadhūpadīpādi puṣpadāmādiśobhitam nair-ṛtyāmarcayedvāstupuruṣaṃ candanādibhiḥ saṃskuryādāsanasthānaṃ caturbhirvīkṣaṇādibhiḥ ādhāraśaktimārabhya svāsanaṃ tatra vinyaset

tatropaviśya vidhivat smared viṣṇuguru mudā pṛthivī devatā proktā viniyogo nijāsane dūrgāṃ kṣetrapatiṃ cāpi vahnyādiṣu samarcayet svastikāsanamāsīnaḥ padmāsanamathāpi vā sthāpayed dakṣiṇe bhāge pūjā dravyāṇi cātmanaḥ prakṣālanāya karayoḥ pātraṃ pṛṣṭhe nidhāpayet darpaṇaṃ cāmaraṃ chatraṃ tālavṛntaṃ ca pāduke nārācamudrayā dṛṣṭyā samayā ca vilokayet aspṛśyasparśanaṃ vāpi yadanyāyārjitaṃ ca vā tatsarvaṃ nāśamāyāti naivedyādyavalokanāt sa tu syācchūbhado vāpi niṣkravyādaḥ sukhapradaḥ vasāmajjādisambhūtairyajñādāvupayojane nārasiṃhena mantreṇa devatīrthena saṃspṛśet vāmena pāṇinā dhṛtvā vāmapārśvasthitaṃ tadā yadajñānādapeyādisaṃsṛṣṭiriha saṅgatā jalāśayaśavasparśāñjanasnānācca saṅgatam natvā guruṃ gaṇeśānaṃ purataḥ sveṣṭadevatām mardayitvā karau samyak surabhīkṛtya sādhakaḥ vakṣyamāṇena mantreṇa caiśānyāṃ duratastyajet vimardanārthaṃ gṛhṇīyāt karaśodhanakarmaṇi prasādena parityāgo diśyaiśānyāṃ viśeṣataḥ aṃgulyāgrāṇi śuddhāni puṣpāṇāṃ grahaṇādbhavet nirmanthanāt pāṇipṛṣṭhaṃ ghrāṇānnāsāgramuttamam upāntyaḥ sāgnicandreṇa rañjitaḥ śūnyasaṃyutaḥ prāntādirvāsudevāntavarṇenāpi ca saṃhataḥ

(agniḥ sadyo binduyutā romabījamudāhṛtam) ūrdhvordhva mūlamantreṇa digbandhamapi deśikaḥ bhūtaśuddhiṃ tataḥ kṛtvā nyāsaṃ kuryādanantaram pādato jānuparyantaṃ caturasraṃ savajrakam jānvorānābhi candrārdhanibhaṃ padmena lāñchitam nābhitaḥ kaṇṭhaparyantaṃ trikoṇaṃ raktavarṇakam kaṇṭhād bhrūmadhyaparyantaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vāyostu maṇḍalam bhrūmadhyād brahmarandhrāntaṃ vartulaṃ dhvajalāñchitam iti dhyātvā tu bhūtāni svakīye deśikottamaḥ aiśvaryāṣṭadalaṃ caiva paraṃ vairāgyakarṇikam kṛtvā tatkarṇikāsaṃsthaṃ pradīpakalikānibham yogayuktena vidhinā so'haṃmantreṇa sādhakaḥ vidhāya prāṇasaṃrodhaṃ vāyubījena vāyunā bhasma tadvātamārgeṇa nirgataṃ cintayet sudhīḥ sañjāte sakale dehe devatopāsanakṣame ātmānaṃ hṛdayāmbhojamānayet paramātmanaḥ devatārādhane yogyamutpannamiti bhāvayet dhyātvaivaṃ brahmarandhrācca hṛdi jīvakalāṃ nyaset yāvanna kurute devi tāvad devārcanaṃ nahi ṣaḍaṅgādyakhilanyāsairdehaśuddhiritīritā paṃktiśchandastu vijñeyaṃ mukhe vinyasya pārvati dhiyāvagantavyatayā sadaiva hṛdi pratiṣṭhā manudevatāyāḥ ṣivarṇādistu vijñānamatastadvyāpakaṃ ca saḥ chādīti dhāturicchāyāṃ dādirdānārthako bhavet vrīḍārthakāddadātīti sampannaṃ devatāpadam

hṛdayaṃ ca śiro devi śikhā ca kavacaṃ tataḥ vaṣaṭ huṃvauṣaḍantaṃ tu phaḍebhiḥ saha vinyaset natyā hutyā ca vaṣaṭ huṃ vauṣaṭ phaḍebhiraṅgakavidhiḥ śikhāyai vaṣaḍityuktaṃ kavacāya humīritam jātiṣaṭkamidaṃ proktaṃ hṛdādyastrāntasaṅgatam khaḍgāya hṛdayāyeti namoyuktaṃ kanīyasī sukhaḍgāya tato vācyaṃ śirase tadanantaram huṃkāraṃ praṇavād devi bindulāñchitamastakam vaṣaḍantaṃ pravinyasyet madhyamāmadhyamāṃgulau kavacāya humityetat tarjanyāmapyanāmayā astrarakṣayamāye cāpyastrāya tadanantaram tantre aṣṭādaśaḥ śvāsaḥ
